translations.source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.reference: “Yanzu muna bera mai watanni 4 wadanda ba su da ciwon sukari ba wadanda ke da suke fama da ciwon sukari,” in ji shi.
translations.hypothesis: "Yanzu da mu akwai 'yan awon da suka kai watanni 4, kuma ba su da ciwon sukari, amma sun kasance da ciwon sukari a baya," ya ƙara.

translations.source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.reference: Dokta Ehud Ur, farfesan magani a Jami’ar Dalhousie da ke Halifax, Nova Scotia kuma shugaban sashen likitanci da bangaren kimiyya na kungiyar masu ciwon sikari ta Kanada ya yi gargadin cewa har yanzu binciken yana kan farkonsa.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, wanda shi ne farfesa a fannin likita a Jami'ar Dalhousie da ke Halifax, Nova Scotia, kuma shugaban sashen ilimi da kimiyya na Kungiyar Diabetes ta Kanada, ya bayyana cewa binciken na har yanzu yana cikin matsayin farko.

translations.source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.reference: Kamar wasu ƙwararrun, yana da shakkun cewa ko za a iya warkar da ciwon sukari, inda ya bayyana cewa sakamakon bincike ba shi da alaƙa da mutanen da tuni su ke da nau’in ciwon sukari na 1.
translations.hypothesis: Kamar wasu masana, yana da shakku game da ko cutar sukari za ta iya janyewa, kuma ya bayyana cewa wannan bincike bai da wani tasiri ga mutanen da suka riga sun kamu da cutar sukari ta hanyar farko (Type 1 diabetes).

translations.source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.reference: A ranar Litinin, Sara Danius, sakatariyar dindindin ta Kwamitin Adabi na kungiyar nagartattu a Kwalejin Nazarin Sweden, ta sanar a bainar jama'a yayin wani shirin rediyo a Sveriges Radio a Sweden kwamitin, ba zai iya kaiwa ga Bob Dylan kai tsaye ba game da lashe kyautar Nobel ta 2016 a Adabi, ta yi watsi da ita kokarinta na isa gare shi.
translations.hypothesis: A ranar Litinin, Sara Danius, sakataren dindin na kwamitin Nobel na littattafi a kungiyar Swedish Academy, ta bayyana a gidan talabijin na Sveriges Radio a Sweden cewa, kwamitin, wanda bai samu damar tuntuɓar Bob Dylan kai tsaye game da samun lambar yabo ta Nobel ta littattafi a shekarar 2016, ya yanke shawarar daina ƙoƙarin tuntuɓarsa.

translations.source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.reference: Danius ya ce, “Yanzu haka ba mwa yin komi. Na kira na kuma aika emails zuwa abokan aikinsa na kusa na kuma anshi amsoshi masu kyau. A yanzu haka, wannan bai isa ba.”
translations.hypothesis: Danius ya ce, "A yanzu haka, ba mu da wani abu da muke yi. Na kira kuma na aika wasika ga wanda yake kusan kusa da shi, kuma na samu amsoshi masu kyau. Domin yanzu, wannan ya isa."

translations.source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.reference: A baya, Shugaban kamfanin Ring, Jamie Siminoff, ya bayyana cewa kamfanin ya fara lokacin da ba a jiyo sauti kararrawar jikin ƙofar sa daga shagonsa a cikin garejinsa.
translations.hypothesis: A baya, shugaban kamfanin Ring, Jamie Siminoff, ya ce kamfanin ya fara ne lokacin da ƙarar bel din gidan sa ba ta iya ji daga cikin ofishin sa da ke cikin garajin.

translations.source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.reference: Ya ce, ya gina ƙararrawar ƙofa ta WiFi.
translations.hypothesis: Ya ce ya gina wani ƙararrawa mai amfani da WiFi.

translations.source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.reference: Siminoff yace ciniki ya karu baya futuwar sa ta 2013 a shinrin wasan kwaikwayin Shark Tank inda masu shirin suka ki biyan kudin sabuwar sana'ar.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff ya ce, sayarwa ta ƙaru bayan bayyana shi a wani shiri na "Shark Tank" a shekarar 2013, inda jami'an shirin suka ki amince da bayar da kudi ga wannan kamfanin da ke sabon fara aiki.

translations.source: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.reference: A ƙarshen 2017, Siminoff ya bayyana a tashar telebijin mai sayarwa ta QVC.
translations.hypothesis: A karshen shekarar 2017, Siminoff ya bayyana a tashar talabijin da ake sayayya ta QVC.

translations.source: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: Ring ta kuma sasanta takardar kotu tsakanin wata kamfanin adawa na tsaro wato ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: Ring kuma ta yi yarjejeniya da kamfanin tsaro mai suna ADT Corporation, wanda ke da bambanci da ita, game da wata shari'a.

translations.source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.reference: Yayinda allurar gwaji rigakafi guda daya ta bayyana tana iya rage mutuwar cutar ta Ebola, har zuwa yanzu, babu wasu kwayoyi da aka nuna da suka dace da maganin cututtukan da suke kamuwa da su.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da wani nau'in allurar gwaji na iya rage yawan mutuwar cutar Ebola, har zuwa yanzu, babu magani da aka tabbatar da cewa ya fi dacewa don jinya da cutar da ta yi wa mutum.

translations.source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.reference: Wani hadaddiyar giyar, ZMapp, da farko ya nuna alƙawari a fagen, amma nazarin yau da kullun ya nuna cewa ba shi da fa'ida fiye da yadda ake neman hana mutuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Wani abu mai suna ZMapp, wanda ya ƙunshi juzu'i daban-daban na antibodies, a farko ya nuna alama mai kyau a fagen ilimi, amma bincike na yawa ya nuna cewa bai yi tasiri sosai yadda ake fatan wajen hana mutuwa.

translations.source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.reference: a nan gwajin PALM, ZMapp yayi bauta a wajen kula, hakan na nufin masana fasaha sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin kasan idan ka kimanta da hanyoyin guda uku nashi.
translations.hypothesis: A wajen gwajin PALM, ZMapp ya yi a matsayin abin da ake amfani da shi don aɗa idanu, watau, masana kimiyya sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin tushe kuma sun aɗa sauran hanyoyin magani uku da shi.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.reference: Masu wasan tsalle tsalle na Amurka sun goyi bayan wasikar kwamitin gasar olympic tare da yarda da cikakkiyar bukatar duk masu wasan olympic da su yada maganar samar da yanayi mara hadari ga dukkan yan wasanmu.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar Gymnastics ta Amurka ta amince da wata takarda da kungiyar Olympic ta Amurka ta fitar, kuma ta yarda da muhimmancin da kungiyar Olympic ta duniya ta saka wajen samar da wani wuri mai tsaro ga duk wasan kwaikwayo.

translations.source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.reference: Mun yarda da bayanin USOC cewa bukatun ƴan wasanmu da kungiyar mu, da wasanninsu, na iya zama mafi alheri ta ci gaba tare da canji mai ma'ana a cikin ƙungiyarmu, maimakon ƙaddamar da doka.
translations.hypothesis: Mun yarda da bayanin kungiyar wasanni ta Amurka (USOC) wanda ya ce, yadda za a inganta ayyukan 'yan wasanmu da kungiyoyinmu, da kuma wasan da suke, zai iya zama ta hanyar canja tsarin kungiyarmu, maimakon cire mata takardar izinin aiki.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.reference: Kungiyan daki motsa jiki na USA na goyon bayan bincike mai zaman kanta wadda take zaton zata kara haske kan cin zarafi wadda wadanda suka tsira daga Larry Nassar suka bayana wadda ba a gano ba na tsawon lokaci kuma ke rungume da duk wani canji mai muhimmanci.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar wasanni ta Amurka tana goyon bayan bincike mai zaman kansa wanda zai iya bayyana yadda cin zarafin da aka bayyana a matsayin yawan abin da wadanda suka yi fama da shi suka bayyana game da Larry Nassar, ya iya kasancewa ba a gano ba na tsawon lokaci, kuma tana karɓar duk wani canji da ya zama dole da kuma dacewa.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.reference: Gidan motsa jiki na Amurka da USOC suna da manufa ɗaya - sa wasan motsa jiki, da sauransu, ya zama mai aminci yadda zai yiwu ƴan wasa su bi mafarkinsu cikin aminci, tabbatacce kuma mai ba da ƙarfi.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar wasanni ta USA da kuma Kungiyar Wasanni ta Amurka suna da burin daya – na samar da yan wasa da suka yi wasan wasanni, da sauran wasanni, cikin tsaro, domin su iya biyan burinsu a wani wuri mai kyau, mai amanci, da kuma wanda ya ba su damar ci gaba.

translations.source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.reference: A duk tsawon 1960, Brzezinski yayi ma John F. Kenedy aiki a matsayin mai bada shawara kuma yayi aiki da gwamnatin Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarun 1960, Brzezinski ya yi aiki a matsayin mai ba shawarwa ga John F. Kennedy, sannan ya yi aiki a gwamnatin Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: A yayin zabukan 1976 ya shawarci Carter kan manufofin kasashen waje, sannan ya zama mai ba da shawara kan Tsaro na kasa (NSA) daga 1977 zuwa 1981, ya gaji Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: A lokacin zaben shekarar 1976, ya ba Carter shawara kan harkokin waje, sannan ya yi aiki a matsayin Shugaban Tattalin Arzikin Kasa (NSA) daga shekarar 1977 zuwa 1981, inda ya maye gurbin Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: kasancewarsa dan NSA, ya taimaka wa Carter a harkokin dokokin kasashen waje wajen kula da lamuran duniya, kamar Yarjejeniyar Camp David, 1978; daidaita alaƙar Amurka da China tana tunanin ƙarshen shekarun 1970; juyin juya halin Iran, wanda ya haifar da rikicin garkuwar da Iran, 1979; da mamayar Soviet a Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: A matsayin Shugaban Tsaron Kasa, ya taimaka wa Carter wajen kula da al'amuran duniya ta hanyar diplomatic, kamar su yarjejenin Camp David na shekarar 1978; da inganta dangantaka tsakanin Amurka da China a karshen shekarun 1970; da juyin mulkin Iran, wanda ya haifar da rikicin fansar da aka yi wa Amurkawa a Iran a shekarar 1979; da kuma mamayewar Afghanistan da sojojin Soviet suka yi a shekarar 1979.

translations.source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.reference: Fin ɗin, da ke nuna Ryan Gosling da Emma Stone, ya sami shiga cikin duk manyan ɓangarorin gasar.
translations.hypothesis: Fim ɗin, wanda ake nuna Ryan Gosling da Emma Stone, ya samu takaitaccen shiga cikin dukkan manyan sashi.

translations.source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.reference: Gosling da Stone sun sami shiga neman cikin kyautar Fitaccen Jarumi da Jaruma.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling da Stone sun samu takardar shaidar shiga gasar kyautar mafi kyawun aktoto (m) da kuma aktoto (m) ta bangare biyu.

translations.source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.reference: Sauran zaɓin sun hada da Hoto Mafi Kyau, Darakta, Majigi, Tsara Tufafi, Gyaran fina-finai, Makin Asali, Tsara Shiri, Gyara Sauti, Haɗa Sauti da kuma Asalin Labari.
translations.hypothesis: Sauran kyautukan da ake bayarwa sun haɗa da: Kyautar Kyakkyawar Fim, Kyautar Daraktoci, Kyautar Kyamar Fim, Kyautar Tsara Kayayyaki, Kyautar Gyara Fim, Kyautar Waƙoƙin Asali, Kyautar Tsara Ƙwallafan Fim, Kyautar Gyaran Sauti, Kyautar Haɗa Sauti, da Kyautar Rubuce-rubuce na Fim.

translations.source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.reference: Waƙoƙi biyu daga fim, Audition (Wawaye Waɗanda Suke Mafarki) da Birnin Taurari, sun karɓi zaɓi don mafi kyawun waƙar asali. Lionsgate studio ta sami nadin 26 - fiye da kowane sauran ɗakunan studio.
translations.hypothesis: Waƙoƙi biyu daga fim ɗin, "Audition (The Fools Who Dream)" da "City of Stars," sun samu izinin shiga gasar kyautar waƙa mafi kyau. Kamfanin Lionsgate ya samu izinin shiga gasa a fannin shirye-shirye 26, wanda ya fi kowanne sauran kamfanoni.

translations.source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.reference: A daren ranar Lahadi shugaban kasar Amurka Donald Trump a cikin wata sanarwa da aka fitar ta sanarwar sakataren, ya sanar da dakarun kasar Amurka zasu bar kasar Syria.
translations.hypothesis: A ranar Litinin da ta wuce, shugaban Amurka, Donald Trump, a wata sanarwa da aka fitar ta wajen kakakin gwamnati, ya bayyana cewa sojojin Amurka za su bar Syria.

translations.source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.reference: An bayar da sanarwar ce bayan Trump ya yi ganawa ta wayar salula da Shugaban Turkiyya Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
translations.hypothesis: An samu wannan sanarwa ne bayan Shugaban Amurka, Donald Trump, ya yi waya da Shugaban Turkiyya, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

translations.source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.reference: Haka kuma Turkiyya za ta karbi aikin gadin mayakan ISIS da aka kama waɗanda, sanarwar ta ce, kasashen Turai suka ki mayar da su.
translations.hypothesis: Turkiyya kuma za ta dauki alhakin kula da 'yan ta'ada na ISIS da aka kama, wanda, kamar yadda jawabin ya bayyana, kasashe masu juyin Turai sun ki mayar da su.

translations.source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.reference: Wannan ya tabbatar cewa ba wai kawai wasu dabbobin dinasour suna da gashi ba, wata fadar ma da ta yadu, amma ta yi cikakken bayanin da rubabbun halittu ba za su iya ba, kamar su launi da kuma tsarin kashi uku.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ya tabbatar da cewa akalla wasu dabbobin da ake kira "dinosaurs" suna da fuka-fukai, wani ra'ayi da ya yi yawa, amma kuma yana bayar da bayani da ƙamshin ƙamshi (fossil) yawanci ba za su iya bayar da shi ba, kamar launin da kuma yadda suke ajiye juna a cikin uku.

translations.source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.reference: Masana ilimin kimiya sun ce fiffiken dabbar launi kasa ne a sama mai dauke da kodaden launi da launin toka-toka ta karkashin ta.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike sun ce launin fuka-fukan wannan dabbarsa ya kasance launin ruwan zaiton a sama, yayin da gefensa ya kasance launin haske ko launin da ake samu daga kayan abinci.

translations.source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.reference: Binciken ya kuma ba da haske game da juyin halittar fukafiki a tsuntsaye.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan binciken ya kuma bawa masana ilimi damar fahimtar yadda fari suka taso a cikin dabbobin tashi.

translations.source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.reference: Domin gashin fuka-fukin dinosaur bashi da isasshen tsari, wanda ake kira kara, amma suna da sauran sifofin gashin fuka-fukan — tsandar gashi da kananan — masu binciken sun kammala cewa wata kila karan wani cigaba ne na juyin halittan wadannan sauran sifofin.
translations.hypothesis: Saboda fariyar da ake samu a jikin dinosaurs ba ta da wani tsari mai ƙarfi, wanda ake kira "rachis," amma tana da wasu siffofin fariwa — "barbs" da "barbules" — masana sun ƙaranta cewa "rachis" na iya zama wani ci gaba na juyin halitta da ya faru ne ne bayan wannan sauran siffofin.

translations.source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Tsarin gashin fuka-fukan ya nuna cewa ba ana amfani da su ba ne domin tashi sama, sai dai domin samar da tsarin daidaiton dumin jiki da kuma motsawa. Binciken ya nuna cewa duk da cewa jelar ta wani karamin kakan kadangare ce, abin na nuna cewa gashin balagagge ne ba na dan tsako ba.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin fuka-fukan ya nuna cewa ba su yi amfani da su wajen tashi cikin iska ba, amma kawai don sarrafa jujjuyawar jiki ko nuna kyau. Masana bincike sun bayyana cewa, ko da yake wannan farji ne na dinosaur mai ƙanƙanta, samfurin ya nuna fuka-fukan da ake samu a manyan dabbobi, ba kuma fuka-fukan ƙanƙanta na jarirai.

translations.source: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Masu binciken sun nuna cewa, duk da cewa sun gamsu jelar ta kakannin kadangare ce, ta kuma nuna cewa ta balagagge ce ba jariri ba.
translations.hypothesis: Masana kimiyya sun bayyana cewa, ko da yake wannan wasƙon yana daga jikin dinosaur mai ƙanƙanta, samfurin ya nuna fuka-fukai na dabbarsa mai tsufa, ba na jariri ba.

translations.source: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.reference: Jiya da safe a ƙasar Turkiyya, wani bom na cikin mota da aka tayar a hedikwatar ‘yansanda da ke Gaziantep, ya yi sanadiyyar mutuwar jami’an ‘yan sanda biyu tare da raunata wasu mutane sama da ashirin.
translations.hypothesis: Wani bam din da aka saka a mota ya fashe a ofishin 'yan sandan birnin Gaziantep a Turkiyya jiya da safiya, wanda ya kashe wasu jaje sun yi rauni. An ce an kashe jaje biyu na 'yan sandan, kuma fiye da mutane ashirin sun samu rauni.

translations.source: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.reference: Ofishin gwamnan ya ce jamia’an yan sanda goma sha tara ne su ka sami raunuka.
translations.hypothesis: Ofishin gwamnan ya bayyana cewa daga cikin wadanda suka jikkata, goma da goma suna cikin jami'an 'yan sandan.

translations.source: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.reference: Ƴan sanda sun ce suna zargin wani da ake zargin dan ta'addar Daesh (ISIL) ne da alhakin kai harin.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar 'yan sanda ta ce suna zargin wani mutum da ake tuhma na kungiyar Daesh (ISIL) ne ya aikata hari.

translations.source: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.reference: Sun gano cewa Rana na aiki akan manufa iri daya kamar sauran taurari: An gano cewa ayukkan duk taurari a cikin tsarin suna samuwa ne ta hasken su, juyin su, banda haka babu komai.
translations.hypothesis: Sunan da suka samu shi ne cewa tauraron Rana yana aiki bisa ga ka'idoji iri ɗaya da sauran tauraron sama: An gano cewa ayyukan duk tauraron sama a cikin wannan tsarin suna da alaƙa da haska su, suke su, kuma ba wani abu mai yawa.

translations.source: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.reference: Ana amfani da haskawa da juyawa tare domin sanin lambar Rossby ta tauraro, wadda take da alaƙa da gudanar jini.
translations.hypothesis: Hasashen haske da motsin juyawa ana amfani da su tare don ƙididdige adadin Rossby na tauraron, wanda yake da alaka da zurufan plasma.

translations.source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.reference: Rashin karfin lambar Rossby daidai yake da rashin karfin tauraron tare da magnetic reversal
translations.hypothesis: Kadanin adadin Rossby, kadan ne matuƙin motsin tauraron dan kasa da damar canzawa a yanayin maganadisu.

translations.source: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.reference: A lokacin tafiyarsa, Iwasaki ya shiga cikin matsala a lokuta da yawa.
translations.hypothesis: A yayin tafiyarsa, Iwasaki ya fuskanci matsaloli sau da yawa.

translations.source: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.reference: Yan fashin teku sun yi masa fashi, mahaukacin kare ya kai masa farmaki a Tibet, ya guje wa aure a Nepal kuma an kama shi a India.
translations.hypothesis: An yi masa fashi da abun da ake yi wa mutane a baharinsa, an kai masa hari a Tibet ta kare mai ci, ya tsere daga aure a Nepal, kuma an kama shi a Indiya.

translations.source: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.reference: Kwatancin 802.11n na aiki duk akan mita 2.4Ghz da 5.0Ghz.
translations.hypothesis: Al'adar 802.11n ta yi aiki ne a cikin hanyoyin sadarwa na 2.4GHz da kuma 5.0GHz.

translations.source: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.reference: Wannan zai ba shi damar zama mai dacewa da baya 802.11a, 802.11b da 802.11g, matukar dai tashar tushe tana da rediyo biyu.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan zai ba shi damar yin aiki da ƙwaƙwalwar kwamfuta da ke amfani da takardun 802.11a, 802.11b, da 802.11g, idan kawancen sadarwa yana da guda biyu.

translations.source: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: Gudun 802.11n na da saurin da ya zarce na wanda ya gabace shi da tsaikon saurin da ya kai 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: Sa'o'in da ke aiki da 802.11n sun fi sauri sosai fiye da na na'urorin da suka gabata, kuma tana iya fitar da bayanan da yawa har zuwa 600 megabit/s.

translations.source: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.reference: Duvall, wanda ke da mata da manyan yaya guda biyu, bai burge Miller ba, wanda ke da alaƙa da labarin.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, wanda ya yi aure kuma yana da yara biyu masu girma, bai bar wani tasiri mai mahimmanci a kan Miller, wanda aka ce masa labarin.

translations.source: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.reference: Da aka nemi tsokacinsa, sai Miller ya ce, “Mike ya yi magana da yawa lokacin zaman jin ba’asin...ina kan shiri saboda haka ban saurari abin da yake cewa ba.”
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da aka tambaye shi game da lamarin, Miller ya ce, "Mike yana magana sosai a lokacin taron... Ni ina shirin, don haka ban ji abin da yake magana ba."

translations.source: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.reference: “Za mu kokarin rage fitar da gurbataccen carbon dioxide a kowane bangare na GDP ta wani muhimmin mataki a 2020 daga matakin 2005,” in ji Hu.
translations.hypothesis: "Muna da niyya na rage yawan fitar da iskar gas na carbon dioxide a kowanne yanki na samfurin cikin gida (GDP) da yawan adadi mai mahimmanci zuwa shekarar 2020, idan aka kwatanta da shekarar 2005," in ji Hu.

translations.source: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.reference: Bai sanya wani adadi don ragewar ba, inda ya ce hakan zai danganta ne da abin da tattalin arzikin China ke fitarwa.
translations.hypothesis: Bai ƙayyade adadi na yawan kuɗin da za a rage ba, ya ce za a yi raguwa ta hanyar la'akari da yawan samfurin tattalin arziki na kasar Sin.

translations.source: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.reference: Hu ya karfafa kasashe masu tasowa “da su guji tsohuwar hanyar gurbatar da farko da kuma tsabtace ta daga baya.”
translations.hypothesis: Hu ya yi wa kasashe masu tasowa nasiha da su "kawo ƙarshe da hanyar da ta saba ta wuce ta cutar da muhalli kafin su yi ƙoƙarin tsaftace shi."

translations.source: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.reference: Ya kara da cewa “ kada su yunkura, sai dai kuwa ana sa su daukar nauyi sama da na matakin cigaban su, da kuma daukan alhaki da iyawar su.”
translations.hypothesis: Ya ƙara da cewa, "duk da haka, ba a kamata a yiwa su buƙata ta janye nauyin da suka wuce matakin ci gaban su, alhakin da suke da shi, da kuma ƙarfin da suke da shi."

translations.source: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.reference: Kungiyar bincike na Iraq sun gabatar da rohotonsu da karfe 12.00 GMT a yau.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar Nazarin Iraq ta gabatar da rahoton nata a yau, a karon 12:00 na lokacin duniya.

translations.source: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.reference: An yi kashedin cewa babu tabbacin cewa duk wani mataki da za’a dauka a kasar Iraki a yanzu zai iya maganin yakin banbance banbance darika, karuwar rikici ko ma dosar rashin doka da oda.
translations.hypothesis: Ana ƙarƙashin hankali cewa babu wanda zai iya tabbatar da cewa kowane mataki da ake ɗauka a Iraƙ a yanzu zai iya dakatar da rikicin addini, karuwar ta'asar, ko kuma ya hana ƙalubalen da ke haifar da rudani.

translations.source: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.reference: Rahoton ya buɗe ne tare da roƙo don buɗe muhawara da kuma kafa yarjejeniya a Amurka game da manufofin Gabas ta Tsakiya.
translations.hypothesis: Rahoto ne da ya fara da roƙo na tattaunawa ta hanyar buɗewa da ƙirƙirar matsayayya a cikin Amurka game da manufofin da ake biyo da suka danganci Gabas ta Tsakiya.

translations.source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.reference: Rahoton ya yi matuƙar yin suka ga kusan dukkan ɓangarorin manufar Ɓangaren zartaswa na yanzu akan ƙasar Iraƙi inda ya nemi a gaggauta canja alƙibla.
translations.hypothesis: Rahoto ne da ke bayyana matsaloli da yawa game da kusan dukkanin sashi na manufofin da gwamnati ke biyo masa a yanzu game da kasar Iraq, kuma yana roƙon canje-canje na gaggawa a wannan hanya.

translations.source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.reference: Na farko daga cikin shawarwarin da ta ba su guda 78 shi ne cewa ya kamata a dauki wani sabon shiri na diflomasiyya kafin karshen wannan shekarar don kiyaye iyakokin Iraki kan tsoma bakin da ake yi da kuma sake kulla alakar diflomasiyya da makwabtanta.
translations.hypothesis: Daya daga cikin takardun shawara da suka kai 78, ita ce a fara wani sabon shiri na diplomatic kafin ƙarshen wannan shekarar, domin kare iyakokin kasar Iraq daga wani mummunan tsoma baki, da kuma sake farawa da dangantakar diplomatic da kasashen makwabta.

translations.source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Majalisar dattijai da matar shugaban kasar Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner ta sanar da fitowar takarar shugaban kasa a yammacin jiya a La Plata, gari dake kilomita 50 (Mil 31) daga Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: Sanatar da ke a ofis a yanzu, Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner, wacce ita ce matar shugaban kasa ta Argentina, ta bayyana cewa za ta takara takarar shugaban kasa ne jiya da yamma a birnin La Plata, wanda yake nisan kilomita 50 (mai mil 31) daga Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.reference: Mrs. Kirchner ta bayyana ra’niyyarta ta tsayawa takarar shugabanci a Gidan wasannin Argentina, wurin da ta yi amfani da shi domin fara kanfen ɗinta na takarar Majalisar Dattawa a shekarar 2005 a matsayinta na wakiliyar Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: Madam Kirchner ta bayyana niyyar takarar kujerar shugaban kasa a gidan wasan kwaikwayo na Argentina, wanda shi ne wurin da ta yi amfani da shi a shekarar 2005 lokacin da ta fara yakin neman kujerar majalisar dattawa a matsayin memba na kungiyar jihar Buenos Aires.

translations.source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.reference: Muhawarar ta samo asali sakamakon rudani game da kashe kudi wajen bada tallafi da sake gine-gine bayan faruwar guguwar katrina, abinda masu ra’ayin mazan jiya su ke tsokana da cewa “Cuwa-cuwar Bush ta New Orleans”
translations.hypothesis: Tattaunawar ta fara ne saboda rikici game da kashe kuɗi akan taimakon gaggawa da sake gina birane bayan barazanar ruwan sama ta Hurricane Katrina; wanda wasu masu adawa da kashe kuɗi suka yi wa suna kiranta da "Yin karin kuɗi na Bush a New Orleans."

translations.source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.reference: Korafe-korafe kan yunƙurin sake gine-ginen ya maida hankali ne a kan bayar da kwangilolin sake ginin ga waɗanda ake ganin ‘yan cikin gida ne a Washington.
translations.hypothesis: Karin bayanin kai na suka yi game da ayyukan sake gina, sun mayar da hankali kan yadda kwantiragogin sake gina suka samu wa mutanen da ake kallon su a matsayin 'yan gida na Washington.

translations.source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan huɗu suka je Rome don halartar jana’izar.
translations.hypothesis: Fiye da mutane miliyan huɗu suka zuwa Rome don halartar jana'izar.

translations.source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.reference: mutanen da suka halarta sun yi yawa yadda ba zai yiwu kowa ya iya samun shiga wajen jana’izar ba da ke dandalin Peter.
translations.hypothesis: Adadin mutanen da suka halarci bikin dauri ya kai ga cewa ba za su iya daukacin su su shiga cikin bikin da ya gudana a filin St. Peter's ba.

translations.source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.reference: An kafa manya garkuwan talabijin da dama wurare da dama a Rome domin mutane su samu daman kallon bikin.
translations.hypothesis: An saka wasu manyan alloje na talabijin a wurare daban-daban a birnin Roma domin mutane su iya kallon bikin.

translations.source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.reference: A sauran biranen kasar Italiya da kuma sauran kasashen duniya musamman a Poland, an kafa makamancin ginuwar wanda ya samu dubiyar jama’a da dama.
translations.hypothesis: A wasu biranen Italiya da sauran sassan duniya, musamman a Poland, an shirya abubuwa iri ɗaya, kuma mutane da yawa suka kalli su.

translations.source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.reference: Masana tarihi sun soki manufofin Hukumar bincike ta Amurka saboda mai da hankali wajen laifuka wadanda ke da saukin warwarewa, musamman satar motoci, domin kawai su nuna yawan nasarar da su ke samu.
translations.hypothesis: Masana tarihi sun yi suka da manufofin da FBI ta yi a baya, domin ta mayar da hankali ga lamari da sauƙi ake warware su, musamman lamarin ɓarkewar motoci, da nufin ƙara yawan nasarar aikin hukumance.

translations.source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.reference: Majalisa ta fara samar da kuɗaɗe ga tsarin batsa a kasafin kudi na 2005 kuma ta fayyace cewa dole FBI ta ware jami’ai 10 don lura da hotunan batsa na manya.
translations.hypothesis: Majalisar ta fara bayar da kudin da ake bukata don wannan shirin yaki da abubuwan banza a shekarar 2005, kuma ta bayyana cewa FBI dole ne ta aika wakilan mata da yawa, akalla 10, don su yi aiki a fannin yanke hukunci kan abubuwan da suka shafi fimotattukai masu ban tabbas.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa shine wanda yafi ciyowa innings kwallo, inda ya ciwo kwallo 41 a cikin 70 ta duka me hudu sau 11 da kuma me shiga sau 2.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa ya samu mafi yawan maki a wasan, inda ya samu maki 70 a cikin ƙwallaye 41, ta hanyar bugawa ƙwallaye 11 masu yawa da kuma ƙwallaye 2 masu tsada.

translations.source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.reference: ‘Yan wasan kurket na tsakiya, Sachin Tendulkar da Rahul Dravid, sun yi kokari kuma sun yi haɗin gwiwa tare a Tseren-ɗari.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu 'yan wasan da suka buga wasan a tsakiyar tawalku, kamar Sachin Tendulkar da Rahul Dravid, sun yi kyau kuma sun samu nasara wajen samar da abubuwa, inda suka haɗu suka samu tsammanin fitar da wasu jefa-jefa.

translations.source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.reference: Amma, bayan rashin nasarar kyaftin din wicket Indiya kawai tayi asarar guda 36 tana kwance wickets 7 don kawo karshen innings.
translations.hypothesis: Amma, bayan da Indiya ta rasa gwarzon dan wasa, ta samu kawai maki 36 kuma ta rasa wasu dan wasa 7 kafin innings ta ƙare.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.reference: Shugaban kasar America George W. Bush ya iso Singapore a safiya 16 ga Nuwanba, domin fara yawon bude ido na tsawon mako daya a Asiya.
translations.hypothesis: Shugaban Amurka, George W. Bush, ya isa birnin Singapore ne a safiyar ranar 16 ga watan Nuwamba, inda ya fara ziyarar da zai yi a kasashen Asiya na tsawon wata.

translations.source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: Mataimakin Firayi Ministan Singapore Wong Kan Sang ne ya tarbe shi, sannan su ka tattauna al’amuran kasuwanci da ta’addanci tare da Firayi Ministan Singapore Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: An yi masa maraba ne a Singapore ta mataimakin shugaban kasa, Wong Kan Seng, kuma ya tattauna game da kasuwanci da matsalar ta'adanci da shugaban kasa na Singapore, Lee Hsien Loong.

translations.source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.reference: Bayan mako guda da shan kaye a zabukan tsakiyar wa’adi, Bush ya fada wa wasu magoya baya fadadar kasuwanci a Asiya.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan wata guda na rashin nasara a zaben tsakiyar mulki, Shugaba Bush ya yi jawabi ga jama'a game da karuwar kasuwancin da ke faruwa a Asiya.

translations.source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.reference: Firayi Minista Stephen Harper, ya amince da aika kudurin ‘Dokar “Tsarkakakkiyar Iska’ zuwa ga kwamitin gamayyar jam’iyyu don sake dubawa, kafin ayi mata karatu na biyu, bayan taron mintuna 25 na ranar Talata tare da shugaban jam’iyyar NDP Jack Layton a PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Shugaban gwamnati, Stephen Harper, ya amince da a tura dokar 'Tsarkake Iska' ta gwamnati zuwa wani kwamitin da ya kunshi wakilan dukkanin jam'iyyun siyasa domin a duba ta, kafin ta zama doka a karon na biyu, bayan taron da ya yi da shugaban jam'iyyar NDP, Jack Layton, wanda ya ci gaba da minti 25 a ofishin shugaban gwamnati.

translations.source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.reference: Layton ya nemi canje-canje ga dokar ra’ayin mazan jiya yanayi lokacin haduwa da Firayim Ministan, yana tambaya don “cikakken sake rubutawar” dokan Jam'iyyar ra’ayin mazan jiya.
translations.hypothesis: Layton ya nemi canje-canje a dokar muhalli da kungiyar masu ra'ayin adawa ta shirya, a lokacin taron da ta yi da Shugaban Minista, inda ta roƙi "gyara ta cikakke da ta yima dokar muhalli da kungiyar masu ra'ayin adawa ta shirya sabon ɗanƙali."

translations.source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.reference: Tun daga lokacin da Gwamnatin Tarayya ta shiga daukar nauyin asibitin Mersey da ke Devonport, Tasmania, gwamnatin jihar da wasu ‘yan majalisar tarayya sun soki wannan aikin a matsayin ci gaban shirin zaben tarayya da za a kira a watan Nuwamba.
translations.hypothesis: Tun lokacin da gwamnatin tarayya ta shiga don ta dauki alhakin kudin da ake kashe a asibitin Mersey a Devonport, Tasmania, gwamnatin jihar da wasu wakilan tarayya sun yi suka ga wannan mataki a matsayin wani abu mara kyau, wanda ake yi ne ne kawai don jawo hankalin jama'a gaba da zaben tarayya da za a yi a watan Nuwamba.

translations.source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.reference: Amma Firayim Minista John Howard ya ce dokar an yi ta ne domin kare ginin asibitin domin kada gwamnatin Tasmania ta rage masa kima, wajen kara kudaden da dala miliyan 45 ta Australiya.
translations.hypothesis: Amma, Firayim Minista John Howard ya ce wannan doka ta kasance kawai don kare wuraren asibiti daga canje-canje da za su iya cutar da ayyukan sa ta hanyar gwamnatin Tasmanian, kuma ya ba da kuɗi na AUD$45 miliyan na ƙari.

translations.source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.reference: Labari na baya bayan nan ya nuna cewa, nazarin motsin teku na nuna alamun wata tsunami ta taso. Hakika an tabbatar da alamun tsunami a kusa da Pago da Niue.
translations.hypothesis: A cewar sabon rahoton, adadi da aka samu na matakin ruwan teku ya nuna cewa an samu wani tsunami. Akwai wasu alamu na yiwuwar samun tsunami a kusa da garin Pago Pago da kuma Niue.

translations.source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.reference: Ba a sami wata mummunar barna ko jin ciwo a rahoton da ke fitowa daga Tonga ba, amma kuma wutar lantarki ta katse, abinda ya hana hukumomi samun sanarwar gargadin tsunami wanda hukumar PTWC ta bayar.
translations.hypothesis: A ban da kowane lalacewar babban ko rauni a Tonga, amma wani lokaci an rasa wutar lantarki, kuma ana rade-raden cewa wannan ya sa hukumomin Tonga ba su samu sanarwar tsutsotsiyar ruwa da PTWC ta fitar ba.

translations.source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.reference: An rufe duk makarantu goma sha hudu a Huawaii wadanda suke kusa da bakin teku a ranar Laraba duk da cewa an janye jan kunnen.
translations.hypothesis: Makarantu goma sha da huɗu da ke jihar Hawaii, waɗanda ke kusa da tafkin ruwa, sun rufe dukkan ranar Laraba, duk da cewa an dage sabisai.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.reference: Shugaban Amurka George W. Bush ya yi maraba da sanarwar.
translations.hypothesis: Shugaban Amurka, George W. Bush, ya maraba da wannan sanarwa.

translations.source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.reference: Mai magana da yawun Bush Gordon Johndroe ya kira alwashin da Koriya ta Arewa ta yi “babban mataki ne ga burin cimma nasarar narkar da makaman nukiliya na zirin Koriya.”
translations.hypothesis: Kakakin gwamnatin Amurka, Gordon Johndroe, ya ce alkawarin da kasar Koriya ta Arewa ta yi "wata matsala mai mahimmanci wajen cimma burin kawar da makamin nukiliya a yankin Koriya."

translations.source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.reference: Guguwar teku ta goma da aka sakawa suna Jerry a kakar guguwar tekun Atalantika ta fara a yau.
translations.hypothesis: Wata ruwan sama mai ƙarfi, wacce aka yi mata suna "Jerry," ta bayyana a yau a cikin Tekun Atlantika, kuma ita ce ruwan sama ta goma da ta fito a lokacin lokacin ruwan sama na Atlantika.

translations.source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.reference: Cibiyar kula da guguwar teku ta kasa (NHC) ta ce a yanzu guguwar Jerry ba ta da wani hadari ga doron kasa.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar Kula da Tsarin Ruwan Sama ta Kasa (National Hurricane Center) ta bayyana cewa, a yanzu haka, Jerry baya daɗa barazuba ga ƙasashen duniya.

translations.source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.reference: {Ungiyar Injiniya ta Amurka ta kiyasta cewa inci 6 na ruwan sama zai iya keta ragowar guguwar da ta gabata.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar Injiniyoyin Amurka ta kiyasta cewa, idan ruwan sama ya kai inci shida, zai iya lalata ragamar da ta riga ta lalace.

translations.source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.reference: Unguwa ta tara, wacce ta ga ambaliyar ruwa har sama da ƙafa 20 a lokacin Guguwar Katrina, a halin yanzu tana cikin ruwa mai ɗumbin yawa yayin da levee na kusa ya cika.
translations.hypothesis: Wurin da ake kira "Ninth Ward," wanda ya fuskanci zub da ruwa har zuwa tsayin ƙafa 20 ne a lokacin hurar Katrina, a halin yanzu yana da ruwa har zuwa ƙarƙashin ƙafa, saboda ruwan ya wuce iyakokin gabar ruwa da ke kusa.

translations.source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.reference: Ruwa na zubewa kan levee a sashi mai fadin kafa 100.
translations.hypothesis: Ruwa na fitowa sama da bangaren da aka gina don hana ruwa, a wani yanki mai faɗi kimanin fut 100.

translations.source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.reference: Mai Gudanarwa na Ƙaramar Majalisa Adam Cuerden ya nuna ɓacin ransa a game da sharewa a lokacin da ya ke magana da Wikinews a watan da ya gabata.
translations.hypothesis: Mai kula da gidan yanar gizo na "Commons," Adam Cuerden, ya bayyana rashin amfaninsa game da yanke sakonkuɗin da aka yi, lokacin da ya yi hira da "Wikinews" a watan da ya wuce.

translations.source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.reference: “Tun daga farko [Wales] ta yi mana karya. Na farko, ta hanyar yin kamar wannan saboda dalilai ne na doka. Na biyu, ta hanyar yin kamar yana sauraron mu, har zuwa goge fasaharsa.”
translations.hypothesis: "Shi [Wales] ya yi mana ƙarya tun daga farko. Na farko, ta hanyar nuna kamar yana yin hakan ne saboda dalilai na doka. Na biyu, ta hanyar jan hankalinmu cewa yana sauraron mu, har zuwa lokacin da ya goge ayyukan fasahar sa."

translations.source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.reference: Fushin al’ummar ya kai ga ƙoƙarin da ake yi na samar da tsari dangane da al’amuran da suka jibanci jima’i a shafin da ke daukar miliyoyin kafafen yada labarai da ke da lasisi.
translations.hypothesis: Matsalar da mutane suka ji game da abubuwan da ake bugawa a shafin, ta haifar da ƙoƙarin da ake yi yanzu na samar da tsarin dokoki game da abubuwan da suka shafi jima'i, a shafin da ke ɗaukar miliyoyin abubuwan watsa labarai da aka ba da izinin amfani da su.

translations.source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Mafi yawancin aiki da aka yi a rubuce ne, amma an tsara tsarin ne domin bunkasa lura da ake wa taurarin Sagittarius.
translations.hypothesis: Aikin da aka yi ya kasance mafi yawan nazarin ilimi, amma shirin ya ƙunshi ƙididdigar da za ta taimaka wajen fahimtar abubuwan da aka gano a galaxiyan Sagittarius.

translations.source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.reference: Tasirin da ƙungiyar ke nema zai haifar ne ta hanyar ƙarfi tsakanin igiyar ruwa tsakanin galaxy da Milky Way mai duhu.
translations.hypothesis: Matsalolin da ƙungiyar ta ke neman samu za su faru ne sakamakon tasirin gravitational da ke tsakanin abubuwan da ba a iya gani ba a cikin galaxiya da abubuwan da ba a iya gani ba a cikin Milky Way.

translations.source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Kamar yadda maganadisun wata ya ke jan duniya, inda hakan ke haddasa murɗawar igiyar ruwa, haka dabakar milky way ke tasiri kan dabakar saggitarius.
translations.hypothesis: Kamar yadda ruwan sama ke jawo ruwan teku, wanda ke haifar da tsire-tsire, haka ma tauraron ruwa (Milky Way) yana jawo ƙarfi akan galaxiyan Sagittarius.

translations.source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.reference: Masana kimiyya sun yanke kan cewa dark matter tana yin tasirin akan wasu dark matter a yanayi iri daya da yadda sauran regular matter yakeyi.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike sun samu nasara wajen kammala cewa, abubuwan da ake kira "mai duhu" suna shafar juna kamar yadda abubuwan da muke sani suke yi.

translations.source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.reference: Wannan ka'idar tana cewa mafi akasarin duhun da ke kusa da galaxy ana samun shi ne a kusa da galaxy a wani nau'in halo, kuma an yi shi da kananan kananan kwayoyi.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan rahoton ya ce cewa mafi yawan abubuwan da ake kira "mai duzuwa" da ke kewaye da galatoci, suna kewaye da galatoci a wani irin sashi, kuma suna ƙunshe da ƙananan furfura da yawa.

translations.source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.reference: Rahotannin talabijin sun nuna farin hayaki na fitowa daga shukar.
translations.hypothesis: Rahoto daga talabijin ya nuna wata ruwan tabarauke ta fito daga masana'anta.

translations.source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.reference: Mahukuntan yankin suna gargadin mazauna yankin da ke kusa da masana’antar da su kasance cikin gidajensu, a kashe na’urorin sanyaya ɗaki kuma kada a sha ruwan famfo.
translations.hypothesis: Jamusai na yankin sun bayyana cewa mazauna yankin da ke kusa da masana'anta sun dage a cikin gida, su kashe na'urori masu sanyaya iska, kuma kada su sha ruwan tabar.

translations.source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.reference: A cewar hukumar nukiliya ta Japan, an gano sinadaran caesium da iodine masu hadari a ma’aikatar.
translations.hypothesis: A cewar hukumar atom da ke kasar Japan, an gano sinadirin radioactive na caesium da iodine a cikin wannan masana'anta.

translations.source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.reference: Hukumomi suna hasashen cewa wannan yana nuna cewa mai yiwuwa gangunan da a ke ajiye man uranium a wurin sun fashe kuma suna zuba.
translations.hypothesis: Jamusai, jami'an gwamnati sun yi zargin cewa wannan alamar nuni ce cewa wadatuttukan da ke dauke da kwalaye na uranium a wurin na iya fashewa kuma suna fitar da abubuwa.

translations.source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.reference: Dokta Tony Moll ya gano kwayar cutar tarin fuka (XDR-TB) a yankin Afirka ta Kudu KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll ya gano cutar kwalbu mai wahala wacce ta fi juriya ga magani (XDR-TB) a yankin KwaZulu-Natal na kasar Afirka ta Kudu.

translations.source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.reference: A cikin wata hira, ya ce sabuwar cutar “na da matukar tada hankali da firgitarwa saboda yawan mace-macen da ta ke haddasawa.”
translations.hypothesis: A wani tattaunawa, ya ce wannan sabon nau'in cutar "ya damu sosai kuma ya haifar da damuwa saboda yawan mutuwata da yake haifarwa."

translations.source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.reference: Kila wasu marasa lafiya sun kamu da cutar a asibiti, Dokta Moll yana tsammani, kuma aƙalla biyu sun kasance ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya na asibiti.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu marasa lafiya na iya kamuwa da wannan cutar a asibiti, kamar yadda Dr. Moll ya bayyana, kuma aƙalla mutane biyu da suka kamu da ita sun kasance ma'aikata na asibiti.

translations.source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.reference: Nan da shekara ɗaya, mutum daya mai ɗauke da cutar zai shafa ma mutane 10 zuwa 15 da suka kusance shi.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin shekara guda, wanda ya kamu da cuta na iya yiwa mutane 10 zuwa 15 waɗanda suke kusa da shi.

translations.source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.reference: Sai dai, kashin XDR-TB da ke jikin duk rukunin mutane da ke da tarin fuka har yanzu da alamar yana ƙasa; 6,000 daga cikin jimillar mutane 330,000 da suka kamu a kowane lokaci a Afirka ta Kudu.
translations.hypothesis: Koy yaya, kashi na cutar XDR-TB a cikin dukkanin mutanen da suka kamu da cutar tuberculosis har yanzu yana da ƙaranci; akwai mutane 6,000 ne daga cikin mutanen da suka kamu da cutar, waɗanda suke kusan 330,000 a kowanne lokaci a kasar Afirka ta Kudu.

translations.source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.reference: Taurarin dan adam ɗin, waɗanda duka biyun nauyinsu ya haura da ƙarin fam 1,000, kuma suke tafiyar kimanin mil 17,500 a sa'a guda, sun yi karo da juna mil 491 sama da Duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Waɗannan satelit biyu, waɗanda kowannen su ya kai nauyin sama da kilo 454 (wanda ya fi nauyin kilo 454), kuma suna tafiya da sauri kusan kilomita 28,200 a sa'a, sun haɗu a wajen kilomita 790 daga ƙasan ƙasar.

translations.source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.reference: Masana kimiyya sun ce fashewar da hatsarin ya haifar na da girma.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike sun ce fashewar da ya faru sakamakon karɓuwa ta yi girma sosai.

translations.source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.reference: Har yanzu suna ƙoƙarin gano yadda girman hatsarin ya kasance da kuma yadda abin zai shafi Duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Har yanzu suna kokarin tantance yawan abin da ya faru a hatsarin, da kuma yadda wannan abin ya iya shafar duniya.

translations.source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.reference: Hukumar Dabaru ta Amurka wato United States Strategic Command ta Ofishin Tsaron Amurka tana bin diddigin ɓarɓashi.
translations.hypothesis: Ofishin Tsarin Tsaro na Amurka, wanda yake ƙarƙashin Ma'aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka, na binne ragowar abubuwan da suka fashe.

translations.source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.reference: Sakamakon binciken za'a futo dashi ne shafin yanar gizo wanda kowa zai iya gani.
translations.hypothesis: Sakamakon binciken da aka yi za a fitar a gidan yanar gizo da ake amfani da shi.

translations.source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.reference: Hukumomi a Ohio sun sanar da cewa wata likita wadda ke aiki a wani asibiti a Pittsburg, za’a caje ta da laifin kisan kai bayan an gano gawar mahaifiyarta a mace a wajen ajiye kaya na bayan motar ta ranar Laraba.
translations.hypothesis: Wata likita da ta yi aiki a asibitin mata da yara na Pittsburgh, a jihar Pennsylvania, za a tuhar da ita da kisan mutane bayan jikin mahaifiyarta aka samu a cikin babbar jaka (trunk) na motarta a ranar Laraba, a cewar jami'an tsaro na jihar Ohio.

translations.source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.reference: An gano Dokta Malar Balasubramanian, 29, a cikin Blue Ash, Ohio, wani yanki kusa da kilomita 15 arewacin Cincinnati kwance a ƙasa kusa da hanya a cikin T-shirt da tufafi a cikin halain tsananin daukan magani.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, wanda shekarunsa 29, an samu a birnin Blue Ash, wani yanki da ke kusa da birnin Cincinnati, a jihar Ohio. An samu a wajen hanya, a kasa, sanye da shafi da rigar ciki, kuma alama ce cewa yana da matuƙar magani a jikinsa. Birnin Blue Ash yana kusan kilomita 24 arewa da birnin Cincinnati.

translations.source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.reference: Ta tura jami’an zuwa bakin motar ta kerar Oldmobile wacce take diddigen kafafu 500 daga inda take.
translations.hypothesis: Ta umartar da jami'an su su bi ta zuwa motarta mai launin fari, wacce ita ce Oldsmobile Intrigue, wacce ke nisan kafa 500.

translations.source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.reference: A can, suka tarar da gawar Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, an lulluɓe da barguna na jini.
translations.hypothesis: A can, sun samu gawar Saroja Balasubramanian, wacce ta kasance shekara 53, wacce aka rufe ta da kwalaye masu jinin.

translations.source: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun ce da alama gawar ta kai tsawon kwana daya a wurin.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar 'yan sanda ta ce jikin mutumin ya bayyana cewa ya kasance a wurin ne tsawon kusan daya.

translations.source: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.reference: An ba da rahoton kamuwa da cutar na farko a wannan kakar a karshen Yuli.
translations.hypothesis: Wakokin farko na cutar sun bayyana a karshen watan Yuli a wannan shekarar.

translations.source: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.reference: Aladu ke dauke da kwayar cutar, wadda ke yin kaura zuwa jikin mutane daga sauro.
translations.hypothesis: Macece ta yi wa mutane cutar, kuma ta fara ne a cikin dabbobin daji, sannan ta yi tafiya zuwa ga mutane ta hanyar kwari.

translations.source: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.reference: Annobar ta sa gwamnatin Indiya daukar waɗannan matakai kamar tura masu kamun alade zuwa yankunan da abin ya fi shafa, raba dubban labulen sauro da kum fesa maganin ƙwari.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan cutar da ta barke ya sa gwamnatin Indiya ta dauki matakai kamar yadda suka hada da aika masu kama dabbobi a yankunan da suka fi damuwa, rarraba dubban riga mai kariya daga kwalaye, da kuma amfani da maganin kashe kwalaye.

translations.source: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.reference: Gwamnati ta alkawarin miliyoyin kwalaben rigakafin encephalitis, wanda zai taimaka wajen shirya hukumomin kiwon lafiya a shekara mai zuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Gwamnati ta kuma alkawari samar da miliyoyin bututuka na allurar rigakafin cutar encephalitis, wanda zai taimaka wa hukumomin lafiya su shiryayyen don shekarar gaba.

translations.source: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.reference: An dakatar da shirye-shiryen kai alluran rigakafi zuwa yankunan da abin ya fi shafa a tarihi a wannan shekara saboda rashin kuɗaɗe da kuma ƙarancin bayar da muhimmanci dangane da sauran cututtuka.
translations.hypothesis: Dabarun samar da allurai zuwa ga yankin da ya fi fama da cutar a shekarar nan sun janyo wani tsari saboda rashin kudin da ake bukata da kuma rashin fifikon samar da allurai a kwance a kan sauran cututtuka.

translations.source: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.reference: A shekarar 1956 Slania ya koma Sweden, inda bayan shekaru uku ya fara aiki da gidan waya na Sweden sannan kuma ta zama shugaban masu zane.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1956, Słania ya koma Sweden, inda shekara uku bayan haka ya fara aiki a ofishin wasiku na Sweden kuma ya zama shugaban masu yin rubuce-rubuce a ofishin.

translations.source: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.reference: Ya samar da sama da stamp 1000 ga kasar Sweden ga kuma wasu kasashen guda 28.
translations.hypothesis: Ya samar da sama da stamps 1,000 don kasar Sweden da wasu kasashe 28.

translations.source: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
translations.reference: Aikin shi yana da shaidan inganci da bayanin filla-filla har yana daya daga kadan daga sanannu cikin philatelists. Wasu sun kore a karban ayukansa kadai.
translations.hypothesis: Aikin sa yana da inganci da kuma cikakken bayani, don haka yana cikin 'yan mutanen da suka fi shahara a cikin masana antelaji. Wasu suna ƙoƙarin tarawa aikin sa ne kawai.

translations.source: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
translations.reference: Hatiminsa na 1,000 ya kasance mafi kyawun “Maɗaukakan Ayyuka na Sarakunan Sweden” da David Klocker Ehrenstrahi ya yi a shekarar 2000, wanda aka sanya a cikin Littafin Bayanan Al’ajabi na Guinness.
translations.hypothesis: Wata takarda mai kyau, wacce ta kasance ta 1,000 da ya samu, ita ce "Ayukan Kirarikin Masarautun Sweden" da David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl ya shirya a shekarar 2000, kuma ta shiga cikin littafin duniya na Guinness.

translations.source: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
translations.reference: Ya kuma tsunduma a zanen kudi ga kasashe da dama, misalai na kwanan nan na aikinsa da ya hada da hotunan Firaminista a gaban sababbin takardun kuɗin ƙasar Canada na dala $5 da $100.
translations.hypothesis: Shi ma ya yi aiki na zura hotuna akan takardun kuɗi na ƙasashe da dama, kuma daga cikin ayyukan da ya yi a baya, akwai hotunan shugabannin gwamnati da aka sanya a gaban takardun kuɗin sabuwar Kanada na $5 da $100.

translations.source: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
translations.reference: Bayan hadarin ya faru, an dauki Gibson zuwa asibiti amma ya mutu jim kadan bayan haka.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan hada saɓon, Gibson an kai shi asibiti, amma ya mutu ba jimawa ba.

translations.source: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
translations.reference: Direban babbar motar, mai shekaru 64, bai ji rauni ba a hatsarin.
translations.hypothesis: Mai tuki mai shekaru 64, ba ya jini a wajen hadarin.

translations.source: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
translations.reference: Abun hawan kadai an dauke shi ne daga wurin hatsarin a kimanin 1200 GMT a wannan ranar.
translations.hypothesis: Motar ta samu wannan lamarin ta hanyar hadarin, kuma an dauke ta daga wurin hadarin ne a kusan karfe 12:00 na UTC a ranar da lamarin ya faru.

translations.source: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
translations.reference: Wani mutum da ya ke aiki a wani gareji kusa da inda hatsarin ya faru ya ce: “Akwai yara da ke jiran su tsallaka titi wadanda su ke ta ihu da kuka.”
translations.hypothesis: Wani mutum da ke aiki a wani gidan gyara motoci da ke kusa da inda lamarin ya faru ya ce: "Akwai yara da suke jiran wuce hanya, kuma duk sun kasa da kuka."

translations.source: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
translations.reference: Dukansu sun gudu daga inda hatsarin ya faru.
translations.hypothesis: Dukkanin mutanen sun yi gudu da sauri daga inda abin da ya faru ya faru.

translations.source: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.

translations.source: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.reference: Majalisar dinkin duniya na kokarin hada kudade domin tallafawa kasashe wadanda ke fama da sauyin yanayi.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya (UN) tana kuma fatan kammala wani tsarin tallafi da zai taimaka wa kasashe da suka lalace sakamakon canjin yanayi don su iya shawo kan matsalolin da suka taso.

translations.source: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.reference: Kudin na iya tafiya ga gidaje masu kariyar ambaliyar ruwa, ingantaccen tsarin ruwa, da kuma canjin amfanin gona.
translations.hypothesis: Kudin na iya shiga wajen gina gidaje waɗanda ba sa lalace sakamakon ruwan sama, inganta tsarin sarrafa ruwa, da kuma jaddadawar nau'in amfanin gonaki.

translations.source: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.reference: Fluke ya rubuta cewa ƙoƙarin wasu na hana mata yin magana game da harkokin kiwon lafiyar mata bai yi nasara ba.
translations.hypothesis: Fluke ya rubuta cewa ƙoƙarin wasu mutane da suke kokarin hana mata su yi magana game da lafiyar mata sun fiye da yadda suka yi nasara.

translations.source: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
translations.reference: Ta kai ga wannan matsayin ne saboda yawan tofa albarkatun bakin mutane tare da kwarin gwiwa wanda maza da mata ke rokar cewa amfani da magungunan hana haihuwa sun zama dole.
translations.hypothesis: Ta isa wannan ƙarshe saboda yawan kalamai masu kyau da goyon baya da mutane, maza da mata, suka aika mata, suna roƙon a yi la'akari da maganin hana jima'i a matsayin buƙatar likita.

translations.source: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
translations.reference: Lokacin da fada ya barke bayan an kai wadanda suka ji rauni zuwa asibiti, kusan sauran fursunoni 40 da suka rage sun zauna a farfajiyar kuma sun ki komawa dakinsu.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da fafatawa ta ƙare bayan wasu mutane da suka ji rauni sun kai su asibiti, kusan mutane 40 daga cikin sauran wadanda suka rage sun zauna a wajen gidan yari kuma sun ki koma cikin dakinansu.

translations.source: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
translations.reference: Masu tattaunawar sun yi kokarin gyara lamarin, amma bukatun fursunonin ba su bayyana ba.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu mutane sun yi ƙoƙarin gyara yanayin, amma buƙatun fursunajen ba su bayyana ba.

translations.source: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
translations.reference: Tsakanin 10: 00-11: 00 pm MDT, fursunoni sun fara wuta a farfajiyar gidan.
translations.hypothesis: Tsakanin sa'o'i 10:00 zuwa 11:00 na yamma (daga lokacin da aka ƙidaya), wasu fursunai sun kunna wuta a wajen gidan.

translations.source: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
translations.reference: Ba da dadewa ba, jami'an da ke sanye da kayan aikin kwantar tarzoma suka shiga yankin sun kore yan fursunan da barkonon tsohuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Ba da daɗi ba, jami'an tsaro da kayan yaki suka shiga filin, suka kuma ruƙo fursunajen a wani kusurma, suka yi amfani da gas din da ke haifar da hawan ido.

translations.source: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.reference: Rundunar kashe gobara sunyi nasara kashe wutan a dai-dai karfe 11:35pm.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyoyin kashe wuta sun sami nasara wajen kashe wutar a kusan karfe 11:35 na dare.

translations.source: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.reference: Bayan gina madatsan ruwan a 1963, ambaliyar ruwa da ke zuwa akai-akai kuma yada kasa zuwa kogi ya tsaya.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan da an gina dam ɗin a shekarar 1963, anyi ƙarshe da raguwar ruwan sama da ke fitowa kowace shekara wanda ke yaduwa da ƙasa a cikin kogin.

translations.source: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.reference: Wannan danshi ya zama dole don ƙirƙirar linta da rairayin bakin teku, waɗanda suka yi aiki a matsayin mazaunin namun daji.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan abu mai ƙura ya zama abu mai mahimmanci wajen ƙirƙirar tsire-tsire da kuma yashi, waɗanda suka zama wurare da dabbobi suka zauna.

translations.source: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.reference: Sakamakon haka, nau'in kifaye biyu sun ɓace, wasu biyu kuma suna cikin haɗari, da suka haɗa da chub mai ƙusumbi.
translations.hypothesis: Daga wannan dalilin, nau'o-nau'o biyu na kifi sun mutu, kuma wasu biyu sun fuskanci barazana, wanda ya haɗa da kifin da ake kiran "humpback chub."

translations.source: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.reference: Duk da cewa Yawan ruwan zai daga kadan bayan ambaliyar, maaikatan na fatan cewa zai isa daidai kimar dawo saman kasar bakin rafin.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake matakin ruwa zai tashi kadan bayan nan, jami'an gwamnati suna fatan cewa wannan tsayi zai isa don dawo da ƙananan ƙuƙƙwalwar ƙasa da aka ɓace a ƙarƙashin ruwa.

translations.source: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
translations.reference: Duk da cewa ba alalmun gargadin guguwa, kuma a cewar hukumar ta Jakarta geophysics, ba za a yi gargadin guguwa ba saboda girgizar ba ta cika adadin da ake bukata na lamba 6.5 ba.
translations.hypothesis: Har yanzu babu wani sanarwa da aka fitar game da tsunami, kuma a cewar hukumar kula da ilimin ƙasa ta Jakarta, ba za a fitar da wani sanarwa game da tsunami ba saboda girman girgizar ƙasa bai isa ƙima ta 6.5 ba.

translations.source: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
translations.reference: Duk da cewa babu barazanar guguwar tsunami, mazauna sun fara firgita kuma sun fara barin kasuwancinsu da gidajensu.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da ba wata barazana ta tsunami ba, mazauna sun fara tsoro suka fara barin kasuwancinsu da gidajensu.

translations.source: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
translations.reference: Kodayake Winfrey ta kasance cikin hawaye a yayin ban kwana, amma ta bayyana wa magoya bayanta cewa za ta dawo.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake Winfrey ta nuna damuwa a lokacin da ta yi adawa, ta bayyana ga magoyaɓanta cewa za ta koma.

translations.source: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
translations.reference: Wannan ba zai zama ban kwana ba ne. Wannan shine rufewar babin sura da bude wani sabo.”
translations.hypothesis: "Wannan ba zai zama tattauna ba. Wannan shi ne ƙarewar ɗaya daga cikin labarai da fara wani sabo."

translations.source: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
translations.reference: Sakamako na karshe daga zabukan shugaban kasa da na ‘yan majalisa na ƙasar Namibia ya nuna cewa an sake zaɓar shugaban kasa mai ci, Hifikepunye Pohamba, da rata mai yawa.
translations.hypothesis: Sakamakon karshe na zaben shugaban kasa da majalisar dokoki a kasar Namibia sun nuna cewa shugaban kasa na yanzu, Hifikepunye Pohamba, ya sake lashe zaben ne da babban rinrin.

translations.source: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
translations.reference: Jam'iyya mai mulki, Ƙungiyar Jama’ar Kudu maso Yammacin Afirka (SWAPO ) ta Kudu maso Yamma ta sake samun rinjaye a zabukan ƴan majalisar.
translations.hypothesis: Jam'iyyar mulki, wacce ake kira South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), ta ci gaba da samun rinjayen adadi a zaben majalisar.

translations.source: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
translations.reference: Sojojin haɗin kai da na Afganistan sun shiga wurin domin ƙwato sashen kuma an tura wani jirgin saman sojojin haɗin kan domin su taimaka.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar sojojin da sojojin Afghanistan sun shiga yawan wannan yanki don tabbatar da tsaro, kuma wasu jiragen sama na kungiyar sun aje don taimakawa.

translations.source: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
translations.reference: Hadarin ya faru ne a saman tsaunuka, kuma ana jin cewa sakamakon wuta ne.
translations.hypothesis: Halin tafka abin da ya faru ya faru a wani wuri mai tsawo a cikin duwainiya, kuma ana tunanin ya faru ne sakamakon wani hari.

translations.source: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.reference: ƙoƙarin da ake don gano wurin da jirgin ya fadi yana samun cikas daga rashin kyan yanayi da kuma yanki mai wahalar shiga.
translations.hypothesis: An ƙoƙarin neman wurin haɗuwar jirgin ya ci karo da yanayi mara kyau da kuma yanayin ƙasa mai wahala.

translations.source: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
translations.reference: Mangola, kungiyar tallafin kiwon lafiya, Sans Medecines Frontieres da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya sun ce ita ce barkewar cuta mafi muni da aka yi a kasar.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyoyin taimakon lafiya na Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres, da Kungiyar Lafiya ta Duniya sun bayyana cewa wannan cutar ce mafi muni da ta tashi a kasar.

translations.source: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.reference: Kakakin kungiyar ta Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman ya ce “Angola na fuskantar barkewar cutar mafi muni da aka taba gani kuma lamarin ya ci gaba da munana a Angola,” in ji shi.
translations.hypothesis: Kakakin kungiyar Medecines Sans Frontiere, Richard Veerman, ya ce: "Angola na bukatar fuskantar mafi muni irin cutar da ta taba fuskanta, kuma yanayin a Angola ya kasance matuƙi," in ji shi.

translations.source: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.reference: An fara wasannin ne da karfe 10:00 na safe tare da yanayi mai kyau kuma banda yayyafin safiya wanda da sauri ya warware, ya kasance cikakkiyar rana don wasan rugby na 7.
translations.hypothesis: Wasannin sun fara ne a karon 10:00 na safiya, kuma yanayi ya kasance mai kyau. Sai dai akwai ruwan zafi da ya fito a tsakiyar safiya, amma ya wuce cikin sauri, kuma ya zama rana mai kyau sosai don wasan rugby na maza.

translations.source: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.reference: Afirka ta kudu masu darajar farko a gasar sun fara da kafar dama yayin da suka sami cikakkiyar nasara 26 - 00 akan ‘yan wasan Zambia masu daraja ta 5.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar Afirka ta Kudu, wacce ta kasance a matsayin mafi kyau a gasar, ta fara da nasara lokacin da ta yi nasara da ci 26 zuwa 00 a kan kungiyar Zambia, wacce ta kasance a matsayin ta biyar.

translations.source: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.reference: Suna nuna alamun rashin kataɓus a gasar da suka buga da takwarorinsu na kudu, sai ga shi Afirka ta Kudu ta ƙara ƙwazo a hankali yayin da gasar ke cigaba.
translations.hypothesis: A yayin wasan da suka yi da tawagar mata ta kudu, kungiyar Afirika ta Kudu ta nuna wani matsayin da ya nuna rashin horo, amma duk da haka, ta ci gaba da inganta wasanta yayin da gasar ta ci gaba.

translations.source: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.reference: Tsarin su na kariya, da kwarewa wajen amfani da hannu da kuma hadin kan su ya sanya suka bambanta kuma alama ya nuna cewa abokan wasan su zasu sha kaya.
