translations.hypothesis: Tsarin tsare-tsaren da suka yi wajen karewa, ƙwarewar su wajen sarrafa ƙwallon, da kuma hadin gwiwar da suka nuna sun sa su zama abokin gani, kuma ya bayyana cewa wannan ƙungiya ce da za a iya fafata da ita.

translations.source: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.reference: Jami'ai a birnin Amsterdam da na cibiyar ajiye kayan tarihi ta Anne Frank, sun bayyana cewa bishiyar ta kamu da gansa kuka, abinda ke da hadari ga lafiyar jama’a sakamakon bishiyar na daf da karyewa.
translations.hypothesis: Jamusai na birnin Amsterdam da Makarantar Anne Frank sun bayyana cewa itacen na da cuta wanda ke haifar da cutar, kuma yana haɗɗamar da barazuba ga lafiyar jama'a, domin sun ce yana cikin haɗarin faduwa kowane lokaci.

translations.source: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.reference: An yanke cewa za’a sare ta ranar Talata, amma sai wani hukunci gaggawa na kotu ya ceci lamarin.
translations.hypothesis: An shirye a yi katse shi a ranar Talata, amma an ceci shi bayan wata hukuma ta kotu ta fitar da wata umurnin gaggawa.

translations.source: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.reference: Dukkan ginshikan kogon, da aka yi wa suna “ ‘Yan uwa mata guda bakwai”, akalla sun kai mita 100 zuwa 250 (kafa 328 zuwa 820) a fadinsu.
translations.hypothesis: Dukkanin shigowar kwalaburen, waɗanda aka sanya musu suna "Ƙungiyar 'Yan Mata Bakwai," suna da ƙirƙirar da ta kai ƙa'idar meters 100 zuwa 250 (feet 328 zuwa 820).

translations.source: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.reference: Hotunan infrared suna nuna cewa bambancin zafin jiki daga dare da rana yana nuna cewa mai yiwuwa koguna ne.
translations.hypothesis: Hotunan da aka ɗauka ta amfani da haske mai ƙarfi (infrared) sun nuna cewa sabanin jujjuyin zafin da ake gani tsakanin dare da rana, yana nuni da cewa suna iya zama kwalaye.

translations.source: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.reference: “Suna da sanyi fiye da kewayan farfajiyar ckin rana kuma suna yin dumi da dare.
translations.hypothesis: "Suna da sanyi fiye da yawan wuraren da ke kewaye a rana, kuma suna da zafi a dare."

translations.source: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Halayyar ɗumi ba tsayayye ba ce kamar manyan koguna a cikin ƙasa waɗanda galibi su ke riƙe zafin jiki na yau da kullun, amma ya yi daidai da waɗannan kasancewarsu ramuka masu zurfi a cikin ƙasa,” in ji Glen Cushing na kungiyar Nazarin Albarkatun Ƙasa ta Amurka (USGS) Ƙungiyar Nazarin Taurari da kuma na Jami’ar Arewacin Arizona da ke a Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: "Yin jujjuyawar zafin jiki da su ke yi ba kamar na manyan kwalbu a duniya ba ne, wanda sau da yawa suna da zurfi kuma suna da tsarin zafin jiki mai ɗorewa, amma yana da daidaito da cewa su su ne manyan ramuka a ƙasa," in ji Glen Cushing, wanda yake a kungiyar bincike ta USGS (United States Geological Survey) da ke kula da binciken taurari, kuma yana Jami'ar Arewa ta Arizona, wacce ke Flagstaff, Arizona.

translations.source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.reference: A Faransa, zaɓe ya kasanace wani abu mai ƙarancin fasahar zamani: masu zaɓe na keɓe kansu a cikin wani akwati, suna saka wata bugaggiyar takarda da ke nuna ɗan takararsu a cikin wata ambulan.
translations.hypothesis: A ƙasar Faransa, zabe a yadda aka saba da shi, ya kasance abu mai sauƙi: masu zabe suna shiga wani wuri daban, sannan su shigar da takarda da aka shirya tana da sunan dan takarar da suka zaɓa a cikin wata jaka.

translations.source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.reference: Bayan jami'ai sun tantance asalin masu jefa kuri'a, mai jefa kuri'ar ya jefa ambulaf a akwatin murfin kuma ya sanya hannu a takardar kada kuri'a.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan jami'an kada kuri'a sun tabbatar da sunan mai kada kuri'a, mai kada kuri'a ya saka takardar kada kuri'a a cikin akwatin kada kuri'a, sannan ya sanya saita a takardar da aka shirya don kada kuri'a.

translations.source: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.reference: Dokar zaɓen Faransa ta tsara yadda ake gudanar da zaɓe bisa matuƙar bin ƙa’ida.
translations.hypothesis: Dokokin zaben Faransa sun ƙayyade tsarin ayyukan zabe ne da ƙa'ida.

translations.source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.reference: Tun daga 1988, dole ne akwatunan zabe su kasance ana ganin abin da ke cikinsu domin masu jefa ƙuri'a da masu sa ido su iya shaidar cewa babu wasu ambulan a ciki a farkon kada kuri'un da kuma cewa ba a kara wasu ambulan ba sai dai wadanda aka kidaya kuma daga masu zaɓe da aka tantance.
translations.hypothesis: Tun shekarar 1988, akwatin kada kuri' dole ne ya kasance mai haske don masu kada kuri' da masu kallo su iya ganin cewa babu wata takarda a ciki a farkon zaben, kuma babu wata takarda da ake ƙara sai kawai wadanda suka cancanta suka kada kuri'a.

translations.source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.reference: Ƴan takarar na iya aika wakilai don su shaida kowane bangare na aikin. Da yamma, masu aikin sa kai suna kidaya kuri'u a karkashin kula mai ƙarfi, suna bin takamaiman hanyoyin.
translations.hypothesis: Wanda ya yi takara na iya aika wakilansa domin su kalli dukkanin matsayin zaben. A yamma, masu ba da taimako na musamman su ne suka ƙidaya kuri'ar, kuma suna ƙarƙashin kulawa mai tsanani, suna biyan tsarin da aka ƙayyade.

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.reference: ASUS Eee PC, wanda aka ƙaddamar da farko a fadin-duniya don ceton-farashi ƙasa da dalilai na aiki, ya zama babban magana a cikin shekarar 2007 Watan Taipei IT.
translations.hypothesis: ASUS Eee PC, wanda aka gabatar a duniya a baya ne domin adana kuɗi da kuma ƙwarewar amfani, ya zama babban batu a watan Satumba na shekarar 2007 a taron fasahar IT da aka yi a Taipei.

translations.source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.reference: Amma kasuwar sayen ɗaiɗai ta kwamfutar hannu za ta banbanta ƙwarai kuma ta canja bayan Mai Zartarwa Yuan na Tarayar Ƙasar Sin ya bai wa ASUS lambar girman Taiwan Sustainable Award a 2007.
translations.hypothesis: Amma kasuwar abokin tarho (laptop) za ta samu sauyi mai yawa bayan kungiyar ASUS ta samu lambar yabo ta "Taiwan Sustainable Award" a shekarar 2007, wacce ta samu ta hanyar hukumar "Executive Yuan" ta Jamhuriyar Sin.

translations.source: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.reference: Shafin yana gizon gidan radion sun yi bayanin shirin a matsayin "tsarin shirin irin na gidan sauraro na da amma tare da dan tsarin zamani mai hayaniya!"
translations.hypothesis: Shirin na wannan tashar, kamar yadda aka bayyana a shafin yanar gizo na tashar, yana da ma'ana cewa "wannan shi ne shirye-shiryen rediyo na baya, amma da sabon hangen nesa da kuma wasu abubuwa masu ban mamaki."

translations.source: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.reference: A farkon zamanin, an nuna wasan ne kawai a gidan rediyo na yanar gizo mai dogon lokaci TogiNet Radio, shafin da ke mayar da hankali kan maganan rediyo.
translations.hypothesis: A farkon fitowar wannan shiri, ya nuna ne kawai a gidan rediyo na intanet mai suna TogiNet Radio, wanda ya ƙware a shirye-shiryen magana.

translations.source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.reference: A karshen 2015, TogiNet ya kafa Rediyon AstroNet a matsayin ƙaramar tasha.
translations.hypothesis: A karshen shekarar 2015, kamfanin TogiNet ya kafa wani gidan rediyo mai suna AstroNet Radio a matsayin wani ɓangare na kamfanin.

translations.source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.reference: Asalin dandalin ya nuna sabbin yan wasa na murya, yan asalin East Texas.
translations.hypothesis: Aikin telewijin na da al'adu na amfani da wasu mutane waɗanda ba su da horo a fagen wasan kwaƙwalwa, kuma su ma suna daga yankin Gabas ta Texas.

translations.source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.reference: Rahotanni sun nuna an kwashe tsawon daren ana wasoson kayan jama’a, sakamakon rashin jami’an tsaro a titunan Bishkek.
translations.hypothesis: An bayyana cewa wasu mutane sun ci gaba da sata a birnin Bishkek dandaliki, domin jami'an tsaro ba su suke kewaye ba a titunan birnin.

translations.source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.reference: Wani mai lura ya bayyana Bishkek a matsayin wanda ke nutsewa cikin halin “fitina” yayin da gungun mutane suka yi ta yawo a titunan tare da fasa shagunan kayayyakin masarufi.
translations.hypothesis: Birnin Bishkek ya sami bayanin cewa ya fada cikin wani hali na "tsauraran rikici," kamar yadda wani mai lura ya bayyana, yayin da kungiyoyi na mutane suka mamaye tituna kuma suka sata shaguna da kayayyakin amfani.

translations.source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.reference: Da dama cikin mazauna Bishkek sun zargi masu zanga-zangar da suka fito daga kudanci da halayyar rashin mutunta doka.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu mazauna birnin Bishkek sun zarga masu tashe-tashen hankali daga kudu da aikata laifi da rashin tsari.

translations.source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.reference: Afirka ta Kudu ta ci nasara akan All Blacks (New Zealand) a wasan rugby union na Tri Nations a filin wasan Royal Bafokeng dake Rustenburg, na kasar Afirka ta Kudu.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar kwallon kafa ta kasar Afirka ta Kudu ta yi nasara a kan kungiyar "All Blacks" ta kasar New Zealand a wasan "Tri Nations" na kwallon kafa da aka buga a filin wasa na Royal Bafokeng a birnin Rustenburg, a kasar Afirka ta Kudu.

translations.source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.reference: An tashi wasan da banbancin maki daya, wato 20-21, abinda ya kawo karshen samun nasarar All Black karo na 15 a jere.
translations.hypothesis: Sakamakon wasanni ya kasance nasara da tsada ɗaya, inda suka samu maki 21 zuwa 20, wanda ya ƙare wasu wasanni 15 da All Blacks suka yi rike da nasara.

translations.source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.reference: Don ƴan Springboks, ya ƙare rashin nasara a wasanni biyar.
translations.hypothesis: Ga kungiyar Springboks, wannan ya kawo ƙarshe ga wasanni biyar da suka yi rashin nasara a jere.

translations.source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.reference: Wasan karshe ne na All Blacks, wanda tuni ya lashe kofin makonni biyu da suka gabata.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ita ce wasan karshe na kungiyar "All Blacks," wacce ta riga ta lashe kofin ne a makon da ya wuce.

translations.source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.reference: Wasan karshe na rukunin zai gudana ne a Ellis Park a Johannesburg mako mai zuwa, lokacin da Springboks za ta buga da Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Wasan karshe na wannan gasar zai gudana a filin wasa na Ellis Park a birnin Johannesburg a makon nan, inda ƙungiyar Springboks za ta buga wasa da ƙungiyar Australia.

translations.source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.reference: An yi wata matsakaiciyar girgizar kasa a yammacin Montana da karfe 10:08 na dare. ran Litinin.
translations.hypothesis: Wata girgizar ƙasa mai karanci ta tashi a yankin yammacin jihar Montana a ranar Litinin, lokacin da aka kai 10:08 na daren.

translations.source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.reference: Babu wani rahoto game da lalacewa nan take da Nazarin Yanayin Kasa na Amurka (USGS) da kuma Cibiyar Bayar da Bayani game da Girgizar Kasa suka samu.
translations.hypothesis: Har yanzu, ba a samu wata rahoton lalacewa ba da ta zo zuwa ga Ma'aikatar Nazarin ƙasa ta Amurka (USGS) da kuma Cibiyar Shirye-shiryen Bayan Tausayi ta kasa.

translations.source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.reference: Girgizar kasar ta fi kamari ne a tsakanin kilomita 20 (wato mil 15) a arewacin arewa maso gabas da kuma kimanin kilomita 65 (wato mil 40) kudu da Buttle.
translations.hypothesis: Jirgin ruwa (earthquake) ya faru ne kusan km 20 (mai mil 15) arewa-gabas na Dillon, kuma kusan km 65 (mai mil 40) kudu na Butte.

translations.source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.reference: Nau’in cutar murar tsuntsaye mai hadari ta H5N1, an tabbatar ita ce ta kama agwagwar daji wadda aka samu ranar lahadi a wani surkuki kusa da garin Lyon da ke gabashin Faransa.
translations.hypothesis: Cutarsa ta cutar tashi mai hatsari ga mutane, wato H5N1, an tabbatar cewa ta kamuwa wata kura mai yawan ruwa da ta mutu, wacce aka samu a ranar Litinin, a wani yanki mai ruwa kusa da birnin Lyon a arewa maso gabas na Faransa.

translations.source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.reference: Faransa ce kasa ta bakwai a cikin Tarayyar Turai da ke fama da wannan cutar; sun bi Austria, Jamus, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Girka da Italiya.
translations.hypothesis: Faransa ita ce kasa ta bakwai a cikin Kungiyar Turai da ta kamu da wannan cuta; bayan Austria, Jamus, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Girisa da Italiya.

translations.source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.reference: Har yanzu ba’a tabbatar da yawan mutane da ake zargi da kamuwa da H5N1 a Croatia da Denmark.
translations.hypothesis: Lamarin cutar H5N1 da ake tuhma a kasar Croatia da Denmark har yanzu ba a tabbatar ba.

translations.source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.reference: Chambers ta yi karan Ubangiji saboda “yaɗuwar mutuwa ko’ina, halakawa da ta’addanci akan miliyoyin mutanen duniya.”
translations.hypothesis: Chambers ya shigar wani shari da ya yi wa Allah tuhuma saboda "mutuwar mutane da dama, lalacewar abubuwa, da kuma tsoro da ya shiga zuciyar miliyoyin mutanen duniya."

translations.source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.reference: Majalisa, wani bafulatani, ya bayar da hujjar cewa karar shi “ba ta da kyau” kuma “kowa na iya tuhumar wani.”
translations.hypothesis: Chambers, wanda ba shi da imani na addini, ya ce shari'ar da ya shigar "ba ta da wata ma'ana" kuma "kowa zai iya shigar shari'a da kowa."

translations.source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.reference: Labarin da Camille Saint-Saenstar ya gabatar a wasan dandamali na Faransa,na wani shahararren mai fasaha ne wanda “wanda rayuwarsa ta ta’allaka kan soyayyarsa da kwaya da kasar Japan”
translations.hypothesis: Wannan labarin da aka gabatar a cikin opera na Faransa, wanda Camille Saint-Saens ya shirya, ya yi magana ne game da wani ɗan adana "wanda rayuwarsa ta ƙarƙice ne ta son shan miya da kuma ƙasar Japan."

translations.source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.reference: A sakamakon haka, masu wasan kan sha tabar wiwi akan dandamalin wasan, kuma shi kansa gidan wasan yana baiwa masu kallo ƙarfin guiwar yin haka.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da haka, masu wasan suna shan sigari na cannabis a kan wajen wasa, kuma gidan wasan yana ƙarfafa masu kallo su shiga cikin wannan al'ada.

translations.source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.reference: Tsohon kakakin majalisar Newt Gingrich, gwamnan Texas Rick Perry, da uwargidan majalisar wakilai, Michele Bachmann sun gama a mataki na hudu, na biyar, da na shida, bi da bi.
translations.hypothesis: Tsohon shugaban majalisar wakilai, Newt Gingrich, gwamnan jihar Texas, Rick Perry, da memba majalisar wakilai, Michele Bachmann, sun zo a matsayin na huɗu, na biyar, da na shida, bi da bi.

translations.source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.reference: Bayan sakamakon ya shigo, Gingrich ya yaba wa Santorum, amma yana da kalmomi masu wuya ga Romney, wanda a madadinsa aka gabatar da tallan kamfe mara kyau a Iowa da Gingrich.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan sakamakon zabe ya fito, Gingrich ya yaba wa Santorum, amma ya yi magana mai tsauri game da Romney, wanda ake ta fitar da wasu abubuwan ban tsoro a jere a jihar Iowa game da Gingrich, a madadinsa.

translations.source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.reference: Perry ya fadi cewa zai “dawo Texas domin tantance sakamakon caucus na daren nan, in tantance ko akwai ko akwai alaman ci gaba man a wannan tsere”, amma daga baya ya ce zai ci gaba da tseren sannan ya yi gasan fid da gwani ran 21 ga Janairu a South Carolina.
translations.hypothesis: Perry ya bayyana cewa zai "komawa Texas don duba sakamakon zaben da aka yi yau, kuma ya ƙayyade ko akwai hanya da za ta bawa shi damar ci gaba a wannan takarar," amma daga baya ya ce zai ci gaba da takara kuma ya shiga zaben farko da za a yi a ranar 21 ga Janairu a jihar South Carolina.

translations.source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: Bachmann, wanda ya lashe zaben Ames Straw Poll a watan Agusta, ya yanke shawarar kawo karshen kamfen din ta.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann, wacce ta lashe zaben farko na Ames a watan Agusta, ta yanke shawarar ƙare yakin ta.

translations.source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.reference: An mayar da mai daukan hoton zuwa asibitin Ronarld Reagan UCLA Medical Center, inda ya mutu.
translations.hypothesis: An yi jigilar mai hoto zuwa asibitin Ronald Reagan na jami'ar UCLA, inda ya mutu a nan gaba.

translations.source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.reference: An ruwaito cewa yana cikin shekaran sa na 20 ne. A cikin wata sanarwa, Bieber ya ce “duk da ya ke ba na wurin kuma ba ni da hannu kai tsaye cikin wannan mummunan hadarin, tunani da addu'o’ina suna tare da dangin waɗanda abin ya rutsa da su.”
translations.hypothesis: An bayyana cewa yana da shekaru ashirin zuwa ashirin da uku. A wata sanarwa, Bieber ya ce, "[d]uk da cewa ba na nan ba ko kuma na shiga cikin wannan lamarin mai kaushi, raɗaɗin da addu'o'i na suna tare da iyalansa."

translations.source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.reference: Shagin yanar-gizo na labarun nishaɗi na TMZ ya fahimta cewa mai ɗaukar hoto ɗin ya tsayar da motsarsa a tsallaken titin Sepulveda Boulevard kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin ɗaukar hotuna na tsayawar ƴan sanda kafin ya tsallaka titin kuma ya ci gaba, wanda ya sa ɗan sanda na Sintirin Babbar Hanya ta California wanda yake ba da hannu ya umarce shi ya koma a ƙetare, sau biyu.
translations.hypothesis: Shirin TMZ, wanda ke bugawa labarai game da nishaɗi, ya bayyana cewa hoton ya tsaya motarsa a gefen biyu na babbar hanya ta Sepulveda Boulevard, kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin ɗaukar hotunan yadda jiran motocin 'yan sandan ke gudana, kafin ya wuce hanya kuma ya ci gaba. Wannan ya sa ɗan sandan da ke kula da zirga-zirgar motoci ya umarce shi da ya koma gefen da ya fito, sau biyu.

translations.source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.reference: Bisa ga fadin yan sanda, direban motan da ya buge mai hoton na iya fuskantan zargin aikata laifi.
translations.hypothesis: A cewar 'yan sanda, yuwane ba za a tuhar da direban motar da ta ramarda gwarzon hoton ba da laifin laifi.

translations.source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.reference: Da lambobin yabo goma sha takwas kacal da ake da su a rana, kasashe da dama sun gaza kaiwa ga dandamalin bada lambar yabo.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da cewa akwai medals goma da goma a kowanne yau, wasu ƙasashe sun kasa samun damar samun medals.

translations.source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.reference: Sun hada da Netherlands, yayin da Anna Jochemsen ta kammala a ta tara a jerin ajin mata a Super-G jiya, da Finland yayin da Katja ke kammalawa a na goma duk a bikin.
translations.hypothesis: Sun haɗa Holland, inda Anna Jochemsen ta zo a matsayin na tara a cikin rukin mata na masu tsayawa a gasar Super-G da aka yi jiya, da kuma Finlandiya, inda Katja Saarinen ta zo a matsayin na goma a cikin wannan gasar.

translations.source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Mitchell Gourley na Ostiraliya ya gama na goma sha ɗaya a cikin tsayuwar Super-G na maza. Ɗan gasar Czech Oldrich Jelinek ya gama na goma sha shida a cikin Super-G na zaunen maza.
translations.hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley, wanda yake daga kasar Australia, ya zo matsayi na goma da goma a gasar Super-G ta maza. Dama haka, Oldrich Jelinek, wanda yake daga kasar Czech, ya zo matsayi na goma da shida a gasar Super-G ta maza.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez na kasar Mexico ya ƙare a matsayin na goma sha biyar a jerin Super-G na maza na zaune. Adam Hall na New Zealand ya ƙare a matsayin na tara a Suƙer-G na maza na tsaye.
translations.hypothesis: Arly Velasquez daga ƙasar Mexico ta zo ta goma sha biyar a gasar Super-G ta maza masu amfani da kujera. Adam Hall daga ƙasar New Zealand ya zo ta tara a gasar Super-G ta maza masu tsaye.

translations.source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Mazaje na Poland masu fama da rashin gani a wasan ƙwallon ƙafa Maciej Krezel da jagorar Anna Ogarzynska sun gama na goma sha uku a gasar Super-G. Jong Seork Park na Koriya ta Kudu ya kammala na ashirin da huɗu a gasar maza ta Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Mai tsere-tsere na kasar Poland, Maciej Krezel, da jagorarsa, Anna Ogarzynska, sun zo matsayi na goma sha uku a gasar Super-G. Mai tsere-tsere na kasar Kudancin Koriya, Jong Seork Park, ya zo matsayi na ashirin da hudu a gasar Super-G ta maza.

translations.source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.reference: Ana tuhumar ma'aikatun majalisar dinkin duniya da suka zo Haiti bayan girgizar kasar shekarar2010 da yada cutuka wayenda suka fara ne daga kusa da mazaunar su.
translations.hypothesis: Sojojin zaman lafiya na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, waɗanda suka zo Haiti bayan girgizar ƙasa ta shekarar 2010, ana zargin su ne da yaduwar cutar wacce ta fara ne kusa da wurin da sojojin suka zauna.

translations.source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.reference: A cewar karar, ba a tsaftace bata daga zangon UN kamar yadda ya kamata ba, ya haddasa kwayoyin cuta shigan ruwa wadda yake kwarara cikin Rafin Artibonite, daya daga ciki babba a Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: A cewar karar da aka shigar, danyen da aka fitar daga sansanin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ba a tsaftace shi yadda ya kamata, wanda ya haifar da fitowar bakteriya zuwa ga wata babbar hanya ta kogin Artibonite, wanda yake daya daga cikin manyan kogaye a Haiti.

translations.source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Kafin isowar sojoji, Haiti bata taba fuskantar matsalolin da suka shafi cutar ba tun a shekarun 1800s.
translations.hypothesis: Kafin sauyin sojoji, Haiti ba ta fuskanci matsala da suka shafi wannan cutar ba tun shekarar 1800.

translations.source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: Cibiyar Tabbatar da Adalci da Demokradiyya ta ƙasar Haiti ta nakalto waɗansu ayyukan nazari masu zaman kansu waɗanda ke tsammanin bataliyar kiyaye zaman lafiya ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya da ke Nepal ce ta kawo cutar Haiti bisa rashin sani.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar Haitian ta wajen Tsarin Shari'a da Dimokradiya ta ambato wasu bincike masu dogaro waɗanda suka nuna cewa rundunar sojojin hadin gwiwar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta Nepal, ba tare da sanin ba, ta kawo cutar zuwa Haiti.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, ƙwararriyar masaniyar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya kan cutar, ta bayyana cewa mai yiyuwa ne sojojin kiyaye zaman lafiya suka haifar da cutar.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, wata masaniyar kungiyar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya game da wannan cuta, ta bayyana cewa, wataƙila juyin cutar ya faru ne sakamakon ayyukan sojojin da ke kula da zaman lafiya.

translations.source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.reference: Hamilton ya tabbatar da Asibitin Jami'ar Howard ya ba da haƙuri a cikin kwanciyar hankali.
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton ya tabbatar cewa asibitin Jami'ar Howard ya karbi mararin gaba a matsayin mai lafiya.

translations.source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.reference: Marar lafiyar ya je Najeriya, inda aka samu wasu sun kamu da cutar ta Ebola.
translations.hypothesis: Marzin yana da tarihi zuwa Najeriya, inda wasu lamari na cutar Ebola suka faru.

translations.source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: Asibitin ta bi ka’idoji na kula da kamuwa da cuta, tare da raba masu jiyya daga sauran jama’a domin hana yaduwan cutan.
translations.hypothesis: Asibitin ya bi dukkanin dokoki da suka dace don hana yaduwar cuta, wanda ya haɗa da keɓancewar mararin daga sauran mutane don hana yaduwar cuta zuwa ga wasu.

translations.source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.reference: Kafin Simpsons Simon ya yi aiki a kan shirye-shirye da yawa a wurare daban-daban.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan mutumin da ake kira Simon, kafin ya shiga shirin The Simpsons, ya yi aiki a wasu shirye-shirye daban-daban a matsayin da dama.

translations.source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: A lokacin 1980s yayi aiki a kan shirye-shirye kamar Taxi, Cheers, da The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarun 1980, ya yi aiki a shirye-shirye kamar Taxi, Cheers, da kuma The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.reference: A cikin 1989 ya taimaka ƙirƙirar Simpsons tare da Brooks da Groening, kuma shi ke da alhakin ɗaukar ƙungiyar masu rubutu na farko.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1989, ya taimaka wajen ƙirƙirar wasan kwaikwayo na "The Simpsons" tare da Brooks da Groening, kuma shi ne wanda ya yi aiki na daukar kungiyar rubutu ta farko da ta yi a wasan.

translations.source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.reference: Duk da barin wasan shirin a 1993 an cigaba da kiransa shugaban shiri, kuma ya cigaba da karbar miliyoyin daloli a kowace kaka na kamasho.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake ya bar shirin a shekarar 1993, ya ci gaba da rike matsayin shugaba na samarwa, kuma ya ci gaba da samun miliyoyin daloli a kowace shekara a matsayin kuɗi.

translations.source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.reference: Tun farko kamfanin dillacin labarai na China Xinhua ya ba da rahoton wani jirgin da aka sace.
translations.hypothesis: A baya, jaridar Xinhua ta kasar Sin ta rahoto cewa an yi awon gaba da wata jirgin sama.

translations.source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.reference: Rahotanni daga baya sun nuna cewa an yi wa jirgin barazanar harin bam, sannan aka karkatar da shi zuwa Afghanistan, inda ya sauka a Kandahar.
translations.hypothesis: Daga baya, rahotannin sun bayyana cewa jirgin ya samu barazanar ta bomba, don haka aka mayar da shi zuwa Afghanistan, inda ya sauka a birnin Kandahar.

translations.source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.reference: Rahotannin farko sun ce an juya akalar jirgin zuwa Afghanistan bayan an hana shi saukar gaggawa a Ürümqi.
translations.hypothesis: Rahoto na farko ya nuna cewa jirgin ya koma Afghanistan bayan da aka kiye masa izinin saukar da gaggawa a birnin Ürümqi.

translations.source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.reference: Hadarin jirgin sama ya zama ruwan dare a Iran, sakamakon tsoffin jirage wadanda ba a kula da su na ayyukan farar hula da sojoji.
translations.hypothesis: Haɗarin jiragen sama ya kasance abu na yau da kullum a Iran, wanda ya yi da jiragen da suka fi shekaru kuma ba a kula da su yadda ya kamata, ko ga ayyukan farauta da na sojoji.

translations.source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.reference: Takunkumin ƙasa da ƙasa na nufin ba za a iya sayan sabon jirgin sama ba.
translations.hypothesis: Sanƙoƙin ƙasa da kasa sun nuna cewa ba za a iya siyan sababbin jiragen sama ba.

translations.source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.reference: A farkon makon nan ne, wani jirgi mai saukar ungulu na yan sanda ya yi hadari inda mutane uku suka rasa rayukansu yayinda wasu ukun su ka jikkata.
translations.hypothesis: A farkon wannan mako, wani jirgin sama na 'yan sanda da ya fashe ya kashe mutane uku kuma ya jefa wasu uku a asirce.

translations.source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.reference: Watan da ta gabata Iran ta fuskanci bala’i mafi tsanani a shekaru da wata jirgin sama da ke hanyar zuwa Armenia ta fadi, ta kashe duka mutane 168 da ke ciki.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan watan da ya wuce, Iran ta fuskanci mummunan lamari a fannin sufurin sama a cikin shekaru, lokacin da jirgin sama wanda ke zuwa kasar Armenia ya fashe, lamarin da ya yi sanadin mutuwar mutane 168 da ke cikin jirgin.

translations.source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.reference: A dai wannan watan ne wani jirgin saman ya kauce daga kan titin da jirgi yake tafiya a kai kafin tsahinsa a Mashad inda ya bugi wata katanga, tare da kashe mutum sha bakwai.
translations.hypothesis: A watan da aka yi wannan lamarin, wani jirgin sama mai daukar fasinjoji ya fita hanya a filin saukar jirgin sama na Mashhad, ya buga bangon gida, kuma mutane goma sabu'in su suka mutu.

translations.source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.reference: Aerosmith sun soke sauran kade-kade a yawon shakatawansu.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar Aerosmith ta dakatar da dukkan wasanni da suka rage a cikin tafiyar su.

translations.source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.reference: Ƙungiyar makaɗan rock za ta fara yawon kaɗe-kaɗe a Amurka da Canada har zuwa 16 ga Satumba.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar mawaƙa ta da shiri na zuwa Amurka da Kanada don yi wa wasanni har zuwa ranar 16 ga watan Satumba.

translations.source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.reference: Sun soke yawon shakatawa bayan fitaccen mawaƙi Steven Tyler ya ji rauni bayan ya faɗo daga fage yayin wasan a ranar 5 ga watan Agusta.
translations.hypothesis: Sun dakatar da tafiyar ta saboda mai rike da murɗin waƙa, Steven Tyler, ya jikkata bayan ya fadi daga matsayin da yake yi a wajen wani taron da ya yi a ranar 5 ga watan Agusta.

translations.source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.reference: Murray ya rasa saiti na farko a bugun tazara bayan duka maza sun rike kowane mai hidimtawa a cikin saitin.
translations.hypothesis: Murray ya yi rashin nasara a wasan farko, inda suka tashi tsakiyar wasan, bayan dukansu biyu sun yi nasara a kowane lokacin da suka yi hidima a wasan.

translations.source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.reference: Del Potro ya samu riba a sa na biyu, amma wannan shima na bukatan tie break bayan an kai 6-6.
translations.hypothesis: Del Potro ya samu damar farko a wasan na biyu, amma wannan ma ya bukaci wasan daidaito bayan da suka kai ga ci 6-6.

translations.source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.reference: Potro ya sami kulawa a kafadarsa a wannan lokacin amma ya sami nasarar komawa wasan.
translations.hypothesis: A wani lokaci, Potro ya samu magani ga raunin da ya samu a gefensa, amma ya yi ƙoƙari ya koma cikin wasan.

translations.source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: An fara shirin da karfe 8:30 na yamma (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar ta fara a karfe 8:30 na yamma, bisa ga lokacin gida (15:00 UTC).

translations.source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.reference: Shahararun mawaka a faɗin ƙasar sun gabatar da bhajans, ko wakokin ibada, zuw ga kafafun Shri Sham.
translations.hypothesis: Manyan mawakan daga ko'in kasar sun yi waƙoƙin addini, wanda ake kira da "bhajans," don girmama Shri Shyam.

translations.source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Mawaki Sarju Sharma, shi ya fara a maraicen sannan sai Shankar Choudhary ya biyo baya da Chhappan Bhog Bhajan ya biyo su. Mawaki, Raju Khandelwal yana raka shi.
translations.hypothesis: Mawaƙin Sanju Sharma ya fara taron, sannan mawaƙin Jai Shankar Choudhary ya ci gaba. Ya kuma yi waƙar "chhappan bhog". Mawaƙin Raju Khandelwal yana taimaka masa.

translations.source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.reference: Sannan, sai Lakkha Singh ya yi jagora a rera waƙar bhajans.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan haka, Lakkha Singh ya fara jagorancin rera waƙoƙin bhajans.

translations.source: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.reference: Farantai 108 na Chhappan Bhog (a Indiyanci, kayan abinci daban-daban gud 56, kamar, Alewa, ƴaƴan itace, masu kwanso, abinci da sauran su waɗanda aka bayar ga abin bauta) ga Baba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: Abin da aka shirya don Baba Shyam ya ƙunshi plates 108 na "Chhappan Bhog," wanda a cikin addinin Hinduun, yana nufin abinci mai nau'i 56 daban-daban, kamar su kayan abinci masu zaki, 'ya'ya, kwalaye, da sauran abinci, waɗanda ake hidimta ga mai tsarki.

translations.source: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh ya kuma gabatar da Chhappan Bhog Bhajan. Singer da Raju Khandelwal yana rakiyarsa.
translations.hypothesis: Lakkha Singh ya shirya waɗannan waƙoƙin "chhappan bhog" kuma. Mawaƙin, Raju Khandelwal, ya yi tare da shi.

translations.source: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.reference: A lokacin gabatar da babban bayani na ranar Alhamis a Nunin Wasan Tokyo, shugaban Nintendo Satoru Iwata ya kaddamar da tsarin sarrafawa na sabuwar na’urar Nintendo Re volution.
translations.hypothesis: A wajen taron baje kolin da aka yi a ranar Alhamis a taron wasan bidiyo na Tokyo, shugaban kamfanin Nintendo, Satoru Iwata, ya nuna yadda ake amfani da na'urorin kontrolin da za a yi amfani da su a sabon kwamfutar wasan bidiyo ta kamfanin, wacce ake kira Nintendo Revolution.

translations.source: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.reference: Kamar makunnin talabijin, makunnin abun yana amfani da sanser biyu da aka jona kusa da talabijin din don a iya gane inta take.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan na'urar, wanda ke kama irin na'urar sarrafa talabijin, tana amfani da masu gano biyu waɗanda ake saka kusa da talabijin na mai amfani don tantance matsayin nata a cikin sararin hanya.

translations.source: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.reference: Wannan zai bai wa masu wasannin bidiyo damar sarrafa wasan ta hanyar motsi da na’urar a cikin iska.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan zai ba wa 'yan wasa damar sarrafa ayyuka da motsin jiki a cikin wasan bidiyo ta hanyar motsa na'urar a cikin iska.

translations.source: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.reference: Motar Giancarlo Fisichella ta kwace masa inda hakan ya jawo fitarsa daga tseren jim kaɗan bayan farawa.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella ya rasa kontrolin motarsa kuma ya ƙare gasar ne da zarar ta fara.

translations.source: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.reference: Abokin wasansa Fernando Alonso shi ne kan gaba a mafi wasane, amma ya tsaya bayan dakatawar zango, watakila saboda lanƙwashewar wilin tayar gaba na ɓangaren dama ne.
translations.hypothesis: Abokin wasansa, Fernando Alonso, ya kasance a gaba na tsawon wasan, amma ya ƙare wasan da zarar ya yi tsayina don gyara motarsa, wanda hakan na iya faruwa ne saboda wata matsala da ta shiga cikin gurbin gaba na hannun dama.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ya gama tserensa ba da daɗewa ba bayan Alonso, saboda lalacewar dakatarwa a yaƙe-yaƙe da yawa yayin tseren.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher ya ƙare gasansa ba da daɗi bayan Alonso, saboda lalacewar sashi a wani ɓangare, wanda ya faru ne sakamakon wasanni da suka faru a lokacin gasar.

translations.source: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.reference: “Tana da kyau sannan tana waka da kyau, kuma,” ya bayana bisa ga kwafi na taron masu yada labaru.
translations.hypothesis: "Ta da kyau sosai kuma tana rera waƙa da kyau," in ji shi, kamar yadda aka rubuta a wani bayani da aka yi a taron manema labarai.

translations.source: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.reference: “An motsa ni kowane lokacin da muke yin maimaitawa kan wannan, daga cikin zuciya ta.”
translations.hypothesis: "Kowane lokacin da muka yi horo game da wannan, zuciyata ta cika da jin dadin, daga zurfin zuciyata."

translations.source: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.reference: Kimanin mintuna 3 da harba jirgin, na’urara daukan hoton da ke ciki ta nuna yadda wani soson kariya ya balle daga jikin tankin mai.
translations.hypothesis: Kusan minti uku bayan fara fitowar jirgin, kamera da ke cikin jirgin ta nuna wasu fursanan da ake amfani da su don karewa sun fita daga tankin man fetur.

translations.source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.reference: Duk da haka, ba'a tunanin cewa sun haifar da wata ɓarna ga abin sufurin.
translations.hypothesis: Koyaya, ba a yi tunanin cewa sun hada wani cutarwa ga jirgin.

translations.source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.reference: Babban jami'in shirin rufe jirgin NASA, N. Wayne Hale Jr. ya ce kumburin ya fadi “bayan lokacin da muke damuwa.”
translations.hypothesis: Shugaban kungiyar jiragen ruwa ta NASA, N. Wayne Hale Jr., ya ce cakarkuwar da ta fadu ta fada "bayan lokacin da muke damuwa da shi."

translations.source: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.reference: Mintuna biyar da fara nunin wata iska ya fara shigowa ciki, kusan minti daya daga baya, iskar ta doshi 70km/h... daga baya ruwan sama yazo, amma da yawa da ƙarfinsa ya sauko yadda zai bugi fatarka kamar allura, saannan wani kankara ya fado daga sama, mutane suna firgita suna kururuwa suna tattake juna.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan minti biyar na nuna abubuwa, iska ta fara fitowa, kuma kusan minti ɗaya bayan haka, iskar ta kai saurin kilomita 70... sannan ruwan sama ya fara sauyawa, amma ne mai ƙarfi sosai da kuma girma sosai, har ya kunna farji kamar ƙungiyar. Sannan, ƙanƙara ta fado daga sama, mutane sun damu suka fara kuka da tsalle, suna tsallake juna.

translations.source: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.reference: Na rasa yar uwata tare da kawarta, kuma a hanya na gamu da wasu nakasassu biyu a kan keke, jama’a suna ta tsallake su tare da tura su,” inji Armand Versace.
translations.hypothesis: "Na rasa uwata da abokiyar ta, kuma a hanyar da nake, akwai mutane biyu masu ciwon jiki suna zaune a kan kujerar motsa jiki, kuma mutane suna tsalle da kuma d'aurawa su," inace Armand Versace.

translations.source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.reference: NHK ta kuma ruwaito cewa masana’antar samar da makamashin nukiliya ta Kashiwazaki Kariwa a gundumar Niigata tana aiki yadda yakamata.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar NHK ta kuma bayyana cewa anajin aiki da masana'antar wutar lantarki ta nukliya ta Kashiwazaki Kariwa, wacce ke jihar Niigata, a yadda ya kamata.

translations.source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: Kamfanin Hokuriku Electric Power Co. ya ba da rahoton babu wata illa daga girgizar kasar kuma an rufe matatar mai lamba 1 da 2 a tashar makamashin nukiliyar ta Shika.
translations.hypothesis: Kamfanin Hokuriku Electric Power ya bayyana cewa ba su ji wani mummunan tasiri daga girgizar ƙasa ba, kuma an rufe makamin wutar nukliya na Shika, wanda ya ƙunshi makamin wutar mai lamba 1 da 2.

translations.source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.reference: An ba da rohoto cewa gidaje 9400 a yankin ba su da ruwa sannan kusan 100 ba su da lantarki.
translations.hypothesis: An bayyana cewa akwai gidaje kimanin 9,400 a wannan yanki da ba su da ruwa, kuma akwai kimanin 100 waɗanda ba su da wutar lantarki.

translations.source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.reference: Wasu hanyoyi sun lalace, al'amuran jirgin kasa ya katse a wuraren da abin ya shafa, kuma Filin jirgin saman Noto da ke yankin Ishikawa ya kasance a rufe.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu hanyoyi sun lalace, ayyukan jiragen ƙasa sun tsaya a yankin da ya shafi, kuma tashar jirgin sama ta Noto a jihar Ishikawa har yanzu ta rufe.

translations.source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.reference: Wani bam ɗaya ya fashe a wajen ofishin gwamna-janar.
translations.hypothesis: Wata babbar makamin fashewa ta fashe a wajen ofishin gwamnan.

translations.source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.reference: Karin Bama-bamai uku sun fashe kusa a gine-ginen gwamnati a cikin tsawon sa’aoi biyu.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu bam din uku suka fashe a wajen gine-gine na gwamnati a cikin awanni biyu.

translations.source: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.reference: Wasu rahotanni sun kai adadin mutuwan zuwa takwas, kuma tabbatacciyar rahoto na tabbatar da cewa mutum 30 suka ji rauni; amma ba a san adadin ƙarshe ba.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu rahotannin sun bayyana cewa adadin mutanen da suka mutu ya kai mutane takwas, kuma rahotannin hukumomi sun tabbatar da cewa akalla mutane 30 sun jikkata; amma adadin gaba daya har yanzu bai sananniya ba.

translations.source: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.reference: Dukkanin cyanuric acid da melamine an same su ne a cikin kayan fitsari daga dabbobin gidan da suka mutu bayan sun sha gurbataccen abincin dabbobi.
translations.hypothesis: An gano sinadirin da ake kira cyanuric acid da kuma melamine a cikin samfuran fitar da jini daga dabbobin gida da suka mutu bayan cin abincin dabbobi da ya ƙunshi sinadirin.

translations.source: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.reference: Magungunan biyu suna aiki tare da juna don samar da lu'ulu'u wanda zai iya toshe aikin koda, masu bincike a jami'ar sun ce.
translations.hypothesis: Manyan masana kimiyya a jami'ar sun bayyana cewa, waɗannan abubuwa biyu suna haɗuwa kuma suna samar da ƙwayoyin da na iya hana aikin ɗan ƙungiya.

translations.source: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.reference: Masu binciken sun lura cewa kiristal sun taru a fisarin kyanwa ta hanyar karin sinadarin melanin da cyanuric.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike sun lura wani abu da ya bayyana a cikin wuya na gogayya, wanda ya faru ne ta amfani da melamine da kuma acidin cyanuric.

translations.source: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: Jumlar sanfurin gilashin suna kama da wanda aka samu a fitsarin dabbar yayin da aka kafa a na’urar infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin abubuwan da ke cikin waɗannan ƙwayoyin ya yi kama da na abubuwan da ake samu a cikin kwalben dabbobin da suka kamu da cuta, kamar yadda aka gano ta hanyar bincike da ake yi ta amfani da haske mai ƙarfi (FTIR).

translations.source: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.reference: Ban sani ba ko kun gane shi ko a'a, amma yawancin kayayyaki daga Amurka ta Tsakiya sun shigo wannan ƙasa ba tare da biyan haraji ba.
translations.hypothesis: Bana da tabbacin ko kun san ko ma ba, amma mafi yawan kayayyakin da ke zuwa daga Amurka ta Tsakiya sun shigo cikin wannan ƙasar ba tare da biyan haraji ba.

translations.source: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.reference: Duk da haka kashi tamanin cikin kayan mu sun samu haraji a kasashen Amurka ta tsakiya. Zamu kula da kai.
translations.hypothesis: Koy yaya, kashi ashirin bisa dari na abubuwanmu ana biyan haraji a kasashe masu alaƙa da Amurka ta Tsakiya. Muna yi maka.

translations.source: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.reference: Na kasa fahimtar abin, hakika babu adalci a ciki.
translations.hypothesis: Abin da ya faru bai yi ma ni ma'ana ba; ba daidai ba ne.

translations.source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.reference: Kawai abin da na ke ce wa mutane shine ku bi da mu yadda muke bi da ku.
translations.hypothesis: Abin da nake cewa ga mutane shine: ku yi mana yadda muku suka yi mana.

translations.source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.reference: Gwamnan California Arnold Schwarzenegger ya sanya hannu a cikin wata doka da ta hana sayarwa ko hayar wasannin bidiyo mai tashin hankali ga ƙananan yara.
translations.hypothesis: Gwamnan jihar California, Arnold Schwarzenegger, ya sanya doka wacce ta hana sayar da ko kuma aika wa yara masu shekaru 18 da ƙasa wasannin bidiyo masu karfi.

translations.source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.reference: Dokar na bukatar a sanya wa wasannin bidiyo na tashin hankali da ake sayarwa a jihar California alama da ke nuna “18” inda ya zamo sayar da su ga kananan yara laifi ne mai jawo hukuncin tarar $1000 a kowane laifi.
translations.hypothesis: Dokokin da aka kafa sun dage cewa wasannin bidiyo masu rikitar da tashin hankali da ake sayarwa a jihar California dole ne a saka musu alama mai dauke da lambar "18", kuma sayar da irin waɗannan wasanni ga wanda bai kai shekaru 18 ba zai haɗa da biyan atafi na dala 1000 a kowanne laifi.

translations.source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.reference: Darektan gabatar da kara na hukumar, Kier Starmer QC, a safiyar yau ya sanar da gurfanar da mutanen biyu, Huhne da Pryce, a gaban shari’a.
translations.hypothesis: Shugaban Ofishin Shari'a, Kier Starmer QC, ya fitar da wata sanarwa a yau biki da ya bayyana cewa za a shigar da tuhar da Huhne da Pryce a gaban kotu.

translations.source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.reference: Huhne ya yi murabus kuma za a maye gurbinsa a Majalisar da Dan Majalisa Ed Davey. Ana tsammanin Dan Majalisa Norman Lamb zai zama Ministan Kasuwanci aikin da Job Davey zai ajiye.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne ya yi murabus, kuma Ed Davey, wanda memba ne na majalisar, zai maye gurbinsa a majalisar ministocin. An yi tsammanin Norman Lamb, wanda shi ma memba ne na majalisar, zai maye gurbin Davey a matsayin ministan harkokin kasuwanci.

translations.source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.reference: Huhne da Pryce an shirya za su bayyana a Kotun Majistare ta Westminster a ranar 16 ga Fabrairu.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne da Pryce za su fito a gaban kotun masu shari'a ta Westminster a ranar 16 ga watan Fabrairu.

translations.source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.reference: Wandanda suka rasu sun hada da Nicholas Alden dan shekara 25, da Zachary Cuddeback mai shekara 21. Cuddeback ya kasance mai tukin.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen da suka mutu sun kasance Nicholas Alden, shekaru 25, da Zachary Cuddeback, shekaru 21. Kuddeback shi ne sojan motar.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla ya sami raunuka a hannusa da muƙamuƙi yayin da aka bar Kristoffer Schneider yana buƙatar tiyata ta gyaran fuskar sa.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla ya samu rauni a hannunsa da kuma fuskarsa, yayin da Kristoffer Schneider ya samu rauni da ya sa ya buƙaci a yi masa aikin gyara fuskarsa.

translations.source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.reference: Makamin Uka ya kasa yayin da yake auna kan mutum na biyar. Schneider na da raɗaɗi da ke gudana, makanta a ido daya, wani bangaren ƙoƙon kai da ya ɓata da fuska da aka sake ginawa daga titanium.
translations.hypothesis: An yi amfani da makamin Uka, amma ya lalace yayin da yake nuni zuwa kai na mutum na biyar. Schneider yana fama da ciwon jiki, ya yi nakaci a daya daga cikin idon sa, wani ɓangare na kansa ya fita, kuma fuskarsa ta sake gina ta ta amfani da ƙarfe.

translations.source: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.reference: Schneider ya ba da shaida ta wurin video link daga tashar USAF a kasarsa na haihuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Schneider ya bayyana gaskiya ta hanyar tattaunawa ta bidiyo daga wani sansanin sojojin Amurka da ke cikin ƙasar sa.

translations.source: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.reference: Bayan abubuwan da suka faru a ranar Laraba, Carpanedo ya yi gasa a tsere guda biyu a wasannin neman zakara.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan taron da ya gudana a ranar Laraba, Carpanedo ya shiga gasa a wasanni biyu na mutum daya a gasar ta.

translations.source: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.reference: Na farko ita ce Slalom, inda ta samu nasarar Ba ta inarshe ba a wasanninta na farko. 36 daga cikin gasa 116 sun sami irin wannan sakamakon a wannan tseren.
translations.hypothesis: Wani daga cikin gasa da ta shiga shi ne na "Slalom," inda ta samu sakamakon "ba ta yi ƙare ba" a zagayen farko. Daga cikin masu takawa na mutum 116, mutum 36 sun samu irin wannan sakamako a wancan gasa.

translations.source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.reference: Sauran tseren nata, Giant Slalom, ta ga ta gama a matsayi na goma a rukunin mata tare da saurin gudu na 4: 41.30, 2: 11.60 a hankali fiye da na farkon da ta kammala mai Austrian Claudia Loesch da minti 1: 09.02 a hankali fiye da na tara. Gyöngyi Dani na Hungary.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan wasan, wanda ake kira "Giant Slalom," ya kasance na gaba, kuma ta samu matsayi na goma a cikin rukin mata da ke amfani da kujera, inda ta samu lokaci na dakika 4:41.30. Wannan lokaci ya fi na wanda ta lashe gasar, wacce ita ce Claudia Loesch daga Austria, da dakika 2:11.60, kuma ya fi na wanda ta zo a matsayi na goma, wacce ita ce Gyöngyi Dani daga Hungary, da dakika 1:09.02.

translations.source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.reference: Hudu daga cikin masu tsere a kungiyar mata sun gaza kamala gudu, kuma 45 a cikin 117 masu tsere a Giant Slalom sun kasa samun nasara a tseren.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu mata huɗu da ke cikin rukin wasan ski na mata, ba su kammala wasan ba, kuma daga cikin wasu mutane 117 da suka shiga wasan ski na "Giant Slalom," wasu 45 ba su samu matsayi a cikin gasar ba.

translations.source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.reference: ‘Yan sandan Madhya Pradesh sun karbo laptop da wayar hannu da aka sace.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar 'yan sanda ta Madhya Pradesh ta sake samun kwamfutar da aka sata da wayar salula.

translations.source: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.reference: D K Arya, mataimakin Sufeto Janar ya ce, “Mun kama mutane biyar da suka yi wa yar kasar Switzerland fyade kuma an gano wayarta ta hannu da kwamfutar taa
translations.hypothesis: Wakilin Inspector Janar, D K Arya, ya ce, "Mun damke mutane biyar da suka yi lalata ga matar Swiss kuma mun kwato wayar ta ta salula da kwamfutar ta."

translations.source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: Wadanda ake zargin sun hada da Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar da Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen da ake zargin sun kasance: Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar da kuma Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.reference: Sufiritendan ‘yan sanda Chandra Shekhar Solanki ya ce wanda ake zargin ya gurfana gaban kotu - fuska rufe.
translations.hypothesis: Kakakin rundunar 'yan sanda, Chandra Shekhar Solanki, ya ce wanda ake zargin ya fito gaban kotu yana rufe fuska.

translations.source: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.reference: Kodayake mutane uku ke ciki lokacin da motar ta yi karo da gidan, amma ba wanda da ya ji rauni a cikinsu.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake mutum uku ne ke cikin gida lokacin da mota ta buga gida, babu wanda ya ji rauni.

translations.source: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.reference: Koyaya, direban yana ɗaukar munanan raunuka a kan sa.
translations.hypothesis: Koyaya, mai motar ya samu raunuka masu tsanani a kan kansa.

translations.source: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.reference: Titin da akayi hatsarin yana rufe na dan wani lokaci yayin da musa aikin gaggawa  suke ceto mutumin daga cikin jar Audi TT.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan hanya wacce abin haushi ya faru ta kasance ta rufe a wani lokaci, yayin da jami'an da suka zo don taimakawa suka ceto direban motar Audi TT mai launin ruwan kasa.

translations.source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: Da farko an kwantar da shi a asibitin James Paget da ke Great Yarmouth.
translations.hypothesis: A farko, an shigar da shi asibiti a asibitin James Paget da ke birnin Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.reference: Daga baya aka canja masa wurin zuwa Asibitin Addenbrooke wanda yake Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: Daga baya, an yi masa canja wuri zuwa asibitin Addenbrooke da ke Cambridge.

translations.source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.reference: Tuni Adekoya ke Kotun Edinburgh in da a ke tuhumarta da kashe danta.
translations.hypothesis: Adekoya tun daga lokacin na cikin kotun shari'a ta Edinburgh, inda aka zargin ta da kashe dan nata.

translations.source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.reference: Tana tsare kafin shigar da kara da kuma hukunci, amma ko wani shaidar wanda ya agni da ido zai iya zama gurbatacce saboda yadda aka yada hoton ta.
translations.hypothesis: Ta na cikin tsare-tsaren 'yan sanda, ana jiran tuhuntar ta da kuma shari'ar. Amma, wani shaidan da aka samu daga wanda ya ga abin da ya faru na iya zama mara amfani saboda hoton ta ya yi yawa a kafofin watsa labarai.

translations.source: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.reference: Wannan shi ne abin gama gari a wasu wurare a cikin Ingila amma adalci na Scottish yana aiki daban kuma kotunan suna kallon wallafa hotunan a matsayin mai yuwuwar wariya.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan hanya ce da ake amfani da ita a wasu sassa na Burtaniya, amma tsarin shari'a na Scotland ya bambanta, kuma majalisar shari'a ta yi mamakin sakon hotunan, domin hakan na iya zama abin damuwa.

translations.source: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.reference: Farfesa Pamela Ferguson na Jami'ar Dundee ta lura “ƴan jarida na ganin kamar suna tafiya ne a wani layi mai hadari idan wallafa hotuna da sauransu wadanda ake zargi.”
translations.hypothesis: Farfesa Pamela Ferguson daga Jami'ar Dundee ta ce, "maƙashin labarai suna iya shiga cikin wata matsala idan suna bugawa hotunan da suka danganci wadanda ake tuhma."

translations.source: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.reference: Ofishin gabatar da Ƙararraki, wanda ke da alhakin gabatar da tuhuma, ya bayyana wa ‘yan jarida cewa ba shi da wani bayani da zai kara har sai bayan an karbi shigar da karar.
translations.hypothesis: Ofishin Crown, wanda ke da alhakin gudanar da tuhume-tuhume, ya sanar da manema labarai cewa ba za a yi wani bayani ba, ko kuma aƙalla har zuwa lokacin da za a gabatar da tuhume.

translations.source: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.reference: Takardar, gwargwadon fallasar, za ta yi magana ne kan rikicin iyakoki, wanda Falasɗinawa ke son ya ɗora shi kan iyakokin kafin Yaƙin Gabas ta Tsakiya na 1967.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan takarda, kamar yadda aka bayyana a wani rahoton, zai yi magana game da matsalar iyakokin, wanda Palastina ke so ta hanyar amfani da iyakokin da ake da su kafin yakin da ya faru a Gabas ta Tsakiya a shekarar 1967.

translations.source: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.reference: Sauran batu da aka tattauna bisa ga fadi sun hada da Jerusalem a nan gaba wadda ke da tsarki ga al’umma biyun tare da batun Jordan Valley.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu batutu da aka ce za a yi magana a kai sun haɗa da halin da za a samu a birnin Kudus a nan gaba, wanda yake da muhimmanci ga kasashe biyu, da kuma matsalar yankin Jordan.

translations.source: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.reference: Isra'ila ta bukaci sojoji su ci gaba da kasancewa a kwarin na tsawon shekaru goma matukar an rattaba hannu yayin da hukumar falasdinawa ta amince da barin irin wannan kasancewar na tsawon shekaru biyar kacal.
translations.hypothesis: Israel na bukatar ci gaba da kasancewar sojoji a wannan yanki na tsawon shekara goma bayan an kammala yarjejeniya, yayin da kungiyar PA ta amince da barin sojoji a wannan yanki ne kawai na tsawon shekara biyar.

translations.source: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.reference: Maharba masu aikin gwajin maganin kwari, zasu kasance karkashin kulawar malaman gandun daji, yayin gwajin domin tantance ingancinsa.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen da ke amfani da makamashi a wani gwaji na kula da cututtukan noma, za a kula da su sosai ta hanyar jami'an ruwa, domin ana kallo da wannan gwajin kuma ana tantance yadda ya yi aiki.

translations.source: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.reference: A cikin haɗin gwiwar NPWS da Sportungiyar Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, an ɗauki ƙwararrun masu sa kai, a ƙarƙashin shirin wasannin kungiyar maharba.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin hadin gwiwar NPWS da kungiyar Sporting Shooters Association ta Australia (NSW) Inc, an nada masu sa kai masu ilimi, a ƙarƙashin shirin kasuwanci na kungiyar Sporting Shooters.

translations.source: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.reference: A cewar Mick O'Flynn, na'ibin Daraktan na Park Conservation da Heritage tare da NPWS, maharban guda hudu da aka zaba don aikin harbi na farko sun sami cikakken tsaro da horo.
translations.hypothesis: A cewar Mick O'Flynn, wanda yake a matsayin Mai Amshi na Sashen Kariya da Adana Muhimman Wurare a ofishin NPWS, wadanda aka zaba su guda huɗu don yin aikin wasan kwaikwayo na farko, sun samu horo da umurnin tsaro na yawa.

translations.source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.reference: Martelly ya rantsar da sabuwar Kwamitin Zabe na Wucin-gadi (CEP) mai membobi guda tara.
translations.hypothesis: Martelly ya nada sabon kwamitin zabe na kungiyar ta CEP, wanda ya ƙunshi membo goma sha biyu, jiya.

translations.source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.reference: Shi ne CEP Matelly na biyar cikin shekara hudu.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan shi ne karo na biyar da Martelly ke shiga kungiyar CEP a cikin shekaru hudu.

translations.source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.reference: A watan da ya gabata ne wani kwamiti na shugaban kasa ya ba da shawarar murabus din CEP tun gabani a matsayin bangare na kunshin daukar matakan ciyar da kasar gaba zuwa sabon zabe.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan watan da ya wuce, wata kwamitin da shugaban kasa ya kafa ta bayyana cewa ya kamata tsohon shugaban hukumar zabe ta CEP ya yi ritaya, a matsayin wani ɓangare na tsarin ayyuka da ke da nufin ja da ƙasar zuwa sabuwar zabe.

translations.source: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.reference: Kwamitin ya kasance martanin Martelly ne game da yaɗuwar zanga-zangar adawa da tsarin mulki da aka fara a watan Oktoba.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan kwamitin wani ɓangare ne na ayyukan da Shugaba Martelly ya yi don amsa matsalar yakin neman sauyin gwamnati da suka fara ne a watan Oktoba.

translations.source: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.reference: Zanga-zangar da wani lokaci suke da tashin hankali sun faru ne saboda gaza yin zaɓuɓɓuka, waɗansu lokacinsu ya wuce tun 2011.
translations.hypothesis: Wani lokaci, zanga-zangar da suka kai ga karfi sun faru ne saboda rashin gudanar da zabe, wasu daga cikinsu da aka dage tun shekarar 2011.

translations.source: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
translations.reference: An ba da rohoton iPods da ba sa aiki kusan 60 saboda yawan ɗaukar zafi, wannan ya haddasa gobara har guda shida tare da barin mutane hudu da kananan ƙuna.
translations.hypothesis: Kusan lambobi 60 na abubuwan da suka haifar da zafi a cikin na'urori masu ci gaba na iPod sun bayyana, wanda ya haifar da wuta a wurare shida kuma ya bar mutane huɗu da rauni.

translations.source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.reference: Ma’aikatar tattalin arziki, Ciniki da Masana’antu ta Japan (METI) ta ce tana sane da hatsarurruka guda 27 da ke da alaƙa da na’urorin.
translations.hypothesis: Ministarance na Tattalin Arziƙi, Kasuwanci da Masana'antu na Japan (METI) ya bayyana cewa sun san game da hatsake-hatsake 27 da suka faru dangane da waɗannan na'urori.

translations.source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.reference: A makon da ya gabata, METI ta sanar da cewa Apple ya sanar da shi wasu karin lamura masu zafi fiye da 34, wadanda kamfanin ya kira “marasa mahimmanci.”
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar da ta wuce, hukumar METI ta bayyana cewa kamfanin Apple ya sanar da su game da wasu lamari 34 na zubar da zafi, wanda kamfanin ya kalli su a matsayin "lamari mara gurnati."

translations.source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.reference: Kungiyar tsaron ta bada martani da kiran daga bayanin na Appe "abun bakin-ciki"
translations.hypothesis: Ministar ya amsa ta hanyar bayyana cewa jinkakawar da kamfanin Apple ya yi wajen fitar da rahoton "mai matuƙar damuwa."

translations.source: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.reference: Girgizan kasa ta bugi Mariana da karfe 07:19 na safe (09:19 p.m. GMT Juma’a).
translations.hypothesis: Wani girgizar ƙasa ya faru a Mariana a karon 07:19 na safiya (daga lokacin gida), watau 09:19 na daren Juma'a (daga lokacin duniya).

translations.source: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.reference: Ofishin gudanarwar da aikin gaggawa na Northern Marianas ya ce babu rohoton barna da aka samu a ƙasar.
translations.hypothesis: Ofishin kula da harkokin gaggawa na jihar Arewa ta Marianas ya bayyana cewa, babu wata lalata da aka samu a fadin kasar.

translations.source: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.reference: Haka kuma Cibiyar Fitar da Gargaɗi kan Tsunami ta yankin Pacific ta sanar da cewa babu alamar Tsunami.
translations.hypothesis: Haka nan, Cibiyar Bayar da Sanarwar Tsunamin Pacific ta bayyana cewa babu wata alama ta nuni da cewa akwai tsunami.

translations.source: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.reference: Wani tsohon dan sanda na Philippines ya tsare mutanen da ke yawon bude ido a Hong Kong ta hanyar satar motar bas din su a Manila, babban birnin Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: Wani tsohon jaje na Philippines ya yi matsalci ga yawon kai daga Hong Kong a birnin Manila, babban birnin Philippines, ta hanyar sata wa motar su.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.reference: Ronaldo Mendoza ya harba bindigarsa samfurin M16 akan ‘yan yawon shaƙatawar.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza ya harbi masu yawon bude ido da bindigar sa ta M16.

translations.source: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.reference: An ceto da dama cikin wadanda aka yi garkuwa da su din, yayin da aka tabbatar da mutuwar akalla guda shida daga cikinsu ya zuwa yanzu.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu mutane da aka yi garkama sun sami ceto, kuma a yanzu haka, akasance akalla mutane shida sun mutu.

translations.source: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.reference: An saki mutane shida da aka yi garkuwa da su, ciki har da yara da tsofaffi da wuri, da kuma masu daukar hoto na Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu mutane tara, ciki har da yara da manya, sun sami sauki a farkon lokaci, kamar yadda masu hoton da suka fito daga Philippines suka samu sauki.

translations.source: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.reference: Masu daukar hoto daga baya sun maye gurbin wata tsohuwa saboda tana bukatar dakin wankan. An bindige Mendoza.
translations.hypothesis: Daga baya, masu hoton sun maye gurbin wata mata mai shekaru da ta buƙaci ta tafi banɗaki. Mendoza ya mutu a wani hari da aka yi masa da bindiga.

translations.source: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.reference: Liggins yabi sahun baban shi ya zabi aikin likitanci.
translations.hypothesis: Liggins ya bi matsayin mahaifinsa kuma ya shiga fagen ilimin likita.

translations.source: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.reference: Ya sami horo a matsayin likitan fannin haihuwa kuma ya fara aiki a Asibitin Mata na Ƙasa da ke Auckland a shekarar 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Ya yi horo a matsayin likitan haihuwa, sannan ya fara aiki a asibitin mata na kasa a birnin Auckland a shekarar 1959.

translations.source: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.reference: A yayin da yake aiki a asibitin, liggins ya fara bincike akan yin nakuda da wurin a lokacin da baya aiki.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da yake aikin a asibiti, Liggins ya fara bincike game da haihu da ta fara da wuri a lokacin da yake da lokaci.

translations.source: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.reference: Bincikensa ya nuna cewa idan an yi amfani da maganin hormone zai hanzarta nuna kosawar huhun jaririn.
translations.hypothesis: Binciken da ya yi ya nuna cewa idan ana ba da horomon, zai sa ci gaban huhunan bayi a cikin ciki ya kasance da sauri.

translations.source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.reference: Xinhua ya bayar da rahoton cewa masu binciken gwamnati sun gano na’urorin naɗar sauti biyu na 'bakin akwatin’ ranar Laraba.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua ta bayyana cewa jami'an gwamnati sun samu da sauri wasu ƙungiyoyin da ake kira "black box" wanda ake amfani da su don adana bayanan jirgin sama, a ranar Laraba.

translations.source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.reference: Abokan kokawar Luna sun yi jimamin mutuwar ta.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu masu fafufa da kuma su, sun yi adawa da Luna.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer yace "Luna ta kasance Sarauniyar Tsaurarawa. manaja ta ta farko. Luna ta mutu ne a daren wata guda biyu. Abu na musamman kamar ita. mace mai jajircewa."
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer ya ce, "Luna ta kasance ta farko da ta samu lakabin 'Queen of Extreme'. Ta kasance manajan na farko na ni. Luna ta mutu a ranar da aka ga watanni biyu a sama. Abin da ya faru ne na musamman, kamar yadda ta kasance. Mazauniya ce mai ƙarfi."
