translations.source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.reference: Dustin “Goldust” Runnels ta yi sharhi cewa “Luna ta kasance mai rauni sosai kamar ni ... wataƙila ma fiye da haka ... ƙaunace ta zai batar da ita ... da fatan tana cikin wuri mafi kyau.”
translations.hypothesis: "Goldust" Runnels ya ce, "Luna ta kasance mai ban tsoro kamar ni...ko ma fiye...ina son ta kuma zan yi mata adawa...ina fatan ta na cikin wani wuri mai kyau."

translations.source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.reference: Daga cikin mutane 1,400 da aka jefa kuri’a gabanin zaben tarayya na 2010, wadanda ke adawa da Australia ta zama jamhuriya sun karu da kashi 8 cikin 100 tun daga shekarar 2008.
translations.hypothesis: Daga cikin mutane 1,400 da aka yi wa takaddun bincike kafin zaben tarayya na shekarar 2010, adadin wadanda suka yi adawa da Australia ta zama kasa mai mulkin gwamnati ta kasa ya karu da kashi 8 bisa dari tun shekarar 2008.

translations.source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.reference: Minista mai rikon kwarya Julia Gillard ta yi ikirarin a lokacin yakin neman zaben shekarar 2010 cewa ya yi imani Australia za ta zama jamhuriya a karshen mulkin Sarauniya Elizabeth II.
translations.hypothesis: Ministan Firaminista mai aiki, Julia Gillard, ta bayyana a lokacin yakin neman zabe na zaben tarayya na shekarar 2010 cewa ta yi imani cewa Australia ta kamata ta zama jamhuriyya bayan ƙarshen mulkin Sarkin Elizabeth II.

translations.source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.reference: kashi 34 na wadanda ke cikin jin ra’ayoyin suna da ra’ayi kamar wannan, son Sarauniya Elizabeth II ta zama mai sarauta ta karshe a Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Kashi 34 cikin dari na mutanen da suka yi wani sabuntawa sun yarda da wannan ra'ayi, kuma suna so cewa Queen Elizabeth II ta zama ta ƙarshe da za ta yi mulki a Australia.

translations.source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.reference: Jin ra’ayoyin jama’a ya nuna cewa kaso 29 na mutanen Australiya na goyon bayan zamanta jamhuriyya cikin gaggawa yayin da kaso 31 kuma ke sukar ra’ayin ta zama jamhuriya.
translations.hypothesis: A gefen kuriar da aka yi, kashi 29 cikin dari na wadanda aka tambaye sun yi ra'ayi cewa Australia ya kamata ta zama jamhuriyya cikin gaggawa, yayin da kashi 31 cikin dari suka yi ra'ayi cewa Australia bai kamata ta zama jamhuriyya ba.

translations.source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.reference: Wanda ya lashe lambar zinare a gasar Olympics ya kamata ne ya yi iyo a tseren mita 100 da 200 kuma a cikin wasanni uku a wasannin Commonwealth, amma saboda korafin da ya yi ya nuna shakku kan lafiyar sa.
translations.hypothesis: Mai lashe lambar zinare a wasan Olympics ya kamata ya yi wasan tsere-tsere a mita 100 da mita 200, kuma a wasanni uku na kungiya a gasar Commonwealth, amma saboda matsalar da yake fama da ita, ana jefa shakka akan lafiyarsa.

translations.source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.reference: Ya gaza shan magungunan da ake bukata domin shawo kan raɗaɗin da yake ji saboda an haramtawa amfani da su a Wasannin.
translations.hypothesis: Ya kasa sha magungunan da ake bukata don kawance ciwon da yake ji, domin an haramta su a wasan.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, masanin lissafi kuma farfesan kimiyyar kwamfuta a Jami'ar Missouri ta Tsakiya, ya gano lamba mafi girman da wata bata shiga cikinta da aka sani a ranar 25 ga watan Janairu.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, wanda shi ne malami a fannin lissafi da kimiyyar kwamputa a Jami'ar Tsakiyar Missouri, ya gano mafi girman adadi na prime da aka sani har zuwa yau, a ranar 25 ga Janairu.

translations.source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Mutane da yawa sun tantance abin da aka gano ta amfani da sassa da kwakwalwar na’ura daban-daban a farkon Fabrairu kuma an ba da sanarwar ranar Talata.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu mutane sun tabbatar da gano wannan abu ta amfani da kayan aiki da software daban-daban a farkon watan Fabrairu, kuma an sanar da wannan labarin a ranar Talata.

translations.source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.reference: Mai yiwuwa taurari masu wutsiya sun kasance ta cikinsu ruwan sama ke zuwa duniya tare da takin dabbobi wanda ke iya samar da kayan gina jiki domin tallafar rayuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Wadansu masanin kimiyya sun yi ikirarin cewa wasu taurari mai wuya (comets) na iya zama wani tushen ruwa da aka kai ga duniya, kuma suna da abubuwan organik da za su iya samar da furotin da kuma tallafawa rayuwa.

translations.source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.reference: Masana kimiyya suna fatan fahimtar yadda taurari suke samuwa, musamman yadda Duniya ta samu, tunda taurari masu wutsiya suka yi karo da duniya lokaci mai tsawo da ya gabata.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike suna fatan fahimtar yadda taurari suka ƙunno kai, musamman yadda duniya ta ƙunno kai, saboda akwai lokacin da tauraron ruwa suka yi karo da duniya.

translations.source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.reference: Cuomo, mai shekaru 53, ya fara mulkin sa a farkon wannan shekarar kuma ya sanya hannu kan wata doka a watan da ya halatta auren jinsi.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, wanda shekarunsa 53, ya fara mulkin jihar a farkon shekarar, kuma a watan da ya wuce, ya sanya doka wacce ta halata aure tsakanin mutanen da suka samo asalin jima'i.

translations.source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.reference: Ya kira jita-jitar da cewa “hirar siyasa da wauta”.
translations.hypothesis: Ya bayyana waɗannan labarai da "maganganun siyasa da rashin da'awa."

translations.source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.reference: Ana hasashen zai tsaya takarar shugaban kasa a 2016.
translations.hypothesis: An dai ana tsammanin zai yi takarar shugaban kasa a shekarar 2016.

translations.source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.reference: NextGen tsari ne wanda FAA ke ikirarin zai bawa jirgin sama damar yin gajeren hanyoyi da kuma adana miliyoyin galan na mai a kowace shekara da kuma yanke hayakin mai.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen wani tsarin ne da FAA ke bayyana cewa zai ba da izinin jiragen sama su tashi ta hanyoyi masu tsawo kuma su adana miliyoyin galon man fetar kowace shekara, da kuma rage fitar da iskar gas.

translations.source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.reference: Yana amfani da fasahar tauraron dan adam maimakon amfani da rada a doron kasa domin baiwa masu kula da zirga zirgar jiragen sama damar gane inda jirage su ke babu kuskure ta yadda za su iya baiwa matukan jirgin sama cikakkun bayanai.
translations.hypothesis: Ana amfani da fasahar da ta dogara ne akan satelit, ba ta hanyar radar da ta kasance a kasa ba, domin ba masu kula da zirga-zirgar jiragen sama damar gano wajen jiragen sama da ƙwarewa sosai, kuma ba su masu aiki da jiragen sama bayanai masu daidaito.

translations.source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.reference: Ba a kara ababen hawa ba, sannan jirgin kasa da ba na karkashin kasa ba, ba zai tsaya a wimbledon ba, sannan babu wajen ajiye motoci da na hawan motoci a wurin.
translations.hypothesis: Babu wani sabon hanya da za a ƙara don samar da tafiye-tafiye, kuma jiragen kasa waɗanda ke tafiya a sama ba za su tsaya a Wembley ba. Hakanan, babu wurin ajiyar motoci ko wuraren da ake samar da motoci don samar da tafiye-tafiye a wurin.

translations.source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.reference: Tsoron rashin isassun motocin zirga zirga na iya tilasta a yi wasan ba tare da yan kallo sun halarta ba.
translations.hypothesis: Tsawo mai cike da damuwa game da rashin hanyoyin tafiya ya nuna yiwuwar cewa wasan zai faru a cikin gida, ba tare da masu goyon bayan kungiyar.

translations.source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.reference: Wani bincike da aka wallafa ranar Alhamis a mujallar Science ya ba da rohoto kan samuwar wani sabon jintsin tsuntsaye a Tsibiran Galapagos na Ecuadoria.
translations.hypothesis: Wani bincike da aka buga a ranar Alhamis a mujallar Science ya bayyana yadda wani sabon nau'in tashi ya bayyana a tsibirin Galápagos na kasar Ecuador.

translations.source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Masu bincike daga Jami'ar Princeton da ke Amurka da kuma Jami'ar Uppsala da ke Sweden sun ba da rahoton cewa sabon jinsin ya samo asali ne a tsararraki biyu kawai, duk da cewa an yi imani da cewa wannan aikin zai dauki lokaci mai tsawo, saboda yaduwar da ke tsakanin tsaunin Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, da kuma bakin kakakus. finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike daga Jami'ar Princeton a Amurka da Jami'ar Uppsala a Sweden sun bayyana wani nau'in sabo na dabbobi, wanda ya taso ne a cikin jinsai biyu kawai, duk da cewa ana tunanin wannan tsari yana ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo. Wannan tasowa ya faru ne ta hanyar haɗuwa tsakanin wani nau'in finch mai suna Geospiza fortes, wanda yake cikin yankin, da wani nau'in finch mai suna Geospiza conirostris, wanda ya zo daga wajen.

translations.source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.reference: Ana iya aikata zinare zuwa kowane irin fasali. Za'a iya mulmula shi zuwa ƙananan abubuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Zubar da zinariya za'a iya samar da ta a daban-daban nau'in siffofin. Za'a iya juyar da ta zuwa ƙananan siffofi.

translations.source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.reference: Ana iya tale shi ya zama siririyar waya, wadda ake iya nadewa ko a kulle, Kuma ana iya dunkule ta ko nada ta zuwa falle falle.
translations.hypothesis: Ana iya ja shi zuwa filayen ƙarfi, waɗanda ake iya juyawa da kuma haɗa su. Hakanan, ana iya buga shi ko juyawa don samar da takardun.

translations.source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.reference: Ana iya yin sa ya zama siriri sosai, kuma ya makale jikin wani ƙarfen. Ana iya yin sa ya zama siriri sosai har wani lokacin ana amfani dashi don yin ado ga hotuna da aka zana da hannu a cikin littattafan da ake kira “illuminated manuscripts”.
translations.hypothesis: Ana iya samar da shi ne da ƙarfi sosai, sannan ana iya adamar da shi a kan wasu ƙungiyar ƙarfe. Haka kuma, ana iya samar da shi ne da ƙarfi sosai har wani lokacin ana amfani da shi don ado da hotunan da aka zura a cikin littattafai da ake kira "litattafai masu haske."

translations.source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.reference: Ana kiran wannan Chemical pH. Za ka iya saka alama ta amfani da ruwan jan kabeji.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ana kiran shi pH na sinadarai. Zaku iya samar da wani abu da zai nuna pH ta amfani da ruwan kabon rodo mai launin ruwan kasa.

translations.source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.reference: Lemun kabeji na canza launin bisa yanayin yawan acid ko alkaline din ma’adanin.
translations.hypothesis: Ruwan karkash ce yana canzawa launin sa dangane da yawan acidity ko alkalinity na sinadarai.

translations.source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.reference: Ana nuna matakin pH ta hanyar yawan sinadarin Hydrogen (na H a cikin pH) kwayoyin dake cikin sunadaran da aka gwada.
translations.hypothesis: Mizanin pH yana nuna adadin sinasar hydrogen (wacce ake kira 'H' a cikin pH) da ke cikin sinadarai da ake gwadawa.

translations.source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.reference: Sinadiran Hydrogen sune proton wadanda suka cire wa Electrons (tunda sunadaran Hydrogen sun kunshi proton daya da electron daya).
translations.hypothesis: Ions na hydrogen su ne protons waɗanda aka yanke elektroni daga su (domin atoms na hydrogen sun ƙunshi proton ɗaya da elektroni ɗaya).

translations.source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.reference: A juya hodojin tare, sannan a sa hannu mai dan danshi a cura su zuwa dan kwallo.
translations.hypothesis: Juya ƙwayoyin busassuka biyu daidai, sannan, ta amfani da hannu mai tsafta da ruwa, adamu su cikin ƙwallon daya.

translations.source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.reference: Laimar da ke hannayenka za ta haɗe da fatar waje, inda zai zama abin nishaɗi kuma zai haifar da wani rin kwanso.
translations.hypothesis: Ruwan da ke hannuwanka zai yi tasiri da sassan waje, wanda zai sa hannuwanka su ji wani abu mai ban tsoro kuma zai samar da wani iri na ruwan kasa.

translations.source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.reference: Biranen Harappa da Mohenjo-daro suna da banɗaki mai ruwa a kusan kowane gida, wanda su ke haɗe wani kyakkyawa tsarin magudanar najasa.
translations.hypothesis: Biranen Harappa da Mohenjo-daro sun da manyan ɗakunan wanka a kusan kowace gida, waɗanda ake haɗa su da tsarin sadarwa mai kyau.

translations.source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.reference: An samo ragowar tsarin shara a gidajen biranen Minoan na Crete da Santorini da ke Girka.
translations.hypothesis: Wani bangare na tsarin samar da iskar gas na gurbata ruwa ya a samu a cikin gidajen biranen Minoan na Crete da Santorini a ƙasar Girisa.

translations.source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.reference: Hakanan akwai bandakuna a zamanin d Misira, Farisa da China. A cikin wayewar Roman, wasu lokuta bayan gida wani bangare ne na gidajen wanka na jama'a inda maza da mata suke tare a cikin haɗin gwiwa.
translations.hypothesis: Har ma da aka samu wurare na kashe ƙanshi a zamanin da ya wuce a ƙasar Masar, Persia, da China. A cikin al'adun Roman, wasu lokuta wuraren kashe ƙanshi sukan kasu cikin wuraren wanka na jama'a, inda maza da mata suke haɗuwa.

translations.source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.reference: Lokacin da kuka kira wanda yake da nisan duban mil kuna amfani da tauraron dan adam.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da kake kiran wanda yake nisan kilomita da yawa, kana amfani da tauraron ruwa (satellite).

translations.source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.reference: Tauraron dan adam a sararin samaniya yana samun kira sannan yana nuna shi baya ƙasa, kusan nan take.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan sateliten da ke sararin sama yana karɓar saƙon, sannan ya mayar da shi ƙasa, kusan nan da nan.

translations.source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.reference: An aika tauraron dan adam zuwa sararin samaniya ta hanyar roka. Masana kimiyya suna amfani da madubin hangen nesa a sararin samaniya saboda yanayin duniya yana gurbata wasu haskenmu da kallo.
translations.hypothesis: An tura sateliten zu sararin sama ta amfani da makamai. Masu bincike suna amfani da teleskop a sararin sama domin isancin cewa iska mai duwatsu ta duniya tana canzawa wasu daga cikin haske da abin da muke gani.

translations.source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.reference: Yana daukan katon kunbo fiye da tsawon kafa 100 domin sanya tauraron dan adam ko abin kawo nesa kusa a sararin sama.
translations.hypothesis: Don shigar da satelite ko teleskopi zuwa sararin sama, ana buƙatar babbar makamai mai tsayin ƙafa sama da fut 100.

translations.source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.reference: Gare garen ta canza duniyan a hanyoyi na ban mamaki. Abu mafi girma da gare garen ta yi mana shine ta bamu hanyoyi masu sauki na sufuri.
translations.hypothesis: Wurin tafiya (wheel) ya canza duniya ne ta hanyoyi da dama. Abin da wurin tafiya ya yi mana mafi mahimmanci shi ne ya bawa mu hanya mafi sauƙi da sauri ta hanyar tafiya.

translations.source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.reference: Lamarin ne ya kawo mana jirgin kasa, mota da hanyoyin sufuri da dama.
translations.hypothesis: Ta kawo mana jiragen kasa, motoci, da sauran kayan da ake amfani da su wajen tafiya.

translations.source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.reference: Karkashin su akwai wasu maguna masu matsakaicin yanayi wadanda ke cin abinci mai madaidaicin yanayi wanda ya fara daga zomaye zuwa barewa da barewan daji.
translations.hypothesis: A ƙarƙashinsu akwai wasu dabbobi masu girma tsakiya waɗanda suke ci abinci mai girma tsakiya, waɗanda suka haɗa da hare, fari, da dabbobi irin su zomo.

translations.source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.reference: Da karshe, akwai kananan kyanwoyi (da suka haɗa da kyanwoyin gida da suka gudu) da suke cin kananan naman da suka kama kamar kwari, ɓeraye, kadangaru, da tsuntsaye.
translations.hypothesis: Karshe, akwai masu yawan ƙananan dabbobi (gami da dabbobin gida waɗanda suka fita) waɗanda suke ciƙin dabbobin ƙanana da suke da yawa, kamar su ƙwayoyin ruwa, dabbobin ƙasa, lizards, da burungin.

translations.source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.reference: Sirrin nasararsu ita ce tsarinsu na samun hutu, aiki na musamman da kowace kyanwa ke riko da shi domin kaucewa yin gasa da sauran.
translations.hypothesis: Sirrin nasararsu ita ce rawar da kowane laushi yake taka, wanda ta sa kowane laushi ya fi samun abin da yake so ba tare da cin karo da sauran ba.

translations.source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.reference: Zakuna ne dangin mage da suka fi daɗin ma’amala, suna taruwa wuri ɗaya abin da ake kira iko.
translations.hypothesis: Zubar ne mafi yawan halaye a cikin dangi, kuma suna rayuwa a cikin ƙungiyoyi iri-iri da ake kira "ƙungiyoyi."

translations.source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.reference: Garken zaki sun kunshi maza manya daya zuwa uku masu dangantaka, tare da mata da dama har zuwa talatin tare da ‘ya’ya.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar lions na ƙunshe da maza masu girma guda ɗaya zuwa uku waɗanda ke da dangantaka, da kuma mata da yara da suka kai kusan ashirin da uku.

translations.source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.reference: Mata yawanci suna da kusanci da juna, kasancewa babban dangi na yan uwa da ƴaƴa mata.
translations.hypothesis: Yawanci, mata suna da dangantaka mai karfi da juna, domin sukan kasance cikin iyali mai girma na 'yan uwana da 'ya'ya.

translations.source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.reference: Taruwar zakuna suna kamar rukunin kyar ko karnuka, dabbobi wanda suka yi kamar da zaki (amma ba sauran manyan kuliyoyi ba) a cikin hali, kuma suna da matukar cutarwa ga abincin su.
translations.hypothesis: Zubar suna da halaye iri ɗaya da kungiyoyin zunzuyoyi ko kare, waɗanda su ma suke da halaye iri ɗaya da zubar (amma ba sa da sauran dabbobin manya), kuma suna da ƙarfi sosai wajen kashe abin da suke ci.

translations.source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.reference: Mai gudu sosai, damisa zai iya hawa (amma ba maikyau ba) yi iwo, tsalen nesa sosai da kuma ja so biya kamar kafin mutum.
translations.hypothesis: Mai wasa ne mai ƙarfi, mai iya yi daban-daban. Ya iya tsaye, ko da yake ba sosai, yana iya yin iyo, yana iya tsalle tsalle, kuma yana iya ja da ƙarfi da ta wuce ta mutum mai ƙarfi kusan sau biyar.

translations.source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.reference: Damisar Tiger tana cikin rukuni guda (Genus Panthera) kamar zakuna, damisar leopards, da jaguars. Wadannan dangin kyanwar guda huɗu sune kaɗai su ke iya ruri.
translations.hypothesis: Zubar ne a cikin wani rukuni guda (genus Panthera) da lions, leopards, da jaguars. Waɗannan dabbobin guda huɗu ne kawai waɗanda za su iya yiwa.

translations.source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.reference: Rurin damisa bai yi kama da cikeke ƙarfin murya zaki ba, amma ya fi kama da gurnani na jimlar kalmomin da aka faɗa da ƙarfi.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙara na zobe ba kamar ƙara mai karfi na zobe ba ne, amma kamar jumla wacce take kunnawa da ƙara da ƙarfi.

translations.source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.reference: Ƴan wasa suna son cin kananan dabbobi. Za su kama birai, macizai, zazzage da tsuntsaye in sun iya. Kusan dukkan dabbobin da dutsen ya farauto suna ƙasa da shi.
translations.hypothesis: Ocelot suna son cin dabbobin ƙanana. Suna iya kama makamai, kwalaye, dabbobin ƙasa da su, da kuma burungai idan suka samu damar. Kusan dukkan dabbobin da ocelot ke kashe suna da ƙaramin girma fiye da ita.

translations.source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.reference: Masana ilimin kimiyya suna tunanin cewa ocelots na bin dabbobi da kama su ta hanyar sansanar sawun inda su ka bi su ka wuce.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike sun yi tunanin cewa dabbobin da ake kira "ocelot" suna bin fursajin da suke son ci (abinci) ta amfani da ƙamshin su, suna kuma tunzama don su gano inda fursajin suka wuce a ƙasa.

translations.source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.reference: Suna iya gani sosai cikin duhu tare da ganin na dare, kuma suna tafiya cikin sanɗa. Kyanwar daji na farautar abin farautar su ta hanyar sajewa da wurin da su ke sannan su dirar wa abin farautar su.
translations.hypothesis: Suna iya ganin da kyau a cikin duhu ta amfani da ido mai haske, kuma suna iya motsawa cikin santsi. 'Yan shanu suna kashe abin da suke ci ta hanyar ɓacin kansu a cikin muhallacin da suke ciki, sannan su kaiwa abin da suke son kashe hari.

translations.source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.reference: Yayin da wani karamin gungun dabbobi (jama’a kadan) su ka kasance sun rabu da babban gungun da su ke ciki (misali idan su ka koma kan wasu jerin tsaunuka, ko wani kogi ko kuma su ka koma wani sabon tsibirin yadda ba zasu iya komowa ba) akasari su kan sami kansu a muhalli na daban da inda su ka fito.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da ƙungiyar ƙananan rayuwa (ƙananan yawan mutane) ta rabu daga ƙungiyar ta asali (misali, idan su ka koma wani tsauni ko kogwa, ko kuma su ka koma wata tsakiyar ruwa wacce ba za su iya komawa cikin sauƙi ba), sau da yawa suna samun kansu a wani wuri mai bambanci fiye da yadda suke da baya.

translations.source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.reference: Wannan sabon muhallin yana da albarkatu daban da kuma masu gasa daban, don haka sabuwar al’umma za ta buƙaci mabambantan fasali ko karɓuwa don zama ƙaƙƙarfar mai gasafiye da abin da su ka buƙata a baya.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan sabon yanayi yana da kayayyakin da suka bambanta da kuma masu zama da suka bambanta, don haka sabon jama'a zai buƙe ƙwarewar da ta bambanta ko canje-canje don su zama masu rinjaye fiye da abin da suke buƙata a baya.

translations.source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.reference: Asalin al’umman basu canza ba ko kadan, suna bukatan karbuwa kamar da.
translations.hypothesis: Yawan mutane da ke nan ba su canza ba, kuma har yanzu suna buƙatar abubuwan da suke buƙata kamar yadda suke buƙata a baya.

translations.source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.reference: A kan lokaci, yayin da sabbin yawan jama’a suka fara daidaita da sabon yanayin su, sai su fara dawo kadan da kadan kamar waɗancan yawan jama'a.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da lokaci, yayin da sabon jama'a ke daidaita kansu da sabon yanayin da suke ciki, suke fara zama irin mutane daban da sauran jama'a.

translations.source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.reference: A ƙarshe, bayan dubun dubbai ko ma shekaru miliyoyi, yawar jama’a biyu za su zauna da banbancin da ba za a kira su da wannan jinsin ba.
translations.hypothesis: Karshe-karshe, bayan shekaru dubu ko ma miliyoyin, waɗannan ƙungiyoyin mutane za su iya zama daban sosai har sai da ba za a iya kiranta su da suna cikin ɗaya ba.

translations.source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.reference: Samar da sabon jinsi, hanya ce mai mahimmanci wadda ba za’a iya kauce mata ba a cikin tsarin asalin halittu.
translations.hypothesis: Muna kiran wannan tsari da "tsarin samar da nau'in halittu," wanda ke nufin kawai samar da sababbin nau'in halittu. Samar da sabbin nau'in halittu wani abu ne da ya faru ko ba faru ba kuma wani ɓangare ne mai mahimmanci na tasirin halittu.

translations.source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.reference: Shuke-shuke suna sanya iskar oxygen wanda mutane ke shaka, kuma suna shan iskar carbon-dioxide wanda mutane ke fitarwa (ma'ana fitar da iska).
translations.hypothesis: Tsire-tsire suna samar da iska wanda mutane suke numfashi, kuma suna shafe iskar gas wacce mutane suke fitarwa (watau, numfashi).

translations.source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.reference: Tsire-tsire suna yin abincinsu daga rana ta hanyar hotuna. Suna kuma bayar da inuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Tsire-tsire suna samar da abincinsu daga rana ta hanyar wani tsari da ake kira photosynthesis. Sannan su ma suna ba da inuwa.

translations.source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.reference: Muna gina gidajenmu ne daga itatuwa kuma muna yin sitirunmu daga itatuwa. Mafi yawan abincin da muke ci daga tsirrai ne. Idan babu tsirrai, mutane da dabbobi ba za su rayu ba.
translations.hypothesis: Muna gina gidajenmu daga tsire-tsire, kuma muna yin tufafi daga tsire-tsire. Yawancin abincin da muka ci su ne tsire-tsire. Ba tare da tsire-tsire ba, dabbobi ba za su iya rayuwa ba.

translations.source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus ita ce babbar dabbar da ke farautar dabbobi a zamaninta, don haka bata fargabar komi ba, in ban da dabbobin Mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: Mosasaurus shine babban mai ci da yake da ƙarfi a lokacin da yake rayuwa, don haka ba yana tsoron wani abu ba, sai dai wasu masauran da ke da irinsa.

translations.source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.reference: Dogon haban sa sun cika da hakora masu ci kamar reza sama da 70, tare da ƙarin saiti a cikin rufin bakinsa, ma'ana babu mafaka ga wani abu wanda ya ketare hanyar sa.
translations.hypothesis: Farkon bakinsa yana da tsayin dangi, kuma an saka masa fiye da fantsa 70 na fantsama, da kuma wasu wasu a cikin rufin bakinsa, wanda hakan ya nuna cewa babu wani abu da zai iya tserewa idan ya fada cikin hanya.

translations.source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.reference: Bamuda tabbaci amma watakila yana da harshe me cokali me yatsu. abincin shi ya hada dodon kodi, manyan kifaye, da wasu masosaurs kuma zai iya akwai mai cin nama.
translations.hypothesis: Ba mu da tabbacin, amma yana yiwuwa yana da harshe mai bambanta. Abincin da yake ci ya haɗa da kura, kifi na girma, sauran dabbobin mosasaur, kuma yana yiwuwa ma yana iya cin jinsinsa.

translations.source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.reference: Ta na kai wa duk wani abu farmaki da ya shiga ruwan, ko da kuwa gabjejen kakan kadangare mai suna T.Rex ba zai iya ja da shi ba.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, yana kaiwa wani abu da kowanne wanda ya shiga cikin ruwa; ko ma da ƙaramar dabbarsa mai girma kamar T. rex, ba za ta iya tsayayya da shi ba.

translations.source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.reference: Duk da yake yawancin abincinsu zai zama sananne gare mu, Romawa suna da nasu yankin na baƙin bukukuwa ko abubuwan biki da ba a saba da su ba, da suka haɗa da akuyar daji, dawisu, dodon-koɗi, da kuma wani nau’in ɓera da ake kira dormousee
translations.hypothesis: Duk da cewa mafi yawan abincin da suke ci suna da alaƙa da abinci da muka saba da shi, Romans sun sami wasu abinci masu ban mamaki ko kuma na musamman a cikin abincinsu, kamar su daji, fari, ƙwayar ruwa, da kuma wani nau'in dabbobin ƙasa da ake kira "dormouse."

translations.source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.reference: Wani banbamcin kuma shi ne talakawa da kuma mata sun cinye abincinsu yayin da suke zaune a kan kujeru, masu hannu da shuni kuma suna son cin abinci tare a inda suke zama a manya-manyan dakunan shakatawa domin cin abincin.
translations.hypothesis: Wani bambanci kuma shine cewa, yayin da mutanen da suka yi ƙaranciya da kuma mata suke cin abincinsu suna zaune a kujeru, manya-manyan mutane suna son yin liyafi-liya tare, inda suke zaune a gefe suna cin abincinsu.

translations.source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.reference: Cikin abubuwan da ake ci a tsohuwar daular Rum, ba zai kasance abincin da ya zo Turai daga Amurka ba ko kuma daga Asia a karnonin da su ka zo daga baya.
translations.hypothesis: Abincin da ake ci a zamanin daular Roma ta baya ba zai iya hada da abinci da aka kawo zuwa Turai daga Amurka ko daga Asiya a karni mai zuwa.

translations.source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.reference: Alal misali, ba su da masara, babu tumatur, babu dankali. babu koko, kuma babu mutumin tsohuwar Rum da ya taɓa ɗanɗana talotalo.
translations.hypothesis: Alal misali, ba su da dawa, ba su da tomato, ba su da dankali, ba su da kakao, kuma babu wani dan Roma na zamanin da ya taɓa cin naman turkey.

translations.source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.reference: Yan Babylon sun gina wa kowanne allansu haikali da ya zama matsayin gidan allan.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen Babilon sun gina wajen ibada na musamman ga kowane daya daga cikin santsuwarsu, wanda ake yiwa daraja kuma ake ganinsa a matsayin gidan santsuwar.

translations.source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.reference: Mutane za su kawo hadaya ga abubuwan bauta yayin da malaman bautar za su yi ƙoƙarin biyan buƙatun abubuwan bautar ta hanyar bukukuwa da shagulgula.
translations.hypothesis: Mutane suna kawo abubuwa azurfa ga sarakinannu, kuma malamai suna kokarin biyan buƙatun sarakinannu ta hanyar bikin da kuma bukukuwa.

translations.source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.reference: Kowane wajen bauta tana da budaden haraba tare da kebantaccen mihrabi wanda limamai kadai ke shiga.
translations.hypothesis: Kowane falalaki yana da wani waje mai buɗewa, sannan akwai wani wuri na cikin gida wanda kawai malamai ne suke shiga.

translations.source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.reference: Wasu lokuta an gina hasumiya na musamman mai siffar dala, wanda ake kira ziggurats, domin su zama sashi na haikali.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan lokaci, wasu tsare-tsaren da suka yi kama da pyramids, wanda ake kira da "ziggurats," ana gina su a cikin fadar ibada.

translations.source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.reference: Saman hasumiyar wuri ne na musamman na abun bautan.
translations.hypothesis: Babban wajen ginin na da wani wuri na musamman da ake amfani da shi don bautar da Allah.

translations.source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.reference: A cikin yanayi mai zafi na Gabas ta tsakiya, gida ba shi da matuƙar mahimmanci.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin yanayin zafi na Gabas ta Tsakiya, gidan bai kasance mai mahimmanci ba.

translations.source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.reference: Yawancin rayuwar dangin Ibrananci sun faru ne a sararin sama.
translations.hypothesis: Babban ɓangaren rayuwar iyalan Hebrew na faruwa a cikin waje.

translations.source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.reference: Mata sun yi girki a farfajiyar; shagunan buɗe ido ne kawai suna kallon titi. An yi amfani da dutse don gina gidaje.
translations.hypothesis: Mata suke daidaita abinci a waje; kasuwanni sun kasance kawai dukkanin wurare masu buɗɗewa waɗanda ke fuskantar hanya. Akwai amfani da duwatsu wajen gina gida.

translations.source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.reference: Babu wani daji mai girma a ƙasar Kan'ana, saboda haka katako yana da tsada.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin ƙasar Canaan, babu duffufa masu girma, don haka kayan itace suna da tsada sosai.

translations.source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.reference: An zauna a Greenland a warwatse. A cikin yankin Norse sun ce an kori Erik the Red daga Iceland saboda kisan kai, kuma lokacin da ya kaɗa ya yi yamma, sai ya gano Greenland kuma ya ba ta suna Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: Greenland ta kasance da yawan jama'a kaɗan. A cikin labaran Norse, ana ceawa cewa Erik mai launin ruwan kasa (Erik the Red) ya fito daga Iceland saboda laifi, kuma yayin da yake tafiya zuwa arewa-maso-yamma, ya ga Greenland kuma ya sanya mata suna Greenland.

translations.source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.reference: Amma duk da ganowar sa, dama tuni ƙabilun Eskimo suna zaune a wurin a lokacin.
translations.hypothesis: Amma, ko da yake ya gano wani abu, ƙungiyoyin mutanen Eskimo sun riga su na zaune a wannan yanki a lokacin.

translations.source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.reference: Kodayake kowace ƙasa ta kasance 'Scandinavia', akwai bambance-bambance masu yawa tsakanin mutane, sarakuna, al'adu da tarihin Denmark, Sweden, Norway da Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da kuwa kowanne ƙasa yana cikin yankin Arewa maso Gabas na Turai, akwai bambance-bambance masu yawa tsakanin mutanen, sarakuna, al'adu da tarihi na Denmark, Sweden, Norway da Iceland.

translations.source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.reference: Idan ka kalli majigi mai suna National Treasure, za ka yi tsamanin an rubuta taswirar taska a bayan takardan Ƙudurin ‘Yancin Kai.
translations.hypothesis: Idan kun ga fim din da ake kira "National Treasure," wataƙi za ku iya tunanin cewa wata takarda mai bayanin inda akwai abubuwa masu daraja ta kasance a bayan takardar da ta bayyana 'yancin kasashen Amurka.

translations.source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.reference: Sai dai kuma, wannan ba gaskiya ba ne. Duk da cewa akwai wani abu da aka rubuta a bayan daftarin, ba taswirar taskar arziki ba ce.
translations.hypothesis: Kamar yadda aka ce, hakan ba gaskiya ba ce. Ko da yake akwai wani abu da aka rubuta a bayan takarda, ba ita ce takardar neman dukiya.

translations.source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.reference: An rubuta a bayan Bayanin Samun Ƴancin kai kalmomin “Asalin Sanarwar Samun' Yanci ne a ranar 4 ga Yuli 1776”. Rubutun ya bayyana a ƙasan takardar, juye.
translations.hypothesis: A baya ga Takardun 'Yancin Kai, akwai kalmomin "Takardar Asali ta 'Yancin Kai wacce aka yi a ranar 4 ga watan Yuli, shekara ta 1776." Wannan rubutun yana bayana a ƙarƙashin takardar, kuma yana juyawa.

translations.source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.reference: A yayin da babu takamaiman wanda ya rubuta shi, an sani cewa a farkon rayuwar shi, babban takardan (yana daukar ma'aunin inci 29¾ zuwa inci 24½) an nada shi don ajiya.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da ba wanda ya san wacce ta rubuta takardar, amma ana sanin cewa a farkon rayuwarta, takardar ta da babbar ƙasa (wacce girinta ya kai inci 29 da rabi da inci 24 da rabi), an juye ta a cikin igiyar don a adana.

translations.source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.reference: Don haka, da alama an ƙara tsarin rubutun ne kawai a matsayin laƙabi.
translations.hypothesis: Don haka, yana yiwuwa an ƙara wannan alamar ne kawai don nuna wani abu.

translations.source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.reference: Saukar D-Day da yaƙe-yaƙe masu zuwa sun ƴantar da arewacin Faransa, amma har yanzu kudanci bai sami yanci ba.
translations.hypothesis: Wajen yakin da aka yi a ranar D-Day da kuma yakin da ya biyo bayan sa, sun kawar da matsalar arewacin Faransa, amma kudu maso gabas na kasar har yanzu bai samu 'yanci ba.

translations.source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.reference: Faransawa '' Vichy '' suka mallake shi. Waɗannan mutanen Faransa ne waɗanda suka yi sulhu da Jamusawa a 1940 kuma suka yi aiki tare da masu mamaye maimakon yaƙar su.
translations.hypothesis: An kasance ƙarƙashin mulkin "Vichy," wanda su ma su ne Faransawa. Wannan rukuni na Faransawa ne da suka yi sulhu da Jamani a shekarar 1940, kuma sun yi aiki da masu mamayar maimakon su yi yaƙi da su.

translations.source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.reference: A ranar 15 ga watan Agusta 1940, Kawayen sun mamaye kudancin Faransa, mamayar da aka yi wa lakabi da sunan “Operation Dragoon”.
translations.hypothesis: A ranar 15 ga watan Agusta na shekarar 1940, sojojin kungiyar 'yan adawa sun shiga arewacin kasar Faransa, kuma wannan shiga ya samu sunan "Aikin Dragoon."

translations.source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.reference: A cikin makonni biyu kawai Amurkawa da Sojojin Faransa na ƴancin faransa suka ƴantar da kudancin Faransa kuma suka juya zuwa Jamus.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin kwanaki biyu kawai, sojojin Amurka da sojojin Faransa masu 'yanci sun sake kwanciyar arewa ta kudu ta Faransa kuma suna shiga kasar Jamus.

translations.source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.reference: Wayewa al’ada ce guda wadda mutane da dama da ke zama da aiki tare na daukan nasu ce, al’umma.
translations.hypothesis: Al'adu wata ƙungiya ce ta zamani wacce mutane da dama masu tasiri suka raba, wadanda suke rayuwa da aiki tare cikin hadin kai, wato wata al'umma.

translations.source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.reference: Kalmar civilization ta zo ne daga kalmar latin civilis, ma’ana farar hula, mai dangantaka da civis na Latin, ma’ana yan kasa, da cavitas, ma’ana birni ko birnin-jiha, kuma yana ba da adadin yawan jama’a.
translations.hypothesis: Kalmar "farfasa" ta fito daga harshen Latin, wacce ake kira "civilis," wacce ke nufin "mai ka'ida," kuma ta danganta da kalmar "civis" ta Latin, wacce ke nufin "ma'aikaci," da kuma kalmar "civitas," wacce ke nufin "birni" ko "jihar birni." Wannan kuma, wataƙila, yana bayyana girman al'umma.

translations.source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.reference: Biranen gari sune kashin bayan al'ummomi. Al'adar wayewar tana nuna wucewar ilimi a cikin tsararraki da yawa, rabe-raben al'adu da rarraba gaskiya.
translations.hypothesis: Jihar-jihar da ke cikin birane su ne tushen ƙasashe. Al'adun zamani yana nufin watsa ilimi zuwa ga jinsai da dama, da kuma ci gaba da al'ada da kuma yaduwar ilimi.

translations.source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.reference: kananun al’adu galibi su kan shuɗe ba tare da barin tabbatattun shaidu na tarihi ba kuma ba a saka su cikin jerin manyan zamunna.
translations.hypothesis: Al'adun ƙananan ƙabilu sau da yawa suna guje wa tarihi ba tare da barin wata hujja mai mahimmanci ba, kuma ba a yarda da su a matsayin al'adu masu tasiri.

translations.source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.reference: A lokacin Yaƙin Juyin Juya Hali, jihohi goma sha ukun sun kafa gwamnatin tsakiya mai rauni - wadda ta kunshi Majalisa kawai - a ƙarƙashin dokar gwamnatin hadin gwiwa.
translations.hypothesis: A lokacin yakin juyin juya hali, jihar da suka haɗu goma sha uku sun ƙirƙiri wata ƙungiyar gwamnati ta tsakiya ta da wuri, wacce Majalisar ta kasance kawai wani ɓangare na wannan kungiyar, ta hanyar kungiyar da ake kira "Articles of Confederation."

translations.source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.reference: Majalisa ba ta da wani iko na kakaba haraji, sannan kuma, kasancewar babu ɓangarorin zartaswa da na shari’a na ƙasar, ta dogara ne kan hukumomin jihohi, waɗanda mafi yawanci ba sa bayar da haɗin kai, wajen ganin an tilasta aiki da dokokin.
translations.hypothesis: Majalisar ta kasa ba ta da wani iko na saka haraji, kuma, saboda babu gwamnati mai daraja a ƙasa ko kotu, ta dogara ne akan hukumomin jihar, waɗanda sau da yawa ba su ba da hadin kai, don aiwatar da duk ayyukan majalisar.

translations.source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.reference: Hakanan ba ta da ikon yin watsi da dokokin haraji da haraji tsakanin jihohi.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, ba ta da ikon mayar da ayyukan haraji da kuɗin shiga da ake biyan tsakanin jihohi.

translations.source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.reference: Labaran sun buƙaci yarjejeniya baki ɗaya daga dukkan jihohin kafin a iya gyara su kuma jihohi sun ɗauki gwamnatin tarraya a sauƙaƙe cewa wakilansu ba su nan.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan dokokin sun buƙaci yardar dukkanin jihohin da ke cikin ƙasar kafin a iya canje-canje su, kuma jihohin sun ɗauki gwamnatin tsakiyar da wuya, har ma da cewa wakilan su suna fita ba sa zuwa taron.

translations.source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.reference: Masu kwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Italiya, tare da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Jamus ita ce ta biyu mafi nasara a duniya kuma sun kasance zakarun ƙwallon ƙafa na FIFA a 2006.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar kwallon kafar kasa ta Italiya, kamar kungiyar kwallon kafar kasa ta Jamus, ce ta biyu mafi nasara a duniya, kuma ta lashe gasar FIFA World Cup a shekarar 2006.

translations.source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.reference: Shahararrun wasanni sun hada da kwallon kafa, kwallon kwando, wasan kwallon raga, wasan ruwa, wasan takobi, wasan kwallon rugby, tseren kekuna, kwallon gora, wasan kwallon gorar kankara da na tseren motoci na F1.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu wasanni da suka samu masaniya sun haɗa da kwallon ƙafa, kwallon basket, kwallon volleyball, kwallon ruwa, wasan fafatawa da takalma, kwallon rugby, tseren motoci, kwallon wasa a kan kasa, kwallon wasa da aka yi ta amfani da motocin da ke da gurɓas, da kuma gasar motocin F1.

translations.source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.reference: Wasannin hunturu sun shahara a yankuna na Arewa, inda da Italiyawa su ke fafatawa a wasannin kasa da kasa da wasannin Olympic.
translations.hypothesis: Wasanni na hunturu suna da muhimmanci sosai a yankin Arewa, inda 'yan kasar Italiya suke shiga gasa a manyan wasanni da kuma gasuwan Olympics.

translations.source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.reference: Japans suna riƙe da kusan tsibirai 7,000 (babba shine Honshu), yana mai sanya Japan tsibiri na 7 mafi girma a duniya!
translations.hypothesis: Japanka tana da kusan tsibirin 7,000 (babban tsibirin shine Honshu), wanda ya sa Japanka ta zama ta bakwai a duniya bisa girman tsibirin.

translations.source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.reference: Saboda tari/rukunin tsibirai da Japan ke da su, sau da yawa akan kira Japan, a matsayin yanki, da suna “tarin tsibirai”.
translations.hypothesis: Saboda jigon tsabar ƙasashe da Japan ke da su, ana kiran Japan, a fannin ƙasa, da "tsakiyar ƙasa" ko "jigon ƙasa".

translations.source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.reference: Farkon Taiwan ya faro tun baya cikin karni na 15 inda Turawa matukan jirgin ruwa da ke wucewa suka ɗauki sunan tsibirin a matsayin IIha Formosa, ko kyakyawan tsibiri.
translations.hypothesis: Taiwan ta fara kasancewa a shekarar 1500, lokacin da manyan jiragen ruwa na Turai da suka wuce sun rubuta sunan tsibirin a matsayin "Ilha Formosa," watau "tsibirin kyau."

translations.source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.reference: A cikin 1624, Kamfanin Dutch East India Company ya kafa tushe a kudu maso yammacin Taiwan, yana ƙaddamar da canji a cikin ayyukan noman hatsi na asali da ɗaukar ma'aikata na China don yin aiki a gonakin shinkafa da sukari.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1624, kamfanin Dutch East India ya kafa wani shuni a kudu maso yammacin Taiwan, wanda ya haifar canji a yadda mutanen yankin suka ke yin noma, kuma sun dauki ma'aikata daga kasar Sin domin su yi aiki a gonakin su na shinkafa da sukari.

translations.source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.reference: A shekarar 1683, sojojin daular Qing (1644-1912) sun kwace ikon lardin Taiwan na yammacin da arewacin gabar teku, suka ayyana Taiwan a matsayin lardin daular Qing a shekarar 1885.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1683, sojojin da ke ƙarƙashin mulkin Qing (wanda ya kasance daga shekarar 1644 zuwa 1912) sun mamaye sassan arewa da yammacin gabar teku na Taiwan, kuma a shekarar 1885, sun sanar da Taiwan a matsayin wata jiha a ƙarƙashin mulkin daular Qing.

translations.source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.reference: A shekarar 1895, bayan kayarwa a cikin Farkon Yaƙin Sino-Japanese (1894-1895), gwamnatin Qing su sa-hannu a Yarjejeniyar Shimonoseki, ta wanda ta bayar da mulkin kan Taiwan zuwa ga Japan, wanda ya yi mulkin tsibirin har 1945.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1895, bayan rashin nasara a yakin Sino-Japani na farko (1894-1895), gwamnatin Qing ta sanya hannu kan yarjejenin Shimonoseki, wanda ta hanyarsa ta ba Japan mulkin Taiwan, wanda Japan ta mulki har zuwa shekarar 1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu ya hada da tsari uku, masu suna Intihuatana, Temple of the Sun, da Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu ta ƙunshi gine-gine uku masu mahimmanci, waɗanda su ne: Intihuatana, falal din rana, da dakin da ke da tagogi uku.

translations.source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.reference: An sake gina mafi yawan gine-ginen da ke gefen rukunin ginin domin ƴan yawon buɗe ido su fahimci yadda asalin siffarsu ta ke.
translations.hypothesis: Karin bangare na gine-gine da ke gefen wuraren da aka gina, an sake gina su domin bawa masu zuwa wurin damar ganin yadda suke da baya.

translations.source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.reference: Zuwa shekarar 1976, an farfado da kashi talatin na gine ginen Machu Picchu kuma har yanzu ana ci gaba da aikin.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1976, kashi ashirin da uku na wurin tarihi na Machu Picchu ya sake samun sabon ɗabi'a, kuma aikin sake gina wannan wurin na ci gaba har zuwa yau.

translations.source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.reference: A misali, nau’in hoto marar motsi da aka fi sani a duniya shi ne 35mm, wanda shi ne girman fim na hoto da aka fi amfani da shi a ƙarshen zamanin fim ɗin hannu.
translations.hypothesis: Misali, mafi yawan tsarin hoton da ake amfani da shi a duniya shine na 35mm, wanda ya kasance mafi yawan girman fim a lokacin da zamani ya fara tasowa.

translations.source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.reference: Har yau din nan ana sarrafa shi, amma muhimmin abu a nan kyamarar komi da ruwanka ce ta gaje shi da ke sunsuno hotuna.
translations.hypothesis: Har yanzu ana samar da shi, amma mafi muhimmanci, ma'aɗadin sa ya taso a cikin tsarin masu tura hoton kameroji na dijital.

translations.source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.reference: Abin mamaki shine zubin 35mm a haƙiƙa fadin 36mm ya ke da shi da kuma tsawon 24mm.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin da ake kira "35mm" a zahiri, kuma wani lokaci yana iya zama mai rikitarwa, yana da adadin milimita 36 a fuka da milimita 24 a tsaye.

translations.source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.reference: A lissafin wannan tsarin (idan aka raba sha biyu domin samun adadi mafi karancin lamba) zai kasance a daidaiton 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: Ana kiran ma'aunin wannan tsarin (wanda ake samu ta hanyar rarraba da goma sha biyu don samun ma'aunin da ya fi dacewa) da 3:2.

translations.source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.reference: Yawancin hanyoyin gama gari na yau da kullun (misali tsarin APS na iyali) ya kusa da wannan tsari.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da cewa akwai hanyoyi da dama na shirya abubuwa (misali, wasu nau'in shirye-shiryen APS), wasu daga cikinsu suna da ma'aɗadin wannan yawan girmama ko kuma suna da ma'aɗadi kusan iri ɗaya.

translations.source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.reference: Dokar da aka fi rainawa itace dokar gina dynamism tare da tabbatar da tsarin a hoto.
translations.hypothesis: Daidaiton "rufi na uku" wacce ake amfani da ita sosai kuma wanda ake taɓa ƙara wa banza, ita ce hanya mai sauƙi wacce tana ƙirƙirar motsi yayin da take kula da tsari a cikin hoto.

translations.source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.reference: Ya bayyana cewa wuri mafi mahimmanci a darasin shine mahadar layuka wanda ya raba hoton a tsaye da kuma a kwance (duba misali).
translations.hypothesis: An bayyana cewa mafi kyawun wuri don sanya babban abu a cikin hoto shine a wajen wurin da layuka ke haɗuwa, inda layukan da ke rarraba hoton zuwa uku a tsaye da uku a fage (duba misali).

translations.source: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.reference: A wannan lokaci na tarihin Tarayyan Turai, cocin Katolika, wadda ta yi ƙarfi da arziki, ta fuskanci bincike.
translations.hypothesis: A lokacin wannan zamani a tarihi na Turai, majalisar Katolika, wacce ta sami karbuwa da karfi, ta fuskanci bincike da kuma duba.

translations.source: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.reference: Sama da shekara dubu addinin Kirista ya haɗe kasashen Turai waje guda duk da banbance banbance na harsuna da ala’adu.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da bambance-bambancen harsuna da al'adu, addinin Kiristanci ya hada jihar Turai a cikin shekaru sama da dubu ɗaya.

translations.source: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.reference: Ƙarfin barnansa ta shafe kowa daga sarki har na gama-gari.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙarfin da yake da shi ya shafar kowa, daga masu mulki zuwa al'umma.

translations.source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.reference: Daya daga cikin shishikan addinin krista shine yin amfani da arziki wajen magance matsaloli da kuma yakar talauci sannan kuma jami’in kudi na cocin suna can musamman saboda wannan dalilin.
translations.hypothesis: Ɗaya daga cikin muhimman ka'idoji na addinin Kiristanci shi ne cewa dukiya ta kamata a yi amfani da ita don kawancewar wahala da talauci, kuma kudin da kungiyar ta mallaka shi ne don wannan dalili ne musamman.

translations.source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.reference: Babban cibiyar shugabancin coci ta kasance a Roma sama da dubban shekaru kuma mayar da arziki da mulki can ya jawo cece-kuce game da ko ana bin wannan shikashikin.
translations.hypothesis: Hukumar tsakiyar majalisar ta kasance a Rome sama da shekaru dubu ɗaya, kuma wannan tarin ikon da kuɗi ya sa mutane da yawa su yi mamaki idan wannan alkawarin ya kasance a aiwatar da shi.

translations.source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.reference: Jim kaɗan bayan ɓarkewar tashin hankalin, Birtaniya ta fara toshe mashigan ruwa na Jamus.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan fara rikicin, kasar Ingilishi ta fara hana jiragen ruwa su shiga da fita zuwa kasar Jamus.

translations.source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.reference: Dabarun sun yi tasiri, hana shigar da muhimman kayayyakin soja da na farar hulla, ko da yake wannan toshewa ta sabawa dokoki na ƙasa da ƙasa waɗanda yarjejeniyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa da dama na ƙarnoni biyu da suka wuce suka tsara.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan tsari ya nuna tasiri, ya katse hanyoyin samar da kayayyakin soja da kuma kayayyakin da ake bukata ga al'umma, duk da cewa wannan hana hanyoyin ya saba da dokokin kasa da kasa da ake amshi a duniya, waɗanda aka ƙididdige a cikin yarjejeniyoyi da dama na shekaru biyu da suka wuce.

translations.source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.reference: Birtaniya ta dasa bama bamai a teku domin hana jiragen ruwa shiga wannan yanki na teku, abinda ke da hadari ga jiragen yan baruwanmu.
translations.hypothesis: Birtaniya ta yi amfani da makamin ruwa don toshe wasu sassan ruwan duniya, domin hana wata kowane jirgi shiga ciki, wanda hakan ya haifar da haɗɗari ga ma jiragen da ba su da wata alaka.

translations.source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.reference: Tunda aka samu karancin sakamako ga wannan dabarun, Jamus tayi tsammanin sakamako irin haka zuwa ga yakin kasan tekun da bashi da kayyadewa.
translations.hypothesis: Tun da an samu amsoshi kaɗan akan wannan hanyar, Jamus ta yi tsammanin za a samu amsoshi iri ɗaya akan yakin ta da jiragen ruwa na kasa da ba su da iyaka.

translations.source: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.reference: A lokacin 1920s, halaye mafi rinjaye na yawancin ƴan ƙasa da ƙasashe shine na zaman lafiya da keɓewa.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarun 1920, ra'ayoyin da yawancin mutane da kasashe ke da su sun kasance kan zaman lafiya da kuma kaucewa al'amuran duniya.

translations.source: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.reference: Bayan ganin munanan abubuwa da munanan yaƙe-yaƙe yayin Yaƙin Duniya na ɗaya, al'ummomi sun so su guje wa irin wannan yanayin a nan gaba.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan ganin abũbuwan ban hausa da mugunta da suka faru a lokacin yakin duniya na farko, kasashe sun yi burin kaucewa irin wannan yanayin a nan gaba.

translations.source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.reference: A cikin 1884, Tesla ya koma Amurka don karɓar aiki tare da Kamfanin Edison a cikin New York City.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1884, Tesla ya koma Amurka domin karɓar aiki a kamfanin Edison a birnin New York.

translations.source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: Ya iso Amurka da sulai 4 kacal, da wani littafin wakoki, da wasikar gabatarwa daga Charles Batchelor (manajansa a aikin da ya bari) zuwa ga Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: Ya zo Amurka yana da kudi 4 kawai a hannunsa, wata kundin shaidan fage, da wata wasika ta shawarar da Charles Batchelor (wanda shi ne manajan nasa a aikin da ya yi da baya) ya rubuta zuwa Thomas Edison.

translations.source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.reference: Ƙasar China ta zamanin da tana da wata hanyar musamman ta nuna lokutan yanayi daban-daban; kowane mataki na China ko kowane iyali da ya hau karagar mulki to shi ma daula ce ta daban.
translations.hypothesis: China ta daɗa ta yi amfani da hanyar musamman wajen nuna lokuta daban-daban; kowane zamani a cikin tarihi na China ko kowane iyali da ya mallaki mulki, ya kasance wani tsari mai bambanci.

translations.source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.reference: Haka nan tsakanin kowace daula a kan sami lokaci na rashin zaman lafiya tsakanin larduna. Fitacce daga waɗannan zamuna shi ne zamanin Masarautu Uku da ya faru tsawon shekaru 60 tsakanin Daular Han da ta Jin.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, tsakanin kowace mulki, akwai lokaci mai wahala na rarrabuwar lardinaye. Ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan lokuta da suka fi sananniya shi ne lokacin "Ƙungiyoyin Bakwai," wanda ya faru na shekaru 60 tsakanin mulkin Han da mulkin Jin.

translations.source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.reference: A wancan lokaci yaki ya barke tsakanin mafi yawan gidajen sarauta da ke hankoron kujerar sarki.
translations.hypothesis: A lokacin waɗannan zamani, yaƙe masu tsanani suka faru tsakanin manyan jami'ai da suka yi gwagwarmaya don samun mulki.

translations.source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.reference: Masarauta Uku ya kasance daya daga cikin zamunan da aka fi zub da jini a tarihin Tsohuwar China dubban mutane sun mutu suna gwagwarmaya don zama a kan madaukakiyar kujera a babbar fada a Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: "Zamanin 'Ƙungiyoyin Ukun" ya kasance ɗaya daga cikin lokutan da suka fi wahala a tarihi na ƙasar Sin ta da, inda mutane da yawa suka mutu a yayin yaƙi don samun matsayin mafi girma a cikin fadar mulkin da ke birnin Xi'an.

translations.source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.reference: Akwai tasiri na zamantakewa da siyasa masu yawa kamar amfani da tsarin awo cikakke, barin kama-karya zuwa jamhuriyya, kishin ƙasa tare da imanin cewa ƙasar ta mutanen ƙasa ce ba mutum ɗaya mai mulki ba.
translations.hypothesis: Akwai abubuwa da yawa masu tasiri na zamantakewa da siyasa, kamar yadda ake amfani da tsarin adadi, canje-canje daga mulkin mutum daya zuwa mulkin jam'iya, ƙasa-ƙarƙashiya, da kuma ɗaukaka ra'ayin cewa ƙasar ta kasance ta mutane, ba ta wani mutum ɗaya ba.

translations.source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.reference: Hakanan bayan juyin halin an bude ayyuka ga duk maza masu neman aiki inda hakan ya bada dama ga masu buri da kokari su sami cigaba.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan juyin mulki, ayyukan yi sun zama buɗu ga duk maza da suka nema, wanda ya ba wa masu himma da nasara damar samun ayyukan.

translations.source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.reference: Hakanan ya kasance ga sojoji saboda maimakon martaba sojoji ya kasance bisa la'akari da aji sai yanzu suka dogara da cailaber.
translations.hypothesis: Haka ne ma a sojojin, domin maimakon matsayin sojoji su dogara ne akan matakin ilimi, yanzu sun dogara ne akan matakin horo da suka samu.

translations.source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.reference: Juyin Juya Hali na Faransa ya kuma ba sauran wasu mutane masu tsananin ƙarfi na wata ƙasa damar fara nasu juyin juya halin.
translations.hypothesis: Juyin juya halin da ya faru a Faransa ya kara ba da wahayi ga wasu mutanen da ake danne-danne a wasu ƙasashe, domin su fara juyin juya halin su.

translations.source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.reference: Muhammadu yana matukar sha'awar al'amuran da suka wuce rayuwar wannan duniya. Ya na yawan ziyarar kogon da a ka fi sani da na “Hira” a tsaunin “Noor” (wato haske) domin kadaicewa yayi tunani.
translations.hypothesis: Muhammad yana da sha'awar al'amuran da suka wuce rayuwar yau da kullum. Ya kasance yana zuwa wani tsauni mai suna "Noor" (haske) inda yake shiga wani banza da ake kiransa "Hira'a" domin yin tunani.

translations.source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.reference: ya ɓoye kansa, wanda ya rayu a lokacin, yana ba da hoton karkatawar ruhaniyar Muhammad a tsarari.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan kogon, wanda ya tsufa lokaci, yana nuna tasiri mai karfi game da halin addinin Annabi Muhammad.

translations.source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.reference: Kasancewa a saman ɗayan duwatsun arewacin Makka, kogon ya zama ya keɓe daga sauran duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan bango ne da ke saman ɗaya daga cikin duwainen da ke arewa da birnin Mecca, kuma yana da tsarin da yake keɓancewa daga sauran duniya.

translations.source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.reference: A hakika akwai matukar wahalar gano wajen ko ma ka idan ka san ya kasance. Kana shiga cikin kogon zaka ji kadaita ta kama ka.
translations.hypothesis: A zahiri, ba sauri ba ne a samu, ko da wanda ya san cewa yana nan. Lokacin da aka shiga cikin wani bango, ana cikin wani wuri mai izoli sosai.

translations.source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.reference: Babu abin da za a iya gani face kyakkyawan sararin samaniya da tsaunuka masu yawa da ke kewayen. Baka iya ji ko ganin wadannan daga cikin kogon.
translations.hypothesis: Babu wani abu da za a iya ganwa sai sararin sama mai kyau da kuma tsaunuka da dama da ke kewaye. Kowane abu mai yawa a duniya ba za a iya ganinsa ko jiinsa daga cikin wannan taron ba.

translations.source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.reference: Babban alwatikan a Giza shine kawai ɗayan abubuwan al'ajabi bakwai da har yanzu suke tsaye a yau.
translations.hypothesis: Babban tutar da ke cikin birnin Giza shi ne daya ne kawai daga cikin manyan abubuwa bakwai waɗanda har yanzu yake nan a yau.

translations.source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.reference: Babban Masarautar da Masarawa suka gina a ƙarni na uku KZ, Babban alwatika yana ɗayan manyan gine-ginen dala da aka gina don girmama Fir'auna da ya mutu.
translations.hypothesis: An ƙirƙirar tutsan da aka fi sani da "Great Pyramid" ne a shekarar da ta wuce ta shekarar 300 BC, kuma ita ce ɗaya daga cikin manyan tutsosen da aka gina don girmama sarakuna da suka mutu.

translations.source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.reference: Giza Plateau, ko “Giza Necropolls” a Kwarin Massar na matattu yana kunshe da dala iri-iri ( wanda babban dala shine mafi girma), yawancin kananan kaburbura, gidajen bauta, da babban gunkin Sphinx.
translations.hypothesis: Plateau na Giza, wanda ake kiranta "Giza Necropolis" a cikin wani yanki na Masar wanda ake kira "Valley of the Dead," tana da manyan tudun tarihi (waɗanda mafi girma a cikin su shine tudun tarihi na Girma), wasu ƙananan makaburbai, wasu cibiyoyi, da kuma babban Sphinx.

translations.source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.reference: Babbar dalar an kafa ta ne domin girmama Fir’auna Khufu, kuma da daman cikinsu da kushewu da wuraren ibada an gina su ne domin matan Khufu tare da iyalan gidansa.
translations.hypothesis: Babban tutar da aka gina ta kasance don girmama sarkin Khufu, kuma manyan tutocin, makabartu, da gidajen ibada da aka gina sun kasance don girmama matan Khufu da sauran mambobin iyalansa.

translations.source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.reference: Alamar “kwarin sama” ta yi kama da V sannan “alamar kwarin ƙasa” kamar maɗauri ne ko murabba’i da ya kuskure gefen ƙasan ta.
translations.hypothesis: Alamar "ƙirƙirar ƙasa" tana kama irin hali da haruffa 'V', kuma alamar "ƙirƙirar sama" tana kama irin hali da ƙugiya ko kuma murabba' da aka rasa gefensa na ƙasa.

translations.source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.reference: Sama yana nufin ya kamata ka fara daga sama ka tura bakan, sannan kasan yana nufin ka fara daga kwado (wanda shine inda hannunka ke rike da baka) ka ja bakan.
translations.hypothesis: Idan aka ce "sama," ya kamata ku fara daga ƙarshen ƙugiyar kuma ku ja ta. Idan kuma aka ce "ƙasa," ya kamata ku fara daga wajen wanda ku ke riƙe da ƙugiyar (wanda ake kira "frog") kuma ku ja ta.

translations.source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.reference: Yawancin lokoci up-bow na fitar da murya mai laushi, haka kuma down-bow na da ƙarfi da tabatarwa sosai.
translations.hypothesis: Wani iri na kunna ƙonsa wanda yake ƙara ƙararrawa yana samar da sauti mai taushi, yayin da wani iri na kunna ƙonsa wanda yake ƙara ƙararrawa ya fi ƙarfi da kuma ƙarfin tunani.

translations.source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.reference: Ka saki jikinka wajen bada naka makin, amma kar ka manta makin da aka buga su na da dalilai na kida, don haka ya kamata a girmama su.
translations.hypothesis: Yin watsi da al'adar ƙara alama da kai, amma ku tuna cewa alamun da aka buga sun kasance don dalilin fasaha, don haka yawanci ya kamata a bi su.

translations.source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.reference: A firgice Sarki Louis da Sarauniya Marie Antoinette da yayansu guda biyu (Marie yar shekaru 11 da kuma Louis-Charles dan shekara hudu) da kuma yar'uwar Sarki, Madam Elizabeth, wadanda matan kasuwa masu bore a ranar 6 ga watan Oktoba 1789 sun tilasta musu komawa birnin Faris daga garin Versailles.
translations.hypothesis: A ranar 6 ga watan Oktoba na shekarar 1789, mazaunin birnin Paris sun tilasta wa Sarkin Louis XVI, matarsa, Sarkin Marie Antoinette, yayeansu biyu masu shekaru goma sha goma (Marie Therese) da shekara huɗu (Louis-Charles), da kuma uwarsa, Madam Elizabeth, su koma zuwa Paris daga Versailles. Mazaunin sun yi hakan ne a matsayin wani yakin neman gyara.

translations.source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.reference: A cikin tarago, suka koma zuwa Paris zagaye da wasu gungun mutane da ke ihu suna kalaman barazanar a kan Sarki da Sarauniya.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin mota, suka koma birnin Paris, suna cikin zurɓi na mutane da ke ta haifar da ƙara da barazanar ga Sarki da Uwar Sarki.

translations.source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.reference: Tarin mutanen ya tilastawa sarkin da sarauniyar bude tagogin abun hawan nasu.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyar mutane ta tilasta wa Sarkin da Uwar Sarkin su bude ragunan motarsu.

translations.source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.reference: A wata lokaci memba na yan zanga-zanga shugaban wata sarauta tsarewa sun kashe wata Versailles a gaban Sarauniya mai firgita.
translations.hypothesis: A wani lokaci, wani daga cikin mutanen da suka yi tarzoma ya nuna kai mai jarrabawar sojan da aka kashe a Versailles ga malkiya, wanda take tsoro.

translations.source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.reference: Kuɗaɗen ɗaukar nauyin yaƙi na mulkin mallakar Amurka a yakin mallake Philippines mutanen Phillippines ne da kansu suka biya.
translations.hypothesis: Kudin da Amurka ta kashe wajen mamaye Philippines, sun fiye da yadda aka yi tsari, kuma mutanen Philippines ne suka biya kudin.
