translations.source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.reference: An tilasta musu su biya haraji ga gwamnatin mulkin mallaka ta Amurka don biyan wani babban kaso na kudaden da aka kashe da kuma kuɗin-ruwa na kan basukan da aka fitar da sunan gwamnatin Philippines ta cikin bankunan Wall Street.
translations.hypothesis: Sun yiwa su bukatar biyan haraji ga gwamnatin mulkin mallaka ta Amurka domin biyan wani babban bangare na kudin da ake kashewa da kuma babban adadin da ake biya akan bond din da aka fitar a sunan gwamnatin Philippines ta hanyar bankunan da ke Wall Street.

translations.source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.reference: Tabbas, babban ribar da aka samu daga kwarar da aka dade ana yi wa ‘yan Filifins ya zama shi ne tushen nasarar mallakar bayan yanci da Amurka ta samu.
translations.hypothesis: Tabbas, kudin da aka samu ta amfani da mutanen Philippines tsawon lokaci zai zama babban nasarar da kasar Amurka ta samu ta hanyar mulkin mallaka.

translations.source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.reference: Don fahimtar Templars dole ne mutum ya fahimci mahallin da ya haifar da ƙirƙirar tsari.
translations.hypothesis: Don fahimtar kungiyar Templars, ya kamata a fahimci yanayin da ya jawo kafa ta.

translations.source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.reference: Zamanin da al'amuran suka faru galibi ana masu lakabi da Mafi girmn Shekarun Tsakiya lokacin tarihin Turai a ƙarni na 11, 12, da 13th (AD 1000 - 1300).
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da waɗannan abubuwa suka faru ana kiran shi da "Ƙarni na Tsakiya," wanda yake daya daga cikin lokutan tarihi na Turai a tsakanin ƙarni na 11, 12, da 13 (shekarun 1000 zuwa 1300).

translations.source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.reference: Lokacin karni na tsakiya na sama yana rigaye ne lokacin karni na tsakiya da ya zo kafin shi sannan yana tafe ne lokacin karni na tsakiya da yazo daga can gaba, wanda ya kamata ace ya kare a  daidai shekarar1500.
translations.hypothesis: Zamanin tsakiyar tarihi na farko ya biyo bayan zamanin farkon tarihi, kuma bayan zamanin tsakiyar tarihi na farko akwai zamanin ƙarshen tarihi, wanda, bisa ga alkawari, ya ƙare a kusan shekarar 1500.

translations.source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.reference: Wanzuwar Fasahar Ƙere-ƙere al’amari ne da ya haɗo wani faffaɗan fage na ra’ayoyi a aikace, daga bunƙasar fasaha ko muhimmancin fasahar ƙere-ƙere zuwa ga haƙiƙanin sanin cewa makomar dan adam tana tafiya ne bisa tabbatacciyar hikima wadda ke da alaƙa da dokokin kimiyya da kuma bayyanar su a cikin fasahar ƙere-ƙere.
translations.hypothesis: "Taswirar fasaha" wani kalma ce da ta ruɗe ƙungiyoyin ra'ayoyi da dama a aikace, daga yadda fasaha ta iya shafar abubuwa zuwa ga tunanin cewa tasirin fasaha ya kasance wajibi, har zuwa ra'ayin cewa makomancin ɗan Adam ya dogara ne akan tsari mai zurfi da ke da alaka da dokokin kimiyya da yadda suke bayyana a cikin fasaha.

translations.source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.reference: Yawancin fassarar tabbatuwar fasahar zamani sun kunshi ra’ayi mafiya yaduwa guda biyu: cewa na fasaha ita kanta na bin tafarki wacce ta sha bamban da tasirin al’ada ko siyasa da kuma cewa fasaha nada “tasiri” ga al’umma masu asali, fiye da na tsarin yanayin zamantakewa.
translations.hypothesis: Yawancin tafsirin ra'ayin cewa fasaha ta kasance mai ƙarfi, suna da ra'ayoyi biyu masu mahimmanci: cewa ci gaban fasaha yana biyo bayan hanya wacce ta fiye da tasiri daga al'adu ko siyasa, kuma fasahar, a nata bangare, tana da "tasiri" ga al'ummomi wanda yake cikin halin da take, ba wanda aka ƙirƙira ta hanyar al'adu ba.

translations.source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.reference: Misali, mutum na iya cewa motar tilas ba zata haifar da ci gaban hanyoyi ba.
translations.hypothesis: Misali, wanda yake magana zai iya cewa motocin tafiya suna tilasta ci gaban hanyoyi.

translations.source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.reference: Koyaya, hanyar sadarwa ta ƙasa gabaɗaya ba ta da tasirin tattalin arziƙi don ƙarancin motoci, saboda haka ana ƙirƙirar sabbin hanyoyin samarwa don rage farashin mallakar mota.
translations.hypothesis: Koy yaya, gina hanyoyin da suka kai dukkanin ƙasar ba zai zama mai fa'ida ba idan kawai akwai ƴan motoci kaɗan, don haka ana ƙirƙirar sababbin hanyoyin samarwa don rage farashin siyan mota.

translations.source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.reference: Hakanan mallakar motoci da yawa yana haifar da yawan hadari a kan hanyoyi, wanda ke haifar da kirkirar sabbin dabaru a fannin kiwon lafiya don gyaran jikin da ya lalace.
translations.hypothesis: Yawan motocin da ake mallaka kuma yana haifar da karuwar hatsarin mota a tituna, wanda ke jawo buƙatar ƙirƙirar sababbin hanyoyin kula da lafiya don gyara jikin mutane da suka ji rauni.

translations.source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.reference: Tsarin fasaha da adabi samar da al’adu, wanda marubuta irinsu Gothe, Fichte da Schlegel su ka samar.
translations.hypothesis: Romanticism ta ƙunshi wani ɓangare mai yawa na tunanin cewa al'ada ce ke da matuƙar tasiri, wanda aka samu daga marubuta kamar Goethe, Fichte, da Schlegel.

translations.source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.reference: A cikin siyakin romanci, yanayin kasa ya canza mutane, kuma lokaci da yawa sai al'adu da al'adu masu alaƙa da wannan yanayin suka taso, kuma waɗannan, kasancewar suna jituwa da matsayin jama'a, sun fi ƙa'idodi da aka kafa bisa doka da oda.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin mahallin falsafar Romanticism, yanayin ƙasa ya tasiri ga mutane, kuma tsayin lokaci ya haɗa da al'adu da dabi'u da suka danganci wannan yanayin. Waɗannan al'adu da dabi'u, saboda suke da dangantaka da yanayin da al'umma ke rayuwa, sun fi kyau fiye da dokokin da aka ƙayyade ba bisa ga yanayin ba.

translations.source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.reference: Kamar yadda aka san Paris da babban birnin salon zamani na duniyar yau, ana ɗaukar Constantinople a matsayin babban birni na zamani na Turai.
translations.hypothesis: Kamar yadda birnin Paris ya shahara a matsayin babban birnin fashen kayan zamani, to birnin Constantinople ya kasance babban birnin fashen kayan zamanin Turare ta baya.

translations.source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.reference: Shaharar ta na kasancewa cibiyar jin daɗi ya fara ne a kusan shekara ta 400 A.D. kuma ya kai har kusan 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan yanki ya shahara da kasancewarsa wani wurin da ake samu abubuwa masu kyau, kuma wannan shahara ta fara ne a kusan shekarar 400 AD, kuma ta ci gaba har zuwa kusan shekarar 1100 AD.

translations.source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.reference: Matsayinta ya yi kasa a ƙarni na goma sha biyu musamman sakamakon dawowar mayakan jihadin kuros dauke da kyaututtuka irin su siliki da kayan ɗanɗanon abinci waɗanda ake ɗauka da daraja fiye da abubuwan da ake sayarwa a kasuwannin Daular Rum.
translations.hypothesis: Matsayinsa ya ragu a lokacin karni na goma sha biyu, musamman saboda dalilin da ya faru cewa masu yaki (Crusaders) sun koma suna da kyauta kamar su kayan zani da kuma abinci mai daɗi, waɗanda suke da daraja fiye da abubuwan da kasuwannin Byzantine ke sayar da su.

translations.source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.reference: A wannan lokacin ne sauya mukamin na Kawar Babban Birni daga Constantinople zuwa Paris ya faru.
translations.hypothesis: A lokacin ne aka yi canjin sunan "Babban Birnin Fashin" daga Constantinople zuwa Paris.

translations.source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.reference: Tsarin Gothic ya yi shura a tsakankanin karni na 10 zuwa na 11 da kuma karni na 14.
translations.hypothesis: Salon fasaha na Gothic ya kai karshen girma nasa a tsakanin shekarun 10 zuwa 11 da kuma shekarun 14.

translations.source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.reference: A farkon lamari, kabilar Byzantine da ke gabashi ta karfafa saka tufafi.
translations.hypothesis: A farko, salama ta sami tasiri mai yawa daga al'adun Byzantine a gabas.

translations.source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.reference: Koyaya, saboda saurin tashoshin sadarwa, salo a yamma na iya zama baya zuwa shekara 25 zuwa 30.
translations.hypothesis: Koy yaya, saboda tsarin sadarwa da yake tafiya ta hanyar da ta fi yawa, salon kayan sawa da ake amfani da su a yammacin duniya na iya jinkewa zuwa shekaru 25 zuwa 30.

translations.source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.reference: a karshen karnin tsakiya sashin nahiyar turai na yamma ta fara bunkasa nata tsarin. Daya daga cikin abubuwan da aka gina a wannan lokacin da taimakon ‘yan jihadi shine fara amfani da anini don rike riga.
translations.hypothesis: A ƙarshen zamanin tsakiyar tarihi, Turare suka fara ci gaba da ƙirƙirar salo na musamman. Ɗaya daga cikin manyan ci gaban da aka samu a wancan lokacin, sakamakon yakin jihadi, mutane suka fara amfani da maƙallan don rufe kayan sawa.

translations.source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.reference: Noma domin abinci shine tsarin noma wanda ake yinsa domin kawai a samar da abincin da zai wadatar da mutum da iyalansa.
translations.hypothesis: Noma na zamantakewa shi ne noma da ake yi ne don samar da abinci mai yawa don biyan buƙatun mai noma da iyalansa.

translations.source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.reference: Noma domin abinci kawai abu ne mai sauki, sau da yawa, ana amfani da iri na shuka wanda ya dace da kasar noman wajen, tare da sauya abin shuka duk shekara a gona guda, domin samun cikakkiyar yabanya.
translations.hypothesis: Noma na zamani wanda ake yi ne don samar da abinci ga iyali, yawanci ana yi ne ta hanyar amfani da kayan lambu da aka adana su kuma sun fi dacewa da ƙasar, sannan ana amfani da hanyoyi masu sauƙi kamar juyawar amfanin ƙasa ko wasu hanyoyi iri ɗaya don ƙara yawan abokin gona.

translations.source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.reference: A tarihance mafi yawan manoma sun kasance suna aikin noma kuma wannan har yanzu haka lamarin yake a yawancin ƙasashe masu tasowa.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar da suka wuce, yawancin manoma suna yin noma don su ci gaba da rayuwarsu, kuma wannan har yanzu yana faruwa a cikin kasashe da dama masu tasowa.

translations.source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.reference: Rassan al’adu suna sada mutane masu tunani iri daya da suke ji tsarin rayuwa na al’umma bai dace da su ba inda suke ba su damar ganin suna da muhimanci a al’umma.
translations.hypothesis: Subcultures suna haɗa mutane da suka yi imani iri ɗaya waɗanda suke jin sun rasa wani abu a cikin al'adu da suka wanzu, kuma suna ba su damar samun fahimta game da kansu.

translations.source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.reference: Ana iya bambanta kananan al’adu saboda shekara, bangarenci na jama’a, matsayi cikin al’umma, guri, da/ko kuma jintsin membobi.
translations.hypothesis: Sub-al'adu na iya bambanta ne saboda shekarar, zuriyar, matakin zamantakewa, wurin da ake zama, da kuma/ko jinsi na mazauna.

translations.source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.reference: Kyawawan siffofin da suke tabbatar da wata ƙaramar al’ada a matsayin wadda ta fita daban kan iya kasancewa na yare, kyau, addini, siyasa, jinsi, na yanki, ko hadin abubuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Abubuwan da ke saɓabbuwa wata ƙungiya ko al'umma daga sauran al'ummomi suna iya kasancewa harshe, fasaha, addini, siyasa, al'adu, ƙa'ida, ko ma wasu abubuwa da suka haɗu.

translations.source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.reference: Membobin masana'antar sau da yawa suna nuna alamar kasancewa memba ta hanyar rarrabe mai amfani da alama ta salon, wanda ya haɗa da salon, halayen kirki, da ɗaukar hoto.
translations.hypothesis: Matafiya na wata ƙungiya ta musamman suna nuna cewa su ne mambobi ta hanyar amfani da salo na musamman da alama, wanda ya haɗa da salo na tufafi, yadda ake magana da al'adu, da kuma kalmomin da ake amfani da su a cikin wannan ƙungiya.

translations.source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.reference: Daya daga cikin matakan da ake amfani dashi domin nuna muhimmacin zamantakewa shine nuna kadan daga cikin hali na takaici wanda yara suka fuskanta, ta hanyar sakaci, masifa, ko cin zarafi, kuma basu zamantakewa da manya ba yayin da suke girma.
translations.hypothesis: Ɗaya daga mafi yawan hanyoyin da ake amfani da su don nuna muhimmancin hadin kai shi ne ta hanyar zayyana wasu misalan da suka yi muni, na yara waɗanda, ta hanyar rashin kulawa, rashin sa'a, ko kuma cin zarafi, ba su samu damar hada kai da manya yayin da suke girma.

translations.source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.reference: Ana kiran irin waɗannan yaran “sakakku” ko masu wuyar juyawa. Mutane sun sha kulle waɗansu sakakkun yara (yawanci iyayensu ne); a wasu al’amuran kuma barin yaran na da alaƙa da ƙin amincewar iyaye da naƙasar basira ko ta jikin yaro.
translations.hypothesis: Yaran da irin haka ake kira su da "mai halaye mara kyau" ko "mai halaye na dazara." Wasu daga cikin yaran da irin wannan halaye suna da su, mutane suka rufe su (kwanan nan, iyayensu ne); a wasu lokuta, barin yaron a waje ya faru ne saboda iyayensa sun ki amfani da yaron saboda matsalar ilimi ko jikin da yake da ita.

translations.source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.reference: Yaran mara zuciya masu jin tsoro na iya fuskantar mummunan cin zarafin yara ko rauni kafin a watsar da su ko su gudu.
translations.hypothesis: Yaran da suka rasa iyayensu ko kuma suka tsere daga gida suna iya fuskantar matsalar zalunci ko wahala sosai kafin su fita.

translations.source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.reference: Wasu ana zargin dabbobi ne suka yi rainon su; an ce wasu sun yi rayuwa a daji da kansu.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu mutane ana tuhmance su da cewa an girma su ne ta hanyar dabbobi; kuma wasu kuma ana cewa sun yi rayuwarsu a cikin filin daji ba tare da wani mutum ba.

translations.source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.reference: Idan ya kasance dabbar da ba mutum bace ta raini yaro gaba daya, zai kasance yaro zai taso da (na zihiri) kusan duka irin suffar dabi'un dabbar da ta kula dashi,misali irin yadda yake tsoro da rashin ko-in kula ga sauran mutane.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da yaro ya girma karkashin kulawar dabbobi ba mutane ba, yaro ɗin yana nuna halaye (a cikin iyakan jikin sa) kusan iri ɗaya da na dabbarsa, kamar su tsoronsa ga mutane ko kuma rashin son su.

translations.source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.reference: Duk da yake tushen koyo game da aiki yakamata ya sauƙaƙa ilmantarwa kuma ya zama mai ban sha'awa, ƙwanƙwasa aiki ya wuce mataki.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da cewa koyarwa ta hanyar ayyuka na iya sa koyarwa ta zama sauƙi da kuma mai daɗi, tsarin "scaffolding" ya wuce wannan mataki.

translations.source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.reference: Nannadewa ba hanya ce ta ilmantarwa ba amma taimako ne wanda ke bayar da tallafi ga mutanen da ke fuskantar sabon ƙwarewar ilmantarwa kamar amfani da sabon shirin komputa ko fara sabon aiki.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin taimako (scaffolding) ba hanya ce ta koyo ba, amma wani taimakon ne da ke ba da goyan baya ga mutane waɗanda suke samun sabon ilimi, kamar yadda ake samu a lokacin amfani da sabon shirin kwamfuta ko fara wani sabon aiki.

translations.source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.reference: Scafflods zasu iya zama na gaske da kuma virtual, a wasu kalaman, malami wani bangare ne na scafflod amma hakanan ma dan karamin abun makale takarda a microsoft office.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙungiyoyin taimako na iya zama na zahiri ko na ɗabi'a, watau, malami yana iya zama wani nau'in Ƙungiya, amma haka ma wani ƙaramin almara da ake amfani da shi a cikin Microsoft Office.

translations.source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.reference: Ana saka kariya cikin manhajojin domin su yi tambaya, su yi nuni da bada bayanai wadanda dalibai su kadai ba za su iya fuskanta ba.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin taimakon da ake samu a cikin software ɗin yana cikin shi ne, kuma an ƙera shi don tambayar, ba da umurnai, da bayyana ayyuka waɗanda zai iya zama masu wahala ga ɗalibin don aiwatar da suwa daya.

translations.source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.reference: Ana sanya yara a Gidan Reno saboda dalilai masu yawa da suka hada da sakaci, zin zarafi, har ma zuwa ƙwace.
translations.hypothesis: Yaran ana shigar da su cikin kulawar wani iyali saboda dalilai da dama, waɗanda suka haɗa da rashin kula da su, zalunci, har ma da cin zarafi.

translations.source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.reference: Bai kamata a ce akwai yaron da zai girma a cikin muhallin da babu reno, kulawa da kuma almantarwa, amma suna yi.
translations.hypothesis: Ba daɗi yaro ya girma a wani wuri da ba shi da ƙaƙƙauyi, kulawa, da ilimi, amma wasu suna fuskantar irin wannan yanayin.

translations.source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.reference: Mun fahimci Tsarin Kulawa na jarirai ya zama yankin aminci ga waɗannan yara.
translations.hypothesis: Muna ganin tsarin kula da yara marasa iyaye wani wuri ne na tsaro ga waɗannan yara.

translations.source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.reference: Ya kamata tsarinmu na karɓar riko ya samar da gidaje masu aminci, masu reno da ke nuna soyayya, ingantaccen ilimi, da tabbataccen tsarin kulawa da lafiya.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin kula da yara marasa iyaye da muke da shi ya kamata ya samar da gidaje masu tsaro, masu kula da su da son zuciya, ilimi mai dacewa, da kuma kula da lafiya ta dogon lokaci.

translations.source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.reference: Yakamata renon yara ya samar da dukkan bukatu wadanda su ke da bukatu a gidan da aka dauko su.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙungiyar kula da yara marasa iyaye tana da niyyar samar da duk abubuwan da suka ƙetare a gidan da suka fita daga ciki.

translations.source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.reference: Yanar gizo ta hada abubuwa biyu na sadarwar tsakanin al’umma da daidaikun mutane.
translations.hypothesis: Intanet yana haɗa abubuwa biyu: sadarwa da yawa da kuma sadarwa tsakanin mutane.

translations.source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.reference: Kyakyawan halaye na intanet suna haifar da karin girma dangane da matakan gamsarwa.
translations.hypothesis: Siffofin musamman da ke cikin intanet sun haɗa ga ƙarin abubuwa dangane da yadda ake amfani da shi da kuma abubuwan amfaninsa.

translations.source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.reference: Alal misali, “koyo” da “cudanya” ana kallonsu a matsayin muhimman hanyoyin ƙarfafa yin amfani da yanar gizo (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: Misali, "nazarin ilimi" da "al'adu" ana bayyana su a matsayin abubuwa masu muhimmanci waɗanda suke da tasiri wajen amfani da intanet (James da sauran, 1995).

translations.source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.reference: “Shiga cikin mutum” da “ci gaba da dangantaka” na cikin sabbin fannonin kwarin gwiwa ta Eighmey da McCord (1998) yayinda suka bincika daukin masu sauraro a gidajen yanar gizo.
translations.hypothesis: "Kungiyoyin mutane" da "al'adu da suka ci gaba" sun kuma kasance wani sabon abu da ya jawo hankali a matsayin abin da ke daidaita mutane, kamar yadda Eighmey da McCord (1998) suka gano lokacin da suke bincike yadda mutane suka yi amfani da shafukan yanar gizo.

translations.source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.reference: Amfani da rikodin bidiyo ya haifar da bincike mai mahimmanci a cikin fassara bayanan fuska, motsin fuska waɗanda ba sa wuce lokaci ƙalilan.
translations.hypothesis: Amfani da bidiyo don riƙo da hotuna ya haɗa da samun sabbin gano abubuwa masu muhimmanci a fannin tafsirin alamomin ƙaramin ɓata, watau motsin fuskoki waɗanda suke faruwa ne a cikin ƴan milisikanin lokaci.

translations.source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.reference: Musamman ma kamar, ikirarin da ya yi cewa zai gano ko mutum yana karyar fassarar/fahimtar kananan maganganu yadda suke.
translations.hypothesis: Musamman, ana ikirarin cewa wani mutum na iya gano ko wani yana ƙarya ta hanyar fahimtar yadda fuskarsa ke nuna alamomin ƙarya.

translations.source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.reference: A cikin takardar shi mai take Jawabin Shugaba Oliver Sacks ya bayyana yadda mutane dake fuskantar masala wajen fahimtar jawabi bisa ga masalar tabin kwakwalwa, yace duk da haka suna iya fahimtar gaskiya daidai.
translations.hypothesis: Oliver Sacks, a cikin takardarsa mai taken "Maganganun Shugaban," ya nuna yadda mutanen da basa iya fahimtar magana saboda lalacewar kwakwalwa, duk da haka, suna iya tantance gaskiya da ƙarya daidai.

translations.source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.reference: Har ma yana ba da shawarar cewa irin waɗannan damar a fassara halayen mutane za su iya rabawa ta dabbobi kamar su karnukan gida.
translations.hypothesis: Har ma da ya bayyana cewa irin wannan ƙwarewar wajen fahimtar yadda mutane suke da alaka, na iya kasancewa a cikin dabbobi kamar kare.

translations.source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.reference: Binciken ƙarni na ashirin ya nuna cewa akwai rabe-raben halittar gado guda biyu: ɓoyayye da na bayyananne.
translations.hypothesis: Bincike da aka yi a karni na ashirin ya nuna cewa akwai hanyoyin biyu na bambance-bambancen halitta: wanda yake ɓoye da kuma wanda yake bayyana.

translations.source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.reference: Maye gurbi yana ƙara sabon bambancin kwayoyin, kuma zaɓi ya cire shi daga tafkin bambancin da aka bayyana.
translations.hypothesis: Canje-canje na jini yana ƙara sabbin bambance-bambancen jini, kuma zabin yana cire su daga cikin bambance-bambancen da ke bayyana.

translations.source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.reference: Rabuwa da sake haduwa iri dabam-dabam baya da gaba tsakanin gidan ruwan guda biyu a kowace karni.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan tsarin da ake kira "segregation da recombination" yana canzawa da kuma juyawa ga bambance-bambancen da ke cikin manyan kungiyoyin da ke cikin kowane zuriyar.

translations.source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.reference: A can cikin yankin savanna, yana da wahala ga wata halitta dangin biri da ke da tsarin narkewar abinci irin na mutum ta iya gamsar da buƙatunta na sinadarin amino daga albarkatun tsirrai da ake da su.
translations.hypothesis: A wajen filin busasshi, yana da wahala ga dabbobin da ke da tsarin narkewa kamar na mutane su samu isasshen abinci mai amfanar (amino acid) daga kayan abinci da ake samu.

translations.source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.reference: Bugu da ƙari, ƙin yin hakan yana tattare da munanan sakamako:kamar rashin yin girma, rashin abinci mai gina jiki, da kuma a karshe mutuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Haka kuma, rashin aiwatar da wannan abu na da sakamakon da ba su da kyau: raguwar ci gaba, rashin abinci, kuma a ƙarshe, mutuwa.

translations.source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.reference: Ma’dinan tsirrai da aka fi saurin amfani da su sun kasance sunadaran gina jiki da za'a iya samu a ganye da ƙwaya, amma waɗannan suna da tauri ga halittu irin mu wajen narkewa har sai an dafa su.
translations.hypothesis: Abubuwan da ake samu cikin sauƙi daga kayan halitta sun kasance su ne furotin da ke cikin leaves da naman daji, amma wannan abu ne da ba sa sauƙin cinye ga dabbobi kamar mu, sai dai idan an yi da shi girki.

translations.source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.reference: Sabanin haka, abincin dabbobi (tururuwa, gara, ƙwai) ba kawai ana iya narkewa cikin sauƙi ba, amma suna samar da sunadarai masu yawa waɗanda ke ɗauke da dukkan muhimman amino acid.
translations.hypothesis: A wanda, abincin dabbobi (kamar ƙwayar ƙasa, ƙwayar ƙwashi, da kuma ƙwayayye) ba wai kawai su sauƙi ne a narkewa ba, har ma suke samar da adadi mai yawa na furotin wanda ya ƙunshi duk mahimman amino acid.

translations.source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.reference: In an yi la’akari da dukkan abubuwa, bai kamata mu yi mamaki ba idan magabatanmu suka magance “matsalar kayan gina jiki” ta irin hanyar da goggon biri a yankin savanna suke yi a yau.
translations.hypothesis: Idan aka duba dukkanin abubuwa, ba za mu ba da mamaki idan iyalanmu na baya sun yi yadda suka yi don magance "al'amarci na protein" ta hanyar iri ɗaya da yadda kwanƙwaran suke yi a yau a cikin filin savanna.

translations.source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.reference: Katse bacci yanayi ne na farkawa da gangan cikin lokacin yin bacci na al’ada da kuma komawa bacci cikin dan kaknkanin lokaci daga baya (minti 10-60).
translations.hypothesis: Tsauraran barci shine tsari ne wanda a ciki ana farkawa a lokacin da ake fama da barci, sannan ana barin mutum ya fafata cikin lokaci mai kaɗan (tsakanin minti 10 zuwa 60).

translations.source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.reference: Za'a iya yin wannan a saukake ta hanyar amfani da kararrawa mara kara sosai da zai tashe ka ba tare da ya wartsakar da kai ba.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan zai iya yi cikin sauƙi ta amfani da ƙararrawa mai ƙararrawa kadan wacce za ta mayar da hankalinka ba tare da ta farka maka gaba ɗaya ba.

translations.source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.reference: Idan ka sami kanka ka sake saita agogo a cikin barcinka, ana iya sanya shi a ɗaya gefen ɗakin, yana tilasta ka tashi daga kan gado don kashe shi.
translations.hypothesis: Idan kana samun damuwa da sake saita agogon yayin da kake barci, za ka iya sanya shi a gefen wani bangare na dakin, wanda zai tilasta maka ka tashi daga gado don ka kashe shi.

translations.source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.reference: Sauran zabukan da suka danganta da lissafin ɗabi’ar rayuwa sun kunshi shan kayan ruwa da yawa (musamman ruwa ko shayi, sanannen sinadari mai jawo fitsari) kafin barci, da ke tilastawa mutum ya tashi ya yi ftisari.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu hanyoyin da ake yi bisa ga tsarin biorhythm sun haɗa da shan ruwa mai yawa (musamman ruwa ko shayi, wanda ake sani da cewa yana tilasta jikin fitar da ruwa), kafin barci, wanda hakan na iya tilasta mutum ya tashi ya yi sujada.

translations.source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.reference: Yawan kwanciyar hankali da mutum yake da shi ya danganta da kishiyantar yawan tashin hankali a cikin jikin mutum da ruhunsa.
translations.hypothesis: Yawan nutsuwar da mutum yake da ita yana da dangantaka da yawan tashin hankali da jiki da ruhinsa ke ji, kuma wannan dangantaka ta kasance mai adawa. Watau, idan mutum yana da nutsuwa sosai, to yana da yuwua tashin hankali a jikinsa da ruhinsa ya kasance ƙasa.

translations.source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.reference: Rage tashin hankali, haka kuma yawan fata na gari da ƙarfin rayuwa zai gabatar. Ko wani mutum na da damar samun kwanciyar hankali da gamsuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Idan matsin lamba ya ƙasa, to ƙarfin rayuwa zai kasance mafi yawa. Kowane mutum yana da damar samun zaman lafiya da farin ciki.

translations.source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.reference: Kowa zai iya cimma wayewa. Abinda kawai ke tsaye kan hanyar wannan burin shine tashin hankali da fargaba.
translations.hypothesis: Kowa zai iya samun haske. Abin da ke hana mu cimma wannan burin shi ne damuwa da mummunan hali da muke da su.

translations.source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.reference: Buddhist na Tibet ya dogara ne da koyarwar Buddha, amma hanyar mahayana da ta hanyar fasahar India da yawa sun ninka ta.
translations.hypothesis: Buddhism na Tibet ta dogara ne akan koyarwar Buddha, amma an ƙara masa da hanyar mahayana wacce ta ƙunshi soyayya, da kuma hanyoyi da dama daga cikin yoga ta Indiya.

translations.source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.reference: A bisa ƙa’ida Budancin Tibet yana da sauƙi. Ya kunshi tsarin motsa jiki na Yoga, kadaicewa domin tunani da kuma bin tafarkin son kowa da komai.
translations.hypothesis: Ainihin, addinin Buddha na Tibet yana da sauƙi sosai. Ya ƙunshi Kundalini Yoga, tunani, da kuma hanya ta soyayya mai karfafa.

translations.source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.reference: Da Kundalini Yoga an samar da kuzarin Kundalini (kuzarin wayarwa da kai) an farka ta hanyar motsawar jiki, motsawar nufanci, mantras da ganin wa.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin Kundalini Yoga, wutar Kundalini (wato wutar haske) ta kasance ta farkawa ta hanyar ayyukan jiki na yoga, motsa jiki, addu'a, da kuma tunani.

translations.source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.reference: Ginshiƙen tunanun Tibetan shi ne Abin Bauta Yoga. Duk da yake kafafen gani na abubuwan bauta daban-daban hanyoyin makamashi an tsaftace su, akan buɗe chakras inda ake ƙirƙirar tunanin wayewa.
translations.hypothesis: Tsakiyar addu'ar Tibet ta kasance a cikin "Deity Yoga." Ta hanyar tunani game da halittu daban-daban, hanyoyin makir ya tsafta, chakras suna samun motsi, kuma fahimtar ilimi tana bayyana.

translations.source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.reference: Jamus abokiyar gabar kowa ce a Yakin Duniya ta 2, wanda hakan ta haifar da haɗin kai tsakanin Tarayyar Sobiyet da Amurka. Da ƙarewar yakin sai sabanin tsarin rayuwa, al’amura da al'adu ya jawo rabuwar kan ƙasashen.
translations.hypothesis: Jamhuriyar Jamus ta kasance abokin adawa a yakin duniya na biyu, wanda ya haifar da hadin kai tsakanin USSR da Amurka. Bayan ƙarewar yakin, bambance-bambancen siyasa, tsari, da al'ada sun haifar da rikici tsakanin kasashe.

translations.source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.reference: Tare da shekaru biyu na ƙarshen yaƙin, tsoffin maƙasudin yanzu abokan gaba ne kuma aka fara Yakin Sanyi.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan shekaru biyu da ƙarewar yakin, wadanda suka yi hada-hadari a baya sun zama abokan adawa, kuma yakin kasashen duniya ya fara.

translations.source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.reference: An tsara zai kai shekaru 40 masu zuwa kuma za ayi yaƙe shi a hakika,ta sojojin haya, a filayen yaƙi daga Africa zuwa Asia, a Afghanistan, Cuba da sauran wurare da dama.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ya kasance zai ci gaba na shekaru 40 na gaba, kuma za a yi yaƙi a kai, ta hanyar sojojin da ake amfani da su, a filayen yaƙi daga Afirka zuwa Asiya, a Afghanistan, Cuba, da sauran wurare da yawa.

translations.source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.reference: Ya zuwa 17 ga Satumba, 1939, tsaron Poland ya riga ya karye, kuma fatan kawai da ake da shi shine na janyewa sannan a sake shiri a kan tozon gadar Romania.
translations.hypothesis: A ranar 17 ga watan Satumba, shekarar 1939, sojojin Poland sun yi rauni, kuma kawai abin da za su iya yi shi ne su ja baya su yi tsari na sabo a wajen iyaka da kasar Romania.

translations.source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.reference: Koda yake wannan shiri ya tashi daga aiki dare ɗaya, yayin da sama da sojoji 800,000 na tarayyar Soviet su ka shiga Belarus da Ukraine inda su ka shata fagen daga bayan mamayar kasar Poland wanda ya karya yarjejeniyar sulhu da aka yi a Riga, sulhu zaman lafiya na kasashen Soviet da Poland da ma wasu yarjeniyoyin na kasashen duniya tsakanin kasarshe biyu ko fiye da haka.
translations.hypothesis: Koyaya, waɗannan shirin sun zamo ayyukan da ba su da amfani cikin sauri, lokacin da sama da sojoji 800,000 daga rundunar soja ta Sovet, wato Rundunar Red, suka shiga kuma suka kafa fagen yakin Belarusiya da Ukraine bayan mamaye yankin gabas na Poland, wanda ya lalata yarjejenin zaman lafiya da aka cimma a Riga, yarjejenin hana rashin sulhu tsakanin Sovet da Poland, da sauran yarjejenin kasa da kasa, duka na gaba da gaba da na kungiyoyi.

translations.source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.reference: Amfani da jirgin ruwa domin kwasan kayayyaki shine mafi inganci wajen kwasan mutane da yawa da kayayyaki ta teku.
translations.hypothesis: Amfani da jiragen ruwa don jigilar kaya shine mafi kyawun hanya don jigilar mutane da kaya cikin adadi mai yawa a fadin tekuna.

translations.source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.reference: Ainihin aikin sojojin ruwa shine domin tabbatar cewa kasarka ta kula da iyawa domin motsa mutanenka da kayayyaki, yayinda kuma a lokaci daya, tsoma baki da kokarin da abokan gaba ke yi domin tafiyar da mutane da kayayyaki.
translations.hypothesis: Aikin sojojin ruwa na da al'ada cewa su tabbatar da cewa ƙasar ku tana da damar jigilar mutane da abubuwa, yayin da suke kuma hana abokan adawarsu damar jigilar mutane da abubuwa.

translations.source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.reference: Daya daga cikin fitattun misalai na kwana nan game da wannan shine gumurzun yankin Atlantika ta Arewa lokacin Yakin Duniya na biyu. Amurkawa suna ƙoƙarin jigilar da sojoji da kayan yaki zuwa ƙetarenTekun Atlantika don taimakawa Biritaniya.
translations.hypothesis: Ɗaya daga cikin misalan da suka fi muhimmanci a zamanin nan shine yakin da aka yi a yankin Arewa da Kudancin Atlantika a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu. Amurkawa suna ƙoƙarin jigilar mutane da kayayyaki ta kogin Atlantika domin taimakon Burtaniya.

translations.source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.reference: A lokaci daya, dakarun ruwa na Jamus, ta hanyar amfani da jirgin U-boats, na kokarin tsayar da wannan cinkoson.
translations.hypothesis: A lokaci ɗaya, rundunar sojojin ruwa ta Jamus, wadda ta fi amfani da jiragen ruwa masu sauya hanya (U-boats), na ƙoƙarin dakatar da wannan ayyukan.

translations.source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.reference: Da Sojan taron dangi ba su yi nasara ba, watakila da Jamus ta iya yi mamaye Biritaniya kamar ta sauran Turai.
translations.hypothesis: Idan kungiyoyin da suka yi adawa da Jamus ba su yi nasara ba, da alama Jamus zata iya sarrafa Burtaniya kamar yadda ta sarrafa sauran kasashen Turai.

translations.source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.reference: Ana ganin akuya ta kasance gida ta farko kusan shekaru 10,000 da suka gabata a tsaunukan Zagros na Iran.
translations.hypothesis: An bayyana cewa, akwai alamu da ke nuni da cewa, wasu mutane sun fara juyin halin dabbobin tuwo kimanin shekaru 10,000 da suka wuce a tsaunin Zagros da ke cikin kasar Iran.

translations.source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.reference: Al’adu da ƙabilun zamanin da ne su ka fara adana su domin sauƙin samun madara, gashi, nama, da kuma fatu.
translations.hypothesis: Al'adu da ƙungiyoyin mutane na daɗe suka fara adana dabbobi domin samun sauƙi wajen samun nono, farji, nama, da fata.

translations.source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.reference: A koyaushe ana ajiye awakin gida a cikin garken shanun da ke yawo a kan tsaunuka ko wasu wuraren kiwo, galibi masu kiwon awaki waɗanda yara da samari ne ke kula da su, kwatankwacin sanannen makiyayi. Wadannan hanyoyin kiwo har yanzu ana amfani dasu.
translations.hypothesis: Awon dabbobin shan tuwo da ake adana a gida galibi ana adana su a cikin kungiyoyi waɗanda suke tafiya a kan duwatsu ko sauran wuraren da ake haye, kuma sau da yawa ana kula da su ne ta hanyar masu kula da dabbobi, waɗanda yawanci suke da shekaru kaɗan ko kuma matasa, kamar yadda ake kula da dabbobi a wasu al'umma. Hanyoyin kula da dabbobin waɗannan har yanzu ake amfani da su a yau.

translations.source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.reference: An samar da layukan tarago a Ingila tun a wajejen Ƙarni na 16.
translations.hypothesis: An gina hanyoyin jiragen ruwa a Ingilishi tun shekarar 16 da farko.

translations.source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.reference: Duk da cewa keken dokin sun kunshi katako a jere, amma su kan ba da dama ga dawakan da ke jan su yin sauri tare da jan manyan kaya fiye da a kan hanyoyi masu gargada na zamanin.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake hanyoyin da ake amfani da su wajen jigilar kaya sun kasance kawai wajen da aka jera da ƙananan ƙasa, sun ba wa dabbobin da ke ja su damar samun sauri sosai da kuma jigilar kaya mafi yawa fiye da yadda suke yi a kan hanyoyin da suke da ƙura a lokacin.

translations.source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.reference: An sanya Crossties tun da wuri don su tsayar layukan. Sai dai, hankali, an gano cewa layukan za su fi dacewa idan suna da ɗori na ƙarfe a saman su.
translations.hypothesis: An fara amfani da ƙwayoyin da ake kiran "crossties" ne da wuri don tabbatar da tsayayyen ayyukan layin ƙetare. Amma, a hankali, aka gano cewa layin ƙetare zai iya aiki sosai idan aka saka ƙaramin ƙarfe a sama.

translations.source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.reference: Wannan ya zama aikin gama gari, sai ƙarfe ya haifar da ƙarin lalacewa a ƙafafun katako na kekunan.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ya zama yadda aka saba yi, amma ƙaramin ƙarfe ya haifar da ƙarin lalacewa ga ƙwanƙwan itace da ake amfani da su a motocin.

translations.source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.reference: Daga karshe, an sauya tayoyin katako da na karfe. A cikin 1767 an kaddamar da farkon hanyar jirgin kasa kerar karfe.
translations.hypothesis: A ƙarshe, ƙungiyar itace ta maye gurbinsa da ƙungiyar ƙarfe. A shekarar 1767, an gabatar da wani sabon tsari wanda ya ƙunshi ƙungiyoyin ƙarfe guda ɗaya.

translations.source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.reference: Hanyar sufuri ta farko da aka sani ita ce tafiya da ƙafa, mutane sun fara tafiya a miƙe shekaru miliyan biyu da suka gabata lokacin bayyanawar Homo Erectus (ma'ana miƙaƙƙen mutum).
translations.hypothesis: Farkon hanyoyin tafiya da aka sani shi ne tafiya da ƙafafunsa, mutane suka fara tafiya a tsaye kimanin shekaru miliyan biyu da suka wuce, lokacin da aka bayyana Homo Erectus (wanda yake nufin "mutumin da yake tsaye").

translations.source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.reference: Magabatan su, Australopithecus ba su yi tafiya miƙe ba kamar yadda ya ke a ɗabi’ance.
translations.hypothesis: Wakilan su, waɗanda ake kira Australopithecus, ba su da yawan tafiya a tsaye kamar yadda suke.

translations.source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.reference: An sami kwarewar dabbobi masu tafiya da kafafu biyu a ƙasusuwan tarihi na Australopithecus daga shekaru miliyan 4.2-3.9 da suka shude, duk da cewa watakila Sahelanthropus sun yi tafiya da kafafu biyu tun wajen shekaru miliyan bakwai da suka gabata.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu halaye na motsa jiki ta hanyar tafiya akan ƙafafun biyu an gano su a cikin ƙamusoshin Australopithecus waɗanda suka mallaki shekaru 4.2 zuwa 3.9 da suka wuce, duk da cewa Sahelanthropus na iya motsa jiki ta hanyar tafiya akan ƙafafun biyu tun da shekaru bakwai da suka wuce.

translations.source: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.reference: Za mu iya fara zaman nuna sabo ga muhalli, za mu iya shiga cikin yunƙurin inganta muhalli, kuma mu kan iya zama ‘yan gwagwarmaya don rage wahala nan gaba a wani mataki.
translations.hypothesis: Za mu iya fara rayuwa ta yadda ta fi dacewa da muhalli, za mu iya shiga kungiyoyin da ke adana muhalli, kuma za mu iya zama masu yakin neman sauyin muhalli domin rage wahala da za ta iya faruwa a nan gaba.

translations.source: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.reference: Wannan kamar magani ne na alamun cuta a lokuta da yawa. Koyaya, idan ba kawai muna son magancewa ta ɗan lokaci ba ne, to ya kamata mu samo tushen matsalolin, kuma mu kashe su.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan yana kama da maganin da ake yi ne kawai don kawar da alamun cuta a wasu lokuta. Duk da haka, idan ba mu so maganin da zai yi aiki ne kawai na wani lokaci, to ya kamata mu gano asalin matsalar, sannan mu kawar da ta.

translations.source: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.reference: A bayyane ya ke cewa duniya ta canza sosai saboda ci gaban Dan Adam a fannonin kimiyya da fasaha, kuma matsaloli sun karu sosai sakamakon yawan jama’a da halayyar mutane ta almubazzaranci.
translations.hypothesis: Yin da ya bayyana cewa duniya ta canza sosai saboda ci gaban ilimi da fasaha da mutane suka samu, kuma matsaloli sun karu saboda yawan yawan mutane da kuma tarzumar rayuwar da mutane suka ƙulla.

translations.source: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.reference: Bayan Majalisar wakilai ta amince da shi a ranar 4 ta Yuli, sa'an nan aka aika wani daftarin da aka rubuta da hannu wanda Shugaban Majalisar John Hancock ya sa hannu da ɗan nesa zuwa ga shagon buga rubutu na John Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: Bayan Majalisar ta yi karbuwa ga takardar ta a ranar 4 ga watan Yuli, wata takarda da aka rubuta da kai, wacce Shugaban Majalisa, John Hancock, da Sakataren, Charles Thomson, suka sanya sa hannu, an aika ta zuwa wani wurin da yake kusa da wajen, zuwa ofishin bugawa na John Dunlap.

translations.source: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.reference: Cikin daren an buga tsakanin 150 da 200 wanda aka fi sani da “Dunlap Broadsides”.
translations.hypothesis: A tsakanin dare, an yi kwafin takardun ne tsakanin 150 zuwa 200, kuma yanzu ana kiranta da "takardun Dunlap."

translations.source: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.reference: John Nixon ne ya yi karatun farko na daftarin a bainar jama’a cikin filin Independence Hall a ranar 8 ga watan Yuli.
translations.hypothesis: Wani mutum mai suna John Nixon ne ya yi karantawa ta farko na takardar ta a gaban jama'a, a wajen gidan Independence Hall, a ranar 8 ga watan Yuli.

translations.source: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.reference: An aika ma George Washington ɗaya a ranar 6 ga Yuli, wanda ya karanta ma sojojinsa a New York ranar 9 ga Yuli. Wani kwafi ya isa Landan a ranar 10 ga watan Agusta.
translations.hypothesis: Wata takarda aka aika zuwa ga George Washington a ranar 6 ga watan Yuli, sai aka karanta ta ga sojojinsa a birnin New York a ranar 9 ga watan Yuli. Wata kwafi ta isa birnin London a ranar 10 ga watan Agusta.

translations.source: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.reference: Manyan bangarori 25 na Dunlap da har yanzu aka san sun wanzu sune mafi thufan kwafin rubutattun takardun. Kwafin rubutun hannun na asali ya salwanta.
translations.hypothesis: Takardun 'yan shari'un Dunlap da ake sanin cewa har yanzu akwai wasu 25, su ne takardun da suka fi shekaru kuma suka tsufa fiye da sauran. Takardar asali da aka rubuta da hannu ba ta nan.

translations.source: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.reference: Yawancin masana burbushin halittu a yau sunyi imanin cewa ƙungiyar dinosaur daya ta rayu kuma tana raye a yau. Muna kiran su tsuntsaye.
translations.hypothesis: Yanzu haka, masu bincike da suka yi nazari akan ƙazalman (paleontologists) da yawa suna ɗaukar cewa wata ƙungiya ta ƙazalman ta tsufa kuma tana nan har yanzu. Muna kiran su "tsofofi" (birds).

translations.source: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.reference: Mutane da yawa basa tunanin cewa suna daga cikin halitun dinosaurs saboda suna da fiffike kuma suna iya tashi sama.
translations.hypothesis: Mutane da yawa basu tunanin su suke cikin halittun da ake kira "dinosaurai" saboda suna da fuka-fukai kuma suna iya tashi cikin iska.

translations.source: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.reference: Amma akwai wasu abubuwa game da tsuntsuye dake kama da na dinosaur.
translations.hypothesis: Amma akwai abubuwa da dama game da dabbobin tashi da suka yi kama da dabbobin ƙanƙara.

translations.source: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.reference: Suna da ƙafafu masu gurji-gurji da fartuna, suna yin ƙwai, kuma suna tafiya kan ƙafafunsu biyu na baya kamar wani T-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: Sun da ƙafafun da ke da ƙwayoyin ƙasa da ƙamshiya, suna haifar da ɗaya, kuma suna tafiya ta ƙafafunsu biyu na baya kamar yadda T-Rex yake.

translations.source: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.reference: Kusan duk kwamfutoci da ake amfani da su a yau sun dogara ne akan iya sarrafa bayanai wanda ake rufewa a sigar tagwayen lambobi.
translations.hypothesis: Kusan dukkan kwamutocin da ake amfani da su a yau suna dogara ne akan aiwatar da bayanai waɗanda aka adana su a matsayin lambobi masu tsari biyu (binary).

translations.source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
translations.reference: Lambar binary na iya samun ɗaya daga darajoji biyu, misali 0 ko 1, kuma waɗannan lambobin ana kiransu da lambobin binary - ko guntaye, in za a yi amfani da yaren kwamfuta.
translations.hypothesis: Adadi mai tsari biyu (binary) na iya samun ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyin biyu, watau 0 ko 1, kuma waɗannan adadi ana kiranta da "binary digits" ko kuma "bits," kamar yadda ake amfani da su a fannin kwamputa.

translations.source: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
translations.reference: Harbuwa da guba a cikin jiki ba abu ne da ake iya ganewa da wuri ba. Alamu irinsu amai gama gari ne don haka ba a iya tantancewa da wurwuri.
translations.hypothesis: Ciwon da ya samo asali a cikin jiki bazai bayyana kai tsaye ba. Alamomin, kamar ciwon hanji, suna da yawa kuma ba su da wata alama ta musamman, don haka ba za a iya samar da wata hujjarsa kai tsaye ba.

translations.source: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
translations.reference: Hanya mafi saukin gane ko ana sami guba a ciki, shine watakila idan an sami budadden kwano na magani ko wasu sinadarai masu guba da ake amfanin yau da gobe da su a gida.
translations.hypothesis: Abin da zai iya nuna cewa wani ya sha maganin da ya cutar da jiki ko kuma ya sha sinadarai masu cutarwa da ake amfani da su a gida shi ne, idan aka samu wata kofiya ta magani ko kuma sinadarai irin su a bude.

translations.source: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
translations.reference: Duba bayanin da ke jiki domin samun bayanai na taimakon gaggawa agame da gubar.
translations.hypothesis: Duba lakabin don samun umurnin da za su bi don bayar da taimakon gaggawa ga mutumin da ya sha wannan nau'in guba.

translations.source: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
translations.reference: Likitocin dabbobi na amfani da kalmar bug wa wannan rukunin kwari.
translations.hypothesis: Kalmar "bug" ana amfani da ita ne a bangaren kimiyyar halittu (entomology) don nuna wannan rukunin kwari.

translations.source: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
translations.reference: An samo kalmar tun zamanin da daga sanayyarsu da kudin cizo, wato wasu kwari da su ke zama muhallin mutane suna tsotsar jininsu.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan kalmar ta fito ne daga ilimin da ake da shi a baya game da kwari, wanda su ma su ne ƙwayoyin halitta waɗanda suka fi dacewa da zama masu cutarwa ga mutane.

translations.source: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
translations.reference: Duka kwarin mutuwa da kuma kudin cizo masu zaman gida ne, sun saba da zama a gidansu ko mazaunin wanda suke shan jininsa.
translations.hypothesis: Duk masu cutar da aka sani da "Assassin-bugs" da kuma "Bed-bugs" suna zaune a cikin fuka-fukan ko wuraren zama na dabbobin da suke cutar da su.

translations.source: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
translations.reference: A duk faɗin Amurka, akwai kusan rahoto 400,000 na cutar Multiple Sclerosis (MS), abinda ya sa ta zama ja-gaba cikin ciwukan sadarwa a jiki ga matasa da masu shekaru tsaka-tsaki.
translations.hypothesis: A duk fadin Amurka, akwai kusan mutane 400,000 da aka tabbatar da cewa suna da cutar Multiple Sclerosis (MS), wanda ke sa ta zama cutar tsofafi da ake samu mafi yawa a cikin mutanen da suka kai shekaru 20 zuwa tsakiyar shekaransu.

translations.source: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
translations.reference: Cutar MS cuta ce da ke shafar lakkar jikin dan adam, da ya hadar da kwakwalwa da jijiyar lakkar da kuma na kai sakonni.
translations.hypothesis: MS wata cuta ce da ta shafar tsarin tsarin jinin mutum, wanda ya ƙunshi kwakwalwa, tsotsotsa, da kuma igiyar ido.

translations.source: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
translations.reference: Bincike ya gano cewa mata sun fi alamar samun MS da ninka biyu a kan maza.
translations.hypothesis: Bincike ya nuna cewa mata suna da karon biyu fiye da maza su sami cutar MS.

translations.source: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
translations.reference: Ma'aurata na iya yanke shawara cewa ba shine maslaharsu ba, ko maslaha ga ɗansu, tarbiyyar da jariri.
translations.hypothesis: Wani ma'aɗi da matar sa na iya yanke shawarar cewa ba su so su dauki yaro, ko kuma ba shi da amfani ga su ko ga yaron da za su haifa.

translations.source: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
translations.reference: Waɗannan ma'aurata na iya zaɓar yin shirin tallafi ga jaririn.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ma'auratan na iya zaɓar yin shirin ɗaukar yaro don ɗaɗa.

translations.source: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
translations.reference: A tsarin mallakar yaro, iyayen da suka haifi yaron za su dakatar da haƙƙinsu na iyaye saboda wasu ma'aurata su kasance iyayen sa.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin tsarin ɗaukar yaro, iyayen da suka haifi yaron suna barin hakkinsu na iyaye, domin wasu ma'aurata su iya kula da yaron.

translations.source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
translations.reference: Babbar manufar kimiyya ita ce gano yadda duniya ke wanzuwa ta hanyar kimiyya. Alal hakika wannan hanya ta bincike ita ce ke yin jagora ga mafi yawan bincike na kimiyya.
translations.hypothesis: Babban burin ilimin kimiyya shi ne fahimtar yadda duniya ke aiki ta amfani da hanyoyin kimiyya. Wannan hanya a zahiri tana jagorancin babban bangaren bincike a fannin kimiyya.

translations.source: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
translations.reference: Ba shi kaɗai bane dai, yin gwaji, kuma gwaji wata hanya ce ta jarrabawa da ake amfani da ita domin kawar da ɗaya ko fiye daga cikin harsashe da za a samu. yin tambayoyi, da fadin ra’ayi su ma suna yin jagora ga binciken kimiyya.
translations.hypothesis: Ba shi kadai ba ne, domin gwaje-gwaje, kuma gwajaba shine gwaji da ake yi don kawar da wasu daga cikin abubuwan da ake tunani, tambayoyi, da kuma lura da abubuwa suna taimakawa wajen bincike.

translations.source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
translations.reference: Masu rajin ɗabi’ar yanayi da masana falsafa sun maida hankali kan tsofaffin rubuce-rubuce, musamman, akan Baibul da a ka rubuta da yaren Latin.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike na halitta da falsafa sun mayar da hankali kan takardun tarihi, kuma musamman, kan Majiyar (Littafin Kudanci) a harshen Latin.

translations.source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
translations.reference: Cikin wadanda aka amince da su akwai ra’ayin/fahimtar Aristotle kan dukkan batutuwan kimiyya, ciki har da ilimin halayyar dan adam.
translations.hypothesis: An yi karbuwa ga ra'ayoyin Aristotle akan dukkan batu na ilimi, gami da ilimin halin dan'adam.

translations.source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.reference: Kamar yadda ilimin Girka ya ragu, ita yamma ta sami kanta daga yankewar tushen falsafa da tushen kimiyya.
translations.hypothesis: Yayin da ilimin Giriki ya ragu, kasashen Yammacin duniya sun rasa alaka da tushen falsafar da ilimin kimiyya da suka samo daga Giriki.

translations.source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
translations.reference: An lura cewa yawancin tsarukan yadda jiki ke aiki da kuma halayya sun dogara ne da samuwar zangogi yadda abubuwa ke juyawa wadanda agogunan jiki ke samarwa.
translations.hypothesis: Daidaiton da ake gani a jiki da ayyukan mutum sau da yawa suna dogara ne sosai ga kasancewar ayyukan da jiki ke yiwa kansa da kuma yadda suke fitowa ta hanyar tsarin da jiki ke amfani da shi.

translations.source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
translations.reference: Periodic rithyms, wayenda ba kawai martani bane zuwa ga periodic cues din waje ba, anyi rubutasu akan yawanci halittu masu rai, irin su bakteriya, fungi, bishiyu da dabbobi.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu ayyukan da suke faruwa a tsaka-tsake, waɗanda ba su wuce mayar da martaba ga abubuwan da ke faruwa a wajen ba, sun tabbata a yawancin abubuwan da suka rayu, gami da bakteriya, fungi, tsire-tsire, da dabbobi.

translations.source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
translations.reference: Halittun jikin mutum sune suke ci gaba da wanzuwa a yayin da mutum ke gudu ko da ba tare da wasu abubuwa daga waje/gefe.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin lantana na jiki na ƙungiya mai ci gaba da kanta wacce za ta ci gaba da aiwatar da ayyukan da take yi, ko da ba ta samun wani abu da ya ba ta umurnin aiwatar da su daga wajen.

translations.source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.reference: Gwajin Hershey and Chase na daya daga cikin shawarwari na gaba-gaba akan DNA ta kasance genetic material.
translations.hypothesis: Wani daga cikin muhimman bincike da aka yi ne na Hershey da Chase, kuma ya nuna cewa DNA ita ce mai adadin halitta.

translations.source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.reference: Hershey da Chase sun yi amfani da phages, ko ƙwayoyin cututtuka, wajen shigar da sinadarin DNA nasu a cikin wata ƙwayar cuta.
translations.hypothesis: Hershey da Chase sun yi amfani da ƙwayoyin cuta, watau virusi, don shigar da DNA dinsa a cikin bakteriya.

translations.source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.reference: Sunyi gwaje-gwaje guda biyu wanda ke nuna alamar ko DNA a cikin fage tare da phosphorus na rediyoaktif ko furotin na phage tare da sulfur na rediyo.
translations.hypothesis: Suka yi gwaje-gwaje biyu, a cikin kowanne daga su, sun yi alama ga DNA na bakteriya (phage) ta amfani da phosphorus mai radioactive ko kuma protein na bakteriya ta amfani da sulfur mai radioactive.

translations.source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.reference: Maye gurbi zai iya samun bambancin nau'ikan sakamako iri daban-daban dangane da nau'in maye gurbi, mahimmancin yanki na kayan gado ya shafa kuma ko kwayoyin halita da abin ya shafa sune kwayoyin halita.
translations.hypothesis: Canje-canje na jini (mutations) na iya zama da tasiri daban-daban, dangane da nau'in canje-canjen, muhimmancin sashi na jinin da ya shafi, da kuma ko sassan jinin da suka shafi su ne sassan da ke samar da ƙwayoyin jima'i.

translations.source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.reference: Rikiɗa a ƙwayoyin halitta na layin ƙwayar cuta ne kaɗai za a iya gadar wa yara, yayin da rikiɗa a wani wuri kan iya haddasa mutuwar ƙwayar halitta ko cutar sankara.
translations.hypothesis: Kawancen canje-canje da ke faruwa a cikin sassaɓen jinsu ne kawai suka iya shiga cikin yara, yayin da canje-canje da ke faruwa a sauran sassa na jiki na iya haifar da mutuwar sassaɓen jini ko kuma cutar kansa.

translations.source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.reference: Yawon shakatawa na yanayi yana jan hankalin mutane masu sha'awar ziyartar yankuna na asali don jin daɗin shimfidar wuri, gami da tsirrai da dabbobin daji.
translations.hypothesis: Balaguro da ake yi ta amfani da halittu, yana jawo hankalin mutane waɗanda suke son ziyartar wurare masu halitta domin jin daɗin kyawawan al'amuran da ke akwai, kamar su tsire-tsire da dabbobi.

translations.source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.reference: Misalin ire-iren ayyukan sun hada farauta, kama kifi, yin hoto, kallon tsuntsaye da kuma ziyartar wurin hutawa da kuma koyan ilimi game da labarin muhallin.
translations.hypothesis: Misalan ayyukan da za a iya yi a wurin sun haɗa da tsere-tsere, ruwa, ɗaukar hotuna, kallon dabbobi, ziyartar parks, da kuma karanta game da yanayin muhalli.

translations.source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.reference: Alal misali, shi ne ziyara da daukar hoto da kuma koyon abubuwan a Borneo.
translations.hypothesis: Misali, zuwa wajen ganin, ɗaukar hotunan, da kuma koyon game da "organgatuangs" a yankin Borneo.

translations.source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.reference: A kowace safiya, mutane na barin ƙananan garuruwan karkara a motoci don zuwa wuraren ayyukan su kuma wasu da idan suka bari ne wajen aikin su na wuce su.
translations.hypothesis: Kowace safiya, mutane suna barin ƙananan biranen ƙauye a motoci don su je wurin aiki, kuma wasu suna wucewa su waɗanda wurin aikin su shine inda mutanen su suka bar.

translations.source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.reference: A cikin wannan na’urar sufuri mai sauyawa kowa na da alaka da juna tare da tallafawa, tsarin sufuri ne wanda ya dogara da motocin daidaikun mutane.
translations.hypothesis: A wannan hanyar tafiya, kowa yana da alaka da tsarin tafiya wanda yake dogara ne akan motocin da ake mallakar su, kuma kowa yana bada goyon baya ga wannan tsari.

translations.source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.reference: Ilimin kimiyya yanzu ya nuna cewa wannan babban tattalin arzikin carbon ya lalata biosphere daga ɗayan ƙasashe masu tabbatacce waɗanda suke tallafawa cigaban ɗan adam shekaru miliyan biyu da suka gabata.
translations.hypothesis: Kimiyya yanzu ta nuna cewa wannan tsarin tattalin arziƙi na karbon mai girma ya saka muhallin duniya cikin wani yanayi mara daidaito, wanda ya bar da wani ɓangare na muhalli da ya kawo ci gaban ɗan-adam a cikin shekaru miliyan biyu da suka wuce.

translations.source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.reference: Kowa yana shiga cikin jama'a kuma yana amfani da tsarin sufuri. Kusan kowa yana korafi game da tsarin sufuri.
translations.hypothesis: Kullun mutum yana yin wani ɓangare na al'umma kuma yana amfani da hanyoyin tafiya. Kusan dukkan mutane suna damuwa game da hanyoyin tafiya.

translations.source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.reference: A kasashen da suka ci gaba ba kasafai ake jin irin wannan korafin ba game da ingancin ruwa ko gadoji da ke faduwa.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin ƙasashe masu tasowa, ba daɗe ake ji da irin wannan adadin ƙarƙashu game da ingancin ruwa ko kuma gilashin da suka rushe.

translations.source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.reference: Me yasa tsarukan sufuri su ke haifar da irin waɗannan ƙorafi, me ya sa suke faɗuwa a kullum? Shin injiniyoyin sufuri ne kawai ba ƙwararru ba? Ko akwai wani mahimmin abu di ke faruwa ne?
translations.hypothesis: Me yasa tsarin jigilar abubuwa ke haifar da irin wannan damuwa, kuma me yasa suke ƙara gajiya kullum? Shin injiniyoyin jigilar abubuwa ba sa da ilimi? Ko akwai wani abu mafi muhimmanci da ke faruwa?

translations.source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
translations.reference: Gudanar Zirga-zirga shine nazari kan zirga-zirgar ɗaiɗaikun direbobi da ababen hawa tsakanin wurare biyu tare da ma’amala da suke yi da juna.
translations.hypothesis: Tarihin zirga-zirgar da motoci shine binciken yadda masu aiwatar motoci da motocin su ke motsawa tsakanin wurare biyu, da kuma yadda suke hulɗa da juna.

translations.source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
translations.reference: Abin takaici, bincikawar zirga-zirga ababen hawa abu ne mai wahala saboda ba’a iya yin hasashen hakikanci halin direba dari bisa dari.
translations.hypothesis: Abin da ya fi wahala shine binciken yadda motoci ke tafiya, domin ba za a iya tsaurara yadda direba zai yi motsa jiki ba da tabbaci 100%.

translations.source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
translations.reference: An yi sa'a, direbobi su na tuki a cikin nutsuwa yadda kwararar ababen hawa a titi ke tafiya a natse don haka ana iya nazarin yanayin ta hanyar lissafi.
translations.hypothesis: Alhamdulillah, yawanci direbobi suna da hali mai daidaito; don haka, zirga-zirgar motoci yawanci suna da wani matakin daidaito kuma za su iya kasancewa a matsayin adadi a cikin lissafi.

translations.source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.reference: Domin gabatar da yanayin hanya, an kulla alaƙa tsakanin muhimman al’amura uku: (1) gudana, (2) cinkoso da (3) watsuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Don inganta yadda zirga-zirgar motoci ke tafiya, an kafa dangantaka tsakanin manyan sifa uku: (1) yawan motoci, (2) adadi, da (3) sauri.

translations.source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
translations.reference: Wadannan dangantaka suna taimakawa wajen tsari, zayyana, da kuma gudanar da kayayyakin babbar hanya.
translations.hypothesis: Waɗannan al'adu suna taimakawa wajen tsara, ƙirƙirar, da aiwatar da ayyukan da ake gina akan hanya.

translations.source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
translations.reference: Kwari ne dabbobin da suka fara tashi cikin iska. Iya tashin su ya taimaka musu wajen kauce wa abokan gaba cikin sauki kuma su sami abinci da yin barnara sosai.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu dabbobi ne suka zama na farko da suka tashi cikin iska. Ƙarfin su na tashi cikin iska ya taimaka musu su kauce wa barazanar, kuma ya sa su samu abinci da abokan aure cikin sauƙi.

translations.source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
translations.reference: Yawancin kwari suna da fa'idar kasancewa suna iya ninke fuka-fukansu su mayar jikin su.
translations.hypothesis: Kusan dukkanin ƙwayoyin ruwa suna da damar kunna fuka-fukansu a kusance da jikin su.

translations.source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.reference: Wannan kan ba su faffaɗan fage na kananan wurare da za su iya boyewa daga mafarauta.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ya ba su damar ɓoyewa a wurare da dama, kuma wannan ya taimaka musu wajen kaucewa abin halaka.

translations.source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
translations.reference: A yau, kwarin kawai da ba za su iya linke fikafikan su ba sune kudan diragon da mayflies.
translations.hypothesis: Yau, kawai wasu nau'in kwari, kamar dragon flies da mayflies, ne ke ba su iya rufe fuka-fukansu ba.

translations.source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
translations.reference: Dubunnan shekarun da suka gabata, wani mutum da ake kira Aristarchus yace Tsarin Rana ya zagaya Rana.
translations.hypothesis: Shekaru da dama da suka wuce, wani mutum mai suna Aristarchus ya ce tsarin tauraron dan kasa yana motsawa a kewayen tauraron rana.

translations.source: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
translations.reference: Wasu mutane suna tsammanin bayaninsa daidai ne, amma wasu da dama na ganin ba haka ba ne; cewa rukunin tauraronmu ke kewaya duniya, ciki har da rana (da ma sauran taurari)
translations.hypothesis: Wasu mutane sun yi tunanin cewa ya yi daidai, amma mutane da yawa sun yi imani da abin da ya su, wato tsarin taurari (Solar System) yana motsawa a kusa da duniya, gami da tauraron rana (da kuma sauran taurari).

translations.source: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
translations.reference: Wannan ya dace da hankali, saboda bai yi kaman duniya tana motsi ba, ko tana yi?
translations.hypothesis: Wannan yana da ma'ana, saboda duniya ba ta nuna alama ta motsi, ko ba?

translations.source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
translations.reference: Ƙoramar Amazon ita ce ƙorama ta biyu mafi tsawo kuma mafi girma a Duniya. Tana ɗaukar ruwa fiye da sau 8 a matsayin babbar ƙorama ta biyu.
translations.hypothesis: Kasar Amazon wata kasa ce mai tsawo ta biyu a duniya, kuma ita ce mafi girma. Tana ɗaukar ruwa fiye da sau goma da shida fiye da mafi girman kasa ta biyu.

translations.source: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
translations.reference: Amazon kuma shine kogi mafi fadi a Duniya, a wasu lokutan nisan mil shida.
translations.hypothesis: Kasar Amazon ita ma ta kasance tafkin mafi faɗi a duniya, wanda a wasu lokuta ya kai faɗin kilomita shida.

translations.source: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
translations.reference: Cikakken kashi 20 cikin dari na ruwan da ke zubowa daga koramun duniyar zuwa cikin teku yana zuwa ne daga Amazon.
