translations.hypothesis: Kashi na yawa, wato kashi 20 cikin dari na ruwan da ke fitowa daga kogaye zuwa cikin oceans, ya zo ne daga kogin Amazon.

translations.source: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
translations.reference: Babbar Ƙoramar Amazon ta na da nisan 6,387 km (3,980 mil). Tana karbar ruwa daga dubban kananan ƙoramu.
translations.hypothesis: Kasar Amazon ta manyan kogin nata yana da tsayin kilomita 6,387 (mai mil 3,980). Kogin yana karɓar ruwa daga dubban sauran koguna masu ƙaramin girma.

translations.source: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
translations.reference: Ko da yake ginin dala a cikin dutse ya ci gaba har zuwa ƙarshen tsohuwar Masarautar, dala ta Giza ba a taɓa wuce ta da girmansu da ƙwarewar fasaha na ginin su ba.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake gina tutsaye da itace ya ci gaba har zuwa ƙarshen Mulkin Tsoho, amma babu wani tutsaye da ya wuce tutsaye na Giza wajen girma da kuma ingancin yadda aka gina su.

translations.source: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
translations.reference: Sabuwar Daula ta daulolin baya na Misra su na yaba yadda kakanninsu su ka giggina abubuwa na tarihi, wadanda ko a wancan lokacin sun haura shekaru dubu.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen masarautar da ta zo bayan ta farko sun mamaye abubuwan tarihi da suka rage daga masarautun da suka gabansu, waɗanda suka kasance shekaru sama da dubu ɗaya a lokacin.

translations.source: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
translations.reference: Yawan al’ummar Birnin Vatican ya kai kimanin mutane 800. Ita ce kasa mafi kankanta cikin kasashe masu yancin kansu kuma mafi karancin yawan jama’a.
translations.hypothesis: Yawan mutane a Vatican City ya kai kusan 800. Shi ne ƙasar da ke da ƙaramin yawan mutane a duniya, kuma shi ne ƙasar da ta fi kowace ƙasa ƙanƙantarwa.

translations.source: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
translations.reference: Fadar Vatican tana amfani da harshen Italiya a dokoki da kuma sadarwar hukuma.
translations.hypothesis: Birnin Vatican yana amfani da harshen Italiya a dokokin sa da kuma sadarwar jihar.

translations.source: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
translations.reference: Yaren Italiyanci kuma yare ne na yau da kullun da yawancin waɗanda ke aiki a cikin jihar ke amfani dashi yayin da ake amfani da Latin a cikin bukukuwan addini.
translations.hypothesis: Ita ma harshen Italiya shi ne harshen da yawancin mutanen da suke aiki a jihar suke amfani da shi a yau da kullum, yayin da harshen Latin sau da yawa ake amfani da shi a bikin addini.

translations.source: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
translations.reference: Dukkan al’ummar Fadar Vatican ‘yan Dariƙar Katolika ne.
translations.hypothesis: Dukkanin mutanen birnin Vatican sun kasance masu addinin Katolika.

translations.source: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
translations.reference: Mutane sun san abubuwan da keɓaɓɓun sinadarai kamar su zinariya, azir, da jan ƙarfe daga tsufa, yadda waɗannan za su iya gano su duka a yanayin halitta kuma sun fi sauƙi ga nawa tare da kayan aikin farko.
translations.hypothesis: Mutane sun san game da wasu sinadirin kimiyya na asali, kamar su zinare, azurfa, da kuraye, tun zamanin da. Wannan ne saboda waɗannan sinadirin za su iya samuwa a cikin halita a yanayin su, kuma suna da sauƙi a gano su ta amfani da kayan aiki masu sauƙi.

translations.source: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
translations.reference: Aristotle, masanin falsafa ne, yayi tunanin cewa komai ya kunshi cakuda daya ko fiye daga abubuwa hudu. Sun kasance ƙasa, ruwa, iska, da wuta.
translations.hypothesis: Aristotle, wani masanin falsafa, ya bayyana cewa komai a duniya yana ƙunshe da haɗuwa ta ɗaya ko fiye da abubuwa huɗu. Wadannan abubuwan su ne: ƙasa, ruwa, iska, da wuta.

translations.source: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
translations.reference: Wannan ya fi kama da yanayi hudu na abu (a tsari iri daya): daskara, ruwa, iska, da damshi, ko da yake ya kuma yi hasashe da cewa su kan canza zuwa sabbin abubuwa domin zama abin da muke gani.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ya fi kama da matsayin abubuwa guda huɗu (a cikin wannan tsari): mai ɗaya, ruwa, iska, da plasma, duk da cewa ya kuma yi ikirarin cewa su canzawa suke zuwa abubuwa na sabo domin suyi abin da muka gani.

translations.source: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
translations.reference: Karafan gami ne na ƙarafa biyu ko fiye da haka. Kar a manta cewa akwai abubuwa da yawa a kan jadawali na lokaci-lokaci.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙungiyoyi sun kasance wani haddi ne na ƙarfi biyu ko fiye. Kar ku mantu cewa akwai abubuwa da dama a tebulin sinadirin.

translations.source: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
translations.reference: Ana alaƙanta sinadarai kamar calcium da kanwa a zaman ƙarafa. Tabbas, akwai kuma ƙarafa kamar azurfa da zinare.
translations.hypothesis: Abubuwan kamar calcium da potassium ana ɗaukarsu azama. Hakika, akwai wasu ƙwayoyin itace irin su azurfa da zinari.

translations.source: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
translations.reference: Haka nan za ka iya gamin da ya haɗa da yanki kaɗan na abubuwan da ba ƙarfe ba kamar gawayi.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, za ku sami kwalbuwa waɗanda suka haɗa da ƙananan adadi na abubuwa waɗanda ba su da ƙarfi, kamar su karbon.

translations.source: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
translations.reference: Duk wani abu cikin sammai da kassai an yi shi da dunkulen kwayar halittar mara rai. Dukunlen kwayar halitta mara rai ya kunshi kanana kwayoyin zarra.
translations.hypothesis: Dukkanin abubuwa a duniya sun ƙunshi abubuwa. Kowane abu yana ƙunshe da ƙananan furfura da ake kira atoms.

translations.source: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
translations.reference: Ƙwayoyin zarra ƙanana ne matuƙa inda tiriliyoyinsu kan iya shigewa cikin ɗigon ayar da ke karshen wannan jimla.
translations.hypothesis: Kwayoyin atom sun ƙanƙantar sosai, har ma da miliyoyin su za su iya shiga cikin alamar da ke ƙarshen wannan jumla.

translations.source: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
translations.reference: Hakika, alkalamin babban amini ne ga mutane da dama lokacin da ya fito.
translations.hypothesis: Don haka, lokacin da aka ƙirƙiri kwal, ya zama abokin kirki ga mutane da yawa.

translations.source: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
translations.reference: Abin bakin ciki, yayin da sababbin hanyoyin rubutu suka fito, sai aka mayar da fensir zuwa matsayi da amfani na ƙasa.
translations.hypothesis: Abin da ya fi damuwa shi ne, yayin da sababbin hanyoyin rubutu suka bayyana, fentin ya rasa muhimmanci kuma ana amfani da shi a yan wasu ayyuka.

translations.source: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
translations.reference: Yanzu mutane suna rubuta saƙonni a kan fuskokin kwamfuta, ba tare da sun taɓa kusantar shafana ba.
translations.hypothesis: Yanzu haka, mutane suna rubuta sakonnai a kan allo na kwamputa, kuma ba sa buɗe su yi amfani da kwalalawa.

translations.source: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
translations.reference: Mutum zai iya yin mamakin abin da keyboard zai zama idan wani sabon abu ya ɓullo.
translations.hypothesis: Ana mamakin yadda keyboard za ta kasance lokacin da wani abu mai sabon zamanta.

translations.source: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
translations.reference: Bam mai tarwatsewa yana aiki ne akan ƙa’idar cewa yana zukar kuzari domin ya dunkule yayan kwayar zarra na protons da neutrons a tsakiyar kwayar zarrar.
translations.hypothesis: Bamban bomb din na nukliya yana aiki bisa ga ƙa'ida cewa yana buƙatar wadatuttuka don haɗa ƙwayar da ta ƙunshi yawan protons da neutrons.

translations.source: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
translations.reference: Kamar gangara babban keke zuwa tudu. Tsage tsakiya kuma sannan ya saki wasu daga cikin wannan kuzari.
translations.hypothesis: Wani abu kamar jan karatsa mai nauyi sama da tsawo. Sake rabawa ƙwayoyin atom da ƙarfi, sannan hakan ya fitar da wasu daga cikin wancan makonnin.

translations.source: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
translations.reference: Wasu kwayar zarra suna da nuclei mai canzawa wanda ya nuna cewa suna iya rabewa da ‘yar ƙarfafawa ko babu .
translations.hypothesis: Wasu atoms na da ƙwayoyin da ba su da ƙarfi, wanda hakan na nufin cewa suna iya rabuwa cikin sauƙi, ko kuma ba tare da wani tsaurin ƙoƙari ba.

translations.source: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
translations.reference: Farfajiyan wata yana da duwatsu da kura. Ana kiran shimfidar wajen wata crust.
translations.hypothesis: Fasfin jikin duniya yana da duwatsu da ƙasa. Layer ɗin waje na jikin duniya ana kiransa crust.

translations.source: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
translations.reference: Kaurin shimfiɗar saman ƙasa ya kai 70 km a gefen kusa da kaurin 100 km a gefen nesa.
translations.hypothesis: Fatawarsa tana da kusan kilomita 70 na kauri a gefen da ke kusa da duniya, kuma kilomita 100 na kauri a gefen da ke nesa da duniya.

translations.source: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
translations.reference: Yana da sirinta a ƙarƙashin maria kuma ya fi kauri a ƙarƙashin tsaunuka.
translations.hypothesis: Yana da ƙarfi a ƙarƙashin yankin da ake kira "maria," amma yana da ƙarfi sosai a ƙarƙashin tsaunuka.

translations.source: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
translations.reference: Za a iya samun ƙarin maria a gefen kusa saboda bangon siriri ne. Abu ne mai sauƙi narkakken dutse ya tashi zuwa saman.
translations.hypothesis: Wadannan ƙwayoyin magama na iya kasancewa mafi yawa a gefen da ke kusa, saboda ƙasa ta wannan gefen ta kasance tausayi. Wannan ya sa ya zama sauƙi ga magungunan da suke cikin ƙasa su fito zuwa sama.

translations.source: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
translations.reference: Tsarin tallan ya dogara wajen gano abinda ya fi ba mutane sha’awa ko su ka fi so.
translations.hypothesis: Theoriyoyin abun da ake yi sun mai da hankali kan neman abin da ke daɗa hankalin mutane ko abin da yake jan hankalin su.

translations.source: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
translations.reference: Waɗannan hasashe suna nuna cewa mutane suna da wasu buƙatu da/ko sha'awa waɗanda akai maida su ciki yayin da suke manyanta zuwa balaga.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ra'ayoyin na nuni da cewa mutane suna da buƙatu da/ko burin da suka haɗa su a cikin halayensu yayin da suke girma suka kai matsayin manya.

translations.source: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
translations.reference: Wadannan ra'ayoyin suna kallon menene game da wasu mutane da ke sa su abubuwan da suke yi da kuma wanne abubuwan ne a muhallin su zai sanya su yi ko kuma kin yin nau’in wasu abu.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan nazarin yana duba abubuwan da ke cikin wasu mutane waɗanda ke sa su so abubuwa da suke so, da kuma abubuwan da ke cikin muhallinsu waɗanda ke sa su yi ko kada su yi wasu ayyuka.

translations.source: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
translations.reference: A matakan bayanan tsarin abubuwa, guda biyu mafi shahara su ne Hierachy of Needs na Maslow Two factor theory na Hertzberg.
translations.hypothesis: Abubuwan da ake amfani da su wajen bayyana abun da ake yi a cikin ayyuka biyu ne: Theoryar Maslow game da matakan buƙatu, da kuma Theoryar Hertzberg game da abubuwan da ke daɗa da kuma abubuwan da ke damfara a wurin aiki.

translations.source: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
translations.reference: A takaice, halaye guda biyu na iya bayyana yayin da manajoji zasu fara jagorantar tsoffin abokan aikinsu. daga cikin ƙarshen bakan yana ƙoƙarin kasancewa “ɗayan mutane” (ko gals).
translations.hypothesis: Gabaɗaya, lokacin da shugabanni suka fara jagorancin abokan su na baya, wasu ayyuka biyu na iya bayyana. Ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan na iya zama kokarin ci gaba da kasancewa "ɗaya daga cikin mutane" (ko mata).

translations.source: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
translations.reference: Irin wannan manajan yana da wahalar yanke shawara mara kyau, aiwatar da ladabtarwa, kimanta aikin aiki, sanya nauyi, da ɗaukar mutane da alhaki.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan nau'in shugaba yana fuskantar matsaloli wajen yanke shawara da ba mutane suka so, aiwatar da санкции, tantance aikin ma'aikata, sadar da ayyuka, da kuma tabbatar da cewa mutane suna da alhakin aikinsu.

translations.source: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
translations.reference: A daya ƙarshen ɓarin, mutum zai zama koma wanda ba za'a iya gane shi ba wanda yake ko ta ke jin dole ne ya ko ta canza duk abinda kungiyar ta ke yi kuma su maida shi nasu.
translations.hypothesis: A gefen wani ɓangaren, akwai wanda yake canzawa zuwa mutum mara tushe, wanda yake jin kamar dole ne ya canza dukkan abubuwan da ƙungiyar ta ke yi, kuma ya mayar da su zuwa abubuwan sa.

translations.source: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
translations.reference: Bayan haka, a ƙarshe jagoran shi yake da alhakin nasara da rashin nasarar kungiyar.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da haka, shugaba yana da alhakin gudanar da ayyukan kungiya, kuma nasarar da ta samu ko rashin nasarar da ta samu, alhakin sa ne.

translations.source: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
translations.reference: Halayyar yawancin lokuta na janyo saɓani tsakanin shugabanni da sauran ‘yan kungiyar.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan yanayin sau da yawa ya haifar da rikici tsakanin shugabannin da sauran mambobin kungiya.

translations.source: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
translations.reference: Tawagogin da bana ainihi ba ana ganinsu daidai da yadda tawagogi na gaske suke, amma dai akwai wasu ‘yan banbance-banbancen da ba za a rasa ba.
translations.hypothesis: Kungiyoyin da ake gudanar da ayyukan su ta lantarki suna da buƙatar samun inganci iri ɗaya da kungiyoyin gaba ɗaya, amma akwai bambance-bambancen da ba su da bayani.

translations.source: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
translations.reference: Mambobin na kan intanet galibi suna aiki a matsayin hanyar tuntuɓa ta rukuninsu na zahiri.
translations.hypothesis: Wanda ke aiki a kungiyar aiki ta lantarki (virtual team) sau da yawa suke zama masu bayar da bayanai ga kungiyar da ke aiki a wurin gani.

translations.source: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
translations.reference: Yawancin lokaci suna da ƴancin kai fiye da membobin ƙungiyar al'ada kamar yadda kungiyoyin su zasu iya haduwa bisa tsarin lokaci daban-daban wanda mai kula da su na iya fahimtar da su.
translations.hypothesis: Suka kasance da wani matakin 'yancin kai fiye da sauran mambobin kungiya, domin kungiyoyin su na iya yin tarurruka a lokuta daban-daban, wanda zai iya zama abin da shugabancin gida bai fahimci ba.

translations.source: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
translations.reference: Kasancewar ainihin “tawagar da ba a iya gani” (Larson da LaFasto, a sheakarar 1989, shafi na 109) shi ma wani nau’i ne na wata tawaga ba ta zahiri ba.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ƙungiyar da ake kira "kungiyar da ba ta bayyana ba" (wacce Larson da LaFasto suka bayyana a shekarar 1989, shafi na 109) ita ma wani ɓangare na musamman ce na kungiyar da ke aiki ta lantarki.

translations.source: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
translations.reference: “Tawagar da ba a gani” ita ce tawagar gudanarwa wadda kowanne memba ya ke biyayya. Tawagar da ba a gani tana sanya ƙa'idodi ga kowanne memba.
translations.hypothesis: "Kungiyar da ba ta bayyana ba" ita ce kungiyar gudanarwa wacce kowane memba ya kai rahotonsa zuwa. Kungiyar da ba ta bayyana ba ta kafa ka'idoji ga kowane memba.

translations.source: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
translations.reference: Me yasa kungiya zata so ta dauki nauyin daukar lokaci don kafa kungiyar ilmantarwa? Buri daya na sanya tunanin ilmantarwa na tsari a aikace shine bidi'a.
translations.hypothesis: Me yasa wata ƙungiya ta so ta sha wahala wajen ƙirƙirar wata ƙungiya mai ilimi? Ɗaya daga cikin dalilan aikatawar ilimin ƙungiyoyi shi ne ƙirƙirar sabbin abubuwa.

translations.source: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
translations.reference: Lokacin da aka yi amfani da duk albarkatun da ke akwai ta yadda yakamata a tsakanin sassan ayyukan ƙungiya, kerawa da ƙwarewa na iya wucewa.
translations.hypothesis: Idan duk kayan aiki da ake samu suka amfana a cikin dukkan sassan wani kamfani, za a iya samun sababbin ra'ayoyi da ƙwarewa.

translations.source: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
translations.reference: A sakamakon haka, matakin na kungiya da ke aiki tare domin magance wata matsala zai iya kai wa ga ƙirƙirar sabon mataki da zai biya bukatun abokan ciniki.
translations.hypothesis: Daga wannan dalilin, tsarin kungiya da ke hada kai don shawo kan wani matsaloli na iya haifar da sabon tsari mai tasiri don biyan buƙatun abokin ciniki.

translations.source: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
translations.reference: Kafin wata ma’aikata ta zama mai kirkira, dole jagoranci ya samar da wata al’ada ta kirki da kuma musayar ilimi da tsarin koyo na ma’aikata.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan kungiya ta iya ƙirƙirar sabbin abubuwa, dole shugabanta ya ƙirƙiri wani yanayi na ƙirƙirar sabbin abubuwa, da kuma rarraba ilimi da ƙirƙirar ilimin kungiya.

translations.source: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
translations.reference: Angel (2006), ya yi bayanin yanayin Continuum matsayin hanar da ka iya taimakawa maaikatu su daukaka tare da kara ƙarfi.
translations.hypothesis: Angel (shekara ta 2006), ta bayyana tsarin "Continuum" a matsayin hanya da ake amfani da ita don taimakon kungiyoyi wajen cimma matakin nasara mai ƙarfi.

translations.source: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
translations.reference: Bayanan sadarwar lantarki a jikin halitta ya bada hujjoji na zahiri ta yadda za a fuskanci bincike na kwakwalwa. Don haka wanna ya rage fadin filin bincike tare da bada tabbaci.
translations.hypothesis: Bayanan da suka danganci ilimin halittar jinin (neurobiology) suna ba da shaidu na jiki don hanyar nazarin tunani. Don haka, wannan yana rage yawan fannin bincike kuma yana sa binciken ya zama mai dacewa.

translations.source: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
translations.reference: Halin da ke tsakanin cututtukan kwakwalwa da halayyar yana tallafawa masana kimiyya a cikin binciken su.
translations.hypothesis: Hanyar da cutar da ke cikin kwakwalwa ke shafar halin mutum tana taimakawa masana kimiyya wajen gudanar da bincike.

translations.source: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
translations.reference: An daɗe kwarai da sanin cewa matsalar ƙwaƙwalwa, firgicewa, gyambo da kumburi daban-daban suna shafar halayya tare janyo sauyi a aiyukan ƙwaƙwalwa.
translations.hypothesis: An san tsawon lokaci cewa nau'o-nau'o na cututtuka da raunuka, lalacewar jini, da kuma tumukai a cikin kafa, suna tasiri ga halin mutum kuma suna haifar da canje-canje a wasu ayyukan tunani.

translations.source: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
translations.reference: Tashin sabbin fasaha ya bamu daman gani da bincika tsarin kwakwalwa da tafiyar matakai wadda ba a taba gani ba a da.
translations.hypothesis: Tasirin sababbin fasahohi ya ba mu damar ganin da bincika sassan da ayyukan makoginin waɗanda ba a taɓa ganinsu ba a baya.

translations.source: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
translations.reference: Wannan yana ba mu bayanai masu yawa da kayan aiki don gina samfuran kwaikwayo waɗanda ke taimaka mana fahimtar matakai da ke zukatun mu.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan yana ba mu bayanin da kuma kayan aiki da yawa don gina samfurori na simiyoci waɗanda sukan taimaka mana wajen fahimtar ayyuka a cikin tunaninmu.

translations.source: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
translations.reference: Kodayake AI yana da ƙarfin ƙarin ma'anar almara ta kimiyya, AI ya kasance wani reshe na kimiyyar kwamfuta mai matuƙar muhimmanci, da ke mu'amala da halayya, koyo da kuma shigar da fasahar ƙwaƙwalwa a cikin inji.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake fasahar kere-kere (AI) tana da alaka mai karfi da wasu labarai na ilimi, AI wani bangare mai mahimmanci ne na ilimin kwamputa, wanda ke yiwa ayyuka da suka haɗa da ayyukan injiniya, koyo, da kuma canzawa ta hanyar amfani da ilimi a cikin injiniya.

translations.source: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
translations.reference: Bincike a kan na’urorin mutum mutumi ya jibanci saka na’urori aiki wanda ke bukatar basira kafin aikata su.
translations.hypothesis: Bincike a fannin AI ya ƙunshi ƙirƙirar injina da za su iya aiwatar da ayyuka waɗanda suka buƙe ƙwarewa da fahimta.

translations.source: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
translations.reference: Misalai sun hada da sarrafawa, shiryawa da tanadi, iya amsa tambayoyi da ganewar asali na abokan ciniki, tare da gane rubutun hannu, murya da fuska.
translations.hypothesis: Misalan sun haɗa da sarrafa ayyuka, tsara da shirye-shirye, damar amsa tambayoyin abokin ciniki da kuma gano abubuwa kamar rubuce-rubuce, murya da fuskoki.

translations.source: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
translations.reference: Irin waɗannan abubuwa sun zama horo daban, waɗanda ke mai da hankali kan samar da mafita ga matsalolin rayuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan irin abubuwa sun zama fannin ilimi daban-daban, waɗanda ke mai da hankali kan samar da hanyoyin warware matsala a rayuwar yau da kullum.

translations.source: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
translations.reference: Yawacin lokuta ana amfani da tsarin AI a bangarorin tattalin arziki, likitanci, injiniya da sojoji, kamar yadda aka gina cikin ɗimbin komfuta na gida da bidiyon softwaya na mahanjar wasa.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin kere-keren kwakwalwa (AI) yanzu haka ake amfani da shi sosai a fannin tattalin arziki, likita, injiniya, da kuma sojoji, kamar yadda aka saka shi a wasu aikace-aikacen kwamputa da wasannin bidiyo.

translations.source: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
translations.reference: Tafiyar koyo a filaye babban bangare ne na kowane aji. Sau da yawa malamin na son ɗaukar ɗaliban sa zuwa wuraren da tafiya da bas ba abin zaɓi ba ne.
translations.hypothesis: Ziyartar wurare na wani ɓangare na muhimanci a kowace makaranta. Kusan ko yaya, wani malami zai so ya ɗauki dalibansa zuwa wasu wurare inda tafiya da mota ba zata yiwuwa ba.

translations.source: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
translations.reference: Fasaha tana ba da mafita tare da tafiye-tafiye na fili. Dalibai na iya kallon kayan tarihin, ziyartar akwatin kifaye, ko kuma sha'awar kyawawan fasaha yayin zama tare da ajinsu.
translations.hypothesis: Technolojin na ba da mafita ta hanyar ziyartar wurare ta lantarki. Ƙwararru na iya kallon abubuwan da ke cikin muziyum, ziyartar wurin ruwan ruwa, ko kuma kallon fasalin fasaha mai kyau, duk da suke zaune a cikin dandalinsu.

translations.source: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
translations.reference: Musayar bayanan tafiyar gani da ido shi ma wata babbar hanya ce ta yin tunani kan tafiya da kuma sanar da abubuwan da aka sani ga azuzuwa masu zuwa nan gaba.
translations.hypothesis: Ragu da ziyartar wani wuri ta lantarki yana da kyau kuma, domin yana ba da damar tunani game da ziyartar da aka yi da rashi, da kuma rarraba abubuwan da aka kalli da sauran kungiyoyin makaranta a gaba.

translations.source: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
translations.reference: Misali, kowace shekara ɗalibai daga Makarantar Bennet a Arewacin Carolina suna tsara gidan yanar gizo game da tafiyarsu zuwa Babban Birnin Jiha, kowace shekara gidan yanar gizon yana sake fasalin su, amma ana ajiye tsofaffin sigar akan layi don zama littafin shara.
translations.hypothesis: Misali, kowanne shekara, daliban makarantar Bennet da ke jihar North Carolina suna ƙirƙirar shafi na yanar gizo game da tafiya da suka yi zuwa babban birnin jihar. Kowane shekara, shafin yanar gizon na canzawa, amma wasu sigogi na baya-bayan nan ana adana su a yanar gizo don su yi a matsayin littafin tunawa.

translations.source: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
translations.reference: Shafukan yanar gizo na gulmace-gulmace na iya taimakawa inganta rubuce-rubucen ɗalibai. Yayinda ɗalibai kan fara kwarewar su ta yanar gizo tare da lafuzza mara kyau da rubutu, kasancewar masu sauraro gabaɗaya suna canza hakan.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙungiyoyin yanar gizo (blogs) kuma na iya taimakawa wajen inganta yadda dalibai suke rubuta. Ko da yake yawanci dalibai suna fara amfani da Ƙungiyoyin yanar gizo tare da ƙa'idodi marasa kyau na harshe da ƙamus, ko'ina da akwai masu karatu, wannan yawanci ya canza yanayin.

translations.source: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
translations.reference: Tun da dalibai sune galibin wadanda suka ziyartar shafi, mawallafin shafin intanet lallai ne ya yi kokarin inganta salon rubutunsa saboda gujewa suka.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da cewa ɗalibai sukan kasance masu sukar da ake yi musu, marubucin blog yana ƙoƙarin inganta ƙirarin rubutu don kauce wa sukar.

translations.source: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
translations.reference: Har yanzu a wallafar ta shafin intanet “ya saka dalibin kara farga da lamuran duniyar da suke rayuwa ciki.” Bukatar biyan bukatun masu sauraronsu yana saka daliban kaimin zama masu wayo da kuma sha’awarsu (Toto, 2004).
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, amfani da blog yana tilasta wa dalibai su fahimci duniya da ke kewaye da su sosai. Bukatar biyan burin masu karatu tana ba da wahayi ga dalibai su zama masu hikima da kuma sha'awa (Toto, 2004).

translations.source: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
translations.reference: Rubutun ra'ayin kanka a yanar gizo kayan aiki ne wanda ke karfafa hadin gwiwa, da ƙarfafa dalibai don faɗaɗa koyin karatu sosai fiye da ranar makaranta ta al'ada.
translations.hypothesis: Rubutawa blogi wani kayan aiki ne da ke bawa mutane damar yin hadin kai, kuma yana bawa dalibai damar ci gaba da koyo bayan ƙarshen lokacin makaranta.

translations.source: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
translations.reference: Amfani da ingantacciyar hanyar amfani da yanar gizo “na iya ba da ƙarfi ga ɗalibai su zama masu zurfin bincike da mahimmanci; ta hanyar ba da amsa da sauri game da kayan yanar gizo, ɗalibai na iya ayyana matsayinsu a cikin mahallin sauran rubuce-rubucen tare kuma da fitar da nasu hangen nesa kan wasu batutuwan musamman (Oravec, 2002).
translations.hypothesis: Amfani da blogai daidai "na iya ba dalibai damar zama masu bincike da kuma masu sukar abubuwa; ta hanyar amsa ayyukan da ake samu a intanet, dalibai na iya ƙirƙirar ra'ayoyinsu a cikin mahallin abubuwan da wasu suka rubuta, kuma su bayyana ra'ayoyinsu kan batutu daban-daban" (Oravec, 2002).

translations.source: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
translations.reference: Ottawa shi ne ƙayataccen babban birnin Canada mai harsuna biyu wanda kuma ke da jerin gidajen nuni da na kayan tarihi da suke nuna al’adar Canada ta baya da ta yanzu.
translations.hypothesis: Ottawa babban birnin Kanada ne, wanda yake da kyau kuma ana magana da yaren Faransa da Ingilishi a ciki. Hakanan yana da manyan gidan adana kayan tarihi da wuraren nuni na fasaha da suka nuna tarihi da yanzu na Kanada.

translations.source: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
translations.reference: Duk waɗannan abubuwa da ƙari suna haskaka Ontario azaman abin da barewa ke ɗaukar ɗan Kanada.
translations.hypothesis: Dukkan waɗannan abubuwa da sauran su suna nuna cewa Ontario ita ce wani ɓangare na Kanada da mutanen wajen kasar suke ganin ta kasance.

translations.source: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
translations.reference: Manyan yankuna da ke gaba da arewa ba su da yawa kuma wasu kusan ba kowa ke zaune a ciki.
translations.hypothesis: Manyan sassan da ke arewa maso yamma suna da yawan jama'a kaɗan, kuma wasu daga cikinsu sun fi kusan ba su da mutane, suna cikin wani yanki mai ɓangar ba.

translations.source: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
translations.reference: Alakanta al’ummomi da yake bai wa da dama mamaki: Akwai ‘yan asalin Afirka Amurkawa da ke zama a Amurkar fiye da ‘yan kasar Canada masu zama a can.
translations.hypothesis: Don haka, idan aka yi aiyuka game da yawan mutane, wani abu da zai iya mamaye mutane: Akwai mutanen Amurka masu asalin Afirka fiye da yawan 'yan kasa na Kanada da suke zaune a Amurka.

translations.source: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
translations.reference: Tsibiran Gabashin Afirka suna cikin Tekun India kusa da gaɓar gabashin Afirka.
translations.hypothesis: Tsibirin Gabas na Afirka suna cikin Tekun Indiya, a gefen gabas na Afirka.

translations.source: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
translations.reference: Madagascar mafi girma ce, kuma nahiyar kanta ce idan an zo gefen dabbobin daji.
translations.hypothesis: Madagascar ita ce mafi girma, kuma wata ƙasa ce ta musamman wajen halittu da suka ƙunshi dabbobi da ƙwayoyin halitta.

translations.source: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
translations.reference: Yawancin ƙananan tsibirai ƙasashe ne masu zaman kansu, ko kuma suna da alaƙa da Faransa, kuma sanannu ne wuraren shakatawa na rairayin bakin teku.
translations.hypothesis: Karinin tsibirin ƙananan su na kasashe masu yanci ne, ko kuma suna ƙarƙashin mulkin Faransa, kuma suna da suna a matsayin wurare masu kyau don hutawa a bakin teku.

translations.source: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
translations.reference: Larabawa kuma sun shigo da Musulunci zuwa kasashe kuma ya yi tasiri sosai Comoros da Mayotte.
translations.hypothesis: Masu asalin Larabawa sun kawo addinin Musulunci zuwa waɗannan ƙasashe, kuma addinin ya yi yawa a yankin Comoros da Mayotte.

translations.source: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
translations.reference: Tasirin Turai da mulkin mallaka ya fara a cikin karni na 15, kamar yadda mai yawon bincike ɗan ƙasar Ƙortugal Vasco da Gama ya gano Hanyar Cape daga Turai zuwa India.
translations.hypothesis: Tasirin Turawa da mulkin mallaka sun fara ne a karni na 15, lokacin da binciken Turawan Portugal, wanda ake kira Vasco da Gama, ya gano hanya daga Turawa zuwa Indiya ta ta Cape.

translations.source: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
translations.reference: A arewa yankin na da iyaka da Sahel, kuma a kudu da yamma ga iyaka da tekun Atlantika.
translations.hypothesis: A arewa, wannan yanki yana da iyaka da yankin Sahel, kuma a kudu da yamma yana da iyaka da Tekun Atlantika.

translations.source: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
translations.reference: Mata: An bada shawara ce mata da suke tafiye-tafiye suce suna da aure, ko da kuwa basu dashi.
translations.hypothesis: Mata: Ana bada shawara ga mata da suke tafiya, su bayyana cewa suna da aure, ko da ma ba su da aure a gaskiya.

translations.source: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
translations.reference: Zai taimaka kuma a sanya zobe (bawai wanda da gani mai tsada ne ba.
translations.hypothesis: Yana da amfani kuma a saka ƙwanƙwaro (amma ba wanda yake nuna tsada sosai ba).

translations.source: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
translations.reference: Ya kamata mata su gane cewa bambamcin al’ada na iya haifar da sakamako wanda za’a gani kaman cin zarafi da bi wanda ba a sani ba, kama da hannu, da makamancin su..
translations.hypothesis: Mata yakamata su fahimci cewa bambance-bambancen al'adu na iya haifar da abin da suke ganin yaudara, kuma ba waje bane a sami wanda yake bin ma, ko kuma yana ja mata hannu, da sauran irin wannan.

translations.source: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
translations.reference: Jajirce wajen kin amincewa da maza, kuma kada ki ji tsoron kare matsayarki (ko da akwai ko babu banbancin al’ada hakan ba zai sa ya zama daidai ba)
translations.hypothesis: Ka kasance mai ƙarfin hali wajen ƙin waɗanda suke neman soyayya, kuma kada ka ji tsoro wajen dage ƙa'idar ka (ko da akwai bambance-bambancen al'ada, hakan ba ya nuna cewa hakan ya dace!).

translations.source: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
translations.reference: Masuntan ƙabilar Berner su ne suka kafa sabon birnin Casablanca a karni na 10 BCE, kuma Phoenicians, Rumawa, da Merenids sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin tashar jirgin ruwa mai amfani da ake kira Anfa.
translations.hypothesis: Birnin Casablanca na yanzu ya ƙunshi ƙauyen da mutanen Berber suka gina a karni na goma na BCE, kuma mutanen Phoenicia, Romans, da kuma Merenids sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin tashar jiragen ruwa mai mahimmanci wacce ake kira Anfa.

translations.source: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
translations.reference: Yan Portugal sun rushe shi sannan suka sake gina shi a karkashin sunan Casa Branca, amma suka watsar da shi bayan wata girgizar kasa a 1755.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen Portugal sun lalata ginin, sannan suka gina wani gaba da sunan "Casa Branca," amma bayan wani rudani da ya faru a shekarar 1755, sun bar ginin.

translations.source: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
translations.reference: Sarkin na Morocco ya sake gina garin kamar Daru l-Badya kuma ƴan kasuwar Sifen ne suka ba shi suna Casablanca wanda ya kafa cibiyoyin kasuwanci a can.
translations.hypothesis: Sultan ɗin Morocco ya sake gina birnin kuma ya sa masa suna Daru l-Badya. Sai 'yan kasuwancin Sifaniya suka zo suka kafa wuraren kasuwanci a can, kuma suka yi masa suna Casablanca.

translations.source: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
translations.reference: Casablanca yana ɗaya daga cikin wurare da ba a sha’awar siyayya a cikinsu a fadin Morocco.
translations.hypothesis: Casablanca yana ɗaya daga cikin wuraren da ba su da wadatattukar kasuwanci a duk kasar Morocco.

translations.source: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
translations.reference: A kusa da tsohuwar Madina yana da sauƙin samun wuraren sayar da kayan gargajiya na Moroccan, irin su tagines, tukwane, kayan fata, hookahs, da gwanayen gwal iri-iri, amma duka na masu yawon bude ido ne.
translations.hypothesis: A kusa da birnin da ya yi tsayi, Medina, yana da sauƙi a samu wurare da ake sayar da abubuwan al'ada na kasar Morocco, kamar tagines, kayan marmara, kayan fata, shishir, da kuma sauran abubuwa da yawa, amma duk wannan ne don masu zuwa domin ganin abubuwa.

translations.source: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
translations.reference: Goma gari ne na yawon bude ido a Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Congo da ke ƙarshen gabas kusa da ƙasar Rwanda.
translations.hypothesis: Goma birni ne da yawon bude ido a Jamhuriyar Demokradiyar Congo, kuma yana kusa da kasar Rwanda a gabas.

translations.source: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
translations.reference: Laka daga dutsen Nyiragongo ta lalata Goma a shekara ta 2002 wanda ya binne yawancin titunan garin, musamman ma tsakiyar garin.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 2002, garin Goma ya lalace saboda ruwan wuta da ya fito daga volkanon Nyiragongo, wanda ya rufe manyan sassan birnin, musamman bangaren da ke tsakiyar birnin.

translations.source: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
translations.reference: Yayinda Goma na da lafiya mai kan gado, a bincika duk wani ziyara a wajen Goma domin gane yanayin yaki da ta ci gaba a yankin North Kivu.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da cewa Goma ta kasance ta aminci, duk ziyarar da za a yi waje da Goma ya kamata a yi ta da kulawa, domin a fahimci yadda yakin da ke ci gaba a jihar Kivu ta Arewa yake.

translations.source: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
translations.reference: Garin kuma shine wurin da ake hawa dutse me tartsatsin wuta Nyiragongo tare da wasu daga cikin gorilla din kan dutse dasuka fi araha a afrika.
translations.hypothesis: Birnin na kuma zama wajen da ake yi ta hanyar shiga cikin dutsen Nyiragongo, kuma wataƙila shi ne wajen da ake samun mafi ƙanƙantar yawan kuɗi don ganin mai da ƙungiyar gorila a Afirka.

translations.source: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
translations.reference: Kana iya amfani da boda-boda (taksi na babur) domin zagaya Goma. Farashi na al’ada (na gida) shi ne Franks ɗin Congo 500 ga gajeriyar tafiya.
translations.hypothesis: Zaku iya amfani da motocin 'yan awon gaba (motocin babu wuya) don tafiya a cikin birnin Goma. Farashin da aka saba (farashin gida) shine kusan 500 francs na Congo don tafiyar ta fiye da kaɗan.

translations.source: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
translations.reference: Idan aka haɗu da rashin damar isa can, Sunan “Timbuktu” ya zama abin misaltawa ga wuraren nesa, masu wuyar zuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da cewa yana da wahala zuwa, "Timbuktu" yayi karfin gwiwa a matsayin almara wacce ta nuna wurare masu ban mamaki da ke nesa.

translations.source: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
translations.reference: A yau, Timbuktu gari ne na talauci, kodayake mutuncin da take da shi ya sa ta zama hanyar jan hankalin masu yawon bude ido, kuma tana da tashar jirgin sama.
translations.hypothesis: Yau, Timbuktu birni ne mai ƙarancin abinci, duk da cewa suna da suna mai kyau wanda ya jawo hankalin masu zuwa, kuma tana da filayen jirgin sama.

translations.source: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
translations.reference: A shekarar 1990, an saka shi cikin jerin wuraren tarihi na duriya da ke cikin hatsari, saboda barazanar rairayin hamada.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1990, an saka wurin cikin jerin wurare masu muhimmanci a duniya waɗanda ake barazuba, saboda barazanar yaduwar sahurun ƙasa.

translations.source: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
translations.reference: Ya kasance ɗaya daga mahimman wurare da aka tsaya cikin shirin PBS na Henry Louis Gates “Abubuwan mamaki na musamman a Nahiyar Afirka”.
translations.hypothesis: Wani ɓangare ne na shirin "Wonders of the African World" na Henry Louis Gates wanda aka fitar a tashar PBS.

translations.source: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
translations.reference: Birnin ya sha bambam da sauren birane na kasar kasancewa ya fi kama da birnin larabawa fiye da na yan Afirka.
translations.hypothesis: Birnin na bambanta sosai da sauran biranen kasar, domin yana da alamar ƙasar Larabawa fiye da ta Afirka.

translations.source: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
translations.reference: Wurin Shakatawar Ƙasa na Kruger (KNP) yana yankin arewa maso gabas na Afirka ta Kudu inda ya miƙa ta jikin iyakar oasar Mozambique a gabas, Zimbabwe a arewa, kuma a iyakar da ke Ƙoramar Kada ce.
translations.hypothesis: Wurin da ake kira Kuger National Park (KNP) yana arewa-gabashin kasar Afirka ta Kudu, kuma yana da iyaka da Mozambique a gabas, Zimbabwe a arewa, yayin da iyakar kudu ta kasance Kogin Crocodile.

translations.source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
translations.reference: Lambun ya dauki fili mai fadin 19,500 km² kuma ya rabu har kashi 14, kowanne na tallafa wa dabbobin daji dabam.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan wurin shakatawa yana da yawan kasa na kimanin kilomita murabba'i 19,500, kuma an rarrake shi zuwa sassa 14 daban-daban, kowanne ya ƙunshi nau'o'in dabbobi daban-daban.

translations.source: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
translations.reference: Yana ɗaya daga cikin manyan wuraren sha’awa na Afirka ta Kudu kuma ana ɗaukarsa a matsayin ja-gaba a wuraren Buɗe Ido na Afirka ta Kudu (SANParks).
translations.hypothesis: Wani ɓangaren muhimmin abun jan hankali ne a Kudancin Afirka, kuma ana ɗaukarsa a matsayin wani ɓangare mai muhimmanci na kungiyar kare wurare na kasa a Kudancin Afirka (SANParks).

translations.source: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
translations.reference: Kamar yadda yake a dukkanin wuraran shakatawa na Afirka ta Kudu, akwai kiyayewa na yau da kullun da kuɗin shiga wurin shakatawar.
translations.hypothesis: Kamar yadda yake a dukkananan wurare na kare muhalli na Kasa a Afirka ta Kudu, akwai kuɗi da ake biya yau da kullum don kare muhalli da shiga wurin.

translations.source: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
translations.reference: Haka kuma zai iya zama da amfani ga mutum ya sayi Kyanwar Daji, wanda ke samar da wurin shiga ga ko dai zaɓaɓɓun gandun dabbobi a Afirka ta Kudu ko kuma dukkan Gandun Dabbobi na Afirka ta Kudu.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, yana da amfani ga wanda yake son siya da wani katin da ake kira "Wild Card," wanda ke ba da izinin shiga wasu parks a Kudancin Afirka ko kuma dukkan parks na kasa a Kudancin Afirka.

translations.source: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
translations.reference: Tsibirin Hong Kong shine ya baiwa yankin sunansa na Hong Kong kuma shine waje da yawancin yan yawon bude ido suka fi ba mahimmanci.
translations.hypothesis: Tsibirin Hong Kong shine wanda ya ba yankin Hong Kong sunansa, kuma shi ne wajen da yawancin masu zuwa domin neman jin dadi suke ganin shi babban wurin zuwa.

translations.source: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
translations.reference: An kwatanta faretin gine-ginen da ke yin sararin samaniyar Hong Kong da ginshiƙi mai walƙiya wanda aka bayyana ta gaban ruwan Victoria Harbor.
translations.hypothesis: Girma da yawan gine-gine da ke daidaita ƙaramin birnin Hong Kong sun fi kama da takarda mai haske wacce ta bayyana ta hanyar ruwan tashar Victoria.

translations.source: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
translations.reference: Don gani wurare mafi kyaun a Hong Kong, bar tsibirin ka nufi kan gaban ruwan Kowloon da ke tsallake.
translations.hypothesis: Donon ganin kyawawan hangover na Hong Kong, barin tsakiyar birnin kuma je zuwa gefen kogin Kowloon da ke akinsa.

translations.source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
translations.reference: Mafi yawan ci gaban birni na Hong Kong yana cike da adadi a ƙasa mai daɗin kanta ta gefen tsibirin arewacin.
translations.hypothesis: Babban yawan gine-gine da cigaban birni a tsakiyar Hong Kong yana da yawa kuma ana gina su a kan ƙasashen da aka gyara a kusance da gabas.

translations.source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
translations.reference: Wannan shine wurin da ‘yan mulkin mallaka na Birtaniya suka riƙe a zaman nasu kuma idan kana neman shaida ta mulkin mallakar yankin a baya, wannan shine wurin da ya dace ka fara.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan wuri ne da masu mulkin mulkin mallaka na Burtaniya suka yi mulki a ciki, don haka idan kuna neman abubuwan da suka nuna lokacin mulkin mallaka a wannan yanki, wannan wuri ne mai kyau don fara bincike.

translations.source: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
translations.reference: Sundarbans su ne dazukan gefen tekuna mafi girma a duniya, inda suka mika tswon kilomita 80 (mil 50) cikin busassun yankunan kasashen Bangladesh da India daga gabar teku.
translations.hypothesis: Sundarbans ita ce babbar kasa mai tsire-tsire ta mangrove da ke kan teku a duniya, wacce ke da tsayin kilomita 80 (mai mil 50) kuma ta kai zuwa cikin ƙasarmu ta Bangladesh da Indiya daga bakin teku.

translations.source: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
translations.reference: An ayyana Sundarbans a matsayin Wurin Tarihin Duniya na UNESCO. Bangaren daji da cikin yankin Indiya ana kiransa Gandun Dajin Ƙasa na Sundarbans.
translations.hypothesis: Dandalin Sundarbans ya samu takardar shaidar UNESCO ta kasance wani wurin tarihi na duniya. Wurin da ake samun wannan dandalin a cikin ƙasar Indiya ana kiransa Kananan Park na Sundarbans.

translations.source: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
translations.reference: Dazuzzukan ba kawai daji ne mai surkukiyar bishiyoyi da laka ba kawai - sun kunshi daya daga cikin daji mai duhu da su ka rage wanda ya mamayi yankin Gangetic.
translations.hypothesis: Dandalin su ba sa daɗe ne kawai da titin ruwa na mangrove, amma sun haɗa da wasu daga cikin ƙananan ƙananan ƙananan dazogai waɗanda sun wanzu, waɗanda a wani lokaci sun rufe dandalin Ganga.

translations.source: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
translations.reference: Sundarbans sun mamaye yanki mai faɗin 3,850 km², wanda kusan kashi ɗaya bisa ukunsa ruwa/ marsh ce.
translations.hypothesis: Dutsen Sundarbans yana rufe wajen da ya kai kimanin kilomita muraba' 3,850, kuma kusan kashi uku na wannan yawan ya ƙunshi ruwa da filayen tabarau.

translations.source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
translations.reference: Tun daga 1966 Sundarbans ya kasance mafakar dabbobin daji, kuma an ƙiyasta cewa yanzu haka akwai damisar Royal Bengal guda 400 da kuma wasu barewa 30,000 da aka gani a yankin.
translations.hypothesis: Tun shekarar 1966, Sundarbans ta kasance wani wurin kare dabbobi, kuma ana sa ran akwai kimanin dabbobi 400 na nau'in Royal Bengal da kusan dabbobi 30,000 na nau'in da ake kira "spotted deer" a wannan yanki.

translations.source: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
translations.reference: Manyan motocin sun bar tashar zirga-zirga tsakanin yankuna (sun ratsa ta kan kogin) a tsawon rana, duk da dai yawancinsu, musamman wadanda za su tafi gabashi da na Jakar / Bumthang su na tashi tsakanin karfe 06:30 zuwa 07:30.
translations.hypothesis: Motocin bas suna barin tashar bas da ke tsakanin yankuna (a gefen kogin) a duk lokacin rana, amma mafi yawan su, musamman wadanda ke zuwa arewa da Jakar/Bumthang, suna barin tashar ne tsakanin sa'o'i 06:30 zuwa 07:30.

translations.source: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
translations.reference: Motocin bus masu zirga-zirga tsakanin unguwanni kan kasance a cike, shawara ita ce ka sayi tikiti tun kafin kwana biyu.
translations.hypothesis: Domin yadda motocin da ake amfani da su don tafiya tsakanin yankuna sau da yawa suna cike, ya zama dole ku siya tikitin tafiya wasu kwanaki kafin zuwa.

translations.source: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
translations.reference: Ana iya zuwa yawancin gundumomi a cikin kananan bas wadanda ke da kwari ga dadin tafiya.
translations.hypothesis: Kusan dukkanin yankuna suna samun hidima ta hanyar motocin basarar da ake kira "Japanese Coaster," waɗanda suke da sauƙi kuma masu ƙarfi.

translations.source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.reference: Tasi na hadaka suna da sauri da kuma dadin amfani domin yawo zuwa wurare marasa nisa, kamar irin su Paro(Nu 150) da Punakha(Nu 200).
translations.hypothesis: Taxis da ake raba su suna da hanya mai sauri da kuma ta dacewa don tafiya zuwa wurare masu kusa, kamar Paro (farin kudi 150) da Punakha (farin kudi 200).

translations.source: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
translations.reference: Kudiddufin Oyapock River Bridge gadar cable-stayed ce. Ya zagaye kududdufin Oyapock ya hade garuruwan Oiapoque a Brazil da Saint-Georges de I'Oyapock a Faransa Guina.
translations.hypothesis: Kogin Oyapock yana da babbar ƙarƙashiya wacce ta haɗa biranen Oiapoque a ƙasar Brazil da Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock a ƙasar French Guiana. Wannan ƙarƙashiya ta amfani da igari don tallafi.

translations.source: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
translations.reference: Hasumiyoyin guda biyu sun kai tsawon mita 83, tana da tsawon mita 378 sannan tana da layuka biyu masu faɗin 3.50 m.
translations.hypothesis: Manyan ginin biyu sun yi tsayi metres 83, kuma sun yi tsayin kilomita 378, kuma suna da hanya biyu wanda kowannen ya yi faɗi metres 3.50.

translations.source: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
translations.reference: Tsakanin gadar da kasa shi ne mita 15. An kammala ginin a watan Agustan 2011, sai dai ba a bude wajen ba domin motoci har sai a watan Maris din 2017.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin ƙasa da ginshiƙin da ke ƙarƙashin babbar hanya ya kai minti 15. Kwallin gina ya ƙare a watan Agusta na shekarar 2011, amma ba a bude hanya ta ga masu amfani ba har zuwa watan Maris na shekarar 2017.

translations.source: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
translations.reference: An shirya gadar za ta fara aiki sosai a watan Satumba na 2017, lokacin da ake tsammanin gama binciken jami’an hana fasa-kwauri na kasar Brazil.
translations.hypothesis: An tsara a yi amfani da wannan babbar hanya ta hanyar da ta yima a watan Satumba na shekarar 2017, lokacin da ake sa ran an kammala dukkanin wuraren bincike na jihar Brazil.

translations.source: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
translations.reference: Guaraní sun kasance yan asalin kasa mafi mahimmanci da ke zaune a wurinda yanzu yake a gabashin Paraguay, su na rayuwa a matsayin makiyaya kuma maharba sannan su na taba noma.
translations.hypothesis: Guaraní sun kasance kungiyar mutanen da suka mallaki ƙasar da ake kira Gabas ta Paraguay a yanzu, kuma suna rayuwa ne a matsayin masu jera dabbobi waɗanda kuma suke noma ƙananan filaye don abinci.

translations.source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
translations.reference: Yankin Chaco matattara ce ta sauran rukunan ƙabilu ‘yan asalin yanki kamar Guaycuru da kuma Payagua waɗanda su ke rayuwa ta hanyar farauta, tsince-tsince da kuma kamun kifi.
translations.hypothesis: Yayin da yankin Chaco ke da wasu kungiyoyi na al'ummomin asali, kamar su Guaycurú da Payaguá, waɗanda suka rayu ta hanyar sare dabbobi, tarwatar abinci, da kuma kasuwanci.

translations.source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
translations.reference: A cikin karni na 16 Paraguay, wanda a da ake kira “The Giant Province of the Indies”, an haife shi ne sakamakon gamuwa da masu nasara daga Sifen tare da kungiyoyin ƴan asalin ƙasar.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 16 ga ƙarni, Paraguay, wacce a baya aka yi mata suna "Babban Lardin Indiya," ta taso sakamakon tarwar sojojin Spaniya da ƙungiyoyin mutanen da suka mallaki ƙasar a wancan lokacin.

translations.source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
translations.reference: Mutanen Spain sun fara mulkin mallaka wanda ya ɗauki ƙarni uku.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen Spain suka fara zamanin mulkin mallaka wanda ya ci gaba tsawon shekaru uku.

translations.source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
translations.reference: Tun kafuwar Asunción a shekara ta 1537, Paraguay ta sami damar kiyaye ɗumbin asalin ta da asalin ta.
translations.hypothesis: Tun lokacin da aka kafa birnin Asunción a shekarar 1537, kasar Paraguay ta samu nasara wajen adana wani muhimmin bangare na al'adunsa da asalin al'ummar ta.

translations.source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
translations.reference: An san ƙasar Argentina da mallakar ɗaya daga cikin ƙungiyoyin wasan ƙwallon doki da ‘yan wasa mafi nagarta a duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Argentina ta shahara ne saboda ta da daya daga mafi kyawun kungiyoyin polo da 'yan wasa a duniya.

translations.source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
translations.reference: Gasar wasannin mafi girma a shekara ana yin ta ne a watan Disamba a filayen wasan ƙwallon dawakai da ke Las Cantas.
translations.hypothesis: Tseren da ke da manyan wasanni a shekarar na yaye a watan Disamba a filin wasan polo a yankin Las Cañitas.

translations.source: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
translations.reference: Kananan gasa da wasani a kan iya ganin su anan a wasu lokutan shekara.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu wasanni da gasai masu ƙaramin ƙima kuma za su iya nuna su a nan a wasu lokuta na shekara.

translations.source: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.reference: Don samun labaran gasar wasanni da inda za a sayi tikitin wasanni kwallon doki, sai a tuntubi kungiyar wasan kwallon doki ta Argentina.
translations.hypothesis: Don kuɗiɗin labarai game da wasanni da kuma inda za ku iya siyan tikiti don wasannin polo, duba shafin gidan yanar gizo na "Asociacion Argentina de Polo."

translations.source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
translations.reference: Kuɗin Falklands a hukumance shi ne fam na Falkland (FKP) wanda aka saita darajar sa daidai da na fam ɗaya na Ingila (GBP).
translations.hypothesis: Kudin da ake amfani da shi a Falkland shine Falkland pound (FKP), kuma darajar sa ta yi daidaito da darajar ɗaya na kudin Ingilishi (GBP).

translations.source: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
translations.reference: Ana iya musayar kudi a banki daya kaɗai da ke tsibiran wanda ke ketaren Stanley daga shagon FIC West.
translations.hypothesis: Kudin za'a iya canzawa a bankin daya ne da ke cikin tsakiyar ƙungiyar da ke cikin birnin Stanley, wanda yake kusa da kantin sayayya na FIC West.

translations.source: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
translations.reference: Ana karbar fam din Birtaniya kusan a ko’ina a tsibirin da cibiyar hada hadar kudi ta Stanley haka ita ma dalar amurka yawanci ana karbar ta.
translations.hypothesis: Kudin Falkland (British pounds) yawanci ana karɓa a ko'ina cikin tsibirin, kuma a cikin birnin Stanley, ana karɓar katin banki da kuma dalolin Amurka (United States dollars) sosai.

translations.source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
translations.reference: A kan iyakar tsibirin da ke kusa da alama ba za a karɓa ba, kodayake ana iya karɓar kuɗin Birtaniya da Amurka; bincika tare da masu shi don sanin menene hanyar biyan kuɗi da za a karɓa.
translations.hypothesis: A wasu tsibirin da ke nesa, zai yiwu ba a karɓi katin kuɗi ba, amma kuma za a iya karɓar kuɗin Burtaniya da Amurka; don haka, ya kamata ku tattauna da masu gida kafin zuwa domin sanin yadda za ku iya biyan kuɗi.

translations.source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
translations.reference: Abu ne mawuyaci ka sami canjin kudin Falklands idan ka bar tsibirin, don haka kana bukatar canzar kudinka kafin ka bar tsibirin.
translations.hypothesis: Yin canji na kuɗin Falklands a wajen tsibirin yana da wahala sosai, don haka ku canza kuɗin ku kafin ku bar tsibirin.

translations.source: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
translations.reference: Kasancewar birnin Montevideo na kudancin Tsakiyar Duniya, lokacin zafi a can shine na sanyi a arewacin duniya, kuma lokacin sanyi a can shine na zafi a arewacin duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Tun da Montevideo ta kasance a arewa maso yamma na layi mai zurfi (Equator), lokacin bazara ne a can lokacin da ake samun sanyi a arewa maso yamma, kuma akasin haka.

translations.source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
translations.reference: Montevideo na cikin yankuna masu yanayin sauƙin zafi; a lokacin rani, zafi kan kai sama da +30°C.
translations.hypothesis: Montevideo na cikin yankin sub-tropical; a lokacin watannin bazara, yawan zafi da ya wuce digiri 30 na yawa.

translations.source: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
translations.reference: Lokacin hunturu na iya zama mai sanyida wasa-wasa: yanayin zafi ba safai ake yin sanyi ba, amma iska da zafi suna haduwa don sanya shi jin sanyi fiye da abin da ma'aunin zafi da sanyio ya fada.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin sanyi na iya zama mai ƙamshi: ko da yake yanayin zafi yawanci ba su ƙasa da matakin ruwa ba, amma iska da ƙamshin ruwa suna haɗuwa suka sa jiki ya ji sanyi fiye da yadda maƙiyi ya nuna.

translations.source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
translations.reference: Babu “damina” da “rani” na musamman: adadin ruwan sama na kasance iri daya duka shekara.
translations.hypothesis: Babu lokuta na musamman na "jiƙin ruwa" da "bushewa": adadin ruwan da ya fita ya kasance kusan iri ɗaya a duk shekara.

translations.source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
translations.reference: Kodayake yawancin dabbobi da ke wurin killace dabbobin sun saba da ganin mutane, duk da haka namomin daji na da hadari don haka kada a basu abinci ko a tsokane su.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake wasu daga cikin dabbobin da ke cikin wurin shakatawa sun saba ganin mutane, duk da haka dabbobin suna cikin halin da suka kasance, kuma ba a kamata a ba su abinci ko a damu da su.

translations.source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
translations.reference: Kamar yadda hukumomin gandun daji suka fada, tsaya aƙalla nisan yadi/mita 100 daga dabbobin bear da kerkeci da yadi/mita 25 daga sauran dabbobin daji!
translations.hypothesis: A cewar jami'an park, dole ne ku kasance a nesa na kalla mita 90 zuwa ga 'yan sarki da 'yan gurbi, kuma a nesa na kalla mita 23 zuwa ga sauran dabbobin dazuzzuka.

translations.source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
translations.reference: Ko da yaya dolancin su yake, bison, elk, moose, bears, da kusan dukkanin manyan dabbobi za su iya kai hari.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da sun bayyana kamar su ba su da wata matsala, dabbobi kamar bison, elk, moose, bears, da kuma kusan dukkan manyan dabbobi suna iya kaiwa hari.

translations.source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
translations.reference: A duk shekara, gwamman maziyarta na samun raunuka sakamakon gaza bada tazara da ta dace. Kuma dabbobin manya ne, masu fada kuma su na da hadarin gaske, don haka sai an basu tazara.
translations.hypothesis: Koy yanzu, akwai wasu mutane da ake cutar da su kowane shekara saboda su ba su kiyaye nisan da ya kamata. Waɗannan dabbobi manya ne, masu halaye na dazuzzuka, kuma suna iya zama masu haɗari, don haka bar su a cikin yadda suka kasance.

translations.source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
translations.reference: Bugu da ƙari, ka sani cewa ƙamshi na janyo bear da waɗansu namun daji, don haka guji ɗauka ko dafa abinci mai ƙamshi da kuma tsaftace sansani.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, lura cewa ƙamshin abinci na jawo hankalin dabbobi, musamman 'yan kasa, don haka ka guje wa ɗaukar ko dafa abincin da ke da ƙamshi, kuma ka kula da tsafta a wurin taronka.

translations.source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
translations.reference: Apia ce babban birnin Samoa. Garin yana kan tsibirin Upolu kuma yana da yawan al’umma da kadan ya gaza da 40,000.
translations.hypothesis: Apia babban birnin kasar Samoa ne. Birnin na cikin tsakiyar ƙasar, a cikin yankin da ake kira Upolu, kuma yawan mutanen da suke zaune a birnin ya kai kusan mutane 40,000.

translations.source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
translations.reference: An kafa Apia a shekarun 1850s kuma ta kasance ita ce babban birnin Samoa a hukumance tun 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Apia ta ƙirƙita a shekarar 1850s, kuma ta kasance babban birnin jihar Samoa tun shekarar 1959.

translations.source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
translations.reference: Tashar jiragen ruwan ta kasance wurin da aka yi kaurin suna a tashe-tashen hankula a cikin 1889 lokacin da jiragen ruwa bakwai daga Jamus, Amurka, da Biritaniya suka ƙi barin tashar.
translations.hypothesis: Toggan wannan wuri ne da ya samu wani lamari mai ban tsoro a shekarar 1889, inda jiragen ruwa bakwai daga Jamus, Amurka, da Burtaniya suka ki barin tashar.

translations.source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
translations.reference: Duk an nutsar da jiragen ruwan, in ban da wani ƙaramin jirgin ruwan Birtaniya. Kusan rayuka 200 na Amurkawa da Jamusawa aka rasa.
translations.hypothesis: Dukkan jiragen ruwa sun tonkawa, sai daya kawai wanda ya kasance jirgin ruwan Burtaniya. Kusan mutane 200 daga Amurka da Jamus suka mutu.

translations.source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
translations.reference: A yayin gwagwarmayar neman ƴanci da kungiyar Mau ta shirya, taron lumana da aka yi a garin ya haifar da kisan babban sarki Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
translations.hypothesis: A lokacin yakin neman 'yanci da kungiyar Mau ta shirya, wata tarhiyar zaman lafiya da aka yi a birnin ta haifar da mutuwar shugaban kungiyar, Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

translations.source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
translations.reference: Akwai gaɓar teku mai rairayi da dama, sakamakon zagaye tasoshin jiragen ruwa biyu da Auckland ta yi. Fitattun cikinsu suna cikin yankuna uku.
translations.hypothesis: Akwai wurare da dama inda ake yin iyo a cikin ruwa, saboda birnin Auckland yana da biyu manyan tafkin ruwa. Manyan wurare da mutane suke zuwa sun kasance a cikin sassa uku.

translations.source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
translations.reference: Rairayin bakin tekun North Shores (a gundumar North Harbour) suna kan Tekun Pacific sannan suka miƙa daga Long Bay a arewa zuwa Devonport a kudu.
translations.hypothesis: Rahunanan da ke gefen teku a yankin North Harbour suna kan Tekun Pacific kuma sun kai tsayin kilomita, daga Long Bay a arewa zuwa Devonport a kudu.

translations.source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
translations.reference: Kusan dukan su beach ne masu kasa da kuma wurin iyo a kwanciyar hankali, kuma yawancin su suna da inuwa da bishiyun pohutukawa ke bayarwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kusan dukkanin wuraren su suke da tsire-tsire masu ƙura, kuma suna da tsaro don yin wanka, kuma mafi yawan su suna da inuwa da ake samu ta bangaranci mai suna "pohutukawa".

translations.source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
translations.reference: Kogin Tamaki Drive suna kan Waitemata Harbor, a cikin manyan unguwannin bayan gari na Mission Bay da St Heliers a Central Auckland.
translations.hypothesis: Tsofofin Tamaki sun kasance a bakin kogin Waitemata, a cikin yankunan da suka fi kasada na Mission Bay da St Heliers, waɗanda ke cikin birnin Auckland.

translations.source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
translations.reference: Wani lokaci akwai gabobin bakin ruwa da ke cunkushe da iyalai da kuma jerin kantuna. Yin ninkaya a wajen ba shi da hadari.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan wasu lokuta suna da yawan mutane, musamman iyalai, kuma akwai shaguna da dama a kusancen teku. Zama a cikin ruwa yana da amincin.

translations.source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
translations.reference: Giya ta gida da aka sani ita ce ‘Ta Ɗaya’, ba giya ce mai haɗe-haɗe ba, amma tana da daɗi da wartsakarwa. Ana kiran daya giyar ta gida “Manta”.
translations.hypothesis: Man shayi mai yawa a yankin shi ne 'Number One', ba shi da tsami mai yawa, amma yana da daɗi kuma yana samar da numfashi. Wani man shayin da ake samarwa a yankin kuma ansa masa "Manta".

translations.source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
translations.reference: Akwai giya na Faransa da yawa da za a ci, amma giyar New Zealand da Ostiraliya na iya tafiya mafi kyau.
translations.hypothesis: Akwai nau'o-nau'o na shayin faransa da za su iya samuwa, amma shayin da ake samarwa a New Zealand da Australia na iya zama mafi kyau a tafiya.

translations.source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
translations.reference: Ruwan famfon na gida yana da cikakkiyar tsabta don sha, amma ruwan kwalba na da saukin samu idan kana fargaba.
translations.hypothesis: Ruwan da ake samu a masarautar ya kasance mai amanci don sha, amma idan kana tsoro, za ka iya samun ruwan da aka saka a kwalabe cikin sauƙi.

translations.source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
translations.reference: Ga ƴan Australiya, manufar kofi na 'flat white' bakon abu ne. Wani bakar gajeren kofi na 'espresso', yana cike da maiko (ba kumfa ba), ana shan shayi ba tare da madara ba.
translations.hypothesis: Ga mutanen Australiya, rawar naman daji mai suna 'flat white' ba da san adadi ba ne. Kofin 'short black' ana kiransa 'espresso', kuma 'cappuccino' ana yinsa da kyakkyawan man shai (ba fuka-fuka ba), kuma shai ana hidimta ba da nono ba.

translations.source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
translations.reference: Alawar mai zafi ta kai matsayi irin wadda Belgium ta kayyade. Abin sha na kayan itace na da tsada amma akwai dadi.
translations.hypothesis: Kofi mai zafi ne mai kyau, ya yi daidaito da ƙa'idodi na Belgium. Ruwan 'ya'ya yana da tsada, amma mai kyau sosai.

translations.source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
translations.reference: Yawancin tafiye-tafiye zuwa kasan ana yin su duka shekara, kuma raunin da ya auku dalilin kowane dayan daga cikin wadannan sabubba na karkashin ruwa na da karanci.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan wurin da ake zuwa domin kallon rayuwar ruwa (reef) ana zuwa akinsa a duk shekara, kuma yawan raunuka da ake samu a wurin saboda dalilai daban-daban sun kasance da ƙaranci.

translations.source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
translations.reference: Har yanzu, nemi shawara daga hukumomi, yin biyayya ga dukkan alamu, da kuma kula sosai game da gargadin lafiya.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da haka, kar ku manta ku bi umurnin jami'ai, ku bi duk alamomin da aka sanya, kuma ku yi kulawa sosai ga bayanan da suka yi daidai da tsaro.

translations.source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
translations.reference: Gungun jellyfish na taruwa a kusa da rairayin bakin teku da kuma kusa da bakin kogi inda ya hadu da teku tsakanin watannin Oktoba zuwa Afrilu a arewacin 1770. Amma ana iya samunsu jefi jefi a wasu lokutan ma.
translations.hypothesis: Kwanar ruwan da ke cikin sanyi (jellyfish) suna bayyana kusa da rafi da kuma wuraren da koguna ke faduwa cikin ruwa daga watan Oktoba zuwa Afrilu a yankin arewa da birnin 1770. Wannan kwanar ruwa ta iya bayyana a wasu lokuta, ko ma a lokutan da ba su jima.

translations.source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
translations.reference: Akwai shark a zahiri amma basu fiya kawowa mutane hari ba. Yawancin sharks suna tsoron mutane kuma guduwa zasuyi.
translations.hypothesis: Kwanar suke nan, amma yawanci ba sa kai hari ga mutane. Yawancin kwanar suna tsoron mutane kuma suna fita daga wurin.

translations.source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
translations.reference: Kada din ruwa me gishiri basa yawan zama a teku, wurn zaman su shine kududufi estuaries arewa ga Rockhampton.
translations.hypothesis: Kwakwalman ruwan danyen ba sa rayuwa a cikin teku, amma sun fi samun wuraren zama a cikin wuraren da ruwa da teku suka haɗu, musamman a arewa ta Rockhampton.

translations.source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
translations.reference: Biya da wuri tana ba da mafita tare da tafiye-tafiye na fili. Studentsalibai na iya kallon kayan tarihin, ziyartar akwatin kifaye, ko kuma sha'awar kyawawan fasaha yayin zama tare da ajinsu.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan tsarin yin rajista da farko yana bawa mai tafiya kwanciyar rai cewa zai sami wuri da zai kwana da zarar ya isa wurin da yake son zuwa.

translations.source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
