translations.reference: Ma'aikatan tafiye-tafiye galibi suna da ma'amala tare da takamaiman otal, kodayake kuna iya samun damar tsara wasu nau'o'in masauki, kamar filayen zangon, ta hanyar wakilin balaguro.
translations.hypothesis: Masu sayar da tikitin tafiya sau da yawa suna da yarjejeniyoyi da manyan otel, amma kuma zai yiwu ku iya yin ajiyar wurare na zamantakewa, kamar wuraren shakatawa a waje, ta hanyar wani masanin sayar da tikitin tafiya.

translations.source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
translations.reference: Dillalan zirga-zirga galibi suna bayar da hasafin karya kumallo da tsara tafiye-tafiye - na zuwa da dawowa - daga filin jiragen sama ko kuma su kan hada har da na tafiyar jiragen da kuma na otel.
translations.hypothesis: Masu sayar da tikitin tafiya yawanci suna ba da takardun da suka haɗa da abincin safiya, tsarin jigilar abokin haɗin zuwa/daga filin jirgin sama, ko ma da takardun da suka haɗa da tikitin jirgin sama da otel.

translations.source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
translations.reference: Hakanan zasu iya riƙe ajiyar a gare ku idan kuna buƙatar lokaci don tunani game da tayin ko samo wasu takardu don zuwa (misali visa).
translations.hypothesis: Suna kuma iya adana wurin da kuka yi rajista a gare ku, idan kuna buƙatar lokaci don tunani game da alkawarin da aka yi muku ko kuma neman wasu takardun da ake buƙata don tafiya zuwa wurin da za ku je (misali, visa).

translations.source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
translations.reference: Duk wani gyara ko buƙata za a tura ta wurin jami’in tafiye-tafiye da farko ba kai tsaye zuwa otal ba.
translations.hypothesis: Duk wani canje-canje ko buƙata da za ku samu, ya kamata ku tuntuɓi wakilin tafiya da farko, ba kai tsaye ba zuwa otel.

translations.source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
translations.reference: Don wasu bukukuwa, yawancin masu halarta zuwa bukukuwa na kiɗa sun yanke shawara su yi zango a wurin, kuma yawancin masu halarta suna ɗaukar shi muhimmin ɓangare na ƙwarewar.
translations.hypothesis: A wasu bukukuwa, yawanci mahalata da suke halarta, suna yanke shawarar zaunekin su a wurin bukukuwan waƙa, kuma mafi yawan mahalata suna ɗaukar wannan a matsayin wani ɓangare mai mahimmanci na bikin.

translations.source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
translations.reference: Idan kana so ka yi kusa da inda mataki ke faruwa sai ka shiga da wuri domin samun sansani kusa da kidi da waka.
translations.hypothesis: Idan kana son kasancewa kusa da abubuwan da ke faruwa, zaka buƙe ka zo da wuri don samun wani wurin shakatawa kusa da wurin da ake yiwa waƙa.

translations.source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
translations.reference: Ka tuna cewa, duk da kasancewar an datse kade-kade a farfajiyar, akwai kuma wasu sassan bukukuwan da za su ci gaba da kade-kaden har can talatainin dare.
translations.hypothesis: Ka tuna cewa ko da yake waƙoƙin da ke cikin manyan wurare na taron na iya ƙare, har yanzu akwai wasu sassa na taron da za su ci gaba da kunna waƙa har zuwa ƙarshen dare.

translations.source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
translations.reference: Waɗansu bukukuwan na da wurin sansani na musamman domin iyalai da ke da ƙananan yara.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu bukukuwa suna da wurare na musamman don shakatawa waɗanda aka shirya don iyalai da yara ƙanana.

translations.source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
translations.reference: Idan za ka tsallaka Arewacin Baltic a lokacin sanyi, duba wurin taragon, saboda ratsa ƙanƙara na jawo wani mummunan ƙara ga waɗanda abin ya fi shafa.
translations.hypothesis: Idan zaku yi tafiya a cikin yankin Arewa maso Gabas na Baltic a lokacin hunturu, duba inda ake daidaita motocin, domin tafiya ta cikin kankara na iya haifar da ƙara iri-iri na ƙara da zai iya damun mutanen da suke kusa.

translations.source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
translations.reference: Yawon jirgin ruwa a Saint Petersburg ya haɗa da lokaci a cikin gari. An cire fasinjojin jirgin ruwa daga buƙatun visa (duba sharuɗɗan).
translations.hypothesis: Tura da jirgin ruwa a Saint Petersburg ta haɗa da lokaci a cikin birnin. Masu tafiya da jirgin ruwa ba sa buƙatar visa (duba sharuɗɗin).

translations.source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
translations.reference: Gidajen caca yawanci suna yin ƙoƙari da yawa don haɓaka lokaci da kuɗin da baƙi suka kashe. Tagogi da agogo galibi basa nan, kuma hanyar fita na da wahalar samu.
translations.hypothesis: Yawanci kasuwanci na wasanni suna ƙoƙarin samun fa'ida ta hanyar ƙara lokaci da kuɗi da abokan ciniki suke kashewa. Kodayne, ba a saka tagogi ko kuma agogon a cikin wurin, kuma wasu lokuta yana da wahala samun hanyar fita.

translations.source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
translations.reference: Yawanci suna da abinci, abin sha da kuma nishaɗi na musamman da suke samarwa, domin faranta wa baƙi, don su zauna a wurin.
translations.hypothesis: Yawanci suna da takamai na musamman, abinci da abin sha, da kuma wasanni, domin su sa baƙin su cikin farin ciki, kuma su riƙe su a wurin.

translations.source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
translations.reference: Wasu wuraren suna ba da kayan sha na barasa a gidan. Sai dai kuma, maye toshe tunani, kuma duk ƙwararrun ‘yan caca sun san mahimmancin kasancewa ba cikin maye ba.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu wurare suna ba da abinci da abin sha, kamar man shayi da kwalbu, kyauta. Duk da haka, shan giya yana cutar da fahimta, kuma duk masu wasan azara masu kyau suna sanin muhimmancin kasancewa cikin tsarki.

translations.source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.reference: Duk wanda zai yo tuƙi a wurare masu tsananin tudu ko ta kan hanyoyin kan tsauni ya kula da yiwuwar dusar ƙanƙara, ƙanƙara, ko yanayin sanyi mai tsanayi.
translations.hypothesis: Kowa wanda zai yi tafiya da mota a yankin da ke kusa da arewa ko kuma a kan hanyoyin da ke kan tsaunuka, ya kamata ya yi la'akari da yiwuwar samun ƙanƙara, ƙauri, ko kuma yanayin sanyi.

translations.source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.reference: A wajaje masu kankara, ko sanyi halin jiki na zama matsakaici ne a kasashe da yawa, kuma cinkoso na cigabawa ne ba tare da tsayawa ba.
translations.hypothesis: A kan titunan da suka cika da ƙanƙara da ƙaza, matakin tsayayyen abu (friction) yana da ƙaranci, kuma ba za ku iya wanzu ta hanyar motsa mota kamar yadda za ku iya yi a kan titin da bai da wata ruwa ko ƙanƙara ba.

translations.source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.reference: A lokacin guguwar dusar kankara, dusar kanakara kan iya ajiye ku a wuri daya lokacin fadawa a cikin karamin lokaci.
translations.hypothesis: A lokacin ruwan zafi, adadi mai yawa na ƙanƙara na iya fallowa cikin lokaci mai kaɗan, wanda hakan na iya sa mutum ya tsaya.

translations.source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.reference: Hakanan ana iya taƙaita ganuwa ta faɗuwa ko busar da dusar ƙanƙara ko ta iska ko kankara akan windows abin hawa.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan abu na iya saɓabawa gani kuma, musamman idan akwai ƙanƙara ko iska mai ɗauke da ƙanƙara, ko kuma idan akwai ruwan tabarma ko ƙanƙara a cikin gilashin motocin.

translations.source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.reference: A gefe guda, yanayin kankara da dusar ƙanƙara sun zama al'ada a ƙasashe da yawa, kuma yawancin zirga-zirga ba a katsewa duk shekara.
translations.hypothesis: A gefe guda, yanayi mai sanyi da ƙanƙara na al'ada ne a ƙasashe da yawa, kuma tafiyar motoci ta ci gaba da gudana ba tare da tsayayya ba kusan duk shekara.

translations.source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.reference: Watakila Safaris ita ce mafi girman zane-zanen yawon buda ido a Afirka kuma abin birgewa ga baƙi da yawa.
translations.hypothesis: Turaƙe (safaris) na iya zama mafi muhimmin abu da ke jawo masu yawon bude ido zuwa Afirka, kuma su ne abin da yawancin baƙin kasuwa suke jin daɗa.

translations.source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.reference: Kalmar safari an fi danganta da masu bulaguro a kafa domin kallon kyawawan namun daji na Afirka, musamman yankuna marasa duhu da ciyawa sosai.
translations.hypothesis: Kalmar "safari" wacce ake amfani da ita sosai tana nufin tafiya ta ƙasa don ganin halittu masu ban mamaki na Afirka, musamman a yankin savanna.

translations.source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.reference: Wasu dabbobi, kamar giwaye da raƙuman dawa, su kan je kusa da motoci kuma na’ura mai kyau za ta ba da damar kallo sosai.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu dabbobi, kamar zunzuyoyi da girama, suna da al'ada na zuwa kusa da motoci, kuma kayan aiki na yawa suna ba da damar ganinsu da sauƙi.

translations.source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.reference: Zakuna, damisar cheetah da ta leopard wasu lokuta suna kaucewa mutane kuma za ku fi ganin su sosai maduban hangen nesa.
translations.hypothesis: Zuma, fari da bagudu wasu lokuta suna da alamomin shirme, kuma za ku iya ganinsu sosai idan kuna amfani da takaitun kallo.

translations.source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.reference: Safari na tafiya (wanda ake kira “tafiyar daji”, “safari maiyawo”, ko tafiya “ƙafa”) ya ƙunshi yin yawo, ko dai na awanni ko kwanaki da yawa.
translations.hypothesis: Wata tafiya ta neman dabbobi (wacce kuma ake kiranta da "tafiya a cikin filin," "safarin tafiya," ko "tafiya a ƙafa") ta ƙunshi tafiya, ko ta kasance na sa'o'i kaɗan ko kuma na tsawon kwanaki.

translations.source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.reference: Za a gudanar da wasannin nakasassu daga 24 ga Agusta zuwa 5 ga Satumba 2021. Za a gudanar da wasu abubuwan a wasu wurare a duk fadin Japan.
translations.hypothesis: Wasan Paralympics zai gudana daga 24 ga watan Agusta zuwa 5 ga watan Satumba na shekarar 2021. Wasu wasanni za su gudana a wasu wurare daban a fadin kasar Japan.

translations.source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.reference: Tokyo za ta kasance gari daya tilo na Asiya da ya taba karbar bakuncin wasannin Olympics karo biyu, bayan da ta dauki nauyin wasannin a shekarar 1964.
translations.hypothesis: Tokyo zai zama ɗaya daga cikin biranen Asiya da suka yi wa wasannin Olympics na kaka biyu, bayan da ta karbi wasannin a shekarar 1964.

translations.source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.reference: Idan kayi rijistar tashin jirgi da masauki a 2020 kafin sanar da jinkirtawa, zaku iya samun matsala.
translations.hypothesis: Idan kun yi ajin tikitin jirgin sama da wurin zuwa don shekarar 2020 kafin sanarwar janyewa ta fito, zai iya zama cewa kuna cikin wata matsala.

translations.source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.reference: Manufofin sokewa sun bambanta, amma har zuwa ƙarshen Maris yawancin manufofin sakewa na coronavirus ba su wuce zuwa Yuli 2020, lokacin da aka shirya wasannin Olympics.
translations.hypothesis: Siyasar dakatar da ayyuka ta bambanta, amma kamar yadda aka sani a watan Maris na baya, mafi yawan siyasar dakatar da ayyuka da aka yi ta amfani da cutar coronavirus ba ta shafar watan Yuli na shekarar 2020, wanda aka shirya gudanar da gasar Olympics a lokacin.

translations.source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.reference: Ana tsammanin yawancin tikiti na sha’ani za a sayar da su tsakanin ¥2,500 zuwa ¥130,000, yayin da tikiti na yau da kullun su ke kusan ¥ 7,000.
translations.hypothesis: An tsara cewa mafi yawan takardun shiga ga taron za su kasance tsakanin ¥2,500 zuwa ¥130,000, kuma takardun shiga na yawa za su kasance a kusan ¥7,000.

translations.source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.reference: Gugan kayayyakin sawa masu lema su a iya taimaka masu bushewa. Yawancin otal suna da dutsen guga da katakon guga kaya don rance, ko da ba wani a cikin ɗakin ba.
translations.hypothesis: Zubar da kayan sawa da suka daɗe da ruwa na iya taimakawa wajen busa su. Otel da yawa suna da kwalal da allon zubarwa waɗanda ake iya amfani da su, ko da ma ba a samu a cikin ɗakin.

translations.source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.reference: Idan ba a samu dutsen guga ba, ko kuma idan ba ku damu da saka gogaggiyar safa ba, to za ku iya gwada amfani da mabushin gashi, idan akwai.
translations.hypothesis: Idan ba za ku samu ƙaramin kwal, ko kuma idan ba ku so ku saka riguna da aka yi wa girki, to za ku iya ƙoƙarin amfani da injin busa ƙuraye, idan ya kasance a nan.

translations.source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.reference: Yi hankali da ƙin barin masana'anta suyi zafi sosai (wanda zai iya haifar da raguwa, ko kuma a mawuyacin yanayi, zafi).
translations.hypothesis: Kada ku bar kayan abu su zama masu zafi sosai (domin hakan na iya sa su ɓace, ko kuma a wasu lokuta, su lalace).

translations.source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.reference: Akwai hanyoyi daban-daban na tsarkake ruwa, wasu sun fi tasiri kan takamaiman barazanar.
translations.hypothesis: Akwai hanyoyi daban-daban na tsaftace ruwa, wasu daga cikinsu suna da tasiri sosai wajen yaki da cututtuka na musamman.

translations.source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.reference: A wasu wurare, minti daya ya isa ruwa ya tafasa, amma a wasu wuraren kuma yana bukatar mintuna da yawa.
translations.hypothesis: A wasu sassa, zubar da ruwa a cikin waje na dakika ɗaya ya isa, amma a wasu sassa, ana buƙatar tsawon dakika da yawa.

translations.source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.reference: Matata sun bambanta a inganci, idan kana da damuwa, to sai ka yi tunanin sayan naka ruwa a kwalba mai murfi daga amintaccen kamfani.
translations.hypothesis: Takardun da ake amfani da su wajen tsaftace ruwa sun bambanta a yadda suke aiki, kuma idan kana da damuwa, ya kamata ka yi la'akari da siyan ruwan ka a cikin kwalban da aka rufe, daga kamfani mai kyau.

translations.source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.reference: Matafiya na iya fuskantar kwari wadanda basu saba dasu ba a garin su na asali.
translations.hypothesis: Masu tafiya suna iya fuskantar halittu masu cutarwa waɗanda ba su sani ba a yankinsu.

translations.source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.reference: Beraye da dangoginsu kan bata abinci sannan su janyo kaikayi ko kuma ma su haddasa kan jiki tare da yada guba ko kuma ma baza cututtuka.
translations.hypothesis: Cututtuka na iya lalata abinci, haifar da rashin ta'azanci, ko kuma a matsayin matsala mafi muni, su haifar da alurar jiki, yaduwa da guba, ko kuma yaduwa da cuta.

translations.source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.reference: Cututuka masu iya yaduwa da kansu, ko kuma dabbobi da ke da hatsari da za su iya raunatawa ko kashe mutane da ƙarfi, ba su cancanta a matsayin kwari ba.
translations.hypothesis: Cututtukan da ake yi ta hanyar kamuwa da cuta, ko kuma dabbobin da suka haɗaɗɗi waɗanda za su iya jarrabawar mutane ko kashe su, yawanci ba su shiga cikin abubuwan da ake kira "cututtuka" ba.

translations.source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.reference: Sayan kaya ta rahusa ita ce damar siyan kayan da aka kebe daga haraji da fifcewa a wasu wurare.
translations.hypothesis: Sana'antar sayayya ba tare da biyan haraji ba ita ce damar siyan kayayyaki waɗanda aka rage harajin da kuma wasu karin kuɗi a wasu wurare.

translations.source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.reference: Matafiya zuwa ƙasashe masu tsananin haraji za su iya adana wani adadin kuɗin mai yawa a wasu lokuta n, musamman akan abubuwa kamar barasa da taba.
translations.hypothesis: Wanda yake tafiya zuwa ƙasashe da suka fi saka haraji, wasu lokuta suna iya adana kuɗi mai yawa, musamman akan abubuwa kamar man shayi da tabaki.

translations.source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.reference: Yankin tsakanin Point Marion da Fairmont na gabatar da mafi kyawun yanayin tuƙi a kan babbar hanyar Buffalo-Pittsburgh, yana wucewa ta kowane yanki mai zaman kansa da baya.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan hanya tsakanin birnin Point Marion da Fairmont ita ce mafi wahala a kan hanya ta Buffalo-Pittsburgh, kuma ta wuce akai-akai ta cikin wurare masu nisa da kuma ƙananan ƙauyuka.

translations.source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.reference: Idan har ba ka saba da tuki a titunan kasar ba, to ka tattara hankalinka a kanka: kana mai hankalta da tukin da nutsuwa a titin tare da kaucewa tukin gaggawa da daga hankali.
translations.hypothesis: Idan ba ku sani yadda ake wanzar da mota a kan hanyoyin ƙauye, ku yi hankali: hanyoyin suna da tsawo, suna da ƙaramin wuri, kuma suna da kaso masu duwa.

translations.source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.reference: Alamomin kayyade gudun ababen hawa sun yi karanci a nan fiye da a wuraren da ke baya - anfi samun wadanda ba sa wuce mph 35-40 (56-64 km/h) - biyayya ga alamomin na da mahimmanci maimakon rashin yi musu biyayya.
translations.hypothesis: Yawan saurin mota da aka sanya a wannan hanya ya kasance ƙasa fiye da yadda yake a wasu sassan da suka gabace shi da kuma na bayan sa — galibi 35-40 milawa sa'a (56-64 kilomita sa'a) — kuma biyan wannan iyakokin saurin mota yana da mahimmanci fiye da sauran.

translations.source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.reference: Abin ban mamaki, ko da yake, sabis ɗin wayar hannu ya fi ƙarfi a nan fiye da sauran hanyoyin da yawa, misali. Daji na Pennsylvania.
translations.hypothesis: Wataƙi, duk da haka, sabis na wayar salula yana da ƙarfi sosai a nan fiye da wasu sassan hanyar, kamar yadda yake a yankin Pennsylvania Wilds.

translations.source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.reference: Kayan ciye-ciyen Jamusawa akwai kyau, kuma a Bavaria, suna da daɗin gaske da mabambanta, irin na maƙwabciyarsu ta kudanci, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: Abinci mai daɗi na Jamusya yana da kyau, kuma a Bavaria, yana da yawa da kuma bambanci, kamar yadda ake samu a kasar Austria, wacce ke arewa maso yamma.

translations.source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.reference: Abincin ƴaƴan itace sun zama ruwan dare, ta yin abinci da tufa a tsawon shekara, da kuma cherries da plums da ke bayyana lokacin bazara.
translations.hypothesis: Abinci mai tsami da naman 'ya'ya da ake yinsa, yana da yawa, kuma ana yinsa a duk shekara, kuma ana amfani da naman cherries da plums a lokacin bazara.

translations.source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.reference: Yawancin kayayyaki da aka dafa da Jamusanci suma suna da alamomin almara, ƙwaya, da sauran ƙwayoyin itace. Mashahurin wainar ba da daɗewa ba haɗe biyu tare da kofi mai ƙarfi.
translations.hypothesis: Abubuwan da ake yin su daga kayan masarfa a Jamus da dama suna da ƙwayar almond, ƙwayar hazelnut, da sauran ƙwayoyin tsire-tsire. Kayan masarfa da suka shahara sau da yawa suna da kyau sosai idan aka sha da kofin ruwan daskarar.

translations.source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.reference: Idan kuna son ɗan ƙaramin abincimai ɗanɗano, gwada abin da ya dogara da yankin da ake kira Berliner, Pfannkuchen ko Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: Idan kuna son abinci mai ɗan girma amma mai kyau, ku yi amfani da abinci da ake kira Berliner, Pfannkuchen ko Krapfen, waɗanda sun bambanta sunaye a kowace ƙasa.

translations.source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.reference: Curry abinci ne da ta samu asali daga ganyen itace da kayan kamshi, tare da nama ko kayan lambu.
translations.hypothesis: Kari ne wani abu da ake shirya ta amfani da kayan lambu da kayan abinci, kuma ana iya jefa nama ko naman dabba a ciki.

translations.source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.reference: Kori na iya kasancewa “busasshe” ko “mai ruwa” abinda ya danganta da yawan ruwan da ke jikinsa.
translations.hypothesis: Kayan abinci mai daɗi (curry) na iya zama "mai ƙarfi" ko "mai ruwa," dangane da adadin ruwan da yake ciki.

translations.source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.reference: A cikin yankuna masu nisa na Arewacin Indiya da Pakistan, ana amfani da madala a cikin curry; a Kudancin Indiya da wasu yankuna na gabar teku na yankin, ana amfani da madarar kwakwa sosai.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin yankin cikin ƙasar da ke arewa da Indiya da Pakistan, ana amfani da nonon naman daji wajen shirya abinci; a kudu da Indiya da wasu wasu yankunan teku na wannan ƙasar, ana amfani da ruwan coconut.

translations.source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.reference: Tare da tsibirai 17,000 da za a zaɓa daga ciki, abincin Indonesiya laima ce da ke rufe yawancin nau'ikan abinci na yanki da aka samo a duk faɗin ƙasar.
translations.hypothesis: Tare da tsabar tsabar ƙananan tsibiri 17,000 da za'a zaɓa, abincin Indunesiya yana nufin juyin halitta da ke ruƙo da nau'o-nau'o da dama na abinci waɗanda ake samu a fadin ƙasar.

translations.source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.reference: Amma, idan aka yi amfani da shi ba tare da ƙarin ƙwarewar ba, kalmar tana nufin ma'anar abinci asali daga ɓangarorin tsakiya da gabashin babban tsibirin Java.
translations.hypothesis: Amma, idan an yi amfani da kalmar ba tare da ƙarin bayani ba, ta saba da nufin abinci da aka samo asali daga tsakiyar yankin da kuma gabas na babban tsibirin Java.

translations.source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.reference: Yanzu ana samu a faɗin rukunin tsibiran, jerin nau’ikan abincin yan Java, yawancin kayan kamshin da su ka fi sakawa shine na gyada, yaji da sukari (musamman sukarin kwakwa) da kuma wasu kayan kanshin.
translations.hypothesis: Yanzu haka, abincin Javanese yana samuwa sosai a duk fadin wannan ƙungiyar tsibirin. Abincin ya ƙunshi kayan abinci da suka yi amfani da kayan abinci masu sauƙi, kuma abubuwan da ake amfani da su mafi yawa a cikin abincin sun haɗa da man girke, peppers, sukari (musamman sukari na korama na Javanese) da kuma kayan abinci masu daɗi iri-iri.

translations.source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.reference: Likkafa tallafi ne ga ƙafafun mahayi waɗanda su ke rataye a kowane ɓangaren sirdi.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙungiyar da ake kiran "stirrups" wani nau'in tsarin da ake amfani da shi don tallafawa ƙafafun mai amfani da kaya, kuma suna kasancewa a gefen baya na kujerar kaya.

translations.source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.reference: Su na ba da daidaito ga matuki sai dai akwai damuwa dangane hadarin kafar matukin na iya makalewa a jiki.
translations.hypothesis: Suna ba mai suna wuya mai ƙarfi, amma suna iya zama abin damuwa dangane da tsaro saboda yiwuwar ƙafafun mai suna su iya tsayayya a ciki.

translations.source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.reference: Idan mai hawan doki ya faɗi daga kan doki amma ƙafarsa tana jikin matakalar, za a iya jan su idan dokin ya gudu. Domin rage wanna hatsarin, za a iya ɗaukan matakan kariya da dama.
translations.hypothesis: Idan mai suna ya fita daga kan tulu da ƙafarsa na cikin wani abu da ake kiran "stirrup," zai iya jefa shi idan tulu ta tsere. Don rage wannan haɗarin, za'a iya ɗaukar wasu matakan tsaro.

translations.source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.reference: Da farko, yawancin mahaya suna sanye da takalman hawa masu diddige da kuma ƙasan takalmi mai santsi, matsattse.
translations.hypothesis: Na farko, mafi yawan masu suna taya suna sawa takalman da ke da ƙarfi a ƙasan su, kuma ƙasan takalman su yana da laushi kuma yana da ƙaramin fuka-fuki.

translations.source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.reference: Na gaba, wasu siddi, mussamman siddin Ingila, na dauke da kariya dake barin fata ya fita daga siddin yayin da mai hawa ya janyo shi baya gabanin fadowa.
translations.hypothesis: Sannan, wasu nau'in kujeru, musamman kujerun Ingilishi, suna da sassan tsaro waɗanda ke ba da izinin faduwar fata ta ƙafa (stirrup leather) daga kan kujerar idan mai ambarsa ya fadi kuma ya ja ta baya.

translations.source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.reference: Kwarin Cochamó - shine wajen hawan dutse mafi fice da ake zuwa wanda aka sani da Yosemite na Kudancin Amurka, wanda ke da manyan katangu na dutse daban-daban da matakaloli na dutse masu tsawo.
translations.hypothesis: Cochamó Valley - wani wuri mai kyau a kasar Chile, wanda ake kiranta "Yosemite" na Kudancin Amurka, kuma yana da manyan duwainiya da ragowaye na dutsen granite.

translations.source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.reference: Taron na hada da raayi na jamaa da sama. Mutane daga sassa daban-daban na duniya sun ci gaba da samar da sababin hanyoyi tsakanin yawancin albarkun mara karewar ganuwan.
translations.hypothesis: Duk wani babban dutse yana da kyawawan hangover da ake samu daga sama. Masu zagayawar dangi daga ko'ina cikin duniya suna ci gaba da samar da sababbin hanyoyi a cikin wannan wurin, wanda ya ƙunshi dama mara ƙarshe.

translations.source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.reference: Wasannin dusar kankara na gangaren tudu, wanda ya kunshi gudun ƙanƙara da allon zarmiya, sanannun wasanni ne da suka hada da surmiyowa ta kan yankin da dusar ƙanƙara ta rufe da takalman gudun ƙanƙara ko allon zarmiya a ɗaure da kafafunka.
translations.hypothesis: Wasanni da ake yi a kan kwan, waɗanda suka haɗa da skiing da snowboarding, su ne wasanni da suka samu masaniya, inda ake tsallewa a kan ƙasa mai ƙanƙon kwan ta amfani da skis ko snowboarding da ake saka a ƙafafun mutum.

translations.source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.reference: Wasa kan dusar kankara wasa ne na masu tafiye-tafiye da masun goyon baya da yawa, a wasu lokatai an san shi da “ski bums,” suna tsara dukkan hutu ga wasa kan dusan kankara a wani wuri na musamman.
translations.hypothesis: Tafiya da skis wata hanya ce ta yawon bude ido wacce mutane da yawa suka yi amfani da ita, kuma wasu daga cikinsu, wanda ake kiranta da "masu tafiya da skis," suna shirye-shiryen tafiye-tafiye dindin suna zuwa wurare daban-daban domin su yi tafiya da skis.

translations.source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.reference: Wasan dusar kankara ya dade da farawa -- an samu zanen kogo mai nuna masu wasan tun shakarar 5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: Fikrin tserewa (skiing) yana da tsayin dangi sosai - akwai hotunan da aka nuna a cikin kwalaye waɗanda suka nuna mutane suna tserewa, kuma waɗannan hotunan sun kai shekaru 5000 zuwa baya!

translations.source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.reference: Tseren kankara na tsauni an fara shi tun wajajen karni na 17 kuma a shekarar 1861 aka fara gina kulob din masu wannan tsere wanda yan kasar Norway su ka kafa a kasar Australiya.
translations.hypothesis: Wasanni na tsallewa a ƙasa sun fara ne tun shekarar 1700, kuma a shekarar 1861, mutanen Norway sun buɗe wani kulob din wasanni na tsallewa a ƙasa a Australiya.

translations.source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.reference: Daukar jaka a baya don ski: Ana kiran wannan shirin backcountry ski, yawon wasan dusar kankara ko tafiyan wasan dusar kankara.
translations.hypothesis: Tafiya da skis a cikin tsaunin: Wannan ayyuka kuma ana kiran ta "skiing a cikin tsauni," "ski touring," ko "ski hiking."

translations.source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.reference: Yana da alaƙa da amma yawanci ba sa ƙunshi salon tsalle-tsalle ko hawa dutse, na ƙarshen waɗanda aka yi a cikin ƙasa mai tsayi kuma suna buƙatar madaukakan skis da takalma.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan nau'in wasanni yana da alaka da wasu wasanni, amma yawanci ba su da alaka da tafiya da ski a tsaunuka ko kuma hawan baki, wanda na karshe yana faruwa a wurare masu tsanani kuma yana buƙatar ski da takalman da suka fi ƙarfi.

translations.source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.reference: Yi la’akari da hanyar wasan dussar kankara tamkar hanyar tafiya.
translations.hypothesis: Duba hanyar skiing kamar yadda kake duba hanyar tafiya.

translations.source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.reference: A cikin yanayi mai kyau zaku iya yin tafiya mai nisa fiye da takawa da ƙafa – amma ba kasafai ake samun saurin gudu kan kankara ba tare da jakar goyawa a baya mai nauyi a kan hanyar da aka share ƙanƙara.
translations.hypothesis: Idan yanayi ya yi kyau, za ku iya tafiya fiye da yadda za ku iya yi da tafiya a ƙafa – amma kawai sau da sau ne za ku iya samun sauri kamar yadda ake samu a wasan ski, kuma wannan zai faru kawai idan ba ku da jaka mai nauyi a hanyoyi da aka gyara.

translations.source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.reference: Turai nahiya ce karama amma cike da kasashe masu yancin kansu. A tsari ana iya cewa yin tafiye-tafiye tsakanin kasashen na nufin sai ka nemi takardun izinin shiga da ratsa wuraren binciken takardun tafiya.
translations.hypothesis: Turai wani nahiyar ne da kadan girma, amma da ƙasashe da yawa masu 'yancin kai. A yanayi na gabaɗaya, tafiya zuwa kasashe da yawa na iya nufin buƙatar shiga hanyoyin visa da kuma binciken fasfori sau da yawa.

translations.source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.reference: Yankin Schengen, duk da haka, yana aiki kamar ƙasa ɗaya ta wannan.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan yanki na Schengen, duk da haka, a wani ma'aunin, yana aiki kamar wata ƙasa ɗaya a wannan batun.

translations.source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.reference: Muddin ka tsaya a wannan yankin, gabaɗaya zaka iya ƙetare iyakoki ba tare da wucewa cikin wuraren kula da fasfon ba.
translations.hypothesis: Yayin da kake cikin wannan yanki, galibi za ka iya wucewa iyakokin ba tare da sake wucewa ta hanyar tsarin bincike na fasfori ba.

translations.source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.reference: Hakanan, samun izinin shiga kasashen Schengen, ya sa baka bukatar samun izinin daidaikun kasashe da ke cikin jerin kasashen, hakan na rage asarar lokaci, kudi da cike ciken takardu.
translations.hypothesis: Kamar yadda aka ambata, idan kana da visa na Schengen, ba ka buƙatar neman visas zuwa kowace ƙasa mai memba a cikin kungiyar Schengen ta ɗaya ba, wanda hakan ya rage lokaci, kuɗi, da kuma takardun da ake buƙata.

translations.source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.reference: Babu wani ma'anar duniya wanda kayan masana'antu sune kayan tarihi. Wasu hukumomin haraji sun ayyana kayan da suka girmi shekaru 100 a matsayin kayan tarihi.
translations.hypothesis: Babu takamaiman ma'ana da ake amfani da ita wajen bayyana abubuwan da aka samar da su waɗanda ake kira antiques. Wasu hukumomin haraji suna bayyana abubuwa da suka wuce shekaru 100 a duniya a matsayin antiques.

translations.source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.reference: Ma’anar na da banbancin yanki, inda iyakar shekaru ke iya kasancewa kaɗan a wurare kamar Amurika ta Arewa fiye da ƙsashen Turai.
translations.hypothesis: Anan ma akwai bambance-bambance a yankuna daban-daban, inda iyakar shekaru ta iya zama ƙasa a wasu wurare kamar Arewacin Amurka fiye da Turai.

translations.source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.reference: Za'a iya ma'anar kayayyakin aikin hannu azaman tsoffin kayayyakin tarihi, dukda cewa sunfi saurayi irin kayan da aka girka.
translations.hypothesis: Kayayyakin hannu na iya zama abubuwa masu daraja, ko da yake su fi ƙanƙantar da kayayyakin da aka samar da yawa.

translations.source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.reference: Kiwon dabbar Reindeer wani gata mai muhimmanci ne tsakanin ƴan Sámi kuma al'adar a kewayar sana'ar tana da muhimmanci kuma wajen yawanci da suke da wasu sana'o'i.
translations.hypothesis: Kulawar dabbobin reindeer wani muhimmin matsayi ne a rayuwar mutanen Sámi, kuma al'adun da ke cikin wannan kasuwancin yana da muhimmanci ga mutane da yawa masu ayyukan ne dai-dai.

translations.source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.reference: Ko a al'adance, duk da cewa, ba duk dan Sami bane suka tsunduma cikin harkar kiwo mai yawa, amma sun rayu ne daga kamun kifi, farauta da makamantansu, wadanda suke da dabbobin doki akasarinsu dabbobi.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da a baya, ba dukkanin mutanen Sámi suka shiga cikin kiwon dabbobin kare mai girma ba, amma sun dogara ne akan kasuwanci kamar ruwa, sa kai, da sauran ayyuka, yayin da suke amfani da dabbobin kare a matsayin dabbobin tuki.

translations.source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.reference: A yau yawancin Sámi suna yin sana'o'in zamani. Yawon buda ido muhimmin kudin shiga ne a cikin Sámi, yankin na Sámi.
translations.hypothesis: Yau, mutane da dama na al'adun Sámi suna aikata a sana'o'i na zamani. Tourism wani muhimmin tushen kudin ne a yankin Sápmi, wanda yake da al'adun Sámi.

translations.source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.reference: Kodayake ana amfani da shi ko'ina, musamman tsakanin waɗanda ba Romani ba, kalmar “Gypsy” galibi ana ɗaukarta abin ƙyama ne saboda ƙungiyoyinta da ra'ayoyi marasa kyau da ra'ayoyi marasa kyau game da mutanen Romani.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake an yi amfani da kalmar "Gypsy" sosai, musamman a cikin mutanen da ba su yi zurfi a cikin al'adun Romani, alal kashe, ana ɗaukar kalmar ta hanyar da ta iya cutarwa saboda ma'auni da ta haɗa da abubuwa mara kyau da kuma fahimta mara daidaito game da mutanen Romani.

translations.source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.reference: Idan ƙasar da za ka ziyarta ta zama cikin wadanda sai an nemi shawarar masana, inshorar lafiyarka da ta ikon soke tafiya na iya shafuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Idan ƙasar da za ku ziyarci ta sami matsala da ta sa a yi gargadi game da tafiya zuwa, wannan na iya shafar kudin kula da lafiya da za ku biya yayin tafiya ko kuma kudin da za ku biya idan tafiyar ku ta ƙare.

translations.source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.reference: Akwai bukatar neman shawarwari daga wasu gwamnatocin ba gwamnatin ka kawai ba, amma dai shawarwarinsu an tsara su ne domin yan kasar su.
translations.hypothesis: Wanda kuma zai iya samun amfani da shawara daga gwamnatiyu daban, amma shawarin da suke bayarwa an shirya shi ne don 'yan kasarsu.

translations.source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.reference: A misali ɗaya, ‘yan ƙasar Amurka da ke Gabas ta Tsakiya su na iya fuskantar halaye daban daga Turawa ko Larabawa.
translations.hypothesis: A matsayin misali, 'yan kasar Amurka da suke a Gabas ta Tsakiya na iya fuskantar yanayi daban-daban fiye da Turawa ko Larabawa.

translations.source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.reference: Shawara kawai takaitaccen bayani ne game da yanayin siyasar wata kasa.
translations.hypothesis: Takardun bayani sun kasance kawai abubuwan da suka hada ga yanayin siyasa a wani ƙasa.

translations.source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.reference: Ra’ayoyin da aka gabatar galibi na gaggawa ne, na gaba daya kuma marar zurfin tunani idan aka kwatanta su da cikakken bayanin da ake samu a wani wuri.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙaƙƙauyen ra'ayoyi da ake bayarwa sau da yawa suna da ɗan ɗanɗali, masu taƙaitawa, kuma ana bayar da su ne ne kawai, idan aka kwatanta da bayanan da suka fi dacewa da suka kasance a wasu wurare.

translations.source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.reference: Mummunan yanayi kalma ce ga duk wani yanayi mai hatsari tare da yiwuwar haifar da lalacewa, rikicewar zamantakewar jama'a, ko asarar rayuwar ɗan adam.
translations.hypothesis: Matsalolin yanayi masu tsanani su ne maƙasoshi da suka ƙunshi duk wani ɓarna a yanayi wanda zai iya haifar da lalata, tabarbarewar al'umma, ko kuma rasa rayukan mutane.

translations.source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Yanayi mai tsanani na iya aukuwa a ko wani bangare na duniya kuma sun bambanta, kuma sun dogara ne ga yanayin kasa da taswirar kasa da kuma ka’idojin iskar shaka.
translations.hypothesis: Abubuwan iska masu tsanani na iya faruwa a ko'ina cikin duniya, kuma akwai nau'o'i daban-daban na su, waɗanda za su iya dogara ne akan yanayin ƙasa, tsarin ƙasa, da yanayin iska.

translations.source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.reference: Babban iska, ƙanƙara, hazo mai yawa, da gobarar daji siffofi ne da tasirin mummunan yanayi, haka ma hadari, guguwa, kogin ruwa, da mahaukaciyar guguwa.
translations.hypothesis: Iska mai ƙarfi, ƙanƙara, zub da ruwa sosai, da wutar da ta kunna ta kansu, sune wasu nau'o'in abubuwan da suka faru a lokacin yanayi mai tsanani, kamar yadda ake samu a lokacin ruwan sama, girgizar iska, ruwan sama da ya fito a kan ruwa, da kuma tsutsotsi.

translations.source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.reference: Aukuwar tsananin yanayin yanki da na lokacin sun hada da guguwar iska, hadari mai dusar kankara, guguwar kankara, da guguwar ƙura.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu abubuwan da suka shafi yanayi masu tsanani waɗanda suka faru a wasu yankuna da kuma lokuta na shekara sun haɗa da: tsananin sanyi, ruwan ƙanƙara, ruwan lulu, da kuma tsananin ruwan kasa.

translations.source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.reference: Ana matuƙar shawartar matafiya da su kasance masu lura da duk wani haɗarin mummunan yanayi wanda zai shafi yankin su domin za su iya shafar duk wani shirin tafiya.
translations.hypothesis: Ana bada shawara ga masu tafiya su yi taka-tsantsan da kowane nau'in mummunan yanayi da zai iya tasiri a yunkurin su, domin hakan na iya shafar duk wani shiri da suka yi na tafiya.

translations.source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.reference: Duk wanda ke shirin ziyara zuwa wata ƙasa da za a iya kallonta a zaman fagen yaƙi dole ya samu horon ƙwararru.
translations.hypothesis: Kowa da yake shirin zuwa wata ƙasa da za a iya ɗaukarta wani yanki na rikici, ya kamata ya sami horo na ƙwararru.

translations.source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.reference: Binciken yanar gizo don ‘yanayin muhalli mai tsanani’ yana iya fitar adireshin wani kamfanin gargajiya.
translations.hypothesis: Wanda zai yi bincike a intanet don kalmar "kursin tsaye-tsayen yanayi," zai iya samun adireshi na wata kamfani da ke kusa.

translations.source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.reference: Hanya koyaushe za ta rufe dukkan batutuwan da aka tattauna a nan cikin mafi cikakken bayani, yawanci tare da ƙwarewar aiki.
translations.hypothesis: Wani darasi na yawan lokuta zai yi bayanin dukkan abubuwan da aka yi magana a nan, kuma da cikakken bayani, galibi tare da wasu ayyukan da za su taimaka wajen fahimtar su.

translations.source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.reference: Wani kwas wanda za a yi cikin kwana 2-5 wanda zai shafi aikin da ya kunshi horarwa kan agajin gaggawa da kuma a wasu lokutan har da horarwa na makamai.
translations.hypothesis: Wani kwana-kwana na koyarwa yawanci yana farawa ne daga tsakanin kwanaki 2 zuwa 5, kuma zai haɗa da wasanni, horon ilahirin gaggawa, kuma wasu lokuta horon amfani da makamai.

translations.source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.reference: Littattafai da mujallu masu ma'amala da rayuwar jeji sanannu ne, amma wallafe-wallafen da ke magana game da yankunan yaƙi ba su da yawa.
translations.hypothesis: Littattafai da mujallu da suka yi magana game da yadda ake rayuwa a wurare masu wahala sun yi yawa, amma littattafai da mujallu da suka yi magana game da yankin yakin basasa suna da ɗan adadi.

translations.source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.reference: dole sai matafiya masu kokarin yin tiyatar canza jinsi sun tabbatar suna dauke da ingantattun takardun tafiyar komawa gida.
translations.hypothesis: Wanda ke shirin yin aikin canzawa jinsin su a waje, dole su tabbata sun da takardun da suka dace don dawowar su.

translations.source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.reference: Kaunar gwamnatoci don bayar da fasfo ɗin da jinsi ba a bayyana ba (X) ko takaddun da aka sabunta don daidaita sunan da ake so kuma jinsi ya bambanta.
translations.hypothesis: Yin amfani da takardun izinin tafiya (pasporti) da ba su bayyana jinsi (ta amfani da alama 'X') ko kuma sabunta takardun domin suyi da sunan da ake so da kuma jinsin da ake so, ya bambanta daga wata kasa zuwa wata.

translations.source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.reference: Kasancewar yardar gwamnatocin kasashen waje don girmama waɗannan takardu yana da saurin canzawa.
translations.hypothesis: Yin amfani da takardunsu na hukumta da hukumomin kasashe na waje ya kasance da bambanci, kuma wannan bambanci yana yaduwa sosai.

translations.source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.reference: Bincike a wuraren bincike na jami’an tsaro su ma sun zama da karin shishigi bayan zamanin Satumba 11, 2001.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan lokacin, bayan watan Satumba na shekarar 2001, binciken da ake yi a wuraren tsaro ya zama mai tsanani sosai.

translations.source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.reference: kada mutanen da suka sauya jinsinsu su yi tsammanin za su iya wuce wa ta gaban na’urorin haska hoton jiki ba tare da fallasar sirri da mutuncinsu ba.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen da suka yi juyin jinsi kuma suna jiran a yi masu aikin tiyata, ba su da tabbacin cewa za su iya wucewa ta na'urori masu bincike ba tare da lalata sirrin su da kuma mutunci ba.

translations.source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.reference: Igiyar ruwa mai yagawa su ne ruwa ne mai dawowa daga raƙuman ruwa da ke fasa rairayin bakin teku.
translations.hypothesis: "Magunguna masu saurin tafiya (rip currents) su ne hanyoyin da ruwan teku yake dawo da su bayan ya ramu a bakin teku, wanda sau da yawa yake faruwa a wajen ragamar ruwa ko wani wuri mai kama da haka."

translations.source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.reference: Saboda yanayin karkashin ruwa da ke sa gudana da mai da hankali a wurare masu zurfi, sannan igiyar ruwa mafi zurfi na iya haduwa a wurin.
translations.hypothesis: Saboda halin da ake samu a cikin ruwan, tafiyar ruwan da ke komawa ta tara a wasu sassa kaɗan waɗanda suke da zurfi, kuma wataƙila za ta haifar da tafiya mai sauri zuwa cikin ruwan da ke zurfi a wannan yanki.

translations.source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.reference: Yawancin mace-mace suna faruwa ne sakamakon gajiya da ke ƙoƙari ya koma baya kan na yanzu, wanda ƙila ba zai yiwu ba.
translations.hypothesis: Karin yawan mutuwar da ake samu na faruwa saboda gajiya yayin da ake ƙoƙarin faduwa cikin ruwa da ke motsawa, wanda hakan zai iya zama abu mai wuya.

translations.source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.reference: Da zarar ka fita daga ruwan, sake komawa ruwan ba zai zo da wata sarkakiya ba.
