translations.reference: Yi ƙoƙarin auna wani wuri inda ba za a sake samun ka ba ko kuma, ya danganta da ƙwarewarka da kuma cewa ko an gan ka, watakila za ka so jiran ceto.
translations.hypothesis: Kokuma, ƙoƙaya ku su kasance a wuri da ba za a sake kama ku ba, ko kuma, dangane da ƙwarewar ku da ko an lura da ku, zai yiwu ku jira a ceto ku.

translations.source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.reference: Kaɗuwar sake-shiga za ta yi saurin zuwa kafin kaɗuwar al’adu (akwai karancin lokaci na hutun amarci), ya dade, kuma izai ya zama da tsanani sosai.
translations.hypothesis: Matsalar da ake ji bayan dawowar gida daga waje ta iya faruwa da sauri fiye da matsalolin da ake ji lokacin da ake koyon al'adu na waje (kamar yadda akwai ƙarancin lokaci na jin daɗi), tana daɗa fiye, kuma za ta iya zama mai tsanani.

translations.source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.reference: Matafiya waɗanda ke da sauƙin sauƙaƙawa zuwa sabon al'adun a wasu lokuta suna da matukar wahalar gyara al'adunsu na asali.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen da suka yi sauƙi wajen samun al'ada da sabon al'umma, wasu lokuta suna fuskantar wani wahala sosai wajen komawa zuwa al'umman su na asali.

translations.source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.reference: Lokacin dawowa gida bayan zama a ƙasashen waje, kun saba da sabon al'adun kuma kun rasa wasu al'adunku daga al'adunku na gida.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da kake komawa gida bayan zama a waje, kana da al'adu na sabu, kuma wasu daga cikin al'adu da kayi a gida sun canza.

translations.source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.reference: Kasancewa a kasar waje a karo na farko, na sa matafiya yin hakuri da nuna fahimta, saboda sanin cewa matafiya na bukatar hakan domin su saba da wajen.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da ka tafi waje a farko, mutane sun fiye da yiwuwa sun nuna haƙuri da fahimta, suna sane da cewa waɗanda suke tafiya zuwa wani ƙasa suna buƙatar daidaita kansu.

translations.source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.reference: Ba lallai Mutane su fahimci cewa yin haƙuri da nuna fahimta wajibi ne ga matafiya da ke kokarin komawa gida.
translations.hypothesis: Wani lokaci, mutane suna iya rasa fahimtar cewa sabar da fahimta su ma su ne buƙata ga waɗanda suka koma gida bayan tafiya.

translations.source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.reference: Sautin dala da wasan haske na daya daga cikin abubuwa masu dadi a fanni kananan yara.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu daga cikin abubuwan da suka fi jan hankalin yara a wannan yanki shine nuni da sauti da haske da ake yi a wurin pyramid.

translations.source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.reference: Za ka iya ganin dalar a cikin duhu kuma za ka iya ganin su a tsanake kafin shirin ya fara.
translations.hypothesis: Za ku iya ganin pyramids a cikin duhu, kuma za ku iya ganinsu a cikin nutsuwa kafin nuni ya fara.

translations.source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.reference: Yawanci kodayaushe ka kan ji sautin ‘yan yawon shakatawa da masu talla. Labarin sauti da hasken to kawai kamar littafin labari ne.
translations.hypothesis: Yawanci, kullum kana ji da sauti na masu zuwa don neman abubuwa da kuma masu sayar da kayayyaki. Labarin sauti da haske yana kama da labarin littafi.

translations.source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.reference: An yi amfani da sassaken zaki na Egypt a matsayin jigo wajen bada dogon labari.
translations.hypothesis: Togogin Sphinx yana nan a baya, kuma yana daurawa a matsayin wanda ke bayyana labarin mai tsawo.

translations.source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.reference: Ana nuna wuraren akan dalar kuma an haskaka dalolin mabambanta.
translations.hypothesis: Hotunan sun nuna a kan pyramids, kuma kowane pyramid yana haske.

translations.source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.reference: Tsibirin Kudancin Shetland, wanda aka gano a cikin 1819, kasashe da yawa suna da'awar su kuma suna da mafi yawan tushe, tare da goma sha shida suna aiki a 2020.
translations.hypothesis: Tsibirin Kudancin Shetland, da aka gano a shekarar 1819, ana da'awar su ne ta wasu ƙasashe, kuma suna da mafi yawan wurare, inda akwai girmama goma sha shida a shekarar 2020.

translations.source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: Tsibirin na kwanciye 120 km arewa da sashin kasa mai shiga teku. Mafi girma shine King George Island mai dauke da mazauna na Villa Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ƙungiyar tsire-tsire ta kasance kilomita 120 arewa da peninsula. Mafi girma a cikin su shi ne tsibirin King George, wanda yake da birnin Villa Las Estrellas.

translations.source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.reference: Sauran sun hada da Livingston Island, da Yaudarar Inda ambaliyar caldera na har dutsen mai fitad da wuta yana ba da tashar jiragen ruwa na halitta.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu wurare kuma sun haɗa da tsibirin Livingston da Deception, inda wani ƙaramin tafkin da ya cika fadan wani volkan da har yanzu yana da aiki, ke samar da wani babban wurin shiga da fita na halita.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land shine yanki na kudu da masarautar, da Tekun Bellingshausen ya daure.
translations.hypothesis: Ellsworth Land wani yanki ne da ke arewa maso gabas na ƙaramin ƙasa, kuma ana iyakanta da Tekun Bellingshausen.

translations.source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.reference: Tsaunukan da ke nan wurin a Tsibirin sun haɗe da yankin mai tudu, sannan suka sake bulla a gaba inda suka haifar da jerin carbin Tsaunukan Elsworth na tsawon kilomita 360, wanda dunkulen Ƙanƙarar Minnesota ya ratsa ta tsakiyarsu.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da haka, tsaunukan da ke cikin wannan yanki sun haɗu da tsaunin da ke sama, sannan su sake bayyana don su samar da tsarin tsaunukan Ellsworth, wanda yake da tsayin kilomita 360, kuma an raba shi da tsaunin Minnesota.

translations.source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: Yankin arewacin ko Sentinel Range yana da tsaunukan tsaunuka mafi girma na Antarctica, Vinson Massif, wanda yake hawa sama a tsaunin 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: Wurin da ake kira Arewa ko kuma Sentinel Range na da mafi tsananin duwainiya a Antarctica, wato Vinson Massif, wanda yake da tsayin mita 4892, wanda ake kira Mount Vinson.

translations.source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.reference: A wurare masu nisa, idan babu sabis na wayar salula, wayar tauraron dan adam na iya zama zaɓin ku kaɗai.
translations.hypothesis: A wasu wurare masu nisa, inda babu hanyoyin sadarwa ta wayar salula, wayar ta satelite na iya zama hanyar sadarwa ɗaya da za ku iya amfani da ita.

translations.source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.reference: Wayar tauraron dan adam a gaba daya ba za ta maye gurbin wayar hannu ba, domin sai kun kasance a waje tare da yin saiti da tauraron dan adam don yin kiran da wayar.
translations.hypothesis: Wayarsa ta satelite ba ta kasance maye gurbin wayar salula ba, domin dole ne ka kasance a waje kuma ka sami hangen nesa mai kyau zuwa sateliten don ka iya yin kiran waya.

translations.source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.reference: Ana amfani sosai da aikin a harkokin sufurin ruwa, wanda ya hada da jiragen shakatawa da masu bincike da ke bukatar sadarwa a lungu ko bukatar muryoyi.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan sabis yana da amfani sosai ga kamfanonin jigilar kaya, gami da jiragen ruwa da ake amfani da su don nishaɗi, da kuma kungiyoyin da suke yin tafiye-tafe waɗanda suke buƙatar sadarwa da kuma jigilar bayanai a wurare masu nisa.

translations.source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.reference: Yakamata kamfanin wayar tarho na yankin ku ya kasance zai iya bada ƙarin bayani game da yin haɗi da wannan sabis ɗin.
translations.hypothesis: Kamfanin wayar da ke hidima a yankinku na iya ba ku bayanin ƙarin game da yadda za ku haɗu da wannan sabis ɗin.

translations.source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.reference: Wani zaɓi da ya ke kara samun karbuwa ga waɗanda ke shirin ratar-shekara shine yin tafiya don sani.
translations.hypothesis: Wata hanya da ke samun masaniya sosai ga waɗanda suke shirin wakar shekara ce ita ce tafiya da koyo.

translations.source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.reference: Wannan ya shahara musamman ga masu tsallake-tsallake a makaranta, suna basu damar ɗaukar shekara guda kafin jami'a, ba tare da lalata karatunsu ba.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan abu yana da muhimmanci sosai ga masu fita daga makaranta, domin yana ba su damar samun shekara ɗaya kafin shiga jami'a, ba tare da lalata ilimin su ba.

translations.source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.reference: A lokuta da dama shiga/fara kwas na ratan shekara guda a ketare zai iya inganta damammakinka na kara nosawa gaba a karatu idan ka dawo kasar haihuwarka.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin alamomin da dama, shiga wani kwale-kwalen koyo a waje na iya inganta yiwuwar samun shiga makarantu na matakin digiri a cikin ƙasar ku.

translations.source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.reference: Yawanci za a sami kuɗin karatun shiga don shiga cikin waɗannan shirye-shiryen ilimin.
translations.hypothesis: Yawanci, akwai kuɗi da ake biya don shiga waɗannan shirye-shiryen ilimi.

translations.source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.reference: Finland babban wurin zuwan kwalekwale ne. “Ƙasa mai tafkuna dubu” tana kuma da dubban tsibirai, a cikin tafkuna da kuma cikin rukunin tsibirai.
translations.hypothesis: Finland wani wuri ne mai kyau don tafiya da jiragen ruwa. "Kasar dubban tafkuna" tana da dubban tsire-tsire a cikin tafkuna da kuma a cikin yankin teku.

translations.source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.reference: A yankunan masu tsibirai barjak da tafkuna ba lallaia bukaci kanana jiragen ruwaba.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin ƙungiyoyin tsire-tsire da tafkuna, ba lami ce a yi amfani da jirgin ruwa na sarari.

translations.source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.reference: Kodayake tarin tsibirai na bakin teku da manyan tabkuna suna da girman isa ga kowane jirgin ruwa, ƙananan jiragen ruwa ko ma kayak suna ba da kwarewa daban.
translations.hypothesis: Ko da yake manyan tsibirin da ke bakin teku da manyan tafkuna suna da girma sosai don dukkan nau'in jiragen ruwa, amma ƙananan jiragen ruwa ko ma kayaks suna ba da wata hanyar jin daɗi.

translations.source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.reference: Jirgin ruwa jirgi ne na kasar Finland, tare da kwale-kwale ga kowane mutum bakwai ko takwas.
translations.hypothesis: Zaiwa da jirgin ruwa wani abu ne da yawancin mutanen Finland suka fi so, kuma akwai jirgin ruwa a kowace gida ko biyu ko uku.

translations.source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.reference: Wannan ya dace da Norway, Sweden da New Zealand, amma in ba haka ba ya zama na musamman (misali a cikin Netherlands adadi ɗaya ne zuwa arba'in).
translations.hypothesis: Wannan adadi yana da ma'ana a kasashe kamar Norway, Sweden, da New Zealand, amma a sauran kasashe, yana da bambanci sosai (misali, a Netherlands, adadin yana da yawa, wato daya zuwa dari).

translations.source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Yawancin sanannun Baltic Cruises sun ƙunshi karin tsawan zama a St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Kusan dukkanin tafiye-tafiye na ruwa da ake yi a yankin Baltic sun haɗa da tsawon lokaci da ake kashe a birnin St. Petersburg, da ke kasar Rasha.

translations.source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.reference: Wannan na nuna cewa kana iya ziyartar birni mai tarihi na kwanaki da dama yayin da ake dawowa ko yin bacci a cikin jirgin ruwan da dare.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan yana nufin za ku iya ziyartar birnin tarihi na tsawon kwana biyu, sai ku koma jirgin da kuma ku kwana a ciki da dare.

translations.source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.reference: Idan ka hau ruwa ta amfani da yawon bude ido a jirgin ruwa ba za ka buƙaci biza ta daban ba (kamar daga 2009).
translations.hypothesis: Idan kun yi tafiya zuwa filin wajen jirgin hanya, ba za ku buƙaci visa daban ba (tun daga shekarar 2009).

translations.source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.reference: Wasu jiragen ruwa su kan sanya Berlin, Jamus a cikin littafin bayanin. Kamar yadda ka ke gani daga taswirar da ke sama babu inda Berlin ta yi kusa da teku kuma ba a haɗa ziyarar birnin ba a farashin jirgi.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu tafiye-tafiye na ruwa suna nuni da birnin Berlin, na Jamus, a cikin takardun talla. Kamar yadda kake gani daga hoton da ke sama, Berlin ba ta kusa da teku, kuma ziyartar birnin ba ta cikin farashin tafiya.

translations.source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.reference: Tafiya ta hanyar jirgin sama kan iya zama abu mai firgitarwa ga mutane a duk rukunin shekaru da asali, musamman idan ba su taɓa hawa jirgi ba ko kuma sun taɓa shiga al’amari mai firgitarwa.
translations.hypothesis: Yin tafiya da jirgin sama na iya zama abin tsoro ga mutane na duk shekaru da fage, musamman idan ba su taba yin tafiya da jirgin sama ba ko kuma sun sha wani lamari mai wahala.

translations.source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.reference: Ba abun jin kunya bane: bata sha bambam da tsoro da kuma rashin kaunar abubuwan da yawancin mutane ke dashi.
translations.hypothesis: Ba wani abu ne da za a ji kaunarsa: ba shi ne bambanci da wasu abubuwan da wasu mutane suke tsoro ko kuma suke ƙin su, waɗanda mutane da yawa suke fuskanta.

translations.source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.reference: Ga wasu, fahimtar yadda jirgi yake aiki da kuma ko mene ne ke faruwa yayin da jirgin yake tafiya watakila ya taimaka wajen shawo kan fargabar da tushenta ba a ma san shi ba ko kuma ma ba a iya shawo kansa.
translations.hypothesis: Ga wasu mutane, fahimtar yadda jiragen sama suke aiki da kuma abin da ke faruwa a lokacin tashi da saukar jirgin, na iya taimakawa wajen shawo kan tsoro wanda ake samu saboda rashin fahimta ko kuma rashin kula da abubuwa.

translations.source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.reference: A na biyan kamfanonin aika saƙonni sosai don isar da abubuwa da sauri. Akai-akai, lokaci yana da matukar mahimmanci game da takardun kasuwanci, abin sayarwa ko kayan gyara don gyara na gaggawa.
translations.hypothesis: Kamfanonin isar da kaya suna samun kudin yawa saboda isar da kaya cikin sauri. Sau da yawa, lokaci yana da muhimmanci sosai, musamman idan yana dangantaka da takardun kasuwanci, kayayyaki ko sassa don gyara wani abu da gaggawa.

translations.source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.reference: A wasu hanyoyin, manyan kanfanonin na da jiragen samansu, amma a wasu hanyoyi daban da ƙananan kanfanoni akwai matsala.
translations.hypothesis: A wasu hanyoyin tafiya, manyan kamfanonin suna da jiragen su, amma ga wasu hanyoyi da kuma ƙananan kamfanoni, akwai wata matsala.

translations.source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.reference: Idan sun aika da kaya ta hanyar jigilar jirgin sama, akan wasu hanyoyi ya zama ya dauki kwanaki kafin a ya tsallake saukewa na ‘yan kwastam.
translations.hypothesis: Idan sun aika abubuwa ta hanyar jirgin sama, a wasu hanyoyi, yana iya ɗaukar tsawon kwana don su fitar da kaya da kuma kammala dabarar jami'an customs.

translations.source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.reference: Hanya kaɗai mafi saurin wucewarsu shine ta hanyar tura su a matsayin jakunkunan da aka duba. Tsarin dokokin kamfunan zirga-zirgar jiragen sama ba ya bada damar tura jaka ba tare da mai ita zai yi tafiya ba, to anan ne inda za ka shigo.
translations.hypothesis: Taurarin da za ku iya yi don saurin isa shi ne ku aika abin da kuke so a matsayin kaya a cikin jirgin. Dokokin kamfanin jirgin ba su ba da izinin aika kaya ba tare da wanda zai ɗauka ba, kuma shi ne yadda ku ke iya taimakawa.

translations.source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.reference: Sananniyar hanya ta tashi a ajin farko ko ajin kasuwanci na jirgin sama shine ka fito da damin kudi domin gata (ko, mafi kyau tukuna, ka sanya kamfaninka su yi maka).
translations.hypothesis: Hanya mafi sauƙi don yin tafiya a cikin ɗauke ko kuma ɗauke na musamman ita ce ku biya kuɗi mai yawa don samun wannan damar (ko, mafi kyau, ku nemi kamfanin ku ya biya ku don ku).

translations.source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.reference: Sai dai hakan ba ya samuwa cikin sauƙi: a matsayin ƙa’idar ana tsammanin ka biya ribi hudu na ajin marasa ƙarfi kuma ribi goma sha daya na ajin masu wadataa
translations.hypothesis: Koyawa, wannan ba zai iya zama wauta ba: kamar yadda ake ƙididdigar, za ku iya biya har zuwa sau huɗu na farashin da ake biya a yadda aka saba, don tikitin kasuwanci, kuma sau goma sha ɗaya don tikitin matakin farko!

translations.source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.reference: A gabaɗaya, babu ma'ana a cikin koda neman ragi don kasuwanci ko kujerun ajin farko a kan jiragen sama kai tsaye daga A zuwa B.
translations.hypothesis: Gabaɗaya, ba daɗewa ne ko ma neman raguwa akan farashin tikitin jirgin sama na kasuwanci ko na matakin farko akan jiragen da suka tashi kai tsaye daga wani wuri zuwa wani.

translations.source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.reference: Kamfanonin jiragen sama sun sani sarai cewa akwai wasu rukuni na rukuni na wasiƙa waɗanda suke shirye su biya dala mafi girma don alfarmar zuwa wani wuri cikin sauri da jin daɗi, kuma su biya hakan.
translations.hypothesis: Kamfanonin jiragen sama sun san sosai cewa akwai wasu mutane da suke son tafiya da sauri kuma cikin farin ciki, kuma suna da tabbacin cewa za su biya kudin da ake bukata don haka su ma su biya su kudin da ya dace.

translations.source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.reference: Babban birnin Moldova shi ne Chişinău. yaren cikin gida shi ne Romaniyanci, amma ana amfani da harshen Rasha sosai.
translations.hypothesis: Babban birnin Moldova shi ne Chişinău. Harshen da ake amfani da shi a wurin shine Romanian, amma harshen Rasha yana da yawan amfani.

translations.source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.reference: Maldova jamhuriya ce mai kabilu da dama da ta yi fama da rikicin kabilanci.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova wani jihar ne mai al'umma daban-daban wanda ya fuskanci rikici tsakanin al'umma.

translations.source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.reference: A shekarar 1994, wannan rikici ya haifar da kirkirar da kanta mai ikirarin Jamhuriyyar Transnistria a gabashin Moldova, wacce ke da gwamnatinta da kudin ta amma ba wata kungiyar mambobin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta amince da shi ba.
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1994, wannan rikicin ya haifar da kafa wata kasa mai suna Jamhuriyar Transnistria a gabas da Moldova, wacce ta da kanta kuma tana da gwamnati da kuɗi, amma ba wata ƙasa mai memba a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ba ta yarda da ita.

translations.source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.reference: An maido da harkar cinikayya tsakanin bangarori biyu na Maldova duk da rushewar tattaunawar siyasa.
translations.hypothesis: Al'adu da suka shafi tattalin arziki sun sake farfado tsakanin wannan bangare da wani na Moldova, duk da gazawar da ta faru a tattaunawar siyasa.

translations.source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.reference: Babban addini a Moldova shine Kiristocin aqidah.
translations.hypothesis: Babban addinin da ake yi a Moldova shi ne addinin Kiristanci na Orthodox.

translations.source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.reference: Izmir shi ne birni na uku mafi girma a Turkiyya da yawan jama’a kimanin miliyan 3.7, kuma tashar jiragen ruwa ta biyu mafi girma bayan ta Istanbul, kuma babbar cibiyar sufuri.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir babban birni ne a Turkiyya, kuma na uku a girma, da yawan jama'a kusan miliyan 3.7. Hakanan, shi ne babban tashar ruwa na biyu bayan Istanbul, kuma wani muhimmin guri ne na sadarwa.

translations.source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.reference: A da yana a matsayin tsohon birnin Smyrna, yanzu cibiyar hada-hadar kasuwanci ce ta zamani, da ta bnƙasa, da ta ke zagayen wani ƙaton mashigin ruwa sannan kuma yana zagaye da duwatsu.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan birnin, wanda a baya ake kiransa Smyrna, yanzu ya zama cibiyar kasuwanci mai zamani, ta ci gaba sosai, kuma tana da ayyuka da yawa. Ta shima a cikin babbar tafkin ruwa, kuma ta kewaye da duwailu.

translations.source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.reference: Manya-manyan tituna, gidajen gilashi da manyan kantunan siyayya an kawata su da jajayen rufi na gargajiya, kasuwa ta karni na 18, da wani tsohon masallaci da coci, koda yake dai garin ya fi kama da irin na turai da ke gabar bahar rum fiye da ace garin gargajiya ne a kasar Turkiya.
translations.hypothesis: Manyan tituna, gine-gine masu gilashi, da wuraren siyarwa na zamani suna da yawa, kuma a tsakaninsu akwai rufofi masu launin ruwan kasa na gargajiya, kasuwar da ta kasance tun shekarar 18, da kuma masajidai da kananan cococi. Duk da haka, birnin yana da yanayi mai kama da Turukan gabas (Mediterranean Europe) fiye da Turkiyya ta gargajiya.

translations.source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.reference: Kauyen Haldarsvík yana ba da damar kallon tsibirin Eysturoy da ke kusa kuma yana da wata cocin mai kusurwa takwas wadda ba saba ganin irin ta ba.
translations.hypothesis: Garinsu na Haldarsvík yana da kyau kuma ana iya ganin tsibirin Eysturoy da ke kusa, kuma yana da cocin wanda yake da fuka-fukai takwas, wanda yake da kyau sosai.

translations.source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.reference: A cikin farfajiyar majami'ar, akwai zane-zanen marmara mai ban sha'awa na kurciya akan wasu kaburburan.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin filin makabartun kanwa, akwai wasu zane-zanen marmara masu kyau na burungunan tsire-tsire a kan wasu makabbi.

translations.source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.reference: Shafe rabin sa’a na tattaki a cikin shu’umin ƙauyen ya biya.
translations.hypothesis: Yana da kyau a kasance a cikin wannan ƙauyen mai ban mamaki na tsawon minti uku, domin ganin abubuwa masu ban sha'awa.

translations.source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.reference: Ta gefen arewa mai saukin shiga nan ne Birnin Sintra ya ke wanda ya shahara ga yan kasashen waje bayan da Lord Byron ya bada kayatattun labaran kyawonta.
translations.hypothesis: A arewa, kuma kusa da wajen, akwai birnin Sintra mai ban mamaki da kuma wanda ya jawo hankalin mutane, kuma ya zama sananne a duniya bayan wani labarin yabo da Lord Byron ya rubuta game da kyawun sa.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 na yin tafiya sosai zuwa Sintra, tare da dakatawa a Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: Autobasar Scotturb mai lamba 403 yana tafiya akai-akai zuwa garin Sintra, kuma yana tsayawa a Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.reference: Hakanan zuwa arewa ziyarci babban Wuri Mai Tsarki na Uwargidanmu Fatima (Shrine), wuri ne na shahararrun bayyanar Marian a duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, zuwa arewa, ziyarci wurin ibadar "Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima," wanda yake daya daga cikin wuraren da ake yawan ziyartar domin tunawa da al'adar Marian.

translations.source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.reference: Da fatan za a tuna cewa da gaske ana ziyartar babban kabari ne, kazalika da shafin da ke da kusan ma'ana ga yawancin ɓangarorin duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Daƙi ku, ku tuna cewa kuna ziyartar wani wurin da ake saka gawurta, kuma wani wuri ne mai mahimmanci ga mafi yawan mutanen duniya.

translations.source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.reference: Har yanzu akwai maza da mata da yawa da ke raye waɗanda suka rayu lokacinsu a nan, kuma da yawa da yawa waɗanda suke da ƙaunatattunsu waɗanda aka kashe ko suka yi aiki zuwa can, yahudawa da waɗanda ba Yahudawa ba.
translations.hypothesis: Har yanzu akwai mutane da dama, maza da mata, waɗanda suka rayu a lokacin da aka aikata wannan mummunan lamari, kuma akwai wasu da yawa waɗanda iyalansu suka mutu ko kuma aka tilasta musu aiki har suka mutu a wurin, ba wai kawai masu addinin Yahudanci ba, har da sauran mutane.

translations.source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.reference: Da fatan za a kula da rukunin yanar gizon tare da dukkan mutunci, girmamawa da girmama shi. Kada ku yi ba'a game da fitinar Holocaust ko Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Da fatan za ku yi mutunta wannan wurin, kuma ku girmama shi yadda ya kamata. Kar ku yi wasan kwaikwayo ko maganganu masu ban haushi game da yakin kashe mutane (Holocaust) ko Nazis.

translations.source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.reference: Kada ku lalata wurin ginin ta hanyar sa alamar ko kuma nuna alamar rubutu a cikin ginin.
translations.hypothesis: Kar ku lalata wurin ta sanya alamar ko ƙara wasu rubuce-rubuce akan ginotta.

translations.source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.reference: Harsunan Barcelona na yau da kullun sune Catalan da Spanish. Kimanin rabin sun fi son yin magana da Catalan, yawancinsu sun fahimce shi, kuma kusan kowa ya san Sifen.
translations.hypothesis: Hukumar Barcelona ta yi amfani da harshen Catalan da harshen Spanish a matsayin harsunan jihar. Kusan rabin mutanen birnin sun fi so su yi magana da harshen Catalan, kuma yawancin mutane suna fahimtar wannan harshen, yayin da kusan dukkan mutane suna da ilimin harshen Spanish.

translations.source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.reference: Ko da yake, ana nuna galibin alamomin ana nuna su Katalanci sakamakon bisa doka shi ne yaren hukumana farko.
translations.hypothesis: Koyaya, mafi yawan alamomin ana rubuta su ne da harshen Catalan ne kawai, domin doka ta yi watsi da shi a matsayin harshen farko na hukumomi.

translations.source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.reference: Duk da haka, ana kuma amfani da harshen Spanish sosai a harkar sufuri na jama’a da wasu wurare.
translations.hypothesis: Koyawa, harshen Spaniya kuma yana da amfani sosai a cikin hanyoyin tafiya da sauran wurare.

translations.source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.reference: Ana yin sanarwar yau da gobe a jirgin ƙarƙashin ƙasa a Catalan kaɗai, amma na’urar da ke aiki da kanta ce ke sanar da hargitsin da babu shiri a harsuna iri-iri da suka haɗa da Sifaniyanci, Turanci, Faransanci, Larabci da harshen Japan.
translations.hypothesis: Sanarwa da ake yawan yi a cikin tashar Metro suna a cikin harshen Catalan ne kawai, amma lokacin da akacece abubuwa suka damu, wani tsarin atomatik ya fitar da sanarwa a cikin yawan harsuna, kamar su Spanish, Ingilishi, Faransa, Larabci, da kuma Jafani.

translations.source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.reference: Mutanen Paris sun yi suna kan son kai, rashin kunya da girman kai.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen Paris suna da suna na kasancewa masu son kai, masu rudewa, da masu girma.

translations.source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.reference: Yayin da yake wannan yawanci ra’ayi ne wanda ba daidai ba, hanya mafi kyau don yin sabo a cikin Paris har yanzu shine kasancewa kan halayyarka mafi kyau, yin aiki kamar wanda yake “bien élevé” (wanda ya sami tarbiyya mai kyau). Zai sanya yin sabo ya kasance mai sauki.
translations.hypothesis: Kodayake wannan yawanci yana kasancewa wani batu mara daɗi, mafi kyawun hanyar samun nasara a Paris ita ce ku yi ƙoƙarin zama masu kyau, kuma ku yi yadda mutumin da aka koya masa da kyau yake yi. Wannan zai sa yin ayyuka da tafiya ya zama da sauƙi.

translations.source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.reference: Fuskar mutanen Paris ta bazata za ta yi saurin ɓacewa idan ka nuna wasu halayen girmamawa.
translations.hypothesis: Idan kun nuna wani ƙa'ida da kuma mutunci, wani ɓangaren rashin jin daɗin da ake ji a cikin mutanen Paris zai ɓace cikin sauri.

translations.source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.reference: Tafkunan Plitvice na wajen shakatawa yana da wani surkukin daji, galibi da kamannin bishiyoyin fir da na kudan zuma da kuma hadin wanda ya shafi manyan tsaunuka da duwatsu tare da ciyaye na Rum.
translations.hypothesis: Wurin shakatawa na kasa na Plitvice yana da ƙananan tsire-tsire, galibi na itacen beech, spruce, da fir, kuma yana da saɓabbin nau'o'in tsire-tsire na ƙasar Alps da na yankin Meditareniya.

translations.source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.reference: Tana da sanannun dangogin itatuwa iri daban-daban, sabo da jerin yankunan yanayi da ta ke da su, da bayyana nau’ukan ƙasa daban-daban da kuma tuddai masu mataki daban-daban.
translations.hypothesis: Tana da nau'o-nau'o na tsire-tsire da dama, saboda bambance-bambancen yanayi, ƙaƙƙwalwar ƙasa, da kuma matakan tsayin ƙasa daban-daban.

translations.source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.reference: Rukunin muhalli na ga dabbobin daji mabambanta da kuma launukan tsuntsaye.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan yanki kuma yana da nau'o-nau'o na dabbobi da naman ja da dama sosai.

translations.source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.reference: Dabbobin daji da ba su da yawa irin su Malu mai launin ruwan kasa da ke turai, kerkeci, mikiya, mujiya, kyanwar daji da kuma capercaillie a na iya samun su a can, tare da nau’ukan gama garin dabbobi masu yawa.
translations.hypothesis: Wasu dabbobi masu ƙarfi irin su 'yan itaci masu launin ruwan kasa na Turai, dodo, ƙururuwa, ƙwankwaso, lynx, dabbobi masu ban tsoro, da kuma capercaillie, za su iya zama a wurin, sai dai akwai wasu dabbobi masu yawa waɗanda ake samansu a wurin.

translations.source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.reference: Yayin ziyartar gidajen sufaye, an buƙaci mata su sa riguna masu rufe gwiwowinsu kuma su rufe ƙafadunsu, kuma.
translations.hypothesis: Lokacin da ake ziyartar wurare masu tsarki, mata dole su saka riguna waɗanda suke rufe ƙwaƙwalwar su, kuma dole su rufe wuyaansu.

translations.source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.reference: Mafi yawancin gidajen ibada suna samar da mayafai ga matan da ba su zo da shiri ba, amma idan ki ka zo da naki, musamman wanda yake da launuka masu haske, za ki sami murmushi daga mai bauta namiji ko mace a ƙofar shiga.
translations.hypothesis: Karinin manyan wurare na addinin Buddha, yawanci suna samar da kayan rufe jiki ga mata waɗanda suka zo ba tare da kayan su ba, amma idan ku ka kawo kayan ku, musamman wadanda ke da launin haske, za ku sami murmushi daga wanda ke kula da shigar da mutane.

translations.source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.reference: A bisa wannan madogara, ana buƙatar maza su sanya wanduna da ke rufe gwiwoyi.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin irin wannan yanayin, ana buƙatar maza su saka riguna waɗanda suke rufe ƙwaƙwalwa.

translations.source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.reference: Wannan ma za a iya aro shi daga tarin kayan a mashigar amma ba a wanke tufa bayan kowane mutum guda ya yi amfani da tufar don haka ba za ka/ki ji dadin saka wannan bujen ba. Kala guda zai iyamma dukkanin maza.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan kuma za a iya samunsa a wurin da ake sayar da kayayyaki a shigarwa, amma wannan kayan sawa ba a wanke shi bayan kowane mai amfani, don haka yana yiwuwa ba za ku ji daɗi da sawa wannan farfajiyar. Kayan sawa ɗaya ne ga duk maza!

translations.source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.reference: Babban abincin, kamar na yankuna masu kama da wannan a cikin Bahar Rum, ya dogara ne akan burodi, kayan lambu da nama (musamman alade), kuma yana amfani da man zaitun ko'ina.
translations.hypothesis: Abincin yankin Mallorca, kamar abincin sauran yankuna masu kusa a yankin Bahar Rum, yana daidaita da burodi, kayan amfanin gonaki, da naman (musamman naman alaji), kuma ana amfani da man zaitun a kowane ɓangare.

translations.source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.reference: Abincin dare mai sauki musamman ma lokacin bazara, shi ne na Pa amb Oli: Burodi ne da man zaitun da tumatir da kuma duk wani kayan hadin da ya samu kamar cukwui da abincin kifi da dai sauransu.
translations.hypothesis: Abinci mai sauƙi da ake ci da yawa, musamman a lokacin bazara, shi ne "Pa amb Oli": wannan abincin ya ƙunshi buɗe, man zaitun, alkama, da sauran abubuwa kamar su daddun nan da sauran abinci da ake samu.

translations.source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.reference: Dukkan sunaye, wadanda ke da kalmar Sie a ciki, koda yaushe suna farawa ne da babban harafi, koda a tsakiyar jimla ne.
translations.hypothesis: Dukkan kalmomin suna da alama ta farko (babban haruffa), kamar yadda kalmar "Sie" (wacce ke nufin "ku") ta kasance, ko da a tsakiyar jimloli.

translations.source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.reference: Wannan mahimmiyar hanya ce wajen banbance kalmomin aikatau da kalmomi na abubuwa da ake iya gani.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan hanya ce mai mahimmanci don raba wasu kalmomin aiki da abubuwa.

translations.source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.reference: Hakanan yana iya kawo sauƙin karatu, kodayake rubutu yana da ɗan rikitarwa ta hanyar buƙatar gano ko ana amfani da fi'ili ko sifa a cikin sigar tabbatarwa.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, yana iya saukaka karatu, duk da cewa rubutawa na iya zama mai wahala saboda buƙatar tantance ko an yi amfani da ƙarfofi ko adjectives a hali wanda yake kama da sunaye.

translations.source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.reference: Furuci yana da ɗan sauƙi a cikin Italiyanci tunda yawancin kalmomi ana furta daidai yadda ake rubuta suu
translations.hypothesis: Farkawar kalmomin a harshen Italiya sau da yawa ta kasuwa, domin mafi yawan kalmomin ana faɗa su ta yadda ake rubutawa su.

translations.source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.reference: Manyan haruffan da ya kamata a lura da su a nan sune c da g, kasancewar furucinsu ya banbamta daga wannan wasalin da ke biye.
translations.hypothesis: Abubuwan da ya kamata a yi kulawa sun kasance haruffan 'c' da 'g', domin yadda ake yiwa su daɗi ya danganta da saƙon da ke biyo bayan su.

translations.source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.reference: Hakanan, tabbatar da furta r da rr daban: caro yana nufin ƙaunata, yayin da karas yana nufin karusa.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan, tabbatar da cewa kun yi bambanci a yadda kuke faɗin haruffan 'r' da 'rr': 'caro' yana nufin 'masu kaunata', yayin da 'carro' yana nufin 'motar ruwa'.

translations.source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.reference: Farisa tana da nahawu mai sauki da na yau da kullum.
translations.hypothesis: Harshen Farsawa yana da ƙa'ida mai sauƙi kuma mafi yawan ƙa'idodi na daidaito.

translations.source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.reference: Saboda haka, karanta wannan share fagen nahawun zai taimaka muku koya da yawa game da nahawun Farisanci da fahimtar jumla da kyau.
translations.hypothesis: Don haka, karanta wannan littafin koyarwa na ilimin harshen Farisi zai taimaka maka wajen koyon abubuwa da yawa game da ilimin harshen Farisi da kuma fahimtar kalmomin da suka fito.

translations.source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.reference: A bayyane take, idan ka san yaren Romance, zai yi sauki maka ka koyi Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: Ba lallai ne a ambaci, idan kana da ilimi a wani yaren Turanci, zai zama sauƙi a gare ka don koyon harshen Portuguese.

translations.source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.reference: Duk da haka, mutanen da ba su iya yaren sifaniyanci sosai ba ke ganin yaren Portuguese ya yi kusa da shi yadda ba lallai a karance shi daban ba.
translations.hypothesis: Koy yaya, mutanen da suka san ɗan harshen Spaniya suna iya sauri-sauri kammala cewa harshen Portuguese kusan iri ɗaya ne, don haka ba lami bane a koya shi a daban.

translations.source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.reference: Yawanci hasumiyoyin nazarin samaniya na baya sun zama tsohon yayi yanzu, inda suka zama gidajen kayan tarihi, ko kuma wuraren koyon ilimi.
translations.hypothesis: Masu bincike na ilimi da ake gudanarwa kafin zamani yawanci sun zamo ne tarihi a yau, kuma sun kasance wasu wurare na adana tarihi ko kuma wurare na ilimi.

translations.source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.reference: Kamar yadda gurbacewar haske a lokacin ganiyasa ba kamar irin yadda matsalar take a halin yanzu ba, galibi ya fi yawa a birane da kuma harabobin makarantun jami’a, wanda ya fi saukin samuwa akan wadanda aka gina a birane.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da cewa, a lokacin da aka gina su, tabarbancewar haske ba ta kasance matsala kamar yadda take a yau, galibi suna da alama a cikin birane ko a wuraren makarantu, wanda ya sa su su fi sauƙi a kai fiye da wadanda aka gina a zamanin zamani.

translations.source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Yawancin gilasan hangen nesa na bincike na zamani kayayyaki ne masu girma sosai a yankunan da ke da tsarin yanayi masu kyau.
translations.hypothesis: Karin manyan teleskopin bincike na zamani suna da ƙirayoyi masu girma waɗanda ke cikin ƙauyuka masu nisa, kuma suna da yanayi mai kyau.

translations.source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.reference: Kallon buɗewar furen cherry, wanda aka sani da hanami, ya kasance wani ɓangare na al'adun Japan tun ƙarni na 8.
translations.hypothesis: Kallo na fari mai launin ruwan kasa, wanda ake kira da "hanami," ya kasance wani ɓangare na al'adar Japan tun shekarar ta 8.

translations.source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.reference: Tunanin ya fito ne daga China inda plum da suka yi girma sun kasance fure ne wanda aka fi so.
translations.hypothesis: Anan akace wannan ra'ayin ya fito daga kasar Sin, inda ake amfani da furen plum a matsayin alfar.

translations.source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.reference: A Japan, sarkin ne ya shirya kungiyar siyasa na farko don kan sa kawai da wasu membobin da ke da martaba kewaye da kotun sarakuna..
translations.hypothesis: A Japan, manyan jollantar da ake yi a lokacin da tutsen cherry suka fito, sun faro ne a lokacin da sarkin kasar yake da sauran mazaɓɓan masu matsayi a cikin mulkin.

translations.source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.reference: Tsirrai sun fi kyau idan suna muhallinsu na halitta, saboda haka guji zumuɗin tsige ko da samfur “daya ne kawai”.
translations.hypothesis: Tsire-tsire suna da kyau sosai lokacin da suke cikin yanayin dabi'i, don haka ku dage wa tunanin cire ko kadan, ko ma "ɗaya".

translations.source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.reference: Idan kana ziyartar shiryayen lambu, tattara “samfurori” shi ma zai iya jawo wa a fitar da kai, ba tare da tattaunawa ba.
translations.hypothesis: Idan kun zo wani gona da aka shirya shi da kyau, ɗaukar "abubuwa" daga ciki zai sa ku fita, ba tare da tattaunawa ba.

translations.source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.reference: Garin Singapore gari ne da akasari ya ke da tsaro ingantacce kuma da saukin ganewa, kuma ka na iya siyen komai daga saukarka a kasar.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore wata ƙasa ce da ta kasance ta aminci sosai, kuma yana da sauƙi sosai don tafiya a ciki, kuma za ka iya siyan kusan komai da zarar ka isa.

translations.source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.reference: Amma ana sanya ku a cikin “manyan yankuna masu tsaka-tsakin” kawai ƴan digiri kaɗan arewacin kerjin za ku buƙaci ma'amala da zafin rana (koyaushe) da rana mai ƙarfi (lokacin da sama ta bayyana, mafi wuya).
translations.hypothesis: Amma, saboda kasuwancin na ne a yankin "gabashin duniya," wanda yake kusa da layi, za ku iya fuskantar zafi (kullum) da kuma hasken rana mai karfi (lokacin da sararin sama ya bayyana, wanda baya faruwa akai-akai).

translations.source: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.reference: Akwai kuma motocin bas kaɗan masu tafiya arewa zuwa Hebron, asalin wurin da aka binne shugabanni da aka ambata a baibul Ibrahim, Isa, Yakub, da matansu.
translations.hypothesis: Hakanan akwai wasu motoci da suke tafiya zuwa arewa zuwa Hebron, wanda shi ne wurin da ake kasancewa da manyan mutane na addinin Kirista, kamar Abraham, Isaac, da Jacob, da matansu.

translations.source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.reference: Ka tabbatar motar da zaka shiga lalle wadda za ta je Hebron ce ba wadanda ke zuwa sabbin unguwanni yahudawa da ke Kiryat Arba ba ne.
translations.hypothesis: Tabbatar cewa motar bas da kake tunanin yin tafiya ta tana zuwa Hebron, kuma ba kawai zuwa wurin al'ummar Yahudun da ke kusa da ita, wato Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.reference: Jirgin ruwa na cikin gida na iya zama jigo mai kyau don kafa hutu a kusa.
translations.hypothesis: Tarfafun ruwa a cikin ƙasar na iya zama batu mai kyau don tsara hutun.

translations.source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.reference: A misali ziyartar fadoji a Loire Valley, kwarin Rhine ko hawan jirgin ruwa zuwa wurare masu ban sha’awa a Danube ko tafiya cikin kwalekwale ta Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: Alal misali, za ku iya ziyartar duwatsun da ke cikin yankin Loire, yankin Rhine, ko kuma yin tafiya da jirgin ruwa zuwa biranen da suka yi kyau a kan kogin Danube, ko kuma yin tafiya da jirgin ruwa a kan hanyar ruwan Erie.

translations.source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.reference: Hakanan suna ayyana hanyoyi don shahararrun tattaki da hanyoyin keke.
translations.hypothesis: Suna kuma ƙirƙirar hanyoyi don hanyoyin tafiya da kuma hanyoyin motsa jiki da mutane suke amfani da su sosai.

translations.source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.reference: Kirsimeti wani biki ne mai mahimmanci na Kiristanci, kuma ana bikinta a matsayin ranar haihuwar Yesu.
translations.hypothesis: Bikin Kirisimasi yana daga cikin muhimman bukukuwan addinin Kiristanci, kuma ana yi masa kyau ne a matsayin ranar haihuwar Yesu.

translations.source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.reference: Da yawan an al’adun da ke zgaye da bikin sun sami karɓuwa har daga waɗanda ba su yi imani ba a kasashen kristoci da waɗanda bana kristoci ba a fadin duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Daga yawan al'adu da ke cikin bikin, wasu daga cikinsu sun yi karbuwa, har ma ga waɗanda ba su da imani a cikin kasashe masu addinin Kirista, da kuma waɗanda ba su da Kiristanci a duniya.

translations.source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.reference: Akwai wata al'ada ta kwanan zaune a daren Easter a wani wuri buɗaɗɗe don ganin fitowar rana.
translations.hypothesis: Akwai al'ada cewa a tsaye a wani wuri mai buɗewa a dare na Easter don ganin fitar rana.

translations.source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.reference: Tabbas da akwai bayanai daga koyarwar addinin Kirista kan wannan al’adar, amma dai yana iya kasancewa Shekaru ne gabanin bayyanar Kiristanci.
translations.hypothesis: Tabbas, akwai bayanan addinin Kiristanci da ke bayanin wannan al'ada, amma yana yiwuwa wannan al'ada ta kasance wani bikin da ake yi a lokacin bazara da kuma don nuna alherin duniya, wanda aka yi kafin zuwan addinin Kiristanci.

translations.source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.reference: Churchesarin majami'u na gargajiya sau da yawa suna yin Vigil na Easter a daren Asabar a lokacin karshen mako na Ista, tare da ikilisiyoyin galibi suna shiga cikin murna a tsakar dare don bikin tashin Almasihu.
translations.hypothesis: Kwamukan addini na gargajiya galau da su suka yi bikin 'Asabar dare a lokacin watan Phurihu, kuma yawanci mazauna su suna farin ciki da murnar haɓɓukar Yesu a tsakiyar dare.

translations.source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.reference: Duk dabbobin da suka isa tsibirin asalin sun zo nan ne ta hanyar iyo, tashi ko iyo.
translations.hypothesis: Dukkanin dabbobi da suka zo waɗannan tsibirin a farko, sun zo nan ne ko ta yin iyo a cikin ruwa, ko ta tashi cikin sama, ko ta hanyar fadowa a kan ruwa.

translations.source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.reference: Saboda doguwar nesa daga nahiyoyi masu shayarwa ba su iya yin tafiyar ba wanda ya sa katowar kunkuru matsayin dabba ta farko da ake kiwo a Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Saboda nisan da yake daga nahiyar, dabbobin mamšta ba su iya yiwa tafiya ta yadda su kai wannan wurin, don haka kura-kura mai girma ne ke da matuƙar muhimmanci a yankin Galapagos wajen cin abinci.

translations.source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.reference: Tun zuwan mutum ga Galapagos, an gabatar da dabbobi masu shayarwa da yawa da suka hada da awaki, dawakai, shanu, beraye, kuliyoyi da karnuka.
translations.hypothesis: Tun lokacin da mutane suka zo zuwa yankin Galapagos, nau'in dabbobi da dama sun kawo, ciki har da kura, zango, gugu, rats, fari da kare.

translations.source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.reference: Idan ka ziyarci nahiyar Arctic ko Antarctica a lokacin hunturu zaka tsinkayi daren sanyi, wanda a lokacinsa rana bata fitowa.
translations.hypothesis: Idan ka ziyarci yankin Arewa ko Kudancin duniya a lokacin hunturu, za ka ji abin da ake kira "dare mai tsayi," wanda yake nufin rana ba ta fitowa sama ba.

translations.source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.reference: Wannan yana ba da kyakkyawar dama don ganin Aurora borealis, tunda sama zata kasance mai duhu sosai ko ƙasa da agogo.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ya bayar da damar da ta fi kyau na ganin hasken Aurora borealis, domin sararin sama zai kasance duhu kusan duk lokaci.

translations.source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.reference: Tunda yankunan ba su da cinkoson jama’a, kuma babu matsalar gurɓacewar haske, za kuma ka ji daɗin taurarin.
translations.hypothesis: Domin yankin na da yawan jama'a kaɗan, kuma wani lokaci rashin haske mai yawa ba zai zama matsala ba, za ku iya jin daɗin kallon taurari.

translations.source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.reference: Al’adun aiki na Japanese na da matsayi fiye da abin da kasashen yamma suka saba.
translations.hypothesis: Al'adu na aiki a Japan sun fi kasancewa masu tsari kuma masu tsauraran ka'ida fiye da yadda wasu mutanen Yammacin duniya suke saba da su.

translations.source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.reference: Kwat sune kayan sawa na aiki da aka saba dasu kuma abokan aiki suna kiran juna ne da sunan gidan su ko kuma matsayin da mutum yake kai.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙaɗaɗɗun kayan sawa sune kayan aiki na yau da kullum, kuma abokin aiki suna kiranta juna da sunayen danginsu ko kuma da sunayen ayyukansu.

translations.source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.reference: Zaman lafiya a wurin aiki abu ne me muhimmanci, ana bada mahimmanci wurin hadaka tare sama da jinjina yin aiki kai daya.
translations.hypothesis: Tsarin aiki mai sulhu yana da muhimmanci, wanda yake mayar da hankali ga ayyukan kungiya fiye da yabon nasarar mutum ɗaya.

translations.source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.reference: Dole ne ma’aikata su sami amincewar manyan su akan duk wata shawara da suka zartas, kuma ana tsammanin su yi biyayya ga umarnin manyan su ba tare da tambaya ba.
translations.hypothesis: Ma'aikata sau da yawa dole su nemi izinin manyanta kafin su yanke wani shiri, kuma ana sa ran su bi umurnin manyantansu ba tare da tambaya ba.
